question:
Rafael Núñez and colleagues studied how members of the Yupno, an Indigenous group in Papua New Guinea, conceptualize time in both spoken language and gestures. The researchers recorded Yupno speakers explaining certain temporal words and phrases, such as kalip bishap , a past oriented expression that translates to “past times,” and coded each speaker’s manual gestures. Previous research has found a tendency in many cultures to make temporal distinctions along imagined linear axes: for instance, Spanish speakers often refer to the left/right axis to describe events in time. Some researchers believe this tendency is universal, but Núñez and colleagues claim this is not the case.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support N úñez and colleagues’ claim?
selections: A. Yupno speakers typically use their left hand to make temporal gestures regardless of whether the gestures are east oriented or future oriented.
B. Some Yupno grammatical structures used when talking about time are also used in Spanish.
C. Future-oriented gestures used by Yupno speakers do not, on average, point in the opposite linear direction of past-oriented gestures.
D. Yupno speakers were observed making temporal gestures both indoors and outdoors, though with greater frequency when indoors.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： Rafael Núñez 及其同事研究了巴布亚新几内亚原住民 Yupno 人如何在口语和手势中概念化时间。研究人员记录了 Yupno 说话者解释某些时间词和短语（如 kalip bishap，一个指向过去的表达，翻译为“过去时光”）的过程，并对每位说话者的手势进行了编码。先前研究发现，许多文化中存在沿想象线性轴线区分时间的倾向：例如，西班牙语使用者常用左/右轴线来描述时间事件。一些研究者认为这种倾向是普遍的，但 Núñez 及其同事声称情况并非如此。 中文解析： Núñez 的声称是“沿线性轴线区分时间并非普遍现象”。选项 C 指出 Yupno 人的未来导向手势并不平均指向与过去导向手势相反的线性方向，这直接表明他们未使用线性轴线来区分时间，从而支持了声称。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
Coffee farming around the world has changed greatly over time. Originally, coffee plants grew in the shade of tropical forests. Today coffee is often grown without shade cover. This is because full-sun coffee farms can produce more coffee beans. But the lack of trees on such farms means a lack of spaces for many species of birds to roost. Therefore, compared with full-sun coffee farms, shaded farms tend to _____.

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. be home to a more diverse range of birds.
C. have fewer problems with insects and other pests.
D. experience generally milder weather conditions
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 全球咖啡种植随时间发生了巨大变化。最初，咖啡植物生长在热带森林的树荫下。如今，咖啡经常在没有遮荫覆盖的情况下种植。这是因为全日照咖啡农场可以生产更多的咖啡豆。但这种农场缺乏树木，意味着许多鸟类缺少栖息空间。因此，与全日照咖啡农场相比，遮荫农场倾向于______。 中文解析： 文本指出全日照农场因缺乏树木而减少鸟类栖息地，因此遮荫农场应能提供更多栖息地，从而支持更多样化的鸟类。选项A直接与此因果关系相关；其他选项（B土壤质量、C害虫问题、D天气条件）在文本中未提及，缺乏逻辑支持。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
Studies have shown that when we listen to high-tempo music (songs with a high number of beats per minute, or bpm) during endurance exercise, we perceive our effort as lower than it actually is, which leads to an increased pace and a higher heart rate. Researchers recently designed a follow-up study in which participants jogged outdoors for 30 minutes while listening to Aerosmith's “Livin’ on the Edge” (169 bpm) continuously. The next day, participants performed the same activity while listening to Ella Fitzgerald’s “From This Moment On” (93 bpm). As expected, listening to that song resulted in participants ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. perceiving their effort as lower while jogging than they had the previous day.
B. varying their jogging pace more than they had the previous day.
C. exhibiting a higher average heart rate while jogging than they had the previous day.
D. jogging a shorter distance in the 30 minutes than they had the previous day.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 研究表明，在耐力运动期间听高节奏音乐（每分钟节拍数高的歌曲）时，我们会觉得自己的努力程度比实际低，这会导致速度加快和心率升高。研究人员最近设计了一项后续研究，参与者在户外慢跑30分钟，连续听Aerosmith的"Livin' on the Edge"（169 bpm）。第二天，参与者进行同样的活动，但听Ella Fitzgerald的"From This Moment On"（93 bpm）。正如预期的那样，听那首歌导致参与者________ 中文解析： 根据研究，高节奏音乐（169 bpm）会降低感知努力、提高速度和心率。第二天听低节奏音乐（93 bpm）应产生相反效果，即速度减慢，因此在相同30分钟内跑的距离更短，选项D逻辑成立。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
Cycads are palm-like plants with cones. ________ plants were abundant throughout the Mesozoic Era (66 to 252 million years ago).

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 第一句中的“Cycads”为复数名词，第二句需要指代这些植物，因此应使用复数指示代词“These”
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
The theory of plate tectonics explains how large pieces of Earth’s crust, called tectonic plates, move and interact. According to the theory, the movement of tectonic plates forms _______ creates volcanoes, and causes earthquakes.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子中三个动词短语“forms mountains”、“creates volcanoes”和“causes earthquakes”并列，共享同一主语“the movement of tectonic plates”，构成平行并列。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
Many folktales that originate in the Hindi language start with a phrase that roughly translates to “in one era.” Many tales that originate in English use “once upon a time.” Such phrases, known as story starters,_______ from language to language.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子主语“Such phrases”为复数名词，谓语动词需用复数形式“vary”，因此选项D正确。

question:
As jazz singer Sarah Vaughan honed her vocal abilities—acquiring a sophisticated timbre and precise control over pitch, dynamics, and _____ she earned comparisons to opera icon Leontyne Price, one of her personal heroes. The comparisons highlight how Vaughan, a jazz star, had transcended genre boundaries with her singing prowess.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子中的破折号用于引入一个解释性的插入成分，详细说明“声乐能力”的具体内容。为了使插入成分完整并与主句正确分隔，需要在插入成分结束时使用另一个破折号与之配对。

question:
Dating to around 1500, the Unicorn Tapestries are seven large tapestries depicting a unicorn hunt that hang in The Cloisters, a museum of medieval art in New York City. Attempting to explain the tapestries’ symbolism, art historian and former Cloisters head curator Margaret B._____ that while some have interpreted the tapestries as a Christian allegory, unicorns in that era were typically featured in secular rather than religious contexts.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子结构上，分词短语“Attempting to explain...”作为状语，需要主句有完整的谓语动词。选项D“Freeman noted”使“noted”作为谓语动词，引导宾语从句“that while...”。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
Because of its bulky body, the world’s first airplane, the 1903 Wright Flyer, was not very aerodynamic. Modern planes, like the Northrop F-5 jet, have much sleeker, more streamlined bodies.______ they are much more aerodynamic.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 由于其笨重的机身，世界上第一架飞机——1903年的莱特飞行器——空气动力学性能不佳。而像诺斯罗普F-5喷气机这样的现代飞机，拥有更纤细、更流线型的机身，因此它们的空气动力学性能要好得多。 中文解析： 第一句指出早期飞机因“笨重机身”导致空气动力学性能差，第二句说明现代飞机因“更流线型机身”而空气动力学性能更佳，前后是明显的因果关系。选项D“For this reason”。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
KCUW-LP is a Native-run radio station broadcasting from the Umatilla Indian Reservation in Oregon. In 2004, Loris Taylor wanted to make sure that stations like KCUW-LP continued to thrive._____ she founded Native Public Media, a support system for Native radio stations that now includes around sixty stations.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： KCUW-LP 是一个由原住民运营的广播电台，从俄勒冈州的尤马蒂拉印第安保留区播出。2004年，洛里斯·泰勒希望确保像 KCUW-LP 这样的电台能够持续繁荣发展。因此，她创立了“原住民公共媒体”，这是一个为原住民广播电台提供支持的系统，现已涵盖约60家电台。 中文解析： 文本中，泰勒的目的（确保电台繁荣）与她采取的行动（创立支持组织）之间存在直接的因果关系。选项 C “Thus”
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
In 1845, the United States District Court for the state of Iowa was established. Initially, the court’s jurisdiction was a single district that encompassed the entire state, but as Iowa’s population grew, this single district began to struggle to serve the needs of everyone in the state. ______ the court’s jurisdiction was subdivided into two districts, each with its own district court.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 1845年，美国爱荷华州联邦地区法院成立。最初，该法院的司法管辖区是覆盖整个州的单一司法区。但随着爱荷华州人口的增长，这个单一司法区开始难以满足全州人民的需求。最终，法院的管辖区被细分为两个司法区，每个区都设有自己的地区法院。 中文解析： 文本描述了因“人口增长”导致“单一司法区难以满足需求”这一问题，其后的结果是为了解决问题而采取了“细分辖区”的措施。前后构成“问题-解决方案”的因果与时间序列关系。选项A “Ultimately,”（最终）能最合理地表达这一措施是问题发展后采取的最终步骤或结果；
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
On a chilly spring morning in a Virginia park, as sunlight crested the treetops, Kathrin Swoboda raised her Nikon D500 camera and captured an image that would win the Grand Prize in the 2019 Audubon Photography Awards: a red-winged blackbird, exhaling what appeared to be rings of smoke. ________ the “smoke” was actually the blackbird’s breath hitting the cold morning air as the bird sang.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在弗吉尼亚公园一个寒冷的春天早晨，阳光掠过树梢，Kathrin Swoboda举起她的尼康D500相机，捕捉到了一张赢得2019年奥杜邦摄影大赛大奖的照片：一只红翅黑鹂正在呼出看似烟圈的东西。因此，“烟”实际上是黑鹂唱歌时呼出的气息遇到寒冷晨空气所形成的。 中文解析： 前文描述照片看似鸟在吐烟圈，后文解释“烟”其实是鸟的呼吸遇冷空气形成的。两句之间存在一种“看似惊奇，实则理所当然”的转折或解释关系，即“当然/实际上”烟圈只是呼吸遇冷。“Of course,” 在此起到轻微转折与解释作用，符合语境逻辑。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
Vanadium is one of a variety of potentially useful trace elements contained in the chemical-rich brine that remains after seawater is purified through desalination. However, routine extraction of vanadium and other such elements from brine is not yet technologically or economically feasible. ________ most trace elements have only been extracted from seawater on an experimental basis.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 钒是海水淡化提纯后残留的、化学物质丰富的卤水中所含的多种有潜在利用价值的微量元素之一。然而，从卤水中常规提取钒及其他此类元素目前在技术上和经济上均不可行。______大多数微量元素仅是在实验基础上从海水中提取的。 中文解析： 前文指出提取技术的现实不可行性，后句说明大多数元素“仅在实验基础上被提取”，这实际上是延续前文、强调其尚处于非实用阶段的现状描述。“To date”（迄今为止）作为时间状语，最自然地衔接了两者间的逻辑关系。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
●The Highpointers Club is a hiking club. ●One of the main goals among club members is to reach the highest points in all fifty US states. ●Those who achieve this are called 50 Completers. ●In Suk Han became a 50 Completer on November 15, 2013. ●The highest point in Wisconsin is Timms Hill, at 1,951 ft. ●The highest point in Wyoming is Gannett Peak, at 13,809 ft.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to explain the 50 Completers hiking challenge to a new audience?
selections: A. If you are looking for a new hiking challenge, consider joining the Highpointers Club, as did In Suk Han, a hiker who successfully reached the highest point in every US state.

B. Not until after you have reached the highest points in all fifty US states—including Timms Hill in Wisconsin and Gannett Peak in Wyoming—can you include yourself among the 50 Completers of the Highpointers Club.
C. On November 15, 2013, In Suk Han finally completed the feat of reaching the highest point in all fifty US states, including Timms Hill in Wisconsin and Gannett Peak in Wyoming.
D. Hikers aiming to count themselves among the 50 Completers must reach not only West Virginia’s Spruce Knob but also the even higher peak of Mount Elbert in Colorado.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： ●Highpointers Club 是一个徒步俱乐部。 ●俱乐部成员的主要目标之一是到达美国所有50个州的最高点。 ●实现此目标的人被称为“50 Completers”（50州完成者）。 ●In Suk Han 于2013年11月15日成为一名“50 Completer”。 ●威斯康星州的最高点是蒂姆斯山，海拔1,951英尺。 ●怀俄明州的最高点是甘尼特峰，海拔13,809英尺。 中文解析： 题目要求向新受众解释“50 Completers”挑战，最有效的选项应同时包含挑战的定义、目标以及具体示例。选项B 完整说明了挑战规则（需到达所有50个州的最高点），并列举了威斯康星州和怀俄明州的例子作为具体说明，且明确了完成者称号与俱乐部名称，最符合要求。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ● The Incarnations (2015) is an epistolary novel by English author Susan Barker. ●Epistolary novels are novels written primarily as a series of fictional documents. ●These documents can be letters, journal entries, newspaper clippings, and more. ● The Incarnations consists primarily of letters. ●The letters are sent between a taxi driver named Wang Jun and a mysterious woman.

The student wants to provide an example of an epistolary novel. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In 2015, English author Susan Barker published a novel of letters sent between a taxi driver named Wang Jun and a mysterious woman.
B. Consisting primarily of letters sent between a taxi driver named Wang Jun and a mysterious woman, Susan Barker’s The Incarnations is an epistolary novel.
C. It was Susan Barker who published the novel The Incarnations in 2015.
D. An epistolary novel is a novel written primarily as a series of fictional documents, such as letters, journal entries, or newspaper clippings.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记： ●《轮回》（2015年）是英国作家苏珊·巴克的书信体小说。 ●书信体小说主要是由一系列虚构文件构成的小说。 ●这些文件可以是信件、日记条目、剪报等等。 ●《轮回》主要由信件构成。 ●这些信件是在一名叫王军的出租车司机和一名神秘女子之间往来传递的。 中文解析： 题目要求是“提供一个书信体小说的例子”。选项B明确指出了《轮回》是“书信体小说”，并有效结合了其核心特征（主要由信件构成）及信件人物关系，直接而完整地满足了要求；选项A虽然描述了小说内容，但未点明其体裁；选项C未提供体裁信息；选项D只给出了体裁定义，未提及具体小说实例。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ●A synthesis reaction is a type of chemical reaction. ●In a synthesis reaction, two or more substances combine to form a new substance. ●When sodium and chloride combine, they form a substance called sodium chloride. ●This substance is more commonly known as table salt.

The student wants to define the term “synthesis reaction.” Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. A synthesis reaction is a chemical reaction in which two or more substances combine to form a new substance.
B. A new substance is formed when a chemical reaction combines sodium and chloride.
C. The substance sodium chloride, also known as table salt, is formed by a chemical reaction.
D. When sodium and chloride combine, they form a substance commonly known as table salt.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一位学生做了以下笔记： ●合成反应是一种化学反应类型。 ●在合成反应中，两种或更多物质结合形成一种新物质。 ●当钠和氯结合时，它们形成一种称为氯化钠的物质。 ●这种物质更常被称为食盐。 中文解析： 题目要求定义术语。选项A直接概括了合成反应的普遍特征（“一种化学反应，其中两种或更多物质结合形成新物质”），符合定义要求。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ●Documentary TV programs in the slow TV genre consist of uninterrupted broadcasts of ordinary events in real time. ● MORA: Zeichner is a German slow TV program. ●The 45-minute-long program documented an artist making a pencil drawing during a train journey. ●It first aired in 2016. ●Slow TV has been called “the world’s most boring television.” ●American journalist Nathan Heller praises it, writing that “it affords a visceral kind of armchair tourism.”

The student wants to use a quotation to refute the claim that slow TV programs are boring. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. With broadcasts of ordinary events, like artists at work, occurring in real time, slow TV just might be “the world’s most boring television.”
B. Far from boring, slow TV programs can provide a “visceral kind of armchair tourism,” as Heller puts it, whereby viewers can watch artists at work in real time.
C. MORA: Zeichner can afford a “visceral kind of armchair tourism,” as Heller puts it.
D. While some have praised slow TV for affording “a visceral kind of armchair tourism,” others have called it “the world’s most boring television”
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一位学生做了以下笔记： ●慢电视类型的纪实电视节目由对普通事件实时不间断的广播组成。 ●《MORA：绘图者》是一档德国慢电视节目。 ●这档45分钟的节目记录了一位艺术家在火车旅行中绘制铅笔素描的过程。 ●它于2016年首次播出。 ●慢电视被称为“世界上最无聊的电视”。 ●美国记者Nathan Heller赞扬它，写道“它提供了一种发自内心的扶手椅旅游”。 中文解析： 选项B以“远非无聊”直接反驳了无聊的说法，并引用了Heller的正面评价（“发自内心的扶手椅旅游”），同时结合了节目中艺术家实时工作的例子，从而有效地完成了反驳目标。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
In the Metropolitan Museum of Art’s Costume Institute’s innovative multisensory exhibit of garments and accessories spanning four centuries, an emphasis on the ______ of fashion was conveyed both by the exhibit’s theme of perpetual renewal in nature and, more, subtly, by its scientific re-creations of ephemeral elements (like a fragrance worn with a dress more than a century ago).

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 大都会艺术博物馆服装学院举办了一场创新的多感官展览，展出了跨越四个世纪的服装与配饰。展览通过“自然永恒重生”的主题，以及更为微妙地通过科学重现转瞬即逝的元素（例如一个多世纪前与裙子搭配的香味），强调了时尚的______。 中文解析： 原文中“perpetual renewal”与“ephemeral elements”（短暂的元素）提示时尚具有短暂易逝的特性，且“transience”（短暂性）在逻辑上直接呼应“ephemeral”与“renewal”所体现的流转变化。其他选项（B.确定性；C.肤浅性；D.偏颇性）均与语境不符。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
As a defense mechanism, the monarch butterfly _______ toxic compounds from milkweed plants. On ingesting a piece of milkweed, the monarch selectively absorbs toxic cardenolides from the plant in its gut and stores them in the tissues throughout its body, rendering the butterfly unpalatable to predators.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 作为一种防御机制，帝王蝶会从马利筋植物中______有毒化合物。在摄入马利筋叶片后，帝王蝶会在肠道中有选择地吸收植物中的强心甾类毒素，并将其储存于全身组织中，从而使捕食者觉得这种蝴蝶难以下咽。 中文解析： 文段指出帝王蝶主动吸收并储存毒素以用于自卫，这是一种主动“利用”有毒化合物的策略，而非仅仅是中和、阻碍或分泌它们。exploits（利用）最贴合上下文对防御机制的解释逻辑。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
The synthesis of novel superheavy elements, such as moscovium (Mc), has led theorists to consider the feasibility of synthesizing all possible chemical compounds. In 2022, Guillermo Restrepo calculated the historical rates at which newly discovered compounds have entered the scientific literature, expanding the “chemical space.” Using a conservative estimate of the number of viable compounds and assuming a doubling of the historical pace of discovery, Restrepo found that under these hypothetical conditions, all potential compounds could be synthesized and documented by 2050.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It makes a comparison between the past and current rates at which new chemical compounds have entered the scientific literature.
B. It emphasizes the point implicitly made earlier in the text that human inefficiency is the primary constraint on the expansion of the chemical space.
C. It provides details about the qualification later in the sentence regarding the prospect of cataloging the full range of possible chemical compounds.
D. It introduces information that helps explain why the synthesis of superheavy elements has rapidly expanded the chemical space.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 新超重元素（如莫斯科元素，Mc）的合成促使理论学家思考合成所有可能的化学化合物的可行性。2022年，Guillermo Restrepo 计算了新发现的化合物进入科学文献的历史速率，从而扩展了“化学空间”。通过对可行化合物的数量采用保守估计，并假设发现速度比历史速率提高一倍，Restrepo 发现，在这些假设条件下，到2050年，所有潜在的化合物都有可能被合成并记录下来。 中文解析： 划线部分详细说明了 Restrepo 计算时所采用的条件（保守估计的可行化合物数量与假设翻倍的发现速率），这些条件正是后文中“到2050年可能合成并记录所有化合物”这一预测的重要前提。因此，该部分的作用是补充说明得出最终结论时所依据的假设与限定条件。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
Guadalupe Romero Villanueva et al. conducted radiocarbon analysis of paint used in rock art at the Patagonian archaeological site Cueva Huenul 1, revealing that images of a comblike motif date to as early as 8,000 years ago, predating other paintings in the region by several millennia. The motif was subsequently reproduced multiple times at the site over the next 3,000 years, a period coinciding with extremely arid conditions and slightly negative population growth. The motif may therefore have functioned to help preserve cultural knowledge during a time of ecological and demographic stress.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It emphasizes the historical conditions that explain why production of the painted motif described in the text abruptly ceased after 3,000 years of continue use.
B. It provides context that informs the text’s claim about why the peoples of Patagonia chose Cueva Huenul 1 as a culturally significant site.
C. It explains the environmental circumstances that account for the rarity of rock art dating to the same period as the most discussed in the text.
D. It identifies a consideration that factored into an interpretation of the rock art at Cueva Huenul 1 that is presented in the text.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： Guadalupe Romero Villanueva等人对巴塔哥尼亚考古遗址Cueva Huenul 1的岩石绘画颜料进行了放射性碳分析，发现梳状图案的图像可追溯到8000年前，比该地区其他绘画早了几千年。在接下来的3000年里，这一图案在该遗址被多次重复绘制，这一时期恰逢极端干旱条件与人口轻微负增长。因此，这一图案可能在生态与人口压力时期起到了帮助保存文化知识的作用。 中文解析： 划线部分描述了该图案被重复绘制的时期具有极端干旱与人口负增长的特征，这为后文解释其功能——在生态与人口压力下保存文化知识——提供了关键背景依据。因此，该部分的作用是点明影响岩画解读的一个具体历史条件。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
The following text is from Yung Wing’s 1909 memoir My Life in China and America . Yung Wing was the first person from China to graduate from a US university. Little did I realize when in 1845 I wrote, while in the Morrison School, a composition on “An Imaginary Voyage to New York and up the Hudson,” that I was to see New York in reality. This incident leads me to the reflection that sometimes our imagination foreshadows what lies uppermost in our minds and brings possibilities within the sphere of realities.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It explains the origin of Yung’s interest in writing.
B. It indicates Yung’s unwillingness to distinguish between reality and fantasy as a child
C. It illustrates the sense of adventure that Yung developed as a child.
D. It describes an event in Yung’s life that exemplifies a phenomenon.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文字节选自容闳1909年的回忆录《我的中国和美国生活》。容闳是第一位从美国大学毕业的中国人。 1845年，我在马礼逊学校写了一篇作文，题为《假想航行至纽约并溯哈德逊河而上》，当时我完全没有想到自己会真的见到纽约。这件事让我想到，有时我们的想象预示了我们心中最深处的事物，并将可能性带进了现实范畴。 中文解析： 划线句子叙述了容闳少年时写作虚构游记而后成真的个人经历，这一具体事件为后文提出的普遍现象——“想象有时能预示内心所想并让可能变为现实”——提供了例证。因此，该句子在文中起到以个人经历引出并例证后文哲理的作用。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
One notable feature of Southern US literature is its adaptation of established fiction genres to Southern contexts. Mark Twain derived his episodic narrative structures and roguish heroes from the picaresque novel, and William Faulkner realized the decadent aristocrat, the imperiled heroine, and other character types of the Gothic novel as rural Southerners who were more contingent, more caught in the net of societal relations and history than the fantastical figures of the Gothic had been. Some of the region’s poets, such as James Dickey, have shown even greater dexterity by adapting these sources in an altogether different literary form.

The text suggests that some Southern poets have adapted established fiction genres in different literary forms with Southern contexts. Which quotation would best serve as an example of this adaptation in the work of James Dickey?
selections: A. “With its rural settings and rustic characters, Dickey’s poems suggest the influence of the genre of pastoral action, yet Dickey may have instead obtained these elements from pastoral poetry, which preceded its namesake in fiction.”

B. “The Gothic genre emerged in England and Ireland in the 1700s and was later naturalized to the cultural landscape of the Northeastern US, as in the novels of Nathaniel Hawthorne, which Dickey had almost certainly read.”

C. “When Dickey invokes one genre of poetry and, within the space of a few lines, abandons it for another genre of poetry, what can we infer from this gesture if not the poet’s fascination with genre per se, as well as his discomfort with it?”

D. “What is the disturbed, and disturbing, speaker of Dickey’s best poems if not a stock character of the Gothic novel, refracted through the speech and ethos of the South and conditioned by the structures of lyric poetry?”
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 美国南方文学的一个显著特征，是对已有小说类型进行南方化的改造。马克·吐温从他的流浪汉小说中汲取了分段叙事结构和痞子英雄形象，威廉·福克纳则将哥特小说中的堕落贵族、身陷危局的女主角及其他人物类型，实现为更具现实性、更受社会关系与历史网络束缚的南方乡下人，而非哥特小说中那种奇幻角色。该地区的一些诗人，如詹姆斯·迪基，甚至通过以完全不同的文学形式改造这些源头，展现出更出色的技巧。 中文解析： 本文认为南方诗人能将传统小说体裁（如哥特小说）融入南方语境，并转化为诗歌形式。选项D明确指出迪基诗中“令人不安的叙述者”其实就是哥特小说中的典型角色，但经过“南方语言与精神的折射”以及“抒情诗结构的制约”，这完美对应了文本所说的“以不同文学形式改编来源”并赋予“南方语境”。其他选项或未提及文学形式转换，或未联系南方背景，故D为正确答案。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
Most Native languages belong to language families, or groups of languages whose similarities in vocabulary and grammar suggest shared descent from a single language spoken long ago. In contrast, the language spoken by the Yana people in a mountainous area of Northern California was an isolate, or a language with no demonstrated relationship to other languages. Isolates are more prevalent in mountainous regions than elsewhere, likely because challenging terrain inhibits the geographical expansion of language families. Yet it is clear that geographical barriers on their own cannot fully explain this aspect of the distribution of Indigenous languages in California and elsewhere in the present-day United States.

Which statement, if true, would most directly support the claim in the underlined sentence?
selections: A. Shoshone, a language in the Uto-Aztecan family, was originally spoken in a vast expanse of Idaho, Nevada, Oregon, and Wyoming—a region whose mountainousness rivals that of the homeland of the Yana people.
B. In mountainous regions of the western US, isolate-speaking peoples historically met most of their food needs through foraging, hunting, and fishing rather than intensive farming.
C. Although Native languages in non-mountainous areas of California tend to belong to language families, those families do not necessarily share common linguistic ancestry.

D. Yana and other isolates spoken in mountainous regions of California tend to contain many more terms describing features of mountainous terrain than nonisolate languages from relatively flat regions of California do.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 语言群体在词汇和语法上的相似性表明它们源于很久以前的一种共同原始语言。相比之下，北加利福尼亚山区亚纳人所使用的语言是孤立语言，即与其他语言无已知亲缘关系的语言。孤立语言在山区比其他地区更为普遍，可能因为复杂的地形阻碍了语系的地理扩张。然而很明显，仅凭地理障碍本身并不能完全解释加利福尼亚以及当今美国其他地区土著语言的这种分布特点。 中文解析： 文章指出山区虽然容易产生语言孤立现象，但单凭地理障碍并不能完全解释美国原住民语言的分布。选项A以肖肖尼语为例，说明即使在与亚纳人地区同等崎岖的山地环境中，仍然存在属于广泛语系（犹他-阿兹特克语系）的语言，从而质疑了“山地必然导致语言孤立”的简单推论，与原文的辩证逻辑相呼应。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
Studying animals in a laboratory allows variables to be systematically controlled, but removing animals from their wild habitats can affect their behavior and biology in unforeseen ways. Given this, biologists Rebecca M. Calisi-Rodríguez and George E. Bentley examined research on brown-throated three-toed sloths and white-throated sparrows to see whether results from studies in the wild were consistent with the results of studies in the laboratory. Therefore, data showing that brown-throated three-toed sloths tend to sleep fewer than 10 hours per day in the wild would be irrelevant to Calisi-Rodríguez and Bentley’s investigation if _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. they tend to sleep more than 15 hours per day in the lab.
B. white-throated sparrows have low levels of corticosterone hormones outside of the breading season in the wild.
C. this behavior pattern has not been studied in the lab.
D. such data have been collected for white-throated sparrows in laboratory settings but not in the wild.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在实验室中研究动物能系统地控制变量，但将动物从其野生栖息地移出可能会以不可预见的方式影响它们的行为和生理。鉴于此，生物学家 Rebecca M. Calisi-Rodríguez 和 George E. Bentley 对棕喉三趾树懒和白喉带鹀的研究进行了调查，以判断野外研究的结果是否与实验室研究的结果一致。因此，若______，则表明棕喉三趾树懒在野外倾向于每天睡眠少于 10 小时的数据将与 Calisi-Rodríguez 和 Bentley 的调查无关。 中文解析： 题干核心在于比较同一种动物在野外与实验室的行为差异。若要判断野外数据是否与两位研究者的调查有关，必须存在对应的实验室数据可供比较。若该行为（睡眠时长）未在实验室中研究过，则无法进行对比，因此相关野外数据对调查无意义。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
Born in Lyon, Mississippi, in 1902, musician Edward James “Son” House is best known as a key figure in the development of the Delta blues, a variant of blues that originated in the Mississippi Delta region. ______ steeped in the fertile music scene that sprung up in the alluvial delta between the Mississippi and Yazoo Rivers, House and his peers developed their distinctive stripped-down, guitar-driven style.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 音乐家爱德华·詹姆斯“桑”·豪斯于1902年出生于密西西比州里昂市，以作为三角洲布鲁斯发展的关键人物而闻名。三角洲布鲁斯是起源于密西西比河三角洲地区的一种布鲁斯变体。______沉浸在密西西比河与亚祖河之间冲积三角洲兴起的丰富音乐氛围中，豪斯及其同辈人发展出他们独特的简约、以吉他驱动的风格。 中文解析： 该句具体描述豪斯在三角洲地区受音乐环境影响形成其风格的过程。“There”指代前文提到的“密西西比三角洲地区”，既能衔接地点，又能自然引出其音乐风格形成的环境背景，逻辑连贯且过渡清晰。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ●Atsuto Suzuki is a Japanese particle physicist. ●Particle physicists study subatomic particles. ●Neutrinos are some of the least understood subatomic particles. ●Neutrinos were first discovered in the mid-twentieth century. ●Suzuki is known for his discovery of geoantineutrinos.

The student wants to provide an example of a particle physicist whose research focuses on neutrinos. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The research done on geoantineutrinos exemplifies the work particle physicists do to advance our understanding of subatomic particles.
B. Neutrinos are a type of subatomic particle that particle physicists are still trying to understand.
C. Particle physicist Atsuto Suzuki is known for his discovery of geoantineutrinos.
D. By studying geoantineutrinos—to name just one example—particle physicists can learn more about neutrinos.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一位学生记下了以下信息： ●铃木厚人是日本粒子物理学家。 ●粒子物理学家研究亚原子粒子。 ●中微子是最不易理解的亚原子粒子之一。 ●中微子首次发现于20世纪中期。 ●铃木以其对地球反中微子的发现而闻名。 中文解析： 该选项直接点明研究对象为粒子物理学家铃木厚人，并指出其因发现地球反中微子而闻名。地球反中微子属于中微子的一类，因此该例正好符合“研究中微子的粒子物理学家”的要求，信息准确且简洁聚焦。其他选项要么未明确指出具体研究者，要么未明确将研究者与中微子研究挂钩。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question: The function f is defined by f ( x ) = 8 11 − x . What is the value of f ( x ) when x = 9 ?
explanations: 将x=9带入函数 f ( x ) = 8 11 − x ，计算得f(9)=4。

question: On a certain day in June, the lowest recorded wind speed in a town was 9 miles per hour (mph) and the highest recorded wind speed was 20 mph. Which inequality is true for all values of w , where w represents any wind speed, in mph, recorded in the town on this day?
explanations: 风速应该大于等于最低速度，小于等于最高速度。选D。

question: A triangle has a base length of 80 centimeters and a height of 40 centimeters. What is the area, in square centimeters. of the triangle?
explanations: 三角形面积为 1 2 ∗ 底边长 ∗ 高 。所以面积为1600。

question: y = 45 y = 5 x 2 The graphs of the equations in the given system intersect at the point ( x , y ) in the xy -plane. What is a possible value of x ?
explanations: 令两个函数相等，45=5x2，解出x=3或-3。选A。

question: A biologist is tracking the mass (in grams) of a bacterial culture as it grows in a lab dish.She measures the mass every 10 hours. The data are shown in the scatterplot below. Which of the following equations is the most appropriate exponential model for the data shown in the scatterplot?
explanations: 因为函数是增函数，排除A和C。将x=10带入B和D，计算得y分别为50.33和983.47。所以B选项更接近于题目中给的值，选B。

question: Hector receives a gift card worth $70.00 to pay for movies online. He uses his gift card to buy 2 movies for $ 6.50 each. He will spend the rest of his gift card on renting movies for $ 1.50 each. How many movies can Hector rent?
explanations: 设Hector租x个电影。1.5x+6.5*2=70。解出x=38

question: In △ J K L , the measures of both ∠ J and ∠ K are equal and the measure of ∠ L is 138. What is the measure of ∠ J ?
explanations: 三角形内角和为180度, ∠ J + ∠ K + ∠ L = 180 ∘ ,因为 ∠ J = ∠ K 并且 ∠ L = 138 ∘ 是 21 度。

question: In triangle XYZ , the measure of angle X is 90 ∘ . Point W lies on segment YZ , and segment WX is perpendicular to segment YZ . The length of segment WY is 612, and the length of segment WX is 459. What is the value of tan ⁡ Z ?
explanations: 在三角形XZW中， ∠ Z + ∠ Z X W = 90 ∘ 。因为 ∠ Z X W + ∠ W X Y = 90 ∘ ，所以 ∠ Z = ∠ W X Y 。因此 tan ⁡ ∠ Z = tan ⁡ ∠ W X Y = 612 459 = 4 3 。选A。

question: x 2 + y 2 − 10 x − 8 y − 14 n = 0 The given equation represents circle A in the xy -plane, where n is a constant. Point ( 11 , 8 ) lies on circle B, which has the same center but twice the diameter as circle A. What is the value of n ?
explanations: 将圆方程配方成标准形式： ( x − 5 ) 2 + ( y − 4 ) 2 = 14 n + 41 。因此圆A的圆心为(5, 4)，半径为 14 n + 41 。所以圆B的圆心为(5, 4)，半径为 2 14 n + 41 。圆B的方程为 ( x − 5 ) 2 + ( x − 4 ) 2 = 4 ( 14 n + 41 ) 。将点(11, 8)带入圆B的方程，计算得n=-2。

question: 38 ( x − n ) = 38 y + 38 n One of the equations in a system of two linear equations is given, where n is a positive constant: The system has no solution. Which equation could be the second equation in this system?
explanations: 化简方程38(x-n)=38y+38n得到y=x-2n。图像为斜率为1的直线。如果线性方程系统没有解，那么它们的图像应为两条平行的直线，所以第二个线性方程的斜率为1。选项A和D的斜率为1。选项A的方程与题目给出的相同，因此选D。

question: r 2 + q r = 2 r − 55 In the given equation, q is an integer constant. The given equation has no real solutions. What is the largest possible value of q ?
explanations: 化简题中的等式得 r 2 + ( q − 2 ) r + 55 = 0 。当 b 2 − 4 a c < 0 时，方程没有实数解。所以 ( q − 2 ) 2 − 4 ∗ 1 ∗ 55 < 0 ，解出 2 − 220 < q < 2 + 220 。q可取到的最大整数为16。

question:
The following text is adapted from Jhumpa Lahiri’s 2003 novel The Namesake . Gogol is an elementary school student in Massachusetts. In art class, his favorite hour of the week, he carves his name with paper clips into the bottoms of clay cups and bowls. He pastes uncooked pasta to cardboard, and leaves his signature in fat brush strokes below paintings. ©2003 by Jhumpa Lahiri

As used in the text, what does the word “carves” most nearly mean?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文字改编自裘帕·拉希莉2003年的小说《同名人》。高戈尔是马萨诸塞州的一名小学生。 在艺术课上——这是他一周中最喜欢的时光——他用回形针在陶土杯子和碗的底部刻上自己的名字。他将未煮熟的意大利面粘贴到纸板上，并在画作下方用粗大的笔触留下自己的签名。 ©2003 裘帕·拉希莉 中文解析： 文段描述高戈尔在艺术作品上留下名字的不同方式：先用回形针在陶器上刻名字，再用画笔在画作上签名。“carves”与后文的“signature”（签名）形成呼应，都指向在作品上留下个人标记的行为。因此，“carves”在此语境中最贴近“署名/刻写名字”的含义。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
Fossils of ancient arthropods preserved in volcanic ash in Morocco have _______ similarities between ancient arthropods and modern ones, such as spiders. Detailed 3D images of the fossils allowed scientists to see features that look like features found in arthropod species living today.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在摩洛哥火山灰中保存的古节肢动物化石，揭示了古节肢动物与现代节肢动物（如蜘蛛）之间的相似性。这些化石的详细3D影像使科学家得以看到与现今生存的节肢动物物种中类似的特征。 中文解析： 原文描述化石研究展现了古代和现代节肢动物之间的相似之处，这一过程是对科学事实的呈现与揭示。选项D “revealed”准确表达了“化石证据使这些相似性得以显现”的逻辑，符合语境中由影像发现特征的科学推论过程。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
Smart watches and fitness trackers tend to rely on batteries that can’t be easily taken out and swapped for new ones. Environmental policy researcher Carl Dalhammar warns that because these gadgets can’t _______ without working batteries, once the batteries stop working, the devices are typically disposed of as trash.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 智能手表和健身追踪器往往依赖于不易拆卸和更换的电池。环境政策研究员Carl Dalhammar警告称，由于这些设备在没有工作电池的情况下无法______，一旦电池停止工作，这些设备通常就会被当作垃圾丢弃。 中文解析： 文段重点在于说明电池失效会导致设备无法使用，进而被丢弃。“function”直接表达“运行、运作”的含义，与“without working batteries”（没有正常工作的电池）搭配，清晰说明设备依赖电池才能工作的本质，符合上下文逻辑。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
Otake Chikuha’ s 1902 piece Fall of the Castle is an important work of Nihonga , or traditional Japanese painting. To produce the piece, Otake used a centuries-old Japanese approach, applying ink and watercolor to a silk surface. By contrast, Saeki  Yūzō _______ European methods, using oil on canvas to produce Western-style paintings.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 大竹赤坡1902年的作品《落城》是日本画（即传统日本绘画）的重要作品。为创作此作，大竹运用了延续数世纪的日本技法，在丝绢上施以水墨与水彩。相比之下，佐伯祐三______欧洲技法，使用油画布与油彩创作西式绘画。 中文解析： 此处将两位艺术家的创作方法进行对比：大竹使用日本传统技法，而佐伯祐三则使用欧洲技法。 "employed" 意为“采用、运用”，与前文“used a centuries-old Japanese approach”形成直接对照，精确表达了“使用某种方法或技术”的含义。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
A student is writing a research paper on the global rise of the home video game industry during the 1970s and 1980s. The student is surprised by differences in the number of units sold by some systems compared to those sold by others. Most remarkably, the ______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
selections: A. IBM PC sold approximately 18,600,000 units, whereas the TurboGrafx-16 sold only approximately 1,900,000 units.
B. IBM PC sold approximately 6,952,600 units. whereas the TurboGrafx-16 sold only approximately 2,650,000 units.
C. Game & Watch sold approximately 18,600,000 units, whereas the Atari 400/800 sold only approximately 1,900,000 units.
D. Game & Watch sold approximately 6,952,600 units, whereas the Atari 400/800 sold only approximately 2,650,000 units.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一名学生正在撰写一篇关于20世纪70、80年代家用电子游戏产业全球兴起的研究论文。该学生对下列游戏系统的销售数量差异感到惊讶： 中文解析： 该选项正确引用了表格中Game & Watch（18,600,000台）与Atari 400/800（1,900,000台）的销售数据，两者均为游戏相关设备，且销量差异显著（约9.8倍），符合 “most remarkbly”的要求。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
Blue holes, such as the Blue Hole of Gozo in the Maltese Islands, are large seawater sinkholes that tend to have varying water density and irregularities in their steep walls. In 2021, researchers studied the previously unexplored Taam Ja’ Blue Hole (TJBH) in Chetumal Bay, Mexico; using echo sounder mapping, they determined its maximum depth to be about 274 meters. In the complex environments of blue holes, however, echo sounder mapping has limitations. So, in 2023, Teresa Álvarez-Legorreta and colleagues employed a conductivity, temperature, and depth (CTD) profiler to remeasure the depth of the TJBH. The profiler recorded depths around 420 meters but was unable to confirm detection of the bottom of the hole, suggesting that _________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. while the CTD profiler may be better suited than echo sounder mapping for measuring the depth of blue holes, another measurement approach is likely needed to ascertain the maximum depth of the TJBH.

B. while the CTD profiler can discern the properties of underwater terrains more comprehensively than echo sounder mapping can, echo sounder mapping produces more accurate measurements at greater underwater depths.
C. although the maximum depth of the TJBH has yet to be conclusively detected, the bottom of the hole is most likely between 274 and 420 meters below sea level.
D. although both echo sounder mapping and the CTD profiler have known limitations, they produce reliable estimates of the depth of blue holes when used together.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 蓝洞（如马耳他群岛戈佐岛蓝洞）是大型海水沉洞，往往具有变化的水体密度与陡峭内壁的不规则形态。2021年，研究人员研究了墨西哥切图马尔湾此前未被探索的塔姆贾蓝洞（TJBH），通过回声测深测绘确定其最大深度约为274米。然而在蓝洞的复杂环境中，回声测深测绘存在局限。因此，2023年Teresa Álvarez-Legorreta及其同事使用温盐深剖面仪（CTD）重新测量TJBH的深度。该仪器记录到约420米的深度，但未能确认探测到洞底，这表明________ 中文解析： 文中指出CTD仪器虽然测到约420米，但“未能确认探测到洞底”，意味着当前方法仍无法确定最终深度。选项A据此提出“可能需要其他测量方法”，既承认CTD的改进，又指出其局限，与文本逻辑完全衔接。其他选项或与文中数据冲突，或提出缺乏依据的推测。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
In 1941, college student Ann White ______ an offer to train as a codebreaker for the US military, which was preparing for World War II.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 原句主句缺少谓语动词，因此选择“received”作为过去式动词，可直接构成“Ann White received an offer...”的完整主谓宾结构。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
When, on January 9, 1987, Kay A. Orr _______ serving as the governor of Nebraska, she became the state’s first female chief executive.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 原句有明显过去时间状语“on January 9, 1987”，因此谓语动词必须使用过去式。“began”是“begin”的过去式。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
Skeletal muscles are attached to bones. One bone, the humerus, has a skeletal muscle attached to _______ called the brachialis.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子中“attached to _______”的空缺应指代前文“the humerus”（一块骨头），应用单数中性代词“it”。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
The impala ( Aepyceros melampus ) has a species population of about 2,000,000 ______ less than that of the water buffalo ( Bubalus. bubalis ), which has a species population of roughly 172,000,000.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 此处需连接两个独立分句：“The impala... 2,000,000 members”与“this amount is less...”。符合标准英语规范且能正确连接两个独立分句的标点只有分号（;）
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
According to Portuguese researcher Isabel C.F.R. Ferreira, the cinnamic acid found in button mushrooms can protect human cells from damage.______ the acid combats free radicals, a type of unstable molecule that can harm healthy cells in the human body.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 根据葡萄牙研究人员 Isabel C.F.R. Ferreira 的观点，双孢蘑菇中含有的肉桂酸可以保护人体细胞免受损伤。______ 该酸能对抗自由基，而自由基是一种会损害人体健康细胞的不稳定分子。 中文解析： 前一句指出肉桂酸有保护细胞的作用，后句则具体说明其作用机制（对抗自由基），属于从一般到具体的解释关系。因此“Specifically”能准确表达这种细化说明的逻辑关系。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·The Zambezi River is 1,703 kilometers long. ·It is in Africa. ·It ranks No.32 among the longest rivers in the world. ·The Vistula River is 754 kilometers long. ·It is in Europe. ·It ranks No.133 among the longest rivers in the world.

The student wants to indicate where the Zambezi River is located. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The Vistula River is ranked No.133 among the longest rivers in the world
B. The Zambezi River is 1,703 kilometers long.
C. The Zambezi River is located in Africa.
D. The Zambezi and Vistula rivers are among the longest rivers in the world.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一位学生在研究某主题时记录了以下信息： ·赞比西河全长1,703公里。 ·位于非洲。 ·在世界最长河流中排名第32位。 ·维斯瓦河全长754公里。 ·位于欧洲。 ·在世界最长河流中排名第133位。 中文解析： 题目明确要求“说明赞比西河的位置”，选项C直接、准确地使用了笔记中“It is in Africa”这一信息，简洁地达成了目标。其他选项要么未提及位置，要么提及的是其他河流的信息，不符合题目要求。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
·The Smolensk Planetarium in Smolensk, Russia, is home to a Foucault pendulum. ·The pendulum consists of a weighted ball that swings at the end of a roughly 12-meter-long cable. ·Like all Foucault pendulums, it dangles from a fixed point that ensures the swing path of the pendulum doesn’t change. ·To an observer, the swing path of a Foucault pendulum appears to change over time because Earth rotates beneath it. ·Foucault pendulums are used as a simple way to provide evidence of Earth’s rotation.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to specify the length of the Foucault pendulum’s cable?
selections: A. With a swing path that appears to change over time, a Foucault pendulum provides evidence of Earth’s rotation.
B. The Foucault pendulum at the Smolensk Planetarium consists of a weighted ball and a cable.
C. Although the swing path of a Foucault pendulum doesn’t actually change, it appears to change due to Earth rotating beneath the pendulum.
D. The Foucault pendulum at the Smolensk Planetarium in Smolensk, Russia, includes a cable that is roughly 12 meters long.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： ·俄罗斯斯摩棱斯克天文馆设有一个傅科摆。 ·该摆由一个重球和一根长约12米的缆绳组成。 ·与所有傅科摆一样，它悬挂在一个固定点上，确保摆的摆动路径不变。 ·对观察者而言，傅科摆的摆动路径似乎随时间变化，这是因为地球在摆下自转。 ·傅科摆被用作证明地球自转的一种简单方式。 中文解析： 题目明确要求“具体说明傅科摆缆绳的长度”，选项D直接引用了笔记中“a roughly 12-meter-long cable”这一关键信息，并完整指出了该摆所属的地点（斯摩棱斯克天文馆），准确且有针对性地完成了任务。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
One reasonable way to evaluate the ______ of a scholar’s research is to track how often other scholars refer to that research. For example, Deutsche Bundesbank economist Claudia M. Buch, who studies banking regulations, is among the world’s most frequently cited researchers in her specialty, indicating that her work has had a significant effect on the field.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 评价学者研究______的一个合理方法是追踪其他学者引用该研究的频率。例如，研究银行监管的德国联邦银行经济学家Claudia M. Buch是其专业领域内全球被引用最频繁的研究者之一，这表明她的工作对该领域产生了重要影响。 中文解析： 该段文字的核心逻辑是，用“其他学者的引用频率”作为评估标准，这显然是为了衡量一项研究对学术界产生的“影响”或“效果”。选项中只有A（impact）符合这一语境。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第3套M2-Easy-9道题（去重版）

question:
Ethicist Ingrid Robeyns argues in her work that taxes on the very wealthy should be increased so that governments will be enabled to solve problems of collective action, such as mitigating climate change. Robeyns cites the work of economist Mariana Mazzucato, who shows that government subsidies are a more effective engine of innovation than private sector investments; in addition, government-funded innovations tend to lead to further developments in disparate fields (such as the United States mission to land a person on the Moon, which accelerated developments in nutrition as well as navigation).

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It offers a claim by a scholar, then uses the results of a project by another scholar to show why that claim should be rejected.
B. It summarizes the research of one scholar, then presents a study by another scholar that was inspired by the findings of that research.
C. It details the findings of a research project by one scholar, then puts forward the suggestions of another scholar for further investigation.
D. It introduces a proposition by a scholar, then describes that scholar’s use of findings by another scholar to support that proposition.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 伦理学家英格丽德·罗贝恩斯在其著作中主张，应对极富阶层增税以使政府能够解决集体行动问题，例如缓解气候变化。罗贝恩斯引用了经济学家玛丽安娜·马祖卡托的研究，后者指出政府补贴是比私人部门投资更有效的创新引擎；此外，政府资助的创新往往能推动不同领域的进一步发展（例如美国的登月计划，就同时促进了营养学和导航技术的进步）。 中文解析： 文本首先提出罗贝恩斯的观点（对富人增税以支持政府解决集体行动问题），随后描述她引用另一位学者马祖卡托的研究结论来支撑自己的主张。选项D准确概括了这一“提出主张—引用他人研究加以支持”的结构。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第3套M2-Easy-9道题（去重版）

question:
The following text is from Angeline Boulley’ s 2021 novel Firekeeper’s Daughter . The narrator is an Ojibwe teenager who runs in the morning before going to school. Levi is her younger brother. My brother complains about my lengthy warm-up routine whenever he runs with me. I keep telling Levi that my longer, bigger, and therefore vastly superior muscles require more intensive preparation for peak performance. The real reason, which he would think is dorky, is that I recite the correct anatomical name for each muscle as I stretch. ©2021 by Angeline Boulley

What is the main topic of the text?
selections: A. The narrator’s warm-up routine before running
B. A high school teacher whose class the narrator enjoys
C. The career that the narrator’s brother hopes to pursue someday
D. The narrator’s feelings about moving to a new town
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文字摘自安吉琳·布莱 2021 年小说《守火人之女》。叙述者是一名奥吉布瓦族青少年，她在上学前进行晨跑。莱维是她的弟弟。 每当弟弟和我一起跑步时，他总会抱怨我漫长的热身流程。我不断告诉莱维，我更长、更大因而也优秀得多的肌肉需要更充分的准备才能达到最佳表现。而真正的原因——他会觉得这很呆——是我会在伸展时背诵每块肌肉正确的解剖学名称。 中文解析： 文本主要围绕叙述者的热身习惯展开，包括弟弟的抱怨、她对外给出的借口以及真实原因。其他选项（B：喜欢的老师；C：弟弟的未来职业；D：搬家的感受）均未在文本中提及。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第3套M2-Easy-9道题（去重版）

question:
Volcanoes Active since 1800 and since 1960 in Two Countries A student is collecting data about countries with volcanoes that have been active in the time since 1800 and in the time since 1960. The student records that Tonga has ____

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement?
selections: A. no volcanoes that have been active since 1800.
B. the same number of volcanoes that have been active since 1800 as Ecuador has.
C. more volcanoes that have been active since 1960 than Ecuador has
D. fewer volcanoes that have been active since 1960 than Ecuador has.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一名学生正在收集关于自1800年以来和自1960年以来有火山活动国家的数据。该学生记录到，汤加______。 中文解析： 从图表数据可知，汤加自1960年以来活跃的火山数量为3座，厄瓜多尔为6座。因此，汤加 少于 厄瓜多尔自1960年以来活跃的火山数量。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第3套M2-Easy-9道题（去重版）

question:
Memoirs of Eleanor Eldridge is an 1838 historical account by Eleanor Eldridge and Frances Harriet Whipple Green. In the book, the authors caution against inquiring into the private life of the book’s subject beyond what is presented in the text, writing,_______

Which quotation from Memoirs of Eleanor Eldridge most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “Let us, dear reader, remember the punishment of idle curiosity, as taught in the true and affecting history [named] ‘Blue Beard’ and, striving to be content with the facts in the case, seek not to lift the veil, which the sensibility of true love, and feminine delicacy, have alike conspired to draw.”
B. “Home is home, to the lowly as well as the great; and no rank, or color, destroys its sacred character, its power over the mind, and the affections.”

C. “Having thus so comfortably established ourselves, with no evil-minded eaves-dropper to make us afraid, bend now, dear reader, thy most earnest and delicately adjusted ear, for I am going to tell thee a secret.”

D. “How careful ought we to be to speak nothing but the truth, even in regard to the most trifling circumstances; and not only so, but to be well assured that what we suppose to be true, is truth, before we receive it as such.”
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 《埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇回忆录》是埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇与弗朗西丝·哈里特·惠普尔·格林于1838年合著的历史记述。在书中，作者们告诫读者不要探究书中人物在文本内容之外的私生活，并写道：______ 中文解析： 题目要求选择最能体现“作者告诫读者不要探究书中人物私生活”这一主张的引文。选项A明确提醒读者克制无谓的好奇心、满足于已知事实、不去揭开隐私的“面纱”，与题干的警告完全对应。选项B强调“家”的普遍意义，选项C则邀请读者倾听秘密，均不符合警告意图。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第3套M2-Easy-9道题（去重版）

question:
Through the process of photosynthesis, plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to create their own food. This amazing ability allows plants _____and provides oxygen for other living things to breathe.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 根据“allow sb. to do sth.”的固定搭配，应填入不定式“to grow”。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第3套M2-Easy-9道题（去重版）

question:
In Puerto Rico, it’s not unusual for a city or town to be known by a nickname that corresponds to one of its notable features, like landscape, ______ or chief exports. For example, the Puerto Rican municipality of San Sebastián has also been called “the Cradle of Hammocks,” a nickname that alludes to what the area is well known for: the woven hammocks its residents famously produce.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子中“like landscape, ______ or chief exports”为三者的并列结构，需用逗号分隔并列项。选项D在“climate”和“famous residents”后均使用逗号，使三者（landscape, climate, famous residents, or chief exports）清晰并列，语法正确。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第3套M2-Easy-9道题（去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·The Carnegie Prize is an international art competition. ·It is administered by the Carnegie Museum of Art in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. ·One Carnegie Prize gold medal winner is Gaston La Touche of France. ·La Touche’ s painting The Bath was honored in 1907.

The student wants to indicate the name of the artist who created the prize-winning painting The Bath . Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The Carnegie Museum of Art in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, administers a competition honoring outstanding artworks.
B. In 1907, an artist from France won a Carnegie Prize gold medal.
C. The Carnegie Prize is an international art competition administered by the Carnegie Museum of Art.
D. The prize-winning painting The Bath is by the artist Gaston La Touche.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记： ·卡内基奖是一项国际艺术竞赛。 ·该奖项由位于宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡的卡内基艺术博物馆管理。 ·法国艺术家加斯顿·拉图什曾获得卡内基奖金牌。 ·拉图什的画作《沐浴》于1907年获奖。 中文解析： 题目要求明确指出获奖画作《沐浴》的创作者是谁。选项D直接说明“获奖画作《沐浴》出自艺术家加斯顿·拉图什”。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第3套M2-Easy-9道题（去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·A river’s stream length is the length of a line that follows along the river path. ·A river’s valley length is the length of a straight line drawn from the beginning of the river to the end. ·The river’s curviness, or sinuosity, is the ratio of the river’s stream length to its valley length. ·This ratio is less than or equal to 1.5:1 in low-sinuosity rivers and greater than 1.5:1 in high-sinuosity rivers. ·The Congaree River in the United States has high sinuosity. The Luni River in India has low sinuosity.

The student wants to compare the sinuosity of the Congaree and Luni rivers. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In both the Congaree and the Luni rivers, sinuosity is determined by comparing stream length to valley length.
B. The ratio of the Congaree River’s stream length to its valley length is greater than 1.5:1, exceeding that of the Luni River.
C. By comparing the stream lengths of the Congaree and Luni rivers to their valley lengths, one can calculate their sinuosity.
D. While the high-sinuosity Congaree River is located in the United States, the Luni River is in India.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记： ·河流的“河道长度”是沿河流路径测量得到的长度。 ·河流的“河谷长度”是从河流起点到终点画一条直线的长度。 ·河流的弯曲度（即曲率）是河道长度与河谷长度的比值。 ·低曲率河流的该比值小于或等于1.5:1，高曲率河流的该比值大于1.5:1。 ·美国的康加里河为高曲率河流，印度的卢尼河为低曲率河流。 中文解析： 题目要求比较两条河流的曲率。选项B直接指出康加里河的河道长度与河谷长度之比大于1.5:1，并明确其“超过”卢尼河（根据笔记，卢尼河比值≤1.5:1），清晰完成了比较目标。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第3套M2-Easy-9道题（去重版）

question:
The following text is from Mark Twain’s 1876 novel The Adventures of Tom Sawyer . Tom, a child, has been told by his aunt to paint their house’s fence. Tom appeared on the sidewalk with a bucket of whitewash and a long-handled brush. He surveyed the fence, and all gladness left him and a deep melancholy settled down upon his spirit. Thirty yards of board fence nine feet high.

As used in the text, what does the word “surveyed” most nearly mean?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 汤姆提着一桶白涂料和一把长柄刷子出现在人行道上。他审视着篱笆，所有快乐顿时消失，深深的忧郁笼罩心头。这篱笆有三十码长，九英尺高。 中文解析： 在上下文中，“surveyed”描述汤姆仔细查看篱笆的样子，意为“检查”或“审视”，因此选项C“Examined”（检查）最贴切。其他选项（A转变、B组织、D保证）均不符合文意。

question:
The influence of William Shakespeare’s writings is clear in a vast range of subsequent literary works and is similarly ________ in many works in other media, from fine art (such as Edward Alcock’s painting Portia and Shylock ) to popular music (such as the musician Elvis Costello’s song “Miss Macbeth”).

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 威廉·莎士比亚作品的影响在大量后世文学作品中显而易见，同样________ 地体现在许多其他媒介的作品中，从美术（如爱德华·阿尔科克的画作《鲍西娅与夏洛克》）到流行音乐（如音乐家埃尔维斯·科斯特洛的歌曲《麦克白夫人》）。 中文解析： 前半句指出莎士比亚的影响在文学作品中“clear”（明显），后半句以“similarly”（同样地）衔接，因此需选择与“clear”近义的词，强调影响的明显性。B项“apparent”（明显的）最符合逻辑，且与上下文精确对应。

question:
The Apollo Moon landings (1969-1972) brought atmospheric sensors and soil sensors to the Moon and produced large amounts of data, much of which was stored on technologies that are now obsolete. A data-transfer project is working to ________ these data so that the information is available to researcher Noah Petro, who is investigating the geology of the Moon.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 阿波罗登月任务（1969-1972年）将大气传感器和土壤传感器带到月球，并产生了大量数据，其中许多数据存储在现已过时的技术中。一个数据转移项目正致力于________这些数据，以便研究月球地质的研究员诺亚·佩特罗能够获取这些信息。 中文解析： 数据存储在过时技术上，面临无法读取的风险，因此项目目的是“抢救”或“挽回”这些数据。选项A “salvage”（挽救、抢救）是正确答案。其他选项B“改进”、C“修正”、D“简化”均不符合语境，因为重点在于数据恢复而非优化或修改。

question:
The following text is adapted from the 1895 poem “Ojistoh” by Emily Pauline Johnson, a Kanienkahagen (Mohawk) writer also known as Tekahionwake. I am Ojistoh, I am she, the wife Of him whose name breathes bravery and life And courage to the tribe who calls him chief. I am Ojistoh, his white star, and he Is land, and lake, and sky—and soul to me.

As used in the text, what does the word “breathes” most nearly mean?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 我是Ojistoh，我是她，是他的妻子/他的名字为部落注入了勇敢、生命和勇气，部落称他为酋长。/我是Ojistoh，他的白星，而他/是大地，是湖泊，是天空——是我的灵魂。 中文解析： 诗中“breathes”一词用于描述名字能够传递或赋予“勇敢、生命和勇气”，是一种拟人化表达，意为“注入”或“赋予”。因此，选项B“Imparts”（给予、赋予）最贴近文意。其他选项A“拒绝”、C“吸收”、D“默许”均不符合语境逻辑。

question:
Mastering ' ajami, a Syrian art of creating intricately painted wood panels, demands a skill set that ________ innate talent: crafting the panels requires not just the ability to draw but also an understanding of traditional techniques, materials, and design elements, necessitating expertise gained through dedicated guidance from experienced artisans.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 掌握 'ajami（一种叙利亚的绘制精细木板的艺术）需要的技能组合________天赋：制作木板不仅需要绘画能力，还需要理解传统工艺、材料和设计元素，必须通过经验丰富的工匠的悉心指导来获得专业知识。 中文解析： 根据后文解释，掌握'ajami不仅需要天赋，还需要后天学习的知识和技巧，因此技能组合“超越”了单纯的天赋。选项D“transcends”（超越）最符合逻辑，强调技能组合高于或超出天赋。A“限制”、B“复制”、C“以...为特征”均与语境不符。

question:
In factories, humans and robots often work together. A research team ran an experiment to find out how working with robots affects relationships between human coworkers. The experiment included teams working together to make electric motor parts. One type of team included only humans and the other type included both humans and robots. Participants were paid for their work and were asked about their willingness to share their earnings with their human teammates. Participants from teams with robots were more likely to share with each other than participants from teams with only humans were.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It states the results of the experiment discussed in the text.
B. It indicates the question that the study discussed in the text was meant to answer.
C. It explains an important part of the design of the experiment discussed in the text.
D. It illustrates a problem that inspired the study discussed in the text.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在工厂中，人类和机器人经常一起工作。一个研究团队进行了一项实验，以找出与机器人一起工作如何影响人类同事之间的关系。实验包括团队合作制造电动马达零件。一种团队只有人类，另一种包括人类和机器人。参与者因工作获得报酬，并被问及他们是否愿意与人类队友分享收入。与机器人一起工作的参与者比只有人类的参与者更愿意彼此分享。 中文解析： 划线句子描述了实验设计中的参与者薪酬和共享意愿的衡量方式，属于实验方法的一部分，因此其作用是解释实验设计的重要环节，对应选项 C。

question:
Steve Carter’s award-winning play Eden was produced in 1976 by the groundbreaking Negro Ensemble Company (NEC). NEC cofounder Douglas Turner Ward, who worked as an actor, director, and playwright, had met actor and producer Robert Hooks while they were performing in a 1960 touring production of Lorraine Hansberry’s play A Raisin in the Sun. Together, they envisioned a theater company that would nurture and showcase the work of Black theater professionals. Since NEC ’ s founding in 1967, its workshops and performances have given Black playwrights, including Carter, a forum for their compelling stories.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It illustrates the widespread influence of a play discussed earlier in the text.
B. It provides additional information about a person mentioned in the text.
C. It emphasizes the ongoing significance of the theater company discussed in the text.
D. It explains the circumstances that led to the formation of the theater company discussed in the text.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 史蒂夫·卡特的获奖剧作《伊甸园》于1976年由开创性的黑人剧团公司（NEC）制作。NEC联合创始人道格拉斯·特纳·沃德（身兼演员、导演和剧作家）在1960年巡演洛兰·汉斯贝里的戏剧《阳光下的葡萄干》时结识了演员兼制作人罗伯特·胡克斯。他们共同设想建立一个能培养和展示黑人戏剧专业人士作品的剧院公司。自NEC于1967年成立以来，其工作坊和演出为包括卡特在内的黑人剧作家提供了一个展示他们引人入胜故事的平台。 中文解析： 该划线句描述了NEC自成立以来持续发挥的作用和影响，强调了该公司对黑人剧作家的长期支持与贡献，因此其功能是强调该剧院公司的持续重要性，对应选项C。

question:
Despite potential independent confirmation, the apparent detection in 2020 of phosphine (PH3)—a gas that on Earth almost exclusively derives from biological sources—in Venus’s cloud deck remains controversial, in part because Venus is thought to be uninhabitable. To evaluate such a finding’s plausibility, William Bains et al. modeled multiple abiotic PH3 pathways, including geochemical, atmospheric, and photochemical reactions, but none adequately explain the observed levels of PH3 . If Venusian PH3 does exist, it would indicate insufficiencies in the current consensus on Venus’s chemistry.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It introduces an unexpected observation of a particular gas in Venus’s atmosphere, presents an effort to investigate possible mechanisms that could explain that observation, and then notes an implication of that investigation’s findings.

B. It explains why the consensus view of a particular gas in Venus’s atmosphere has recently become controversial, expands on a scientific team’s reasons for questioning that consensus, and then suggests that future observations of Venus’s atmosphere will likely be needed to settle the controversy.

C. It compares the levels of a particular gas on Venus and Earth, sketches the chemical processes that account for differences in these levels, and then addresses some of the practical challenges of studying the presence of this gas on Venus more closely.
D. It questions the effectiveness of the methods used to detect phosphine on Venus, proposes an alternative explanation for the data, and calls for a reevaluation of the planet’s habitability.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 尽管可能有独立的确认，2020年在金星云层中探测到磷化氢（PH3）——一种在地球上几乎完全来自生物来源的气体——仍然存在争议，部分原因是金星被认为不适合居住。为了评估这一发现的可能性，威廉·贝恩斯等人模拟了多种非生物PH3产生途径，包括地球化学、大气和光化学反应，但没有一种能充分解释观察到的PH3水平。如果金星PH3确实存在，它将表明当前对金星化学的共识存在不足。 中文解析： 文本首先引入金星大气中意外探测到磷化氢的争议性发现，接着描述研究团队为解释该发现而建模多种非生物途径的努力，最后指出若发现属实则意味着现有共识的不足。选项A准确概括了这一结构

question:
Given the immense scope of space, the search for extraterrestrial life is almost necessarily concentrated on the exoplanets deemed to have the most plausible chance of success—typically, atmosphere-bearing terrestrial planets orbiting within a certain range of their stars (termed the habitable zone). Claiming that Earth experienced a long transition from single-lid to plate tectonics that accelerated the emergence and evolution of complex organisms, researchers Robert J. Stern and Taras V. Gerya hold that consideration of tectonics, an often overlooked factor, could help further narrow the search for advanced extraterrestrial species.

Based on the text, what do Stern and Gerya most likely believe about the development of complex life on exoplanets?
selections: A. It is more likely to occur on habitable zone planets with atmospheres and plate tectonics than on otherwise similar planets that lack plate tectonics.
B. It is more likely to occur if habitable zone planets with atmospheres transition from single-lid to plate tectonics late in their history than if they transition early in their history.
C. It is probably more dependent on the presence of plate tectonics than on orbital distance from a host star or the presence of an atmosphere.
D. It is unlikely unless the transition from single-lid to plate tectonics occurs before the acquisition of a lasting atmosphere.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 鉴于太空的浩瀚无垠，对外星生命的搜索几乎必然集中在被认为最有可能成功的系外行星上——通常是具有大气层、位于恒星宜居带内的类地行星。研究人员罗伯特·J·斯特恩和塔拉斯·V·格利亚声称，地球经历了从单层盖到板块构造的漫长过渡，这一过渡加速了复杂生物的出现和演化。他们认为，构造运动（一个常被忽视的因素）的考量可能有助于进一步缩小对高级外星物种的搜索范围。 中文解析： 斯特恩和格利亚指出，地球的板块构造过渡加速了复杂生命的演化，并建议在搜索外星生命时考虑构造运动以进一步缩小范围。因此，他们最可能认为：在有大气层和板块构造的宜居带行星上，复杂生命更可能发生，而非在类似但缺乏板块构造的行星上。选项A正确反映了这一观点。选项B涉及过渡时间，文本未提及；选项C夸大板块构造的重要性，文本仅强调其常被忽视；选项D设定条件关系，文本未支持。

question:
In what is now Washington state, the Tulalip Tribes operate the Hibulb Cultural Center. Relying on traditional knowledge to guide the design of exhibits, this institution presents Tulalip history and culture to the tribes’ citizens. The Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa, a tribe in North Dakota, employs a similar strategy in its own cultural center. Both centers contrast with museums that aren’t Indigenous-led; when displaying Indigenous artifacts, such museums tend to anticipate mainly non-Indigenous audiences and rely on Euro-centric strategies for designing exhibits.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. When staging Indigenous exhibits, non-Indigenous institutions should follow the example of the cultural centers operated by the Tulalip Tribes and the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa.
B. The cultural centers operated by the Tulalip Tribes and the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa differ in strategy from non-Indigenous museums that stage Indigenous exhibits.

C. Whereas non-Indigenous institutions stage exhibits on a wide array of subjects, the cultural centers operated by the Tulalip Tribes and the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa serve primarily to present Indigenous history and cultures.

D. The strategy used by the Tulalip Tribes to present history and culture to tribal citizens differs only slightly from the strategy used by the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa in its cultural center.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在现在的华盛顿州，图拉利普部落运营着希布尔布文化中心。该机构依靠传统知识指导展览设计，向部落公民展示图拉利普的历史和文化。北达科他州的奇佩瓦族龟山部落也在自己的文化中心采用了类似策略。这两个中心都与非原住民主导的博物馆形成对比；在展示原住民文物时，这类博物馆往往主要预期非原住民观众，并依赖以欧洲为中心的展览设计策略。 中文解析： 文本的核心是对比：两个原住民文化中心（都依靠传统知识、面向部落公民）与非原住民博物馆（预期非原住民观众、采用欧洲中心策略）在策展策略上的不同。因此，选项B准确概括了主要思想。

question:
The Wonderful Wizard of Oz is a 1900 novel by L. Frank Baum. In the novel, Dorothy, who is from Kansas, finds herself in an unfamiliar place called Oz. Kansas is presented as being less appealing than Oz, as is clear when ________.

Which quotation from The Wonderful Wizard of Oz most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. a character says to Dorothy, “I cannot understand why you should wish to leave this beautiful country and go back to the dry, gray place you call Kansas.”
B. a character says to others, “But it will take more than imagination to carry Dorothy back to Kansas, and I’m sure I don’t know how it can be done.”

C. the narrator states, “Dorothy did not feel nearly so bad as you might think a little girl would who had been suddenly whisked away from her own country and set down in the midst of a strange land.”
D. the narrator states, “Before them was a great stretch of country having a floor as smooth and shining and white as the bottom of a big bowl.”
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 《绿野仙踪》是L. Frank Baum于1900年出版的小说。在小说中，来自堪萨斯的桃乐丝发现自己身处一个叫做奥兹的陌生地方。堪萨斯被描绘得不如奥兹有吸引力，这从________可以清楚看出。 中文解析： 题目要求选择引文来证明“堪萨斯不如奥兹有吸引力”。选项A通过角色之口直接对比了奥兹的“美丽”和堪萨斯的“干燥、灰色”，最能有效说明这一主张。选项B讨论如何带回桃乐丝，未涉及吸引力对比；选项C描述桃乐丝的感受，但未明确评价两地优劣；选项D不完整且仅描述奥兹风景，无关比较。

question:
Average Hours Worked per Person per Year in 1950 and 2017 Country 1950 2017 Change in hours Percent change in hours Brazil 2,042 1,709 -333 -16% Japan 2,030 1,738 -292 -14% Switzerland 2,040 1,590 -450 -22% Germany 2,427 1,354 -1,074 -44% Calculations may be inexact due to rounding. A student in an economics course is examining the decline since 1950 in average hours worked per person per year in various nations due to both increased productivity and the adoption of policies that limit working hours. The first task in this investigation is to determine how the decline in Switzerland compares to that in other countries. The student finds that ______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
selections: A. though the percent decrease in hours worked in Switzerland was less than that in Germany, it was greater than that in Brazil and Japan.
B. the decline in number of hours worked was greater in Switzerland than it was in Germany, Brazil, or Japan.
C. while the number of hours worked rose in Switzerland from 1950 to 2017, it declined in Germany, Brazil, and Japan.
D. though the percent decrease in hours worked in Switzerland was greater than that in Germany and Japan, it was less than that in Brazil.
explanations: 某经济学课程学生正在研究各国自1950年以来因生产力提升和工作时长限制政策导致的人均年工作小时数下降现象。研究首要任务是确定瑞士的下降幅度与其他国家的对比情况。该学生发现______ 中文解析： 根据表格数据，瑞士工作时长下降百分比为22%，介于德国的44%与巴西的16%、日本的14%之间。选项A准确表述了“瑞士降幅小于德国但大于巴西和日本”的对比关系。其他选项均存在数据错误：B项将绝对下降量与百分比混淆；C项误说瑞士工作时长上升；D项则完全颠倒了瑞士与巴西的百分比对比关系。

question:
Percent Change in Average Global Market Prices by Commodity in Two Agricultural Trade-Reform Scenarios C ommodity P ercent change in TFA scenario P ercent change in tariff-removal scenario Fruits and vegetables - 1.50 + 0.04 Processed foods -1.76 -1.00 Rice -0.37 +1.36 Wheat -1.35 +0.45 Ratified in 2017 by two-thirds of World Trade Organization member nations, the Trade Facilitation Agreement (TFA) is a trade-reform measure that aims to reduce redundant customs procedures and other costly aspects of international trade. In a 2021 report, economist Jayson Beckman modeled global market prices of several agricultural commodities under both the TFA and an alternative trade-reform scenario: removal of agricultural tariffs (taxes on imports that generally increase prices on imported goods). After reviewing data from the report, a student concludes that overall, consumers of the commodities listed in the table would likely benefit more from the TFA than they would from tariff removal.

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to support the student’s claim?
selections: A. Under the tariff-removal scenario, the average prices of processed foods, wheat, and fruits and vegetables would decrease by more than 1%, while the average price of rice would decrease by less than 1%.
B. Under the tariff-removal scenario, the average price of processed foods would increase, but the average prices of wheat and rice would decrease.
C. Under the TFA scenario, the average prices of all four commodities would decrease, whereas under the tariff-removal scenario, only the average price of processed foods would decrease.

D. Under the TFA scenario, the average price of rice would decrease by a smaller amount than any of the other three commodities’ prices would, whereas its average price would increase under the tariff-removal scenario.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在2017年，世界贸易组织三分之二的成员国批准了《贸易便利化协定》（TFA），这是一项旨在减少冗余海关程序和其他国际贸易中高成本因素的贸易改革措施。在2021年的一份报告中，经济学家贾森·贝克曼对在《贸易便利化协定》和另一种贸易改革情景（即取消农业关税，即通常会提高进口商品价格的进口税）下几种农产品的全球市场价格进行了建模。在审查了该报告的数据后，一位学生得出结论，整体而言，表中所列商品的消费者可能会比取消关税更能从《贸易便利化协定》中受益。 中文解析： 题目要求用表格数据支持学生的结论——消费者从《贸易便利化协定》（TFA）中获益比取消关税更多。TFA 情景：表格显示，所有四种商品（加工食品、小麦、水果蔬菜、大米）的平均价格全部下降，说明对消费者普遍有利。取消关税情景：只有加工食品价格下降，其他三种（小麦、水果蔬菜、大米）价格上升或降幅极小，对消费者好处有限。C 选项直接对比两种情景，证明 TFA 对消费者更有利，完全支持学生的结论。

question:
The Man-Made World : Or, Our Androcentric Culture is a 1911 nonfiction work by Charlotte Perkins Gilman. In the text, the author emphasizes the importance of cultivating individuals rather than comparing them: ________

Which quotation from The Man-Made World: Or, Our Androcentric Culture most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “That every child on earth shall have right conditions to make the best growth possible to it; that every citizen, from birth to death, shall have a chance to learn all he or she can [absorb], to develop everypower that is in them.”

B. “We do not sadly measure the cabbage-stalk by the corn-stalk, and praise the corn for getting ahead of the cabbage——nor incite the cabbage to [imitate] the corn. We nourish both, to its best growth—and are the richer.”
C. “We have but to learn the real elements in humanity; its true powers and natural characteristics.”
D. “We are now to consider the growth of the family in humanity.”
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 《人造世界：或，我们的男性中心文化》是夏洛特·珀金斯·吉尔曼于1911年出版的非虚构作品。在文中，作者强调培养个体而不是比较他们的重要性：________ 中文解析： 选项B通过卷心菜和玉米的类比，明确表达了不应比较不同个体，而应滋养各自最佳生长的观点，直接且形象地说明了“培养个体而非比较”的主张。其他选项或侧重提供条件（A），或讨论人性要素（C），或偏离主题（D），均未直接体现“不比较”这一核心。

question:
Zooarchaeologist Ophélie Lebrasseur and her team examined a fox skeleton discovered in 1991 at an archaeological site alongside artifacts of human habitation (like spear points) in central Argentina. Lebrasseur et al. determined that the fox was Dusicyon avus , an extinct species resembling a jackal, and radiocarbon dating placed the fox at the site at the same time as human inhabitants. (Indeed, the inhabitants may have deliberately buried the fox.) In addition, while wild foxes have a diet entirely made of meat, isotopic signatures of the skeleton’s teeth indicated that the fox’s diet, like that of the humans, was partly composed of plant material. Lebrasseur et al. therefore concluded that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the humans who were alive at the same time as the fox most likely ate more meat than the fox did.
B. the humans who were alive at the same time as the fox hunted using the spears whose points were also found at the site.
C. the fox may have been a companion animal of the humans who inhabited the site at the same time.
D. the fox had a diet more similar to that of jackals than to that of wild foxes.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 动物考古学家奥菲莉·勒布拉瑟及其团队研究了一具于1991年在阿根廷中部一处考古遗址发现的狐狸骨架，该遗址同时存在人类居住的遗物（如矛尖）。勒布拉瑟等人判定这只狐狸是已灭绝的“Dusicyon avus”物种，其形似豺狼，放射性碳定年显示这只狐狸与人类居民存在于同一时期（事实上，居民可能有意埋葬了这只狐狸）。此外，虽然野生狐狸的饮食全为肉类，但该骨架牙齿的同位素特征表明，这只狐狸与人类的饮食都部分由植物材料构成。勒布拉瑟等人因此得出结论：________ 中文解析： 基于“与人类同时期”、“可能被人类有意埋葬”以及“其饮食与人类相似（包含植物）”等证据，最合理的推断是这只狐狸可能与人类存在某种互动关系，例如作为伴侣动物被人类驯养或共同生活。因此，选项C“这只狐狸可能是当时居住在该遗址的人类的伴侣动物”最符合逻辑。

question:
In the nineteenth century, Elizabeth Cady Stanton and Susan B. Anthony ______ for women’s right to vote in the United States.

Which choice completes the text so that it corriforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 缺少谓语，只有B选项是正确的谓语形式

question:
While conducting an interview for her book Latina Authors and Their Muses, editor Mayra Calvani asked Sarah Cortez, author of the memoir Walking Home , what ________ Cortez’s response was Bury Me Deep by Megan Abbott.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: what引导宾语从句，引导词+主语+谓语是正确的语序

question:
Choreographers George Balanchine and Martha Graham both contributed sections to the dance piece Episodes , which premiered at New York’s City Center of Music and Drama in 1959. This cross-genre collaboration brought together the distinct features of Balanchine’s neoclassical ballet and Graham’s modern _____ the stylistic diversity and creative innovation within the dance world.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 空前面是一个完整的句子，后面showcasing作为现在分词短语做后置定语，和前面用逗号隔开，所以选C

question:
In the book A Theory of Harmony (1985), Swiss musicologist Ernst Levy argued that every chord has an opposite that can be substituted for it. For example, a pianist could replace the vi chord for the bill chord while __________ chord is a given chord’s opposite can be determined using a music visualization tool called the circle of fifths.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: a pianist could replace....improvising是第一个句子，which chord....the circle of fifths是第二个句子，两个句子之间用句号连接

question:
In her Silueta sculpture series, the Cuban American artist Ana ________ to access what she called an “omnipresent female force,” utilized a variety of natural materials to create outlines—or silhouettes—of her own body.

Which choice completes the text so that it comforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: Ana Mendieta是句子主语，utilized 是句子谓语，中间的hoping to属于现在分词短语做插入语，前后逗号隔开

question:
As volcanologists like Tamsin Mather are apt to make clear, not all volcanoes are the same. Tendürek in Turkey, for example, is a shield volcano, a type of volcano named for its low profile, resembling a warrior’s shield lying on the ground. Opala in Russia, ________ is a caldera, a large cauldron-like hollow that forms shortly after the emptying of a magma chamber in a volcanic eruption.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 正如坦辛·马瑟等火山学家喜欢澄清的那样，并非所有火山都是一样的。例如，土耳其的Tendürek是一座盾状火山，这种火山因其低矮的外形而得名，类似于平放在地面上的盾牌。而俄罗斯的Opala，________是一座破火山口，即火山喷发后岩浆房排空不久形成的一种大锅状洼地。 中文解析： 前半句描述盾状火山，后半句描述破火山口，两者为不同类型的火山，形成对比关系。选项中仅有 B "in contrast,"（相比之下）能表达这种对比逻辑。

question:
The United Nations’ Trade and Development organization divides exports into five key categories: food items, agricultural materials, fuels, ores and raw metals, and manufactured goods (i.e., most nonfood goods made by machinery or by hand). In 2022, the majority (62 percent) of Belgium’s exports were manufactured goods.____ vaccines, medicines, and cars were its top exports.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 联合国贸易和发展组织将出口分为五大类：食品、农业原材料、燃料、矿石与金属原材料，以及制成品（即大多数由机器或手工制造的非食品类商品）。2022年，比利时出口的大部分（62%）是制成品。____，疫苗、药品和汽车是其最主要的出口产品。 中文解析： 前一句说“大部分出口是制成品”，后一句列举的疫苗、药品和汽车都属于“制成品”这一类别的具体例子。因此，过渡词应表示“在这个类别中”或“具体而言”，所以B选项"Within this category,"（在这一类别中）最符合逻辑。

question:
A research team led by Gal Badihi has discovered that chimpanzees communicate through exchanges of gestures occurring at a pace similar to that of human conversations.________chimpanzee gesture exchanges have short pauses of about 120 milliseconds between communications, comparable to the 200-millisecond average pause between turns in human speech.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 由加尔·巴迪希领导的研究小组发现，黑猩猩通过交换手势进行交流，其节奏与人类对话相似。________，黑猩猩手势交流之间的间隔约为120毫秒，与人类对话中平均200毫秒的停顿相当。 中文解析： 前一句提到“节奏相似”，是一个总体发现；后一句用具体的停顿时长数据来具体说明这一相似性。因此，过渡词应表示“具体来说”或“精确而言”，所以选项A "Specifically," 最符合逻辑。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ●The Great Salt Lake in Utah is one of the world’s saltiest bodies of water. ●The northern portion of the lake has a higher concentration of salt than the southern portion. ●Crustaceans called Artemia franciscana live in the southern portion. ●Bacteria called Nodularia live in the southern portion.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between Artemia franciscana and Nodularia . Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Artemia franciscana are crustaceans that live in the southern portion of the Great Salt Lake.
B. Artemia franciscana and Nodularia both live in the Great Salt Lake’s southern portion.
C. The northern portion of the Great Salt Lake has a higher concentration of salt than does the southern portion.
D. Artemia franciscana and Nodularia are different types of organisms: Artemia franciscana are crustaceans, whereas Nodularia are bacteria.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记： • 犹他州的大盐湖是世界上最咸的水体之一。 • 湖的北部比南部盐度更高。 • 一种名为“Artemia franciscana”的甲壳动物生活在湖的南部。 • 一种名为“Nodularia”的细菌生活在湖的南部。 中文解析： 笔记中明确指出“Artemia franciscana”是甲壳动物，而“Nodularia”是细菌，这是两者在生物类别上的根本区别。选项D直接说明了这一点，因此最有效地强调了二者的差异。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ●Extravehicular activities (EVAs) are activities performed outside a spacecraft by astronauts in outer space. ●EVAs are also known as spacewalks. ●Richard Mastracchio is a former US astronaut who has performed 9 spacewalks. ●The total time of Mastracchio’s spacewalks was 53 hours and 4 minutes. ●Garrett Reisman is a former US astronaut who has performed 3 spacewalks. ●The total time of Reisman’s spacewalks was 21 hours and 21 minutes.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the astronauts Mastracchio and Reisman. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Reisman has spent less time performing spacewalks than Mastracchio has.
B. EVAs, also known as spacewalks, are activities done by astronauts outside a spacecraft.
C. Mastracchio and Reisman have each performed multiple spacewalks.
D. Mastracchio has performed spacewalks, but Reisman has performed EVAs.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记： • 舱外活动（EVAs）是宇航员在太空航天器外进行的活动。 • EVAs也被称为太空行走。 • 理查德·马斯特拉基奥是一位美国前宇航员，曾执行过9次太空行走。 • 马斯特拉基奥的太空行走总时长为53小时4分钟。 • 加勒特·赖斯曼是一位美国前宇航员，曾执行过3次太空行走。 • 赖斯曼的太空行走总时长为21小时21分钟。 中文解析： 笔记明确指出两位宇航员都曾执行过太空行走（舱外活动），这是他们的共同点。选项C “Mastracchio and Reisman have each performed multiple spacewalks.” 直接说明了他们都执行过多次太空行走，最有效地强调了这一相似之处。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ●The Tijuana Slough National Wildlife Refuge (NWR) is a protected natural area in California. ●It encompasses 1,023 acres. ●The Tijuana Slough NWR was established to safeguard the habitat of the light-footed clapper rail, an endangered species. ●The Tijuana Slough NWR is managed by the US Fish & Wildlife Service. ●The US Fish & Wildlife Service limits human activities in the area.
