The student wants to emphasize the role the US Fish & Wildlife Service plays in safeguarding the habitat of the light-footed clapper rail. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. By limiting human activities in the Tijuana Slough NWR, the US Fish & Wildlife Service safeguards the habitat of the light-footed clapper rail.
B. Human activities are limited in the Tijuana Slough NWR, a protected natural area in California.
C. Home to the light-footed clapper rail, the Tijuana Slough NWR is located in California, where it encompasses 1,023 acres.
D. The 1,023-acre Tijuana Slough NWR was established to safeguard the habitat of the light-footed clapper rail, an endangered species.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记： • 蒂华纳河国家野生动物保护区是加利福尼亚州的一个受保护的自然区域。 • 它占地1,023英亩。 • 蒂华纳河国家野生动物保护区的建立是为了保护濒危物种“轻足秧鸡”的栖息地。 • 蒂华纳河国家野生动物保护区由美国鱼类及野生动物管理局管理。 • 美国鱼类及野生动物管理局限制该区域的人类活动。 中文解析： 笔记明确指出该保护区由美国鱼类及野生动物管理局管理，且其措施是“限制人类活动”，目标是为了保护轻足秧鸡的栖息地。选项A将这三点信息（管理者、具体措施、保护目标）直接联系，最有效地强调了该机构在保护栖息地中的直接作用和角色。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ●The cuneiform script is the earliest known set of symbols used for writing. ●Sumerian was one of the first languages to be written using the cuneiform script. ●Sumerian was a language in ancient Mesopotamia (present day Iraq). ●Clay tablets with Sumerian writing have been found there. ●Some of these tablets are almost 5,000 years old.

The student wants to identify a language that was written using the cuneiform script. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Examples of Mesopotamian writing that are nearly 5,000 years old have been found.
B. A language in ancient Mesopotamia used the cuneiform script for writing.
C. Clay tablets with cuneiform script have been found in present-day Iraq.
D. Sumerian, an ancient Mesopotamian language, was written using the cuneiform script.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记： • 楔形文字是已知最早的一套书写符号。 • 苏美尔语是最早使用楔形文字书写的一种语言。 • 苏美尔语是古代美索不达米亚（今伊拉克）的一种语言。 • 那里发现了刻有苏美尔文字的泥板。 • 其中一些泥板有近5000年的历史。 中文解析： 问题要求明确指出“一种用楔形文字书写过的语言”。选项D “Sumerian, an ancient Mesopotamian language, was written using the cuneiform script.” 直接、完整地包含了“语言”和“用楔形文字书写”这两个关键信息，因此最有效。

question:
Zygomorphic (bilaterally symmetric) flowers remain open and functional on average 1.1 days longer than actionomorphic (radially symmetric) flowers do. Ruby E. Stephens and colleagues claim that this extended period could be______ the relatively small pool of potential pollinators available to zygomorphic flowers and the greater chance at successful pollination that remaining open affords them.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 左右对称花（两侧对称花）平均比辐射对称花保持开放和有效功能的时间长1.1天。Ruby E. Stephens及其同事声称，这一延长的时期可能______左右对称花可用的潜在传粉者数量相对较少，以及保持开放给它们带来的更高成功授粉几率。 答案解析： 句子前半句描述现象（花期延长），后半句给出两个可能的原因（传粉者少、保持开放提高成功率）。这种结构最需要表示“原因解释”的逻辑连接。“attributed to”意为“归因于”，analogous to（类似于）；magnified by（被...放大）；converted by（被...转化）均不符合语境

question:
The following text is from Charles Dickens’s 1861 novel Great Expectations. The narrator is taking a walk near his home on a damp morning. On every rail and gate, wet lay clammy, and the marsh mist was so thick, that the wooden finger on the post directing people to our village—a direction which they never accepted , for they never came there—was invisible to me until I was quite close under it.

As used in the text, what does the word “accepted” most nearly mean?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 查尔斯·狄更斯1861年小说《远大前程》选段。叙述者在一个潮湿的早晨在家附近散步。 "每一条栏杆和门上都湿漉漉地附着湿气，沼泽的雾气如此浓重，以至于杆子上指示人们前往我们村子的木制指路牌——一个他们从未______的方向，因为他们从未来过那里——直到我走到它正下方才看见。" 答案解析： "accepted"在此语境中指人们从未"遵循"或"采纳"路牌指引的方向前往村庄。选项中的"followed"（遵循）最贴近此处的逻辑：路牌指示方向，但他们从未按此方向行进。其他选项"shifted"（改变）、"approved"（批准）、"authorized"（授权）均不符合"接受并遵循指引"的语义。

question:
Analysis of preserved plants cataloged in the United States Virtual Herbarium indicates that rising temperatures correlate with earlier leaf production, but such specimens represent only brief moments in plants’ overall development. ______ this research with studies involving live plants would enable a fuller understanding of how these observed changes affect plant fitness.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 对美国虚拟植物标本馆中保存植物的分析表明，气温升高与叶片更早萌发相关，但这些标本仅代表植物整体发育中的短暂瞬间。将这项研究与涉及活体植物的研究______，将能更全面地理解观察到的变化如何影响植物适应性。 答案解析： 此处需要表达“补充、结合”的含义，因为活体植物研究可以弥补标本研究的局限，从而获得更全面的理解。"Complementing"（补充）准确体现了这种研究方法上的互补关系。其他选项中，"Foregrounding"（突出）、"Categorizing"（分类）、"Anticipating"（预测）均不符合“结合两种研究以完善认知”的逻辑。

question:
Although Mistress and Maid , which depicts two women perusing a letter, is atypical of Johannes Vermeer’s genre paintings (scenes of everyday life) in that its subjects are set against a plain background instead of—as in Woman with a Pearl Necklace —a richly detailed one, the painting nonetheless _______many signature traits of Vermeer’s art, including realistic rendering of natural light.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目翻译： 尽管《夫人与女仆》（描绘了两名女性细读信件的场景）在背景简朴而非如《戴珍珠项链的女人》那般细节丰富这一点上，并不属于约翰内斯·维米尔典型的“风俗画”（日常生活场景），但这幅画仍_______维米尔艺术的许多标志性特点，包括对自然光的写实描绘。 答案解析： 逻辑上，前后形成转折：虽然背景简朴不典型，但仍体现了维米尔的标志性特征。"evinces"意为“显示、表明”，能准确表达此关系。其他选项："repudiates"（拒绝）、"predates"（早于）、"eschews"（避免）均与语境中的转折含义及“保留特征”的语义相悖。

question:
Technological advances have prompted companies to increasingly rely on automation to streamline production. Armin Granulo and colleagues, however, found that for products with higher symbolic value (those viewed as contributing to individual self-expression), consumers prefer products made by humans rather than by robots, likely because human-made products are more strongly associated with uniqueness. When considering automation, therefore, companies — especially those special izing in products of symbolic value — should weigh trade-offs between efficiency gains and consumer preferences.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It refers to a finding presented in the previous sentence to recommend that companies that value product quality reconsider automating their production processes.
B. It emphasizes that a research finding discussed in the text has practical implications that are particularly relevant for businesses making a certain class of product.
C. It presents evidence supporting the text’s argument that consumers prefer products with high symbolic value over products with low symbolic value.
D. It illustrates the need for additional research to evaluate the claim in the previous sentence that automation affects how consumers
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 技术进步促使公司日益依赖自动化来简化生产。然而，Armin Granulo及其同事发现，对于具有较高象征价值（被认为有助于个人自我表达）的产品，消费者更喜欢人造而非机器制造的产品，这可能是因为人造产品更强烈地与独特性相关联。因此，在考虑自动化时，公司——特别是那些专营象征价值产品的公司——应该权衡效率提升与消费者偏好之间的取舍。 答案解析： 画线句（"When considering automation..."）基于前文的研究发现，为特定类型企业（生产高象征价值产品的企业）提出了具体的商业实践建议，强调这一研究发现的现实指导意义。选项B准确抓住了其“强调研究发现对特定类别产品的企业具有实际启示”的功能。

question:
Text 1 To many artists in the mid-nineteenth-century United States, the American wilderness symbolized innocence and untouched beauty. So George Inness’s decision to foreground a railroad in his 1855 painting The Lackawanna Valley is notable, since images of railroads often alluded to the destruction of wilderness in the name of progress. In fact, art historian Nicolai Cikovsky Jr. argues that Inness glorifies the subject of the railroad by painting a scene that suggests hopefulness rather than devastation. Text 2 It is impossible to deduce anything about George Inness’s similarity to other painters of his time from The Lackawanna Valley . In fact, this painting is often used by scholars to highlight a key contrast: while many of his contemporaries avoided depicting industrial elements, Inness made the railroad a harmonious part of the landscape, showing his distinct artistic stance.

Which choice best describes a difference in how the author of Text 1 and the author of Text 2 view the painting The Lackawanna Valley ?
selections: A. The author of Text 1 implies that the styles and themes of the painting are atypical of Inness's body of work, whereas the author of Text 2 claims that the painting is representative of Inness as a painter.

B. The author of Text 1 suggests that the painting can reveal information about Inness's opinions, whereas the author of Text 2 believes that the circumstances of the painting's production prohibit such an interpretation.
C. The author of Text 1 claims that the painting is an accurate representation of a physical place, whereas the author of Text 2 identifies several embellishments that Inness made to alter the scene.

D. The author of Text 1 emphasize the painting’s similarities to the works of other painters at the time, whereas the author of Text 2 uses the painting to exemplify a contrast between Inness and some of his contemporaries
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 文本1： 对于19世纪中期的许多美国艺术家来说，美国荒野象征着纯真与未被玷污的美。因此，乔治·英尼斯在其1855年的画作《拉克瓦纳山谷》中将铁路置于前景的决定是值得注意的，因为铁路的图像常被用以暗喻以进步为名对荒野的破坏。事实上，艺术史学家尼古拉·契科夫斯基认为，英尼斯通过描绘一幅暗示希望而非毁灭的场景，美化了铁路这一主题。 文本2： 从《拉克瓦纳山谷》中无法推断出乔治·英尼斯与同时代其他画家的相似之处。事实上，这幅画常被学者们用来突显一个关键对比：尽管他的许多同代人避免描绘工业元素，但英尼斯却将铁路作为风景中和谐的一部分，这展现了他独特的艺术立场。 答案解析： 文本1作者虽未明说，但隐含该画可能与其他画家在描绘铁路主题上有相似性（都涉及“进步”意象）；文本2作者则明确指出该画常用于对比英尼斯与同期画家的差异，强调其独特性。二者在“这幅画是体现相似性还是差异性”上形成对比，因此D选项正确。

question:
The prints in Images of Autonomous Matter , part of a traveling exhibition of innovative Japanese art from the 1960s and 1970s, exemplify the interest in creating minimalist images of stark materials, such as steel, that first emerged among Japanese printmakers in the mid-to-late twentieth century. Mitsuo Kano’s close-up of a serrated metal fragment, Soldered Blue , and Tatsuo Kawaguchi’s image of a single corroded staple, which belongs to his Relation — Quality series, are two such works in the exhibit. In their emphasis on the innate qualities of manufactured materials, both prints push traditional boundaries for figurative art.

Which statement about the prints by Kano and Kawaguchi in Images of Autonomous Matter is best supported by the text?
selections: A. The portrayal of imperfection in the prints illustrates that the artists’ goal was to disrupt the carefully curated nature of most art exhibitions.
B. The objects depicted and the manner of depiction render the prints distinct from more conventional works of art.
C. The prints showcase how different methods for printing images can offer unique perspectives on stark materials.
D. The prints emulate the style of an earlier artistic movement that used simplistic compositions and featured industrial objects.
explanations: 题目翻译： 《自主物质图像》中的版画是1960-70年代日本创新艺术巡回展的一部分，它们体现了对钢铁等朴素材料创作极简图像的兴趣，这种兴趣首次出现于二十世纪中后期的日本版画家之中。Mitsuo Kano的锯齿状金属碎片特写《焊接蓝》和Tatsuo Kawaguchi的单颗锈蚀钉图像（属于他的《关系-质量》系列）是展览中的两幅此类作品。通过对人造材料内在质感的强调，这两幅版画都突破了具象艺术的传统边界。 答案解析： 文本明确指出两幅版画“通过对人造材料内在质感的强调，突破了具象艺术的传统边界”，这直接支持了B选项“所描绘的对象和描绘方式使这些版画区别于更传统的艺术作品”的说法。

question:
Arturo Casadevall et al. have confirmed that twenty mushroom species (including Marasmius capillaris and species from the genus Russula ) maintain subambient temperatures in both their fruiting bodies and their mycelium (the root-like hyphae from which the fruiting bodies grow), though the benefits of this hypothermic behavior are unclear. Noting that relative coldness was more pronounced in fruiting than in nonfruiting sites of the mycelium—a difference that persisted even after fruit ed bodies were detached—the researchers speculate that thermoregulation in the mycelium may influence reproductive success.

Which statement about the mycelium of the twenty mushroom species is best supported by the text?
selections: A. The mycelium generally maintains temperatures lower than those of the fruited bodies even when considering temperature variations between fruiting and nonfruiting sites.
B. The correlation between higher mycelium temperature and greater fruit productivity indicates that successful reproduction may be dependent on thermoregulation in the mycelium.
C. Variation in thermoregulation across the mycelium may occur independent of the presence or absence of fruited bodies.
D. Temperatures in the fruiting areas of the mycelium are lower than in the nonfruiting areas due to differences in the depth and spread of the mycelium within soil or other organic matter.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： Arturo Casadevall等人已证实20种蘑菇（包括绒小皮伞和红菇属物种）的子实体及其菌丝体（子实体生长的根状菌丝）均维持低于环境温度的低温，尽管这种低温行为的好处尚不明确。研究人员注意到，菌丝体上产子实体部位的相对低温比非产子实体部位更为明显——这一差异甚至在子实体被分离后依然存在——他们推测菌丝体的温度调节可能影响繁殖成功率。 答案解析： 文本关键依据：“这一差异（产孢区更低温）甚至在子实体被分离后依然存在”，直接支持C项“菌丝体的温度调节变化可能独立于子实体的存在与否而发生”。A项与原文“子实体部位温度更低”矛盾；B项“更高温度”与原文低温事实相反；D项提到的深度差异在原文中无依据。

question:
The following text is from William Carlos Williams’s 1925 creative nonfiction book In the American Grain . Williams is discussing how works by nineteenth-century US poet and fiction writer Edgar Allan Poe were received by American readers. Poe must suffer by his originality. Invent that which is new, even if it be made of pine from your own yard, and there’s none to know what you have done. It is because there’s no name. This is the cause of Poe’s lack of recognition. He was American. He was the astounding, inconceivable growth of his locality. Gape at him they did, and he at them in amazement. Afterward with mutual hatred; he in disgust, they in mistrust. It is only that which is under your nose that seems inexplicable.

What does the text most strongly suggest about Poe’s work and American readers?
selections: A. Poe’s work was so innovative that there was not even terminology to describe it, which led American readers to regard both the work and Poe himself as strange but quintessentially American.
B. Poe’s work had few fans among American readers because it tended to present a negative image of American life and institutions
C. American readers largely ignored Poe’s work because its tone and subject matter were out of keeping with mainstream literature.
D. American readers failed to appreciate Poe’s work because of its novelty and the fact that it reflected aspects of the American character too ingrained in those readers for them to comprehend.
explanations: 题目翻译： 以下文本出自威廉·卡洛斯·威廉姆斯1925年的创意非虚构作品《美国性格》。威廉姆斯在讨论十九世纪美国诗人兼小说家埃德加·爱伦·坡的作品如何被美国读者接受。 "坡必因其原创性而受苦。发明新事物，即使它是用你自家后院的松木制成，也没有人知道你做了什么。这是因为没有名称。这就是坡缺乏认可的原因。他是美国人。他是他那片土地惊人、不可思议的产物。他们目瞪口呆地看着他，他也惊讶地看着他们。随后互相憎恨；他感到厌恶，他们则充满怀疑。唯有近在眼前的东西……" 答案解析： 文本的核心逻辑是：坡的作品因过于原创和本土（"美国性"、" locality"），以至于没有现成名称来界定；其反映的美国特质对读者而言太过熟悉和根深蒂固（"under your nose"），反而导致无法被理解和欣赏。D项准确地捕捉了这种因“新颖性”和“反映了读者自身过于根深蒂固而无法察觉的美国特质”而导致的失败欣赏。A项错在“但本质上是美国的”并非文本强调的重点；B项的“负面形象”和C项的“与主流文学不符”在文本中均无依据。

question:
Common name Average mass (kg) Capable of flight? Great bustard 10.6 Yes Trumpeter swan 12.7 Yes Emperor penguin 31.5 No Common ostrich 104.0 No Most bird species that are capable of flight weigh less than a kilogram (kg), which is not surprising considering the burden that extra body weight puts on a flying animal. But not all flying birds are so light, as we can see most clearly in the example of the __________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the example?
selections: A. common ostrich, which has a higher average mass than the emperor penguin.
B. trumpeter swan, which has an average mass of 12.7 kg.
C. common ostrich, which has an average mass of 104.0 kg.
D. great bustard, which has an average mass below 10 kg.
explanations: 题目翻译： 大多数能够飞行的鸟类体重都小于1公斤，考虑到额外体重对飞行动物造成的负担，这并不奇怪。但并非所有飞鸟都如此轻，这一点我们可以从______的例子中看得很清楚。 答案解析： 题干强调“并非所有飞鸟都如此轻”，因此例子必须选择能飞行但体重较重的鸟。B选项“小号天鹅（平均质量12.7公斤）”是唯一既符合“能飞行”（Yes）又体现“体重明显超过1公斤”的选项。

question:
The 2002 production of I’m Not Rappaport was the first Broadway show for which Teresa Snider-Stein was credited as a costume designer. Snider-Stein was among the Broadway costume designers interviewed by Sara Jablon-Roberts and Eulanda A. Sanders for their study of historical accuracy in costume design. They argue that aesthetics often outweigh fidelity to the past among designers for shows with historical settings. In a paper for a theater class, a student claims that the costume design for a modern production of Shakespeare’s A Midsummer Night’s Dream (set in ancient Greece) exemplifies this tendency.

Which quotation from the costume designer for the modern production of A Midsummer Night’s Dream would most effectively support the student’s claim?
selections: A. “For A Midsummer Night’s Dream, I decided not to include the extra fabric that would have been typical of clothing in the period because it made the costumes unappealingly bulky.”

B. “In trying to create the period look of A Midsummer Night’s Dream , I had to make some practical compromises, such as substituting cooler modern fabrics for historically accurate woolens so that the actors didn’t overheat.”
C. “Although historically accurate costumes would have added an air of authenticity to A Midsummer Night’s Dream , they have so many layers that costume changes would have been difficult.”
D. “Costumes must always reflect the correct historical period. Too often, I’ve seen costumes that borrow from a wide span of periods, resulting in a production with a confusing visual style.”
explanations: 题目翻译： 2002年的《我不是拉帕波特》是Teresa Snider-Stein首次在百老汇作品中署名服装设计师的作品。Snider-Stein是Sara Jablon-Roberts和Eulanda A. Sanders为研究服装设计历史准确性而采访的百老汇服装设计师之一。他们认为，对于历史背景的剧目，设计师常常将美学置于对历史的忠实之上。在一篇戏剧课论文中，一名学生声称，莎士比亚《仲夏夜之梦》（背景设定在古希腊）的现代制作版服装设计体现了这种倾向。 答案解析： 题干核心是支持“设计师将美学置于历史忠实性之上”这一论点。A选项明确指出因“显得不美观（unappealingly bulky）”而放弃历史典型特征（extra fabric），直接体现了“美学考量压倒历史准确性”。B项是出于实际舒适度（practical compromises），C项是因换装难度（costume changes would have been difficult），两者均非纯粹的美学优先理由。

question:
Four European High-Speed Rail Hubs Hub Country Hub type København H Denmark existing hub (urban) Lille Europe France peripheral replacement (urban periphery) Reggio Emilia AV Mediopadana Italy distributed services (urban periphery) Stuttgart Hbf Germany existing hub (urban) Installing a new high-speed rail (HSR) hub in an area has the potential to boost residential development nearby, though the amount and type of development vary considerably by location. This potential is greatest when HSR hubs are established in areas far away from city centers, as these locations tend to have more available land for redevelopment into residential areas.

Which statement is best supported by information from the text and table?
selections: A. The area around Lille Europe has greater potential for residential development than the area around Reqg'o Emilia AV Mediopadana does.
B. The area around Lille Europe has greater potential for residential development than the area around København H does.
C. The area around Københav n H has greater potential for residential development than the area around Reggio Emilia AV Mediopadana does.
D. The area around Københav n H has greater potential for residential development than the area around Stuttgart Hbf does.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在欧洲建设新的高速铁路（HSR）枢纽有可能促进附近住宅开发，但开发的数量和类型因地点差异很大。当高铁枢纽建在远离市中心的区域时，这种潜力最大，因为这些位置往往有更多可用土地用于改造为住宅区。 答案解析： 文本指出，位于城市边缘（urban periphery）的高铁枢纽比位于市中心（urban）的枢纽具有更大的住宅开发潜力，因为边缘地区可用土地更多。根据表格，里尔欧洲站和雷焦艾米利亚站位于城市边缘，而哥本哈根站和斯图加特站在市中心。因此，里尔欧洲站（边缘）的住宅开发潜力应大于哥本哈根站（市中心），选项 B 正确。

question:
In 2004, the US state of North Dakota enacted rate stability regulations (RSRs), constraining insurance companies’ latitude to raise premiums (the periodic fees policyholders pay to maintain insurance policies) after policies are in effect. RSRs are effective at protecting existing policyholders from price volatility, but Naoki Aizawa and Ami Ko note that since dynamic pricing of premiums is an important risk-mitigation tool for insurers, RSRs may lead some insurers to scale back or entirely cease selling new policies in the affected market, thereby reducing the competitive pressure that typically restrains premium prices for new policies. Thus, North Dakota’s RSRs may _________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. be more advantageous for insurers than they are for either current or prospective policyholders.
B. benefit policyholders at the expense of nonpolicyholders seeking to acquire policies.
C. prevent large increases in premium prices for new policies despite leading to fewer insurers offering such policies in the affected market.
D. reduce premium price volatility once policies are in effect but increase risks for policyholders.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 2004年，美国北达科他州颁布了费率稳定条例（RSRs），限制保险公司在保单生效后提高保费（投保人为维持保单支付的定期费用）的自主权。RSRs能有效保护现有投保人免受价格波动影响，但Naoki Aizawa和Ami Ko指出，由于保费动态定价是保险公司重要的风险管理工具，RSRs可能导致一些保险公司减少或完全停止在受影响市场销售新保单，从而减少通常抑制新保单保费价格的竞争压力。因此，北达科他州的RSRs可能_________ 答案解析： 根据文本逻辑，RSRs通过限制涨价保护了现有投保人（existing policyholders），但可能导致保险公司退出市场，减少竞争，从而损害了寻求新保单的非投保人（prospective policyholders）的利益，因为他们可能面临更少选择或更高价格。B项准确地捕捉了这种“保护一方、损害另一方”的利益转移关系。A项“对保险公司更有利”与原文（限制定价工具）矛盾；C项“仍能防止新保单大幅涨价”与原文“减少竞争压力”可能导致涨价矛盾；D项“增加投保人风险”在原文未提及。

question:
In an analysis of medieval urbanization in York, Bautzen, and other European settlements, researchers drew on modern urban scaling theory, which posits that population density in core urban areas increases as a city grows larger. Hypothesizing that this typical relationship would have differed in medieval settlements because of the constraining influence of strong hierarchical social structures (which are much less pronounced in modern cities) on social networking and economic integration—drivers of urban agglomeration—the team created a model that accounted for the presence of restrictive institutions. They found that the typically expected density-size relationship held for each of the 173 medieval settlements whose growth they analyzed, suggesting that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the social and economic dynamics that affect urban agglomeration were likely much different in medieval settlements than in modern cities, despite the similarity across time in population density patterns.

B. although there tends to be a positive relationship between population size and development of core urban areas for both medi eval settlements and modern cities, social institutions likely limited the rate at which population density increased in medieval settlements.

C. despite a change in the role of social structures over time, there is likely a notable consistency between medieval settlements and modern cities in underlying elements of the social and economic interactions among individuals that shape the development of core urban areas.

D. the constraining influence of hierarchical medieval institutions likely had a significant effect on individuals in some social groupings but little to no effect on members of other social groupings.
explanations: 题目翻译： 在对约克、包岑等欧洲中世纪聚落城市化的分析中，研究人员借鉴了现代城市规模理论（该理论认为城市核心区人口密度随城市规模扩大而增加）。研究团队假设这一典型关系在中世纪聚落中会有所不同，原因是强大的等级社会结构（在现代城市中远不明显）会限制社会网络与经济整合（城市集聚的驱动因素）。为此他们建立了一个考虑限制性制度存在的模型。他们发现，在所分析的173个中世纪聚落中，典型的密度-规模关系仍然成立，这表明________ 答案解析： 研究发现，尽管假设等级制度会削弱驱动城市集聚的社会经济互动，但中世纪聚落仍呈现出与现代城市一致的密度-规模关系。这表明核心社会与经济互动的底层要素在不同时期具有一致性，其塑造城市发展的力量超越了表层制度差异。C项准确地抓住了这一“深层一致性”的逻辑。A项强调“差异”与发现相反；B项强调“限制了增速”与“关系依然成立”矛盾；D项的“对不同群体影响不同”在文本中无依据。

question:
Painter Georgette _______ for incorporating everyday objects from her Singaporean environment—such as lanterns, mooncakes, and tropical fruits—into her still-life compositions, was a pivotal figure in the mid-twentieth century Nanyang art movement, which sought to blend European painting traditions (including still life) with elements of Southeast Asian cultures and art.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主语Painter Georgette Chen，谓语是was，所以known for...是过去分词短语做插入语

question:
“Streetwide and bitter as hope/strewn between Ei Salvador and San Francisco.” These lines are from a poem by Chicano_______ whose early career as a campesino informs the dialogue on Mexican American politics and identity that unfolds in his work.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: writer和人名之间不加标点符号，人名后需要逗号表示短暂停顿，引出后续定语从句“whose early career...”，因此 D（无逗号）不正确。

question:
Los Angeles-based artist Henry Taylor’s large, vibrant paintings of prominent Black figures such as Olympian Alice Coachman ( See Alice Jump, 2011) and artist David Hammons ( Hammons meets a hyena on holiday , _______celebrated by admirers of twenty-first-century portraiture, attracted legions of new fans in 2024 when they were included in a popular Taylor retrospective at the Whitney Museum.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主语Los Angeles-based artist Henry Taylor’s large, vibrant paintings，谓语是attracted，所以long clebrated...是过去分词短语做插入语

question:
Among the small magazines animating London’s vibrant literary scene in the early twentieth century was_______ by Wyndham Lewis and featuring artwork by Edward Wadsworth, Frederick Etchells, and Jacob Epstein; fiction by Rebecca West and Ford Madox Ford; and a manifesto penned by Lewis, this magazine publicized the work of influential avant garde writers and artists of the day.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 文本中有两个主谓，也就是两个独立的句子，他们之间只能是用句号或者分号连接，两句话并不是并列关系，所以选B。

question:
Reena Esmail’s classical composition “Summitless Mountains” incorporates a raag, a melodic framework used in Hindustani classical music, called Raag Chandrakauns. Often, interplay between the raag’s designated vadi and samvadi (the first-and second-most important notes, respectively) and its prescribed melodic sequences______an unsettled mood.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主语为单数名词短语“interplay between... and...”，因此谓语动词需使用第三人称单数形式“evokes”。

question:
Archived within the stories libraries of Timbuktu, a West African city prominent during the Songhai Empire, is The Pearls Leading to Accepted Guidance, one of the city’s hundreds of thousands of historical manuscripts, each of which______researchers insight into Timbuktu’s tenture as a center of trade and education.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 考察从句的谓语，从句的主语为each，所以谓语应该用三单

question:
As anthropologist Cristina Grasseni explains, many artisanal cheeses in Italy, such as Castelmagno from Piedmont and Quartirolo Lombardo from Lombardy, are highly valued for their regional authenticity;______they are prized for being made using local ingredients and methods typical of their respective geographic regions.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 正如人类学家Cristina Grasseni所解释的那样，意大利的许多手工奶酪（如皮埃蒙特的Castelmagno和伦巴第的Quartirolo Lombardo）因其地域真实性而备受推崇；______它们因其使用当地原料及各自地理区域的典型方法制作而受到珍视。 中文解析： 空格前后两句为解释说明关系。后句（使用本地原料和方法）具体解释了前句所说的“地域真实性”的内涵。"that is,"（即，也就是说）引入解释或重述。

question:
The moon Valetudo orbits Jupiter in the same direction that the planet rotates. _______ Valetudo’s orbit is described as prograde. Mneme, another of Jupiter’s moons, orbits in the opposite direction, so its orbit is described with the opposite term: retrograde.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 木卫六十二（Valetudo）绕木星公转的方向与木星自转方向相同。_______其轨道被描述为顺行。木卫四十（Mneme）作为木星的另一颗卫星，公转方向相反，因此其轨道用相反的术语描述：逆行。 中文解析： 空格前陈述了事实（公转方向与行星自转相同），空格后是据此得出的定义或结论（轨道被称为prograde）。这是一种因果关系，需选用表示“因此”的过渡词。

question:
For several centuries after the birth of opera in sixteenth-century Florence, Italian remained the default language in which most opera scores were written._______ opera singers today, such as the soprano Amira Selim, encounter a wide range of Italian terms—from affettuoso (with feeling) to accelerando (at an accelerating tempo)—when following many eighteenth-century opera scores.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目翻译： 自16世纪歌剧诞生于佛罗伦萨后的数百年间，意大利语一直是大多数歌剧乐谱的默认书写语言。_______今天的歌剧演唱者，如女高音Amira Selim，在研习许多18世纪的歌剧乐谱时，仍会遇到大量的意大利语术语——从affettuoso（富有感情地）到accelerando（渐快地）。 中文解析： 空格前是历史背景（意大利语曾是歌剧默认语言），空格后是延续至今的结果（现代歌手仍需接触这些意大利术语）。这是一种因果延续关系

question:
The Rajahnate of Butuan, a sea power based on Mindanao island in the Philippines that reached the height of its influence around 1100 CE, is classified as a thalassocracy. Thalassocracies are generally considered distinct from tellurocracies, or land-based powers. _______the British Empire (1600s-1900s CE) notably extended its hegemony across both land and sea.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目翻译： 武端王国（Rajahnate of Butuan）是一个以菲律宾棉兰老岛为基础的海上强权，在公元1100年左右达到影响力顶峰，被归类为海权国家（thalassocracy）。海权国家通常被认为不同于陆权国家（tellurocracies）。_______大英帝国（公元1600-1900年代）显著地将其霸权同时扩展到陆地和海洋。 中文解析： 上下文逻辑为：前两句定义并区分了“海权国家”和“陆权国家”两种概念。空格后举例的“大英帝国同时掌控陆海霸权”，其特点不符合前文设定的严格区分，反而使两者的界限变得模糊。因此，"Blurring this line"（模糊了这一界限）最符合此处的转折与例证逻辑。其他选项"Exemplifying this distinction"（例证这一区别）、"Underscoring this difference"（强调这一不同）、"Supporting this claim"（支持这一说法）均与例句的实际作用相悖。

question:
According to climate envelope models, individual organisms that inhabit the coolest areas of their species’ geographic distribution are expected to benefit from a warming climate, while individuals in the warmest areas will struggle. A 2024 University of Arizona study, ______found that warmer-than-average temperatures resulted in a decrease in growth across all areas of the common piñon tree’s distribution range.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目翻译： 根据气候生态位模型，生活在物种地理分布中最冷区域的个体预计会受益于气候变暖，而生活在最暖区域的个体则会艰难生存。一项2024年亚利桑那大学的研究，______发现高于平均温度导致了普通矮松分布范围内所有区域的生长量下降。 答案解析： 前后句为转折关系。前句是模型的普遍预测（冷暖区反应不同），后句是研究的实际发现（所有区域都受负面影响），两者在结论上存在矛盾。"though"（然而）能准确引入这一意外或相反的发现。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ●Birthday Party is a 1957 black-and-white linocut print by Black American artist Margaret Burroughs. ●It depicts a tranquil, everyday scene (a group of children celebrating). ●Amanzi Amthatha (“The cold water takes him”) is a 2001 black-and-white linocut print by South African artist Nomathemba Tana. ●It features a scene with an explicitly political point of view (a Xhosa warrior fighting British colonial rule). ●Relief printing is a technique in which an image is carved onto a printing block, covered in ink or paint, and stamped

The student wants to contrast the subject matter of the two prints. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The print by Tana is a black-and-write linocut; by contrast, Burroughs’s is a relief print.
B. Burroughs made B irthday Party in 1957, while Tana made Amanzi Amthatha (“The cold water takes him”) later, in 2001.
C. Tana’s print expresses an explicitly political point of view, while Burroughs’s depicts a tranquil, everyday scene.
D. The scenes depicted in both works were first carved onto a printing block, then stamped onto paper; however, one work is a linocut, while the other is a relief print.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： ●一位学生在研究某个主题时记录了以下笔记： ●《生日派对》是美国黑人艺术家玛格丽特·伯勒斯于1957年创作的一幅黑白亚麻油毡版画。 ●它描绘了一个宁静的日常场景（一群孩子在庆祝）。 ●《Amanzi Amthatha》（“冷水带走了他”）是南非艺术家诺玛坦巴·塔纳于2001年创作的一幅黑白亚麻油毡版画。 ●它具有明确政治观点的场景（一位科萨武士与英国殖民统治抗争）。 ●浮雕印刷是一种将图像刻在印刷版上、涂上油墨或颜料、然后进行压印的技术。 答案解析： 题干明确要求“对比主题内容”。笔记中对两幅画的描述核心差异在于：Burroughs的画是“宁静的日常场景”，而Tana的画是“具有明确政治观点”。选项C直接、准确地对比了这一主题差异。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ●Researchers Gwangsu Kim et al. sought to explore the relationship between the brain’s ability to process natural sounds and its ability to process music. ●They used an artificial deep neural network (DNN) that models how the brain processes auditory information. The DNN had been trained to detect natural sounds (excluding music). ●Finding: The DNN spontaneously developed neurons that responded to music but not to other auditory stimuli. ●Conclusion: The brain’s ability to process music may arise as a by-product of natural sound processing.

The student wants to present the aim of the study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Using an artificial deep neural network the researchers sought to explore the relationship between the brain’s ability to process natural sounds and its ability to process music.
B. The researchers used an artificial deep neural network, which spontaneously developed neurons that responded to music but not to other auditory stimuli.
C. By training an artificial deep neural network, the researchers aimed to establish that the brain’s ability to process natural sounds arises as a by-product of processing music.
D. In their study, the researchers evaluated whether an artificial deep neural network trained only on natural sounds would develop neurons that respond to music.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一位学生在研究某个主题时记录了以下笔记： 1.研究人员Gwangsu Kim等人试图探索大脑处理自然声音的能力与处理音乐的能力之间的关系。 2.他们使用了一个模拟大脑处理听觉信息方式的人工深度神经网络（DNN）。该DNN曾被训练用于检测自然声音（不包括音乐）。 3.发现：DNN自发地产生了对音乐有反应但不对其他听觉刺激有反应的神经元。 4.结论：大脑处理音乐的能力可能是自然声音处理的副产品。 中文解析： 研究的目的在笔记第一点中明确表述为“探索大脑处理自然声音与处理音乐能力之间的关系”。选项A直接、完整地复现了这一目的陈述。选项B描述的是发现，而非目的；选项C的因果方向与笔记结论（音乐能力是自然声音处理的副产品）相反；选项D（按完整版）描述的是研究方法或检验的问题，而非研究的整体目的。

question: The function f is defined by the equation f ( x ) = 5 x − 6 . What is the value of f ( x ) when x = 10 ?
explanations: 把x=10代入函数式f(x)=5x-6计算可得结果为44。

question: On a certain day in June, the lowest recorded wind speed in a town was 5 miles per hour (mph) and the highest recorded wind speed was 14 mph. Which inequality is true for all values of w , where w represents any wind speed, in mph, recorded in the town on this day?
explanations: 最低风速5，最高风速14，那风速的范围就是D选项。

question: What value of p is the solution to the equation 4 p − 5 p = 14 ?

A polygon with 22 sides has a perimeter of 131 inches. The length of one side is 5 inches. The other 21 sides have equal lengths. What is the length, in inches, of one of the 21 sides with equal lengths?
explanations: 考查多边形的周长等于所有边长的和，其中一条边长是5，那剩余21条边的长度之和就是周长131减去5，即126；剩下所有的边长一致，所以每条边的长度就是126/21=6，故答案为6。

question: To purchase a used car at a total price of 13,000 dollars, a onetime down payment is required, and then fixed monthly payments are made for the remaining amount owed for the car. The equation 13 , 000 = 2 , 600 + 260 t represents this situation, where t is the number of fixed monthly payments that are made. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 260 in this context?
selections: A. The amount, in dollars, of the down payment
B. The amount, in dollars, of each fixed monthly payment
C. The total amount, in dollars, paid for the car after t fixed monthly payments
D. The total number of fixed monthly payments
explanations: 考查线性函数的解释，13000=2600+260t，其中13000是总价，那固定的数字2600就是首付，t表示还贷款的月数，那260就是每月需偿还的金额，故选B。

question: If 3 − 2 x = 42 , what is the value of 1 6 ( 3 − 2 x ) ?
The ratio 72 to m is equivalent to the ratio 4 to 24. What is the value of m ?
explanations: 根据题意可得 72 m = 4 24 ，计算可得m=432，故选D。

question: ( z + 4 ) ( z − 6 ) = 0 What are all possible solutions to the given equation?
explanations: 让两个小括号的式子分别等于0即可得到方程的解为-4或者6，故选B。

question: 7 x − 8 y = x 2 7 x − 8 y = 36 A solution to the given system of equations is ( x , y ) , where x is positive. What is the value of x ?
explanations: 因为7x-8y=7x-8y，所以 x 2 = 36 ，求解可得x为6或者-6，因为题目中说了x是正数，所以x只能是6。

question: The table shows four values of x and their corresponding values of y . There is a linear relationship between x and y . Which of the following equations represents this relationship?
explanations: 将表格中的数字代入检验可得正确答案为A。

question:
For a rational function f , the table shows three values of x and their corresponding values of f ( x ) .
    Which of the following could be the graph of y = f ( x ) ?
explanations: 对比图表中的x等于-4,0,8的时候对应的y值是否与表格中一致，答案为D。

question: A real estate company offers a series of three webinars. 3,125 people attended the first webinar. 56% of the people who attended the first webinar attended the second webinar, and 26% of the people who attended the first and second webinars attended the third webinar. How many people attended all three webinars?
explanations: 参加第一次会议的有3125人，参加第二次会议的有3125*56%=1750人，参加第三次会议的有1750*26=455人，这455人三次会议都参加了，故答案为455。

question: For how many of the 9 data points is the actual y -value greater than the y -value predicted by the line of best fit?
explanations: 图表中有5个点在线上，所以这5个点的实际y值比预测的y值大。

question: What is the value of tan ⁡ X in the triangle shown?
explanations: tan是对边比临边，也就是tanX =168/126=4/3，故选D。

question: The expression 15 x ( x 2 + 9 ) is equivalent to a x 3 + b x 2 + c x , where a , b , and c are constants. What is the value of a b c ?
explanations: 15 x ( x 2 + 9 ) 计算出来只有3次项和一次项，没有二次项，所以b=0，故abc=0，即答案为0。

question: In the xy -plane, an equation of circle R is ( x + 8 ) 2 + ( y + 19 ) 2 = 100 . Circle S is obtained by shifting circle R to the right 3 units. An equation defining circle S is ( x + h ) 2 + ( y + k ) 2 = 100 , where h and k are constants. What is the value of h ?
explanations: 圆R的圆心为（-8，-19），向右平移3个单位，那就变成了（-5，-19），所以圆S的方程就是 ( x + 5 ) 2 + ( y + 19 ) 2 = 100 ，也就是h=5，故答案为5。

question: On January 1, there were 237 views of a video posted on a social media site. Every 2 days after January 1, the number of views of the video had increased by 70% of the number of views 2 days earlier. The function j gives the predicted number of views x days after January 1. Which equation defines f ( x ) ?
explanations: 增加了70%，那底数就是1+70%=1.7；每两天增加70%，那就是2天为一个周期，一共x天，也就是x/2个周期，故选C。

question: Note: Figure not drawn to scale. Triangle TUV is dilated by a scale factor of 1 2 to obtain triangle T ′ U ′ V ′ (not shown), where T corresponds to T ′ and U corresponds to U ′ . What is the measure, in degrees, of angle V ′ ?
explanations: 三角形TUV扩大1/2倍得到T’U’V’，那两个三角形就是相似三角形，相似三角形对应的角大小相等，所以∠V’=∠V=26°，故选A。

question: f ( x ) = 4 x 2 + 16 x + 22 The function f is defined by the given equation. The function h is defined by h ( x ) = f ( x ) + 9 . What is the minimum value of h ( x ) ?
7 ( 5 x ) + 9 ( 8 y ) = 189 7 ( 5 x ) − 9 ( 8 y ) = − 819 The solution to the given system of equations is ( x , y ) . What is the value of 5 x + 8 y ?
explanations: 将上下两个式子相加可得14（5x）=-630，故5x=-45；用上面的式子减去下面的式子可得18（8y）=1008，故8y=56；所以5x+8y=-45+56=11，故选C

question: For the polynomial function when f ( x ) is divided by x − 8 , the remainder is 9. Which of the following must be true about the graph of y = f ( x ) in the xy -plane?
selections: A. It passes through the point ( 9 , − 8 ) .
B. It passes through the point ( − 8 , 9 )
C. It passes through the point ( 9 , 8 )
D. It passes through the point ( 8 , 9 )
explanations: 根据题意f(x)=（x-8）（）（）（）...+9，所以当x=8时，f(x)=9，即该函数通过（8,9）这个点，故选D。

question: The line segment shown in the xy -plane represents side JK of isosceles triangle JKL , where side JL is congruent to side KL . The perimeter of this triangle is 13 17 units. What is the length, in units, of side JL of this triangle?
explanations: 图形中的线段表示JK，那JK的长度是 ( − 7 − 5 ) 2 + ( 4 − 7 ) 2 = 3 17 ；JL和KL全等，那就是JL和KL是相等的两个腰；三角形周长是 13 17 ，那JL的长度就是 ( 13 17 − 3 17 ) / 2 = 5 17 ，故选C。

question: In triangle JKL , the measures of ∠ K and ∠ L are each 51. What is the measure of ∠ J , in degrees? (Disregard the degree symbol when entering your answer.)
explanations: 考查三角形的内角和是180度，180-51*2=78，故答案为78。

question: The table shows three values of x and their corresponding values of y for the equation y = 7 ( 2 ) x + 8 . In the table, a is a constant. What is the value of a ?

The figure shows the xy -plane with the quadrants labeled. The graph of a linear function h (not shown), where y = h ( x ) , is a line completely contained in only quadrants I and II of the xy -plane. Which of the following could define the function h ?
explanations: 直线的图像只在第一二象限，那只能是跟x轴平行，故选C。

question: The scatterplot shows the relationship between two variables, x and y . Which of the following equations is the most appropriate quadratic model for the data shown?
explanations: 考查二次函数的图像问题，抛物线开口向下，所以二次项系数应该为负数，故答案应该是A或者B；根据图像，（49,35）差不多是该函数的顶点值，根据该顶点值确定答案为A。

question: A researcher is designing a study to investigate the average number of hours students at a high school spend reading per day. The researcher will report an estimated average number of hours students at the high school spend reading per day with an associated margin of error. The researcher is considering using a random sample of either 90 or 180 students from the high school. Which of the following would be the most likely effect of using the larger random sample compared to the smaller random sample?
selections: A. The reported margin of error would be lower
B. The reported margin of error would be higher
C. The reported average number of hours would be lower.
D. The reported average number of hours would be higher.
explanations: 考查margin of error，样本数量越大，margin of error越小，故选A。

question: 4 x 2 + x − 7 = 0 What is the greatest solution to the given equation?
explanations: 考查一元二次方程 a x 2 + b x + c = 0 的求根公式 x = − b ± b 2 − 4 a c 2 a ，将该题的方程中对应的数字代入求根公式计算可得AB为方程的解，较大的为B，故选B。

question: If 16 + 1 4 ( 7 x − 6 ) = 3 4 ( 7 x − 6 ) . what is the value of 7 x − 6 ?
explanations: 整理方程可得 16 = 1 2 ( 7 x − 6 ) ，故7x-6=32，所以答案为32。

question: 8 x − 7 y = 5 4 x + y = 8 The solution to the given system of equations is ( x , y ) . What is the value of x + y ?
explanations: 求解该方程组可得x=61/36,y=11/9，故x+y=35/12，所以答案是35/12。

question: H = 2.419 L + 22.83 A group of biology students conducted an experiment to study the relationship between a person's femur length and the person's height. The given equation describes the relationship between the length L , in inches, of a student's femur and the student's estimated height H , in inches, for the students in the group. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 2.419 in this context?
selections: A. The increase in a student's estimated height, in inches, for each increase of 1 inch in the student's femur length
B. The increase in a student's femur length, in inches, for each increase of 1 inch in the student's estimated height
C. The increase in a student's femur length, in inches, for each increase of 22.83 inches in the student's estimated height
D. The estimated height, in inches, of a student whose femur has a length of L inches
explanations: 考查线性函数的解释，y=mx+b，其中斜率m表达的是x每增长1，y就会增长m，符合该说法的是A，故答案为A。

question: 0.10 x + 0.20 y = 0.17 ( x + y ) The equation gives a volume x , in gallons, of a 10% saltwater solution that could be mixed with a volume y , in gallons, of a 20% saltwater solution to produce a 17% saltwater solution. According to this equation, what volume, in gallons, of the 20% saltwater solution could be mixed with 75.0 gallons of the 10% saltwater solution to produce a 17% saltwater solution? (Assume that the volume of the mixture is the sum of the volumes of the two solutions before they were mixed.)
explanations: 根据0.10x+0.20y=0.17(x+y)计算可得7x=3y；将x=75代入该式可得y=175，故答案为175。

question: y < 15 x + 13 For which of the following tables are all the values of x and their corresponding values of y solutions to the given inequality?

In the xy -plane, line h passes through the point ( 0 , 0 ) and is perpendicular to the line represented by the equation − 3 x + y = 20 . If line h also passes through the point ( 18 , t ) , what is the value of t ?
explanations: 将-3x+y=20整理为标准式y=3x+20，故该直线的斜率为3；因为line h与该直线垂直，所以line h的斜率为 − 1 3 ；因为line h通过（0,0），所以line h的表达式为 y = − 1 3 x ；将x=18代入该式可得t=-6,故选B。

question: Which system of linear equations has no solution?
explanations: 考查两根直线的交点问题，A和C选项调整一下正负号发现是两个相同的式子，故有无穷多解；B选项两根直线的斜率不同，故有一个解；所以答案为D。

question: f ( x ) = 6 , 000 ( 1.003 ) 2 x The given function f models the balance of a bank account, in dollars, x years after it is opened. Which statement is the best interpretation of ( 1.003 ) 2 x ?
selections: A. Every 6 months, the balance increases by about $ 3 .
B. Every 2 years, the balance increases by about $ 3
C. At the end of every 6-month interval, the balance increases by about 0.3% of the balance at the beginning of the 6-month interval.
D. At the end of ever 2-year interval, the balance increases by about 0.3% of the balance at the beginning of the 2-year interval
explanations: 1.003表示1+0.3%，故排除AB；指数2x表示x/(1/2)，也就是1/2年为一个周期，1/2年表示6个月，故选C。

question: Which of the following is a factor of the expression 2 x 2 + ( 18 r + 5 ) x + 45 r , where r is a nonzero constant? i. x + 9 r ii. 2 x + 5 r
explanations: 考查二次函数的因式分解，原式可因式分解为（2x+5）（x+9r），故I是原式的一个因式，II不是，所以选A。

question: The equation 5 | x − 8 | = k , where k is a constant, has exactly one solution. Which of the following could be the value of k 5 ?
explanations: 考查绝对值方程；当绝对值方程等于0时，方程只有一个解，即k=0，那k/5=0，故选C。

question: Each of the following frequency tables represents a data set. Which of these frequency tables represents the data set with the smallest standard deviation?
explanations: 考查标准差的基本定义，一组数据越集中，即越多的数字靠近平均值，这组数据的标准差越小，故选D。

question: The quadratic function g models the depth, in meters, below the surface of the water of a Weddell seal t minutes after the seal entered the water during a dive. The function estimates that the seal reached its maximum depth of 382.2 meters 7 minutes after it entered the water and then reached the surface of the water 14 minutes after it entered the water. Based on the function, what was the estimated depth, to the nearest meter, of the seal 10 minutes after it entered the water?
explanations: 根据给出的最大值可列出该二次函数的顶点式 g ( t ) = a ( t − 7 ) 2 + 382.2 ，将（14,0）代入该函数求解可得a=- 7.8，故函数表达式为 g ( t ) = − 7.8 ( t − 7 ) 2 + 382.2 ；将t=10代入计算可得答案为312。

question: f ( x ) = 11 x 10 + 3 x 8 g ( x ) = − 17 x 7 + 9 x 5 The polynomial p ( x ) is defined as the product of the given polynomials, f ( x ) and g ( x ) . What is the coefficient of x 15 in p ( x ) ?

A scientist studied the effects of mixing two chemicals, chemical A and chemical B , by gradually adding more of each chemical to a mixture of the two chemicals. At the start of the study, the mass of chemical A in the mixture was equal to the mass of chemical B in the mixture. From the start of the study to the end of the study, the mass of chemical A in the mixture increased by 2,600% and the mass of chemical B in the mixture increased by 380%. At the end of the study, approximately how many times greater was the mass of chemical A in the mixture than the mass of chemical B in the mixture?
explanations: 设最初A和B的数量均为x，实验结束时A的数量为（1+2600%）x=27x，B的数量为（1+380%）x=4.8x；(27x)/(4.8x)=5.625，故选D。

question: r 2 + q r = 8 r − 87 In the given equation, q is an integer constant. The given equation has no real solutions. What is the largest possible value of q ?
explanations: 考查一元二次方程 a x 2 + b x + c = 0 根的个数，当 b 2 − 4 a c < 0 时，方程无解；将题目中的方程整理成标准的一元二次方程为 r 2 + ( q − 8 ) r + 87 = 0 ，代入 b 2 − 4 a c < 0 计算可得 − 2 87 + 8 < q < 2 87 + 8 ，因为q是整数，所以q最大是26，故答案为26。

question: An isosceles right triangle has a perimeter of 34 + 34 2 inches. What is the length, in inches, of one leg of this triangle?
explanations: 等腰直角三角形的周长是 34 + 34 2 ，如果两个直角边之和是34，那一条直角边就是17，斜边就是 17 2 ，此刻周长和题干中的不相同，此种情况不成立；那直角边之和只能是 34 2 ，那一条直角边就是 17 2 ，斜边就是34，周长符合题干，此情况成立；故选B。

question:
The following text is adapted from Jhumpa Lahiri’s 2003 novel The Namesake . Gogol is an elementary school student in Massachusetts. In art class, his favorite hour of the week, he carves his name with paper clips into the bottoms of clay cups and bowls. He pastes uncooked pasta to cardboard, and leaves his signature in fat brush strokes below paintings.

As used in the text, what does the word “leaves” most nearly mean?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文字改编自朱帕·拉希里2003年的小说《同名人》。戈戈尔是马萨诸塞州的一名小学生。 在艺术课上（他每周最喜欢的时刻），他用回形针在黏土杯碗的底部刻下自己的名字。他将未煮熟的意大利面粘贴到纸板上，并在画作下方用粗犷的笔触“留下”自己的签名。 答案解析： 文中“leaves”与“signature”（签名）搭配，在艺术创作语境下引申为“写下”或“留下”签名的意思。选项D “Writes”（书写）最贴合此处的动作含义。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Several scholars of children’s literature recently _____ to discuss the work of Jerry Pinkney, illustrator of such lauded books as The Talking Eggs : A Folktale from the American South . Once together, they talked about his style, influences, and themes.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 几位儿童文学学者最近 _____，以讨论杰里·平克尼（曾为《说话的蛋：美国南方民间故事》等备受赞誉的书籍绘制插图）的作品。他们聚在一起后，探讨了他的风格、影响与主题。 答案解析： 空格后的“Once together”（一旦聚在一起）明确提示学者们是“聚集/召开会议”进行讨论。选项中只有 C convened（召集，集合）能准确表达“为讨论而聚集”的意思，且与上下文逻辑紧密衔接。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
The following text is from Thomas Hardy’s 1874 novel Far from the Madding Crowd . Bathsheba and Liddy are traveling down a road when Liddy points out a neighbor whom Bathsheba hasn’t met yet. Liddy looked. “That! That’s Farmer Boldwood—of course ‘tis — the man you couldn't see the other day when he called.” “Oh, Farmer Boldwood” murmured Bathsheba, and looked at him as he outstripped them. The farmer had never turned his head once, but with eyes fixed on the most advanced point along the road, passed as unconsciously and abstractly as if Bathsheba and her charms were thin air.

As used in the text, what does the phrase  “most advanced” most nearly mean?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文本选自托马斯·哈代1874年的小说《远离尘嚣》。芭丝谢芭和莉蒂正沿路行走时，莉蒂指出了一个芭丝谢芭尚未见过的邻居。 莉蒂看了看。“那是农夫波德伍德——当然是他——就是那天他来拜访时你没见到的那个人。”“哦，农夫波德伍德，”芭丝谢芭低声说，并看着他超过了她们。农夫一次也没有回头，而是双眼“紧盯着路上最 ______ 的一点”，毫无知觉、心不在焉地走过，仿佛芭丝谢芭和她的魅力稀薄如空气。 答案解析： 文中描述农夫目光锁定在“路上最 ______ 的一点”，结合“他超过了她们”以及“双眼固定在路上某一点”的语境，应理解为“视野前方最远处”。选项 D Farthest（最远的）最符合这一空间描述。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Though Vasily Grossman’s novel Stalingrad is not as beloved as his later work Everything Flows , some critics commend it despite its mangling by Soviet censors: Marcel Theroux in The Guardian called it “lucid and readable.” Several draft versions have been ______, and translators consulted those drafts when working on what they hoped would be a definite English edition.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 尽管瓦西里·格罗斯曼的小说《斯大林格勒》不如他后来的作品《一切都是流动的》那样受人喜爱，但一些评论家仍称赞它——尽管它曾被苏联审查机构篡改：《卫报》的马塞尔·泰鲁称它“清晰易读”。这部小说的几份草稿版本被 ____，译者在努力完成他们希望成为权威英文版本时参考了这些草稿。 答案解析： 后半句提到译者在翻译时consulted those drafts（参考了这些草稿），说明草稿需要被保存下来才能被参考。因此，空格应填入表示“保存、保留”的词。选项 C preserved 最符合语境逻辑。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
How does the friction between different surfaces and a rolling object affect the speed of the object? One way to explore this question is to use the scientific method. This method involves forming a hypothesis, conducting an experiment, collecting data, and drawing a conclusion. Using the scientific method helps us understand how things work and helps us answer questions, such as the one about friction and a rolling object.

Which choice best describes the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To criticize an experiment scientists conducted about friction and a rolling object
B. To explain one way to answer the question about friction and a rolling object
C. To summarize two sides of a scientific debate
D. To describe the career of a famous scientist
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 不同表面与滚动物体之间的摩擦力如何影响物体的速度？探索这个问题的一种方法是使用科学方法。该方法包括提出假设、进行实验、收集数据并得出结论。使用科学方法能帮助我们理解事物运作的原理，并帮助我们回答诸如上述关于摩擦力和滚动物体的问题。 答案解析： 文本围绕“如何探索摩擦力对滚动物体速度的影响”这一问题展开，核心是介绍“科学方法”作为解答该问题的一种途径。选项 B “解释回答关于摩擦力和滚动物体问题的一种方法”准确概括了文本主旨。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Text 1 Economist Thomas Piketty’ s book Capital in the Twenty-First Century has a more rigorous structure than its sequel, Capital and Ideology . While the first book’ s chapters all contribute to bolstering a clear, coherent argument about income inequality, the second book’ s digressions on subjects such as the various constitutions of France do not just make the book tedious but also muddy its reasoning. Text 2 Capital and Ideology has different aims than Piketty’s earlier books. It should be judged not just in the context of Piketty' s previous work but placed next to books like William T. Vollmann’ s Rising Up and Rising Down , in which the stated theme of justifications for violent acts is mainly an excuse for a polymath to map his own mind. Even when sections do not explicitly support the central thesis, they link to each other in intriguing ways. None of them should be considered extraneous.

Based on the texts, which choice best describes a difference in how the authors of Text 1 and Text 2 view Capital and Ideology?
selections: A. The author of Text 1 finds the claim that Capital and Ideology resembles the work of Robert Burton to be dubious, while the author of Text 2 believes there is sufficient evidence to substantiate the claim.

B. The author of Text 1 thinks that Capital and Ideology does not entirely succeed in its attempt to make a single coherent argument, while the author of Text 2 contends that making such an argument is not the book's ambition.

C. The author of Text 1 thinks that the structure of Capital and Ideology makes it a less well-written book than Capital in the Twenty-First Century , while the author of Text 2 thinks that the structure of Capital and Ideology is why it is superior to Capital in the Twenty-First Century.

D. The author of Text 1 thinks that Piketty’ s expertise as an economist does not qualify him to discuss the various constitutions of France in Capital and Ideology, while the author of Text 2 holds that academics such as Piketty should feel comfortable discussing subjects outside their fields of study.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 文本1： 经济学家托马斯·皮凯蒂的著作《二十一世纪资本论》结构比其续作《资本与意识形态》更严谨。前者的所有章节都致力于巩固一个关于收入不平等问题的清晰、连贯的论点，而后者的离题内容（例如对法国各种宪法的讨论）不仅使该书显得冗长乏味，还使其推理变得模糊不清。 文本2： 《资本与意识形态》的目标与皮凯蒂的早期著作不同。评价它不应仅依据皮凯蒂之前的作品，而应将其与威廉·T·沃尔曼的《起与落》这类书籍并列。在后一本书中，关于暴力行为正当性的主题，实际上只是一位博学者用以描摹自己思想的借口。即使某些章节没有明确支持中心论点，它们也以有趣的方式相互关联，没有一部分应被视为多余。 答案解析： 文本1批评《资本与意识形态》结构松散、论证模糊，暗示其未能成功构建统一连贯的论点。文本2则认为该书的目标本就是进行博学式的思想漫游，不必追求严密论证。因此核心分歧在于：文本1认为该书在构建单一论点方面不成功，而文本2则主张这根本就不是该书的目标。故应选择 B。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Animals use many objects as tools to achieve goals more easily. Such goals include grooming, finding food, and protecting themselves. For a long time, people thought tool use was unique to primates. Elephants and other animals, though, have busted the myth that tool use requires hands. Inventively, elephants use branches to scratch themselves. Woodpecker finches also get creative. They use cactus spines to pry insects from hiding places.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Unlike primates, elephants are exceptionally skillful at using different tools.
B. Contrary to long-held beliefs, primates aren’t the only animals to use tools.
C. There are many myths about tools use that researchers are starting to challenge.
D. Animals find it difficult to use objects as tools.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 动物会用许多物体作为工具，以便更容易实现目标。这些目标包括梳理毛发、寻找食物和自我保护。长期以来，人们认为使用工具是灵长类动物的独有本领。然而，大象和其他动物打破了“使用工具需要用手”的迷思。大象创造性地使用树枝来搔痒自己。啄木鸟雀也很有创意，它们用仙人掌刺将昆虫从藏身处撬出来。 答案解析： 文章以“动物使用工具”为背景，先指出“过去人们认为工具使用是灵长类动物独有的”，然后通过大象和啄木鸟雀的例子反驳了这一观点。因此，文章的核心是说明除灵长类外，其他动物也会使用工具。选项B“与长期持有的观念相反，灵长类并非唯一使用工具的动物”准确概括了主旨。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
River Lengths Researcher Shaochuang Liu and team presented updated measurements of the lengths of several rivers.

According to the table, which river is the longest?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 研究者刘绍川及其团队公布了几条河流的最新长度测量数据。 答案解析： 表格中三条河流的长度数据为：长江（6,236 km）> 鄂毕河（5,525 km）> 刚果河（5,118 km）。因此最长的河流是长江，对应选项 D（虽有拼写错误，但可识别为 Yangtze River）。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Number of City Residents Who Often Biked to Work in 2016 In the table, the city with the lowest number of residents who often biked to work in 2016 is _____

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 表格中，2016年经常骑自行车上班的居民人数最少的城市是 _____ 答案解析： 对比表格数据：凤凰城（4,709）＜ 博尔德（5,314）＜ 麦迪逊（7,186）＜ 西雅图（14,801）。人数最少的是 凤凰城，对应选项 C。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
It may seem that works of art are best experienced in person. However, in an online collection from the Museo de Arte de Lima in Lima, Peru, people can zoom in on a high-quality image of the drawing Drawing B... by Gilda Mantilla. A student argues that viewers usually can’t examine works of art in a museum as carefully as they can examine works in online collections.

Which statement, if true, would most directly support the underlined argument?
selections: A. Most museums have signs that provide basic information about the works of art on display.
B. Most museums don ’ t allow visitors to get very close to the works of art on display.
C. Many museums have started adding images of works from their collections to their websites.
D. Museums don’ t always put works by different artists together in one room.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 人们可能认为艺术作品最好亲身体验。然而，在秘鲁利马的利马艺术博物馆的在线藏品中，人们可以放大吉尔达·曼蒂利亚的画作《绘图B……》的高清图像。一位学生认为，观众通常无法像在在线藏品中那样仔细地观察博物馆里的艺术品。 答案解析： 论点核心是：在博物馆里无法像在线查看那样仔细看艺术品。要直接支持这一点，需要说明博物馆存在某种限制，阻碍了近距离仔细观察。选项B“大多数博物馆不允许参观者太靠近展出的艺术品”直接解释了为何在博物馆无法仔细看，因此最有力地支持了论点。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
In a recent study, Antonia Olivia Dolan and colleagues investigated the relationship between people ’ s music preferences and their preferred listening volume. Participants listened to recordings — Led Zeppelin ’ s “Whole Lotta Love,” Ludwig van Beethoven ’ s Symphony No.5 in C Minor, and others — at their preferred volume and indicated their most and least favorite among the recordings. The researchers found that participants listened to recordings they liked most at a higher volume than recordings they liked least. And given that the frequencies in all the recordings were within the audible range of these participants (all of whom had clinically typical hearing), it is therefore likely that for a given participant, the _____.

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. relationship between the preferred volume of a recording and the participant’s attitude toward that recording cannot be attributed to its genre.
B. fact that the preferred volume offered by recording cannot be attributed to the participant wanting to hear the favorite recording at a higher volume than the least favorite recording.
C. difference between the preferred volumes of the favorite and least favorite recordings cannot be attributed to one recording being inherently harder to hear than the other.
D. identification of one recording as the favorite and another recording as the least favorite cannot be attributed to the participant having prior familiarity with either recording
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在一项最新研究中，安东尼娅·奥利维亚·多兰及其同事探究了人们的音乐偏好与他们偏好的听音音量之间的关系。参与者在以自己偏好的音量听了几段录音（齐柏林飞艇的《Whole Lotta Love》、路德维希·范·贝多芬的《C小调第五交响曲》等）后，指出其中最喜爱和最不喜爱的录音。研究者发现，参与者听最喜爱的录音时音量高于最不喜爱的录音。鉴于所有录音的频率都在参与者（所有参与者听力均临床正常）的可听范围内，因此很可能对于任一参与者来说，_____。 答案解析： 研究结论是：人们听更喜欢的音乐时会把音量调得更高。由于所有录音都在可听范围内，可以排除“某段录音本身更难听清”这一干扰因素。因此，最合理的推断是：喜不喜欢音乐与音量的关系，不是因为某个录音更难听，而是因为喜好。选项C“最喜欢和最不喜欢录音的偏好音量差异，不能归因于其中一个录音本质上比另一个更难听清”最符合逻辑。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Research such as the 2010 study of arthropods by Alvin Aaden Yim-Hol Chan and colleagues has shown that noise from human activity, like traffic on a busy highway, has various significant effects on animals, and many governments require studies of the potential noise effects on wildlife before approving highway construction projects. For one of these projects, a group of researchers suggested that, although there are both arthropods and birds in the area, taking actions to reduce the effects of noise on the arthropods will probably protect both types of animals because noise tends to affect arthropods more strongly than birds. Another group of researchers indicated that, although the effects are usually greater on arthropods, addressing only those effects won't reduce the potential harm to the birds in the area because______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the species of birds in the area experience different negative effects from noise than the species or arthropods in the area do.
B. the actions to reduce effects on the arthropods are significantly more robust than is needed to lessen the effects on the birds in the area.
C. the effects of noise on birds have been more thoroughly studied than the effects on arthropods have.
D. the types of actions that are usually taken to lessen the effects of noise on birds can sometimes harm arthropods.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： Alvin Aaden Yim-Hol Chan 及其同事在2010年关于节肢动物的研究等表明，人类活动（如繁忙公路的交通）产生的噪音会对动物产生多种显著影响，因此许多政府在批准公路建设项目前，要求研究噪音对野生动物的潜在影响。针对其中一个项目，一组研究人员提出，尽管该区域同时存在节肢动物和鸟类，但采取措施减少噪音对节肢动物的影响很可能同时保护这两类动物，因为噪音对节肢动物的影响通常比对鸟类更强。另一组研究人员则指出，虽然噪音对节肢动物的影响通常更大，但仅仅针对这些影响采取措施并不会减少对该区域鸟类的潜在危害，因为______ 答案解析： 第二组研究者认为，仅解决噪音对节肢动物的影响并不能减少对鸟类的危害。这是因为鸟类和节肢动物对噪音的负面反应类型不同（例如敏感频率、行为干扰模式等差异），因此针对节肢动物有效的降噪措施未必能覆盖鸟类所受的影响。选项A准确指出了这一关键区别，而其他选项均未直接解释“为何单保护节肢动物仍无法保护鸟类”这一逻辑。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Few stories in art history rival the gilded drama of James McNeill Whistler ’ s Peacock Room . This sumptuous dining space became the setting of a spectacular falling-out between Whistler, who transformed the somber room into a golden aviary, and shipping magnate Frederick Leyland, who commissioned the work but refused to pay for what he _____ as a tasteless, gaudy design.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 空格前是“what he... as a tasteless... design”，缺少宾语从句的谓语动词，所以选B
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
When searching for clues about how Neolithic peoples lived, British archaeologist Lisa-Marie Shillito starts by examining ____ trash. Buried trash deposits (known as middens) are a rich source of information for archaeologists like Shillito.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句中“Neolithic peoples”是复数名词，指新石器时代的人们，其正确的复数所有格代词是 their。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
One example of public art (art that’s readily accessible to the general public) ____ the work Singing Ringing Tree . This sculpture is installed on public land in Burnley, England.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子主语是“One example”，为单数第三人称，因此谓语动词应使用单数形式 is。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Many ranching terms come from Spanish. For example, the word “rodeo” (a roundup) comes from the Spanish word rodear, and “cinch” (a belt)_____ from cincho . This is because the first Anglo, African, and Native American cattle ranchers in the southwestern US learned the trade from Spanish-speaking Mexican vaqueros, or cowboys.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 本句讲述的是词汇来源的客观事实，应使用一般现在时。主语为单数名词谓语动词需用第三人称单数形式 comes，与前半句的时态和结构保持一致。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Many places in the United States share a name with a foreign city or country. When founding the town of Edinburgh, Indiana, residents decided to name_____after the Scottish city of Edinburgh.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 指代前文提到的“the town of Edinburgh, Indiana”（印第安纳州的埃迪森堡镇），这是一个单数名词（城镇），因此应使用单数代词 it 来指代。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Thousands of years ago, the Olmec civilization ’ s reign over parts of eastern Mexico ended. _____ the Olmecs ’ massive stone statues of human heads remain. Two of these statues, known as Monument 4 and Monument 3, weigh over 5 tons!

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 数千年前，奥尔梅克文明对墨西哥东部部分地区的统治结束了。_____ 奥尔梅克人的巨大石制人头雕像仍然留存。其中两座被称为纪念碑4号和3号的雕像，重量超过5吨！ 答案解析： 第一句说奥尔梅克文明的统治“结束了”，第二句说其石像“仍然留存”。两句之间是转折关系，强调尽管文明已逝，但遗迹仍在。因此，需要一个表示“尽管如此、然而”的转折连接词。选项 A Still, 最符合逻辑。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Unlike the sprawling, permanent mural installations of Aurora Reyes Flores and other contemporaries of the Muralismo Mexicano movement, the easily reproducible block print posters that Alberto Beltrán and Jean Charlot created as part of the printmaking collective Taller de Gráfica Popular (TGP) were highly portable. _____ the prints were a boon to the TGP ’ s goal of spreading their artwork throughout Mexico and the world beyond.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 与奥罗拉·雷耶斯·弗洛雷斯等墨西哥壁画运动同时代艺术家所创作的大规模永久性壁画装置不同，阿尔贝托·贝尔特兰和让·夏洛作为版画团体“大众图像工作室”（TGP）成员创作的可大量复制的木版画海报具有高度便携性。_____ 这些版画对TGP将其艺术作品传播至墨西哥乃至世界各地的目标而言是一大助力。 答案解析： 前一句说木版画海报“高度便携”，后一句说它们“对传播目标是一大助力”。两句之间是因果关系：因为便携，所以有助于传播。因此，需要一个表示“因此、这样一来”的逻辑连接词。选项 D As such.（因此，这样）最符合此处的因果逻辑。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·The Vistula River is in Europe. ·It is the eighth longest river in Europe. ·It crosses the countries Belarus and Poland. ·It ranks No.133 among the longest rivers in the world. ·It is 1,213 kilometers long.

The student wants to specify how many kilometers long the Vistula River is. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The Vistula River crosses both Belarus and Poland in Europe.
B. The Vistula River in Europe is 1,213 kilometers long.
C. Among the longest rivers in the world, the Vistula River ranks No. 133.
D. The eighth longest river in Europe, the Vistula River crosses s both Belarus and Poland.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一名学生在研究某个主题时记录了以下笔记： ·维斯瓦河位于欧洲。 ·它是欧洲第八长的河流。 ·它流经白俄罗斯和波兰。 ·它在世界最长河流中排名第133位。 ·它全长1,213公里。 答案解析： 题目要求明确说明河流的长度。选项B直接给出了“维斯瓦河全长1,213公里”，并补充了“在欧洲”这一地理位置，完全符合目标。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·Chapantongo is a municipality in the state of Hidalgo, Mexico. ·It had a population of 12,967 in 2020. ·Chapulhuacán is a municipality in Hidalgo. ·It had a population of 22,903 in 2020. ·Municipalities are governmental regions responsible for providing many public services to their residents. ·Hidalgo is divided into 84 municipalities.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between Chapantongo and Chapulhuacán. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Chapantongo is one of 84 governmental regions, known as municipalities, in Hidalgo, Mexico.
B. As of 2020, Chapantongo was not as populous as Chapulhuacán.
C. As a municipality of Hidalgo, Chapulhuacán is responsible for providing many public services.
D. Both Chapantongo and Chapulhuacán are municipalities in Hidalgo, Mexico.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一名学生在研究某个主题时记录了以下笔记： ·查潘通戈是墨西哥伊达尔戈州的一个市镇。 ·它在2020年人口为12,967人。 ·查普尔瓦坎是伊达尔戈州的一个市镇。 ·它在2020年人口为22,903人。 ·市镇是负责为居民提供许多公共服务的行政区划。 ·伊达尔戈州分为84个市镇。 答案解析： 题目要求强调两个地点之间的“相似之处”。笔记中明确指出二者都是“伊达尔戈州的市镇”。选项D直接点明“查潘通戈和查普尔瓦坎都是墨西哥伊达尔戈州的市镇”，准确抓住了这一核心共同点。其他选项只分别说明单方面信息或对比差异，未突出“共同点”。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·Sodium is a chemical element. ·When the electrons of a chemical element change energy states, certain wavelengths of light are released. ·This unique collection of wavelengths is known as the emission spectrum of the element. ·Sodium ’ s emission spectrum includes the 589.5 nanometer (nm) wavelength of light. ·Wavelengths of 570–590nm make up the yellow portion of the visible spectrum.

The student wants to indicate one of the wavelengths of light in sodium ’ s emission spectrum. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Sodium ’ s emission spectrum consists of a unique collection of wavelengths.
B. When sodium ’ s electrons change energy states, certain wavelengths of light are released.
C. One of the wavelengths in sodium ’ s emission spectrum is the 589.5 nm wavelength.
D. If a chemical element releases a wavelength of light between 570-590 nm, that wavelength would be part of the yellow portion of the visible spectrum.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一名学生在研究某个主题时记录了以下笔记： ·钠是一种化学元素。 ·当化学元素的电子改变能量状态时，会释放特定波长的光。 ·这种独特的波长组合称为该元素的发射光谱。 ·钠的发射光谱包含波长为 589.5 纳米（nm）的光。 ·570–590 nm 的波长构成可见光谱的黄色部分。 答案解析： 题目要求“指出钠发射光谱中的一个波长”。笔记中明确提到“钠的发射光谱包含 589.5 nm 的波长”。选项C直接陈述“钠发射光谱中的一个波长是 589.5 nm”，并使用了笔记中的具体数据，最精准地实现了目标。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·Ukiyo-e woodblock prints were a popular artistic form in Japan from the 1600s through the 1800s. ·Ukiyo-e prints were produced by teams of artisans that included artists, wood-carvers, printers, and publishers. ·Sōsaku-hanga was a popular Japanese printmaking movement that emerged in the early 1900s. ·Sōsaku-hanga prioritized individual artistic expression. ·An artist working in this style typically handled all aspects of print creation, from drawing to wood carving to printing.

The student wants to contrast ukiyo-e and Sōsaku-hanga production methods. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In contrast to ukiyo-e prints, Sōsaku-hanga prints were produced using methods such as drawing and wood carving.
B. Ukiyo-e prints were popular in Japan from the 1600s through the 1800s, while sōsaku-hanga prints emerged later, in the early 1900s.
C. One notable distinction between ukiyo-e and Sōsaku-hanga prints is sōsaku-hanga's emphasis on individual artistic expression.
D. Teams of artisans produced ukiyo-e prints, whereas individual artists typically handled all aspects of Sōsaku-hanga printmaking themselves.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一名学生在研究某个主题时记录了以下笔记： ·浮世绘木版画是17世纪至19世纪日本流行的艺术形式。 ·浮世绘版画是由艺术家、木雕师、印刷师和出版商组成的工匠团队制作的。 ·创作版画是20世纪初兴起的一场日本流行版画运动。 ·创作版画强调个人艺术表达。 ·这种风格的艺术家通常亲自处理版画创作的所有环节，从绘画、木雕到印刷。 答案解析： 题目要求“对比生产方法”。笔记明确指出：浮世绘由“团队”制作，而创作版画由“个体艺术家”独立完成所有环节。选项D“团队工匠制作浮世绘，而个体艺术家通常自行处理创作版画的所有方面”直接对比了二者的制作方式，最契合要求。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Bing Xie and her team have discovered that plains zebras make at least four types of vocalizations: “snorts,” “soft snorts,” “squeals,” and “quagga quagga” calls. The researchers used machine-learning algorithms to_____ recorded vocalizations according to type, finding that snorts vary across individual zebras, while squeals are more uniform across zebra populations.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： Bing Xie和她的团队发现平原斑马至少能发出四种类型的叫声：“喷鼻声”、“轻柔喷鼻声”、“尖叫声”和“quagga quagga”叫声。研究人员使用机器学习算法根据类型对记录的叫声进行______，发现喷鼻声因斑马个体而异，而尖叫声在不同斑马种群中更为一致。 中文解析： 文中提到研究人员要区分四种叫声类型，并使用机器学习算法进行分析，因此最合理且精确的动词是“分类”（categorize）。其他选项如collapse（合并）、extend（扩展）、suppress（抑制）均不符合“按类型区分声音”的语境和逻辑。

question:
The dinosaur displays at museums such as the Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County in Los Angeles (which has a mounted Allosaurus fragilis skeleton among its Holdings) are notable for the______ of the research behind them—the museum staff consulted numerous sources to ensure the accuracy of the displays.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 诸如洛杉矶县自然历史博物馆（其馆藏中包含一具安装好的脆弱异特龙骨架）等机构的恐龙展览，因其背后研究的______而引人注目——博物馆工作人员参考了大量资料以确保展览的准确性。 中文解析： 文中提到工作人员“参考了大量资料以确保准确性”，这直接体现了研究过程的细致、严谨和高标准。rigor 意为“严谨、严格”，最符合语境。其他选项：A. shallowness（浅薄）与文意相反。B. novelty（新颖性）未在文中体现。C. obscurity（模糊性）与“确保准确性”矛盾。

question:
Ian Gilligan et al. claim that during the Ice Age, humans at Stajnia Cave in Europe made fitted clothing by boring holes in pieces of hide and fur with a sharpened bone tool called an awl and then threading cord through the holes to bind the pieces together. Eventually, as evidenced by artifacts at Shuidonggou 2 in East Asia, someone perforated the end of a bone awl to make an eye (hole) to hold the cord, thereby creating a sewing needle with which both steps could be performed in a single motion. This sped up the process of making clothing and, by freeing them from the need to push cord through holes manually, allowed artisans to make smaller holes and thus finer seams.

Based on the text, what can be concluded about clothing made during the Ice Age?
selections: A. Clothing made with awls at sites like Stajnia Cave could likely be made more quickly than clothing made with needles at sites like Shuidonggou 2.
B. Clothing made at sites like Stajnia Cave was likely made with needles, while clothing made at sites like Shuidonggou 2 was likely made with awls.
C. Clothing made with awls at sites like Stajnia Cave likely had coarser seams than clothing made with needles at sites like Shuidonggou 2 did.
D. Clothing made with awls at sites like Stajnia Cave likely had finer seams than clothing made with needles at sites like Shuidonggou 2 did.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： Ian Gilligan等人声称，在冰河时期，欧洲斯塔尼亚洞穴的人类使用一种名为“锥子”的尖锐骨制工具，在兽皮和毛皮上钻孔，然后用绳索穿过孔洞将碎片绑在一起，制作出合身的衣物。后来，根据东亚水洞沟2号遗址的文物证据，有人在骨锥末端穿孔制成“针眼”以固定绳索，从而发明了缝衣针，使得两个步骤可以一次完成。这加快了制衣过程，并且由于无需手动穿线，工匠可以制作更小的孔，从而得到更精细的缝线。 中文解析： 文本明确指出，使用针（水洞沟2号）可以制作更小的孔和更精细的缝线，而使用锥子（斯塔尼亚洞穴）则需要手动穿线，无法实现同样精细的缝制效果。因此，使用锥子制作的衣物缝线相对更粗糙。

question:
All stainless steel contains varying amounts of iron, carbon, and corrosion-inhibiting chromium. However, ferritic stainless steel, often used for induction cookers, contains a higher percentage of chromium (at least 10.5%) than does austenitic stainless steel and a higher concentration of iron, which is responsible for its magnetic properties. Unlike ferritic stainless steel, austenitic stainless steel has a face-centered cubic crystalline structure resulting from the addition of nickel to the alloy. Austenitic stainless steel has two subtypes: the 200 series, often used for home water tanks, and the 300 series, which has more nickel than the 200 series and is often used for pharmaceutical equipment or compensate. Thus, stainless steel used to manufacture __________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. pharmaceutical equipment will have a concentration of chromium lower than 10.5%, while stainless steel used to manufacture home water tanks will not.
B. home water tanks will have a lower percentage of chromium in its composition than stainless steel used for induction cookers will.
C. compensate with similar magnetic properties to stainless steel used to manufacture induction cookers.
D. induction cookers will have a face-centered cubic crystalline structure.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 所有不锈钢都含有不同量的铁、碳和抗腐蚀的铬。然而，常用于感应炊具的铁素体不锈钢比奥氏体不锈钢含有更高比例的铬（至少10.5%）和更高浓度的铁，这使其具有磁性。与铁素体不锈钢不同，奥氏体不锈钢因添加镍而具有面心立方晶体结构。奥氏体不锈钢有两个子类型：200系列（常用于家用热水箱）和300系列（镍含量更高，常用于制药设备或补偿）。因此，用于制造_____空白的不锈钢 中文解析： 选项B（家用热水箱的不锈钢铬含量将低于用于感应炊具的不锈钢）最符合文本逻辑，因为文本明确指出铁素体不锈钢（用于感应炊具）的铬含量高于奥氏体不锈钢，而家用热水箱使用的是奥氏体不锈钢的200系列，因此其铬含量自然较低。其他选项与文本信息矛盾或缺乏支持。

question:
During a 2022 expedition led by research zoologist Andrea Quattrini, scientists discovered a new species of black coral off the coast of Puerto Rico. Like other black corals, the newly discovered species, which they named Aphanipathes puertoricoensis , has coiled branching structures that ____ it survive in the deep sea.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 因为关系代词that指代复数名词coiled branching structures，所以动词必须使用复数形式help以保持主谓一致。

question:
In eastern Mexico, Monument 89 and Monument 4 are the names given to two massive human head statues that were left behind by the ancient Olmec civilization. Both statues are made of stone and are extremely heavy. _____ they each weigh more than 5 tons!

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在墨西哥东部，Monument 89 和 Monument 4 是古代奥尔梅克文明留下的两个巨大人头雕像的名称。这两个雕像都是用石头制成的，而且非常重。_____ 它们每个都重达5吨以上！ 中文解析： 选项D "In fact,"（事实上）是最逻辑的过渡，因为它用于进一步强调或证实前一句的陈述（雕像"非常重"），通过提供具体重量（5吨以上）来强化事实。

question:
In a theater-in-the-round, the stage is surrounded on all sides by the audience. This means that the play must remain visible from all angles. _____ plays performed in-the-round often use minimal sets and scenery, so the view of the actors is not blocked.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在圆形剧场中，舞台被观众四面环绕。这意味着戏剧必须从所有角度都可见。_____ 在圆形剧场中演出的戏剧经常使用极简的布景和道具，这样演员的视线就不会被阻挡。 中文解析： 选项D "For this reason,"（因此）是最逻辑的过渡，因为它表示因果关系：前两句说明圆形剧场要求戏剧从所有角度可见，这直接导致了使用极简布景的结果，以确保视线不受阻挡。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ● The Galápagos penguin is a species of bird found in the Galápagos Islands. ● It has an average weight of 2,500 grams. ● The large ground finch is a species of bird found in the Galápagos Islands. ● It has an average weight of 35 grams.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two bird species. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The large ground finch and the Galápagos penguin are both bird species.
B. The large ground finch and the Galápagos penguin can be found in the Galápagos Islands.
C. On average, the Galápagos penguin weighs 2,500 grams, while the large ground finch weighs only 35 grams.
D. The Galápagos penguin is a bird with an average weight of 2,500 grams.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记： ●加拉帕戈斯企鹅是一种在加拉帕戈斯群岛发现的鸟类。 ●它的平均重量为2500克。 ●大嘴地雀是一种在加拉帕戈斯群岛发现的鸟类。 ●它的平均重量为35克。 中文解析： 选项C直接比较了两种鸟类的重量（企鹅2500克 vs. 地雀35克），突出了重量上的巨大差异，从而最有效地实现了强调差异的目标。因此，正确答案应为C

question:
• Calida Garcia Rawles is an African American painter. • She is known for her large-scale, hyperrealistic paintings depicting African American figures in water. • The painting When It calls (16×12 in) depicts a bearded man with his arms outstretched floating in the bottom left corner of the canvas. • Lost in the Shuffle (36×24 in) depicts two young men with their arms outstretched floating in the bottom left and upper right corners of the canvas. • She paints the water with vivid blue colors, including black blue and mint blue. • The mood in the paintings is calm.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to emphasize a difference between the two paintings?
selections: A. Although the number of figures may differ, constant among Rawles’s hyperrealistic works is the calm mood that the paintings evoke.
B. While some of Rawles’s works, such as When It Calls , feature one figure in the composition, Lost in the Shuffle features two figures floating in the vivid blue water.
C. Among the many stunning works of Calida Garcia Rawles is Lost in the Shuffle , a calm 36-by-24-inch painting depicting two young men floating with their arms outstretched in the vivid blue water.
D. Calida Garcia Rawles captures the water in paintings such as When It Calls and Lost in the Shuffle in vivid hues of black blue and mint blue.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： •Calida Garcia Rawles 是一位非洲裔美国画家。 •她以大型、超写实的绘画而闻名，描绘了水中的非洲裔美国人物。 •画作《When It Calls》（16×12 英寸）描绘了一个有胡子的男人，双臂伸展，漂浮在画布的左下角。 •《Lost in the Shuffle》（36×24 英寸）描绘了两个年轻男人，双臂伸展，漂浮在画布的左下角和右上角。 •她用鲜艳的蓝色画水，包括黑蓝色和薄荷蓝。 •画中的氛围是平静的。 中文解析： 选项B最有效地强调了两幅画的差异，因为它直接对比了《When It Calls》中只有一个 figure（人物）而《Lost in the Shuffle》中有两个 figures。

question:
The following text is from Robert Lowel’s 1964 poem “For the Union Dead.” The South Boston Aquarium closed permanently in 1954. The old South Boston Aquarium stands in a Sahara of snow now. Its broken windows are boarded. The bronze weathervane cod has lost half its scales. The airy tanks are dry. ©2003 by Robert Lowell

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To contrast the effects of different kinds of weather on a building
B. To argue that a building should be rehabilitated
C. To describe details of the deteriorated state of a building
D. To explain why a once-popular building was abandoned
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文本摘自罗伯特·洛威尔1964年的诗《为联邦死者》： 南波士顿水族馆于1954年永久关闭。 古老的南波士顿水族馆如今矗立在一片雪的撒哈拉中，它破碎的窗户被木板封住。 青铜风向标鳕鱼掉了半片鳞片。 通风的水箱都干了。 中文解析： 选项C正确，因为文本主要通过对窗户被封、风向标损坏和水箱干涸等细节的描绘，生动地展现了水族馆的破败状态，而没有涉及天气对比、修复论证或废弃原因的解释。

question:
