explanations: 题目文本翻译： 学生在研究时记录了以下信息： • 危地马拉省领导人于1821年9月15日宣布中美洲脱离西班牙帝国独立。 • 随附的《独立宣言》由洪都拉斯学者兼政治家何塞·塞西利奥·德尔瓦耶撰写。 • 1812年西班牙宪法曾赋予中美洲一定程度的自治权，但1814年被西班牙国王废除。 • 瓦耶曾长期反对独立，并担任西班牙帝国在中美洲行政官员的忠诚顾问。 • 他在1820年拉斐尔·德尔列戈上校起义后改变立场，该起义要求恢复1814年失去的权利。 中文解析： 题目要求“将宣言置于瓦耶政治立场转变的背景中”，需同时体现其立场变化（从反对独立到支持） 与撰写宣言的直接关联。选项B准确整合了“长期反对独立→1820年起义后改变立场→撰写1821年宣言”的完整因果链条，直接满足题目要求。其他选项存在事实错误：A将转变时间错误关联到1814年宪法废除；C、D虽提及起义的影响，但未明确说明瓦耶撰写宣言的关键行动。

question:
In a 2020 experiment, Kai Ruggeri and his team presented participants from Spain, Slovenia, and seventeen other countries with questions that were _____ those used in a groundbreaking 1979 study. By using the same questions that the earlier study did, Ruggeri and his team attempted to reproduce that study’s findings.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在2020年的一项实验中，Kai Ruggeri和他的团队向来自西班牙、斯洛文尼亚以及其他十七个国家的参与者提出了一些问题，这些问题与一项开创性的1979年研究中使用的问题______。通过使用与早期研究相同的问题，Ruggeri和他的团队试图复制该研究的发现。 中文解析： 选择A“identical to”（与...相同），因为文本明确提到“using the same questions”（使用相同的问题），这表明2020年实验中的问题与1979年研究中的问题完全一致。
exam_name: 2025年11月亚太第1套阅读语法 M2-easy

question:
Annie Smith Peck, who was the first person to climb Mount Nevado Huascarán in the Andes, and Sophia Danenberg, who was the first Black woman to summit Mount Everest, are ensured lasting places in our historical memory. No matter what others may do in the future, nobody can ever ______ the standing of these women as the first to accomplish these feats.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 安妮·史密斯·佩克是第一个攀登安第斯山脉内瓦多胡亚斯卡兰山的人，索菲亚·丹enberg是第一个登上珠穆朗玛峰的黑人女性，她们在我们的历史记忆中确保了持久的地位。无论未来别人可能做什么，没有人能______这些女性作为首次完成这些壮举的地位。 中文解析： 选择C“undermine”（破坏），因为文本强调无论未来他人取得何种成就，都无法改变或削弱这些女性作为“第一”的历史地位。
exam_name: 2025年11月亚太第1套阅读语法 M2-easy

question:
The following text is from Alice Moore Dunbar-Nelson’s 1895 poem “In Memoriam.” The speaker describes sunshine coming into a cathedral. The light streams through the windows arched high, And o’er the stern, stone carvings breaks In warm rich gold and crimson waves, Then steals away in corners dark to die.

As used in the text, what does the phrase “steals away” most nearly mean?

question:

My—heart is affected here, and that I don’t like. I prefer living in the south. London is too full of fogs and—and serious people, Lord Windermere. Whether the fogs produce the serious people or whether the serious people produce the fogs, I don’t know, but the whole thing rather gets on my nerves.

As used in the text, what does the word "produce" most nearly mean?

question:
A study by Mohamed Alburaki, Dennis van Engelsdorp, and colleagues suggests that overall, US honey bee populations exhibit low genetic diversity. Working with a large sample of honey bee specimens collected from most US states, the researchers determined that there are just three maternal evolutionary lineages in the populations: the North Mediterranean lineage, the West Mediterranean lineage, and the African lineage. They found that of the specimens from Montana, 100% descended from the North Mediterranean lineage— a finding in keeping with that for the lineage in many of the other states studied.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It expands on the claim made earlier in the sentence by providing specific data.
B. It indicates that a result described earlier in the sentence reflects a widespread trend.
C. It acknowledges that the results of the study discussed in the text are not entirely consistent with the researchers’ hypothesis.
D. It summarizes the central conclusions of the study that is discussed in the text.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一项由 Mohamed Alburaki、Dennis vanEngelsdorp 及其同事进行的研究表明，总体而言，美国蜜蜂种群表现出较低的遗传多样性。研究人员收集了来自美国大多数州的大量蜜蜂标本，并确定这些种群中仅有三个母系进化谱系：北地中海谱系、西地中海谱系和非洲谱系。他们发现，在蒙大拿州的标本中，100% descended from the North Mediterranean lineage—a finding in keeping with that for the lineage in many of the other states studied。 中文解析： 选择B,因为划线部分“—a finding in keeping with that for the lineage in many of the other states studied”直接指出蒙大拿州的结果（100%标本来自北地中海谱系）与许多其他州的研究结果一致，从而表明这一发现并非孤立，而是反映了更广泛的趋势。
exam_name: 2025年11月亚太第1套阅读语法 M2-easy

question:
Text 1 The poet Audre Lorde once claimed that poetry is the most inexpensive of art forms to practice. While people who pursue other art forms—sculpture, architecture, theater—require large blocks of uninterrupted time as well as money to complete their work, poets can write, as Lorde said, “between shifts, in the hospital pantry, on the subway, and on scraps of surplus paper.” So poets can make worthwhile art even if they must earn their living in another way. Text 2 Any assessment of the state of contemporary poetry must reckon with the professionalization of the field. While it is possible in theory for anyone to publish in Poetry, Kenyon Review , or a similar major poetry outlet, many people who do so have professional training in poetry and extensive practice writing it, which requires time not often available to those who must also work full-time jobs. Thus, financial security indirectly affects which people become poets.

Based on the texts, how would Lorde (Text 1) most likely respond to the argument presented in Text 2?
selections: A. By indicating that those poets who publish in major poetry journals are most likely to be able to earn a living by writing poetry
B. By pointing out that people can produce valuable poetry in other circumstances than those described by the author of Text 2
C. By suggesting that those artists who specialize in more financially rewarding artistic forms are unlikely to also be successful as poets
D. By asserting that people often work full-time jobs in order to afford the professional training described in Text 2
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 文本1： 诗人奥德丽·洛德曾声称，诗歌是最廉价的实践艺术形式。从事其他艺术形式（如雕塑、建筑、戏剧）的人需要大段不间断的时间和金钱来完成作品，而诗人则可以像洛德所说，“在轮班之间、在医院配餐室、在地铁上、在多余的纸片上”写作。因此，诗人即使必须另谋生计，也能创作出有价值的艺术。 文本2： 任何对当代诗歌状况的评估都必须考虑该领域的专业化。虽然理论上任何人都可以在《诗歌》、《肯庸评论》或类似的主要诗歌刊物上发表作品，但许多这样做的人都有诗歌的专业训练和广泛的写作实践，这需要时间，而那些必须全职工作的人往往没有这种时间。因此，财务安全间接影响了哪些人能成为诗人。 中文解析： 选择B，因为文本1中洛德强调诗歌的灵活性和可及性，认为诗人可以在零碎时间和简陋条件下创作有价值的产品，这直接反驳了文本2关于专业化需要大量时间和财务安全的论点。洛德会指出，诗歌创作不必依赖于专业训练或全职投入，人们在其他 circumstances（如工作间隙）也能产出优秀作品，从而质疑文本2的核心假设。
exam_name: 2025年11月亚太第1套阅读语法 M2-easy

question:

Economist Andrés Hincapié studied why young adults are relatively less likely to start businesses and whether there are ways to increase entrepreneurship in early adulthood. Hincapié found that one impediment is lack of knowledge about the practical details of how businesses are started; he further found that simply providing young adults with good information resources on the topic significantly alleviates this problem.

Based on the text, what would Hincapié most likely say is a promising way to increase entrepreneurship in early adulthood?
selections: A. Creating social networks of young adults who are interested in starting a business
B. Providing young adults with practical information about how to start a business
C. Encouraging young adults to brainstorm business ideas
D. Giving young adults training opportunities at a variety of businesses
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 美国人们创业的平均年龄是35岁。经济学家安德烈斯·辛卡皮埃研究了为什么年轻人相对不太可能创业，以及是否有方法增加年轻成年期的创业精神。辛卡皮埃发现，一个障碍是缺乏关于如何创业的实践细节的知识；他进一步发现，仅仅为年轻人提供关于该主题的良好信息资源就能显著缓解这个问题。 中文解析： 选B，因为文本明确指出，缺乏创业实践知识是主要障碍，而提供相关信息资源能显著缓解这一问题。

question:
Blue holes, such as Watling’s Blue Hole near San Salvador Island, are large marine sinkholes. They are typically located in areas where the ocean bedrock is made of soluble material (e.g., marble) because rock erosion is crucial to their formation. Because of the diverse marine life they contain, blue holes attract numerous divers and scientists. Currently, the Taam Ja’ Blue Hole in Chetumal Bay, Mexico, is the deepest blue hole on record, measured by Teresa Álvarez-Legorreta and colleagues to be at least 420 meters below sea level.

According to the text, what draws divers and scientists to blue holes such as Watling’s Blue Hole and the Taam Ja’ Blue Hole?
selections: A. A hope to encounter a variety of marine organisms
B. A desire to witness the erosion of the rocks in the blue holes
C. A commitment to protecting the marble and other soluble materials in the blue holes
D. An interest in comparing the depths of Watling's Blue Hole and the Taam Ja’ Blue Hole to the depths of other blue holes
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 蓝洞，比如圣萨尔瓦多岛附近的瓦特林蓝洞，是大型海洋沉洞。它们通常位于海洋基岩由可溶性材料（如大理石）组成的区域，因为岩石侵蚀对它们的形成至关重要。由于它们包含多样的海洋生物，蓝洞吸引了众多潜水员和科学家。目前，墨西哥切图马尔湾的塔姆贾蓝洞是记录中最深的蓝洞，由特蕾莎·阿尔瓦雷斯-莱戈雷塔和同事测量，至少在海平面以下420米。 中文解析： 选A最符合逻辑，因为文本明确提到“由于它们包含多样的海洋生物，蓝洞吸引了众多潜水员和科学家”。
exam_name: 2025年11月亚太第1套阅读语法 M2-easy

question:
In a 2024 study, Caihong Vanderburg and colleagues examined whether the composition of soil microbial communities could affect plants’ flavor chemistry. Whereas Jimenez-Gomez et al. (2017) showed that adding specific bacterial or fungal strains to soil can yield increased vitamin C in strawberry crops, Vanderburg and team applied intact microbial communities gathered from ecologically distinct settings across Colorado, including areas of aspen grove and sagebrush, to mustard plants and evaluated the flavor compounds in the plants’ seeds. This ensured that the microbial conditions in their experiment would better reflect the variation and complexity of naturally occurring communities.

Based on the text, what is the most likely reason Vanderburg and colleagues chose to avoid the method used in the strawberry study?
selections: A. The microbial community in the soil from the strawberry study affected plants’ nutrition, not their flavor chemistry.
B. The diversity of species of microorganisms in the soil from the strawberry study was already abnormally high before the researchers added further microorganisms.
C. The composition of microorganisms in the soil in the strawberry study may not have been representative of a naturally existing composition.
D. The microbial community in the soil from the strawberry study likely included similar species to those in wild soils.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在2024年的一项研究中，Caihong Vanderburg和同事研究了土壤微生物群落的组成是否会影响植物的风味化学。虽然Jimenez-Gomez等人（2017）的研究表明，向土壤中添加特定的细菌或真菌菌株可以增加草莓作物中的维生素C，但Vanderburg团队将从科罗拉多州生态不同地点（包括山杨林和山艾树地区）收集的完整微生物群落应用到芥菜植物上，并评估了植物种子中的风味化合物。这确保了他们的实验中的微生物条件能更好地反映自然群落的变异性和复杂性。 中文解析： 选C，因为文本明确提到Vanderburg团队使用完整微生物群落是为了“更好地反映自然群落的变异性和复杂性”，这暗示草莓研究的方法（只添加特定菌株）可能无法代表自然存在的微生物组成，因此Vanderburg团队避免使用该方法以确保实验更贴近自然条件.
exam_name: 2025年11月亚太第1套阅读语法 M2-easy

question:
Evan MacLean and colleagues evaluated behavioral and genetic data from over 14,000 dogs, representing more than 100 breeds, and found that genetic variations track to differing extents with behavioral variations between the breeds. This was the case for the behavioral categories of dog rivalry and excitability but was especially pronounced for attachment and attention-seeking, which can be seen when a dog solicits affection or attention. In another study, researchers found that the boxer and the Yorkshire terrier breeds exhibit very different levels of attachment and attention-seeking. When considered in light of the study by MacLean and colleagues, this finding suggests that _____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. boxers and Yorkshire terriers are more likely to share genes associated with attachment and attention-seeking than to share genes associated with dog rivalry or excitability.
B. there may be a greater tendency toward attachment and attention-seeking in boxers and Yorkshire terriers than in some other dog breeds.
C. there may be a substantial dissimilarity between boxers and Yorkshire terriers in the genes associated with attachment and attention-seeking.
D. individual boxers may display higher levels of attachment and attention-seeking than individual Yorkshire terriers do.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： Evan MacLean及其同事评估了来自14,000多只狗的行为和遗传数据，这些狗代表100多个品种，发现遗传变异在不同程度上与品种间的行为变异相关。这在狗 rivalry 和兴奋性行为类别中也是如此，但在依附和寻求关注方面尤其明显，这可以从狗寻求 affection 或关注时看出。在另一项研究中，研究人员发现拳师犬和约克夏梗品种在依附和寻求关注方面表现出非常不同的水平。结合MacLean及其同事的研究，这一发现表明________ 中文解析： 因为MacLean的研究表明遗传变异与行为变异（尤其是依附和寻求关注）相关，而另一项研究显示拳师犬和约克夏梗在这些行为上存在显著差异。因此，结合MacLean的发现，这种行为差异很可能源于遗传基因上的差异。

B. The capital of Cameroon is Yaoundé; the capital of Liechtenstein is Vaduz.
C. While Douala is in Cameroon, Schaan is in Liechtenstein.
D. Although neither is a capital city, both Douala and Schaan are the most populous cities in their countries.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记： ·通常，一个国家的首都也是其人口最多的城市。 ·喀麦隆的首都是雅温得。 ·其人口最多的城市是杜阿拉。 ·列支敦士登的首都是瓦杜兹。 ·其人口最多的城市是沙恩。 中文解析： 选择D最有效地强调相似性，因为它直接指出杜阿拉和沙恩的共同点：两者都不是首都，但都是各自国家中人口最多的城市.
exam_name: 2025年11月亚太第1套阅读语法 M2-easy

question:
·The Highpointers Club is a hiking club. ·One of the main goals among club members is to reach the highest points in all fifty US states. ·Those who achieve this are called 50 Completers. ·In Suk Han became a 50 Completer on November 15, 2013. ·The highest point in West Virginia is Spruce Knob, at 4,863 ft. ·The highest point in Colorado is Mount Elbert, at 14,440 ft.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to explain the 50 Completers hiking challenge to a new audience?
selections: A. Hikers aiming to count themselves among the 50 Completers must reach not only West Virginia’s Spruce Knob but also the even higher peak of Mount Elbert in Colorado.

B. Not until after you have reached the highest points in all fifty US states—including Spruce Knob in West Virginia and Mount Elbert in Colorado—can you include yourself among the 50 Completers of the Highpointers Club.
C. If you are looking for a new hiking challenge, consider joining the Highpointers Club, as did In Suk Han, a hiker who successfully reached the highest point in every US state.
D. On November 15, 2013, In Suk Han finally completed the feat of reaching the highest point in all fifty US states, including Spruce Knob in West Virginia and Mount Elbert in Colorado.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记： ·Highpointers Club 是一个徒步俱乐部。 ·俱乐部成员的主要目标之一是到达美国所有50个州的最高点。 ·实现这一目标的人被称为“50 Completers”。 ·In Suk Han 于2013年11月15日成为了50 Completer。 ·西弗吉尼亚州的最高点是Spruce Knob，海拔4,863英尺。 ·科罗拉多州的最高点是Mount Elbert，海拔14,440英尺。 中文解析： 选择B最有效地解释了挑战，因为它直接明确了成为50 Completer的条件是到达所有50个州的最高点，并使用具体例子（Spruce Knob和Mount Elbert）来 illustrate 这一要求，从而向新观众清晰传达了挑战的本质。其他选项均不完整：A只强调两个州，未提及所有50个州；C侧重于加入俱乐部和个人例子，但未明确挑战的定义；D仅描述个人成就，未一般化解释挑战。
exam_name: 2025年11月亚太第1套阅读语法 M2-easy

question:
•Antonio Stradivari (1644-1737) was an Italian instrument maker. •He made about 1,000 violin s in his lifetime. •Musicians prize his Stradivarius violin s for their famed sound quality. •The Marie Hall Stradivarius is named for former owner Marie Hall, a British violinist.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to introduce Marie Hall to a new audience?
selections: A. The Marie Hall Stradivarius is named after Marie Hall.
B. Of the 1,000 or so violins Antonio Stradivari made, only about 500 exist today.
C. Marie Hall was a British violinist who once owned a Stradivarius violin.
D. Born in 1644, Antonio Stradivari was an Italian instrument maker whose violin s are famous for their quality.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： ·安东尼奥·斯特拉迪瓦里（1644-1737）是意大利乐器制作师 ·他一生制作了约1000把小提琴 ·音乐家们因其著名的音质而珍视他的斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴 ·"玛丽·霍尔斯特拉迪瓦里"小提琴以曾任所有者、英国小提琴家玛丽·霍尔命名 中文解析： 选择C最有效地介绍了玛丽·霍尔，因为它直接说明了她的小提琴家身份和她与斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴的所有关系，完整地呈现了她在音乐史上的相关身份。
exam_name: 2025年11月亚太第1套阅读语法 M2-easy

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: •Lighthouses send out crucial light signals to help ships and other watercraft navigate at night. •Before automation, lighthouses were run by lighthouse keepers. •Fannie May Salter was the lighthouse keeper at Turkey Point Light in Maryland. •She held this position for twenty-two years (1925-1947). •Ida Lewis was the lighthouse keeper at Lime Rock Light in Rhode Island. •She held this position for fifty-four years (1857-1911).

The student wants to compare the length of time Fannie May Salter and Ida Lewis worked as lighthouse keepers. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. From 1925 to 1947, the nighttime waters of Maryland were more navigable thanks to lighthouse keepers Fannie May Salter and Ida Lewis.
B. Fannie May Salter worked as a lighthouse keeper for twenty-two years, but Ida Lewis did so for even longer: fifty-four years.
C. Fannie May Salter and Ida Lewis were both lighthouse keepers at a time when such a person was needed to operate a lighthouse.
D. Before automation, lighthouse keepers like Fannie May Salter, who served for twenty-two years, and Ida Lewis were crucial to ensuring safe navigation for watercraft.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记： ·灯塔发出关键的光信号，帮助船舶和其他水上交通工具在夜间导航。 ·在自动化之前，灯塔由灯塔看守人管理。 ·Fannie May Salter 是马里兰州土耳其角灯塔的看守人。 ·她担任这一职位二十二年（1925-1947）。 ·Ida Lewis 是罗德岛莱姆岩灯塔的看守人。 ·她担任这一职位五十四年（1857-1911）。 中文解析： 选择B最有效地比较了工作时间长度，因为它直接使用了笔记中的具体数据（Salter的22年和Lewis的54年），并明确指出Lewis的工作时间更长，从而实现了比较的目标。
exam_name: 2025年11月亚太第1套阅读语法 M2-easy

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·The meter of a poem is the rhythmic structure or pattern of accents in its lines. ·Alliterative meter is structured by a pattern of repeated sounds. ·Quantitative meter is structured by a pattern of long and short syllables. ·The Old English poem Widsith uses an alliterative meter. ·The Sanskrit poem Meghadūta uses a quantitative meter.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the meters of the two poems. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The Sanskrit poem Meghad ū ta uses a quantitative meter, while the meter of the Old English poem Widsith uses a pattern of long and short syllables.
B. The poem Widsith is written in Old English, but Meghad ū ta is written in Sanskrit.
C. Alliterative meter is a pattern of repeated sounds, but quantitative meter is a rhythmic structure or pattern of accents.
D. The lines of the poem Meghad ū ta use a pattern of long and short syllables, whereas Widsith ’s lines use a pattern of repeated sounds.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记： ·诗的格律是诗行中的节奏结构或重音模式。 ·头韵格律通过重复声音的模式来构建。 量化格律通过长音节和短音节的模式来构建。 ·古英语诗《Widsith》使用头韵格律。 ·梵语诗《Meghadūta》使用量化格律。 中文解析： 选择D最有效地强调了两首诗格律的差异，因为它直接使用笔记中的具体信息，将《Meghadūta》的量化格律（长音节和短音节的模式）与《Widsith》的头韵格律（重复声音的模式）进行对比，准确反映了两种格律的本质区别。其他选项均不准确：A错误描述了《Widsith》的格律（它使用头韵格律，而非长音节和短音节模式）；B只强调语言差异，未涉及格律；C仅描述格律定义，未具体应用到两首诗上。
exam_name: 2025年11月亚太第1套阅读语法 M2-easy

question: If 9 x + 4 = 67 , what is the value of 90 x + 40 ?
Note: Figure not drawn to scale. In the figure, line p is parallel to line r , and line t intersects both lines. What is the value of x ?
explanations: x与72度是对顶角，所以x=72度，故选B。

question: A length of 450 meters is equal to how many decimeters ? (1 meter =10 decimeters)
explanations: 考查单位换算，450 m=450 *10 dm =4500 dm，故答案为4500。

question: The equation 58 = 2 x + 2 y gives the perimeter of a rectangular garden that has length x , in feet, and width y , in feet. The width of the garden is 14 feet. What is the length, in feet, of the garden?
explanations: 把y=14代入58=2x+2y求解可得x=15，故答案是15.

question: The relationship between the variables x and y is defined by an exponential equation. When x = 0 , the value of y is 40, and for every increase in the value of x by 1, the corresponding value of y increases by 50% of its previous value. Which equation represents this relationship?
explanations: 指数函数 y = a ∗ b x ，当x=0时，y=a*1=a=40；x每变大1，y增长50%，即b=1+50%=1.5，故选A。

question: The function f is defined by f ( x ) = 1 8 x . What is the value of f ( x ) when x = 9 ?
explanations: 把x=9代入函数式可得f(x)=1/72 （约等于0.0138），故答案为1/72或者.0138。

question: The function f is defined by f ( x ) = 3 x − 1 4 . What is the y -intercept of the graph of y = f ( x ) in the xy -plane?
explanations: y-intercept表示x=0，把x=0代入函数求解可得答案为A。

question: x + 6 y = 28 6 y = 14 The solution to the given system of equations is ( x , y ) . What is the value of x ?
explanations: 把6y=14代入第一个方程可得x+14=28，计算可得x=14，故答案为14。

question: The length of a side of square X is 9 centimeters. The area of rectangle Y is 32 square centimeters. What is the total area, in square centimeters, of square X and rectangle Y ?
explanations: 正方形的面积是9*9=81，长方形的面积是32，两个图形的面积之和就是81+32=113.故选B。

question: During hibernation, American black bears do not eat or replenish calories. A certain black bear weighed 293 pounds when entering hibernation and lost weight at a mean rate of 0.9 pounds per day. At this rate, how many days after entering hibernation would the black bear weigh 230 pounds?
explanations: 根据题目可得重量与时间的关系是y=293-0.9x，将y=230代入该函数求解可得x=70，故选C。

question: The complete graph of y = f ( x ) is shown. For how many values of x does f ( x ) = 0 ?
explanations: f(x)=0表示与x轴的交点，图像中曲线与x轴的交点有3个，故选C。

question: b 2 + 4 c = 7 d The given equation relates the real numbers b , c , and d , where d > 4 7 c . Which equation correctly expresses b in terms of c and d ?
explanations: 求解二次方程，可得答案为D。

question: x 2 − 81 16 = 0 How many distinct real solutions does the given equation have?
explanations: 考查一元二次方程解的个数，该方程中 b 2 − 4 a c = 0 − 4 ∗ 1 ∗ ( − 81 / 16 ) > 0 ，故该方程有两个实数根，答案为C。

question: Note: Figures not drawn to scale. Triangles ABC and A ′ B ′ C ′ are shown. Triangle ABC is dilated by a scale factor of 6 to form triangle A ′ B ′ C ′ . If the length of A B ― is 18, what is the length of A ′ B ′ ― ?
What is the radius of the circle in the xy -plane defined by ( x + 3 ) 2 + ( y + 9 ) 2 = 361 ？
explanations: 圆心为（a,b），圆的半径为r，那圆的方程就是 ( x − a ) 2 + ( y − b ) 2 = r 2 ，即 r 2 = 361 ，求解可得r=19，故答案为19。

question: In the xy -plane, which of the following does NOT contain any points that are part of the solution set to 5 x − 7 y > 35 ?
selections: B. The region where x > 0 and y > 0
C. The region where x < 0 and y < 0
D. The region where x < 0 and y > 0
explanations: 在坐标轴中做出直线，符合条件的为第一、三、四象限，那第二象限，即D选项不包含不等式的解，故答案为D。

question: The table shows the distribution of people in a certain city by age group. If a person in this city is selected at random, which of the following is closest to the probability of selecting a person who is greater than 65 years old, given that the person is at least 18 years old?
explanations: 考查概率，待选条件是21%+29%+24%=74%，需要挑选的占比是24%，故概率是24%/74%=0.32，故答案为B。

question: Line h is defined by 1 2 x + 1 9 y − 54 = 0 . Line j is perpendicular to line h in the xy -plane. What is the slope of line j ?
explanations: 将line h的表达式整理成直线的标准式为 y = − 9 2 x + 54 ∗ 9 。垂直的两条直线的斜率相乘得-1，所以与line h垂直的line j 的斜率是 − 1 / ( − 9 2 ) = 2 / 9 ，故选D。

question: a , 26, 29, b , 31, 47, c For the given data set, the data values are listed in ascending order, where a , b , and c are constants. For this data set, the mean is 36, the median is 29, and the range is 72. What is the value of c ?
explanations: 数据按照从小到大排列的，故正中间的b是median，故b=29；根据题意可得( a+26+29+29+31+47+c )/7=36，c-a=42， 求解该方程组可得c=81，故选C。

question: Note: Figure not drawn to scale F In triangle QRS shown, Q R < R S . Which expression represents the length of Q S ― ?
explanations: 根据选项中用到的∠Q，待求的QS，还有已知的边长37可知 sin ⁡ Q = 37 Q S ，求解可得 QS = 37 sin ⁡ Q ，故选D。

question: y = 9 ( a 7 ) x + c − b How many times does the graph of the given equation in the xy -plane cross the x -axis, where a , b , and c are positive constants such that a > 7 and b > c ?
explanations: 指数函数 y = a ∗ b x 是单调函数，与x轴只能有0或者1个交点，因为b是正数，所以是将指数函数向下平移了b个单位，那便与x轴只有一个交点，故选B。

question: A certain town has an area of 4.29 square miles. What is the area, in square yards, of this town? (1 mile = 1,760 yards)
explanations: 考查单位换算， 4.29 mile 2 = 4.29 ∗ ( 1760 yard ) 2 ，计算可得答案为D。

question: Zuri has a goal to run at least 16 miles per week while training for a race. This week, she has run 4 miles. If x represents the additional number of miles Zuri needs to run this week to meet her goal, which inequality represents this situation?
explanations: additional表示加，at least表示大于等于，故选D。

question: Note: Figure not drawn to scale. In the figure shown, line k intersects lines r and s . If w = 147 , which additional piece of information is sufficient to prove that lines r and s are parallel?
explanations: 考查平行线中同位角相等，故选B。

question: At a fundraiser, a family pays a fixed entrance fee. They then purchase food tickets, which each have the same cost. The table shows the relationship between the number of food tickets, x , that are purchased and the total amount paid y , in dollars, for both the entrance fee and the food tickets. Which equation represents the relationship between x and y ?
explanations: 将表格中的数字代入选项检验可得到答案为A。

question: A group of 10 gardeners recorded data on the germination rates of their tomato crop for one growing season. The scatterplot shows the relationship between the number of tomato seeds planted, x , and the number of tomato seeds that germinated, y , for each of the gardeners. A line of best fit is also shown. Which of the following is the best interpretation of the slope of the line of best fit in this context?
selections: A. The number of tomato seeds planted is predicted to increase by 60 seeds every 100 days.
B. The number of tomato seeds planted is predicted to increase by 300 seeds every 100 days.
C. The number of tomato seeds that germinate is predicted to increase by 60 seeds for every additional 100 tomato seeds that are planted.
D. The number of tomato seeds that germinate is predicted to increase by 300 seeds for every additional 100 tomato seeds that are planted.
explanations: 直线的斜率计算可得为3/5，符合要求的是AC，根据x轴、y轴表达的含义可知答案为C。

question: The graph of 2 x + y = 11 in the xy -plane is a line. What is the slope of the line?
explanations: 将直线整理成标准表达式可得y=-2x+11，直线的斜率为-2，故答案为-2。

question: f ( x ) = 2 x + 3 g ( x ) = 7 x − 2 h ( x ) = 5 x + 6 The functions f , g , and h are defined as shown. If f ( x ) ⋅ g ( x ) − h ( x ) = a x 2 + b x + c , where a , b , and c are constants, what is the value of b ?
explanations: 将f(x)、g(x)、h(x)的表达式代入f(x)*g(x)-h(x)计算可得 14 x 2 + 12 x − 12 ，故b为12，所以答案是B。

question: The function f is defined by f ( x ) = x + 11 5 , and f ( a ) = − 18 , where a is a constant. What is the value of a ?

The table shows values of x and their corresponding values of y for three points on line j in the xy -plane. Line k also lies in the xy -plane and is defined by the equation y = 4 x . At what point ( x , y ) do lines j and k intersect?
explanations: 设line j的表达式为y=mx+b，从表格中选取两组数据代入该表达式计算可得m=6, b=-10，故line j的表达式为y=6x-10；将该式子与line k的表达式y=4x联立形成方程组求解可得x=5，y=20，故答案为A。

question: h ( t ) = − 16 t 2 + b The function h estimates an object’s height, in feet, above the ground t seconds after the object is dropped, where b is a constant. The function estimates that the object is 19.36 feet above the ground when it is dropped at t = 0 . How many seconds after being dropped does the function estimate the object will hit the ground?
explanations: x=0时，h(t)=0+b=19.36，故 h ( t ) = − 16 t 2 + 19.36 ；撞击地面即为h(t)=0，代入函数求解可得t=1.1，故答案为1.1。

question: | 4 x − 3 | = − 9 How many solutions does the given equation have?
explanations: 绝对值大于等于0，故绝对值等于-9是不可能的，该方程没有解。

question: The function h is defined by h ( x ) = a x + b , where a and b are positive constants. The graph of y = h ( x ) in the xy -plane passes through the points ( 0 , 10 ) and ( 2 , 13 ) . What is the value of ab ?
explanations: 将题目中的两个点的坐标代入函数表达式可得 h ( 0 ) = a 0 + b = 1 + b = 10 ， h ( 2 ) = a 2 + b = 13 ，求解该方程组可得a=2，b=9，故ab=2*9=18，所以选B。

question: A circle has center P , and points A and B lie on the circle. The measure of arc AB is 45 ∘ and the length of arc AB is 4 π units. What is the length, in units, of the radius of the circle?
explanations: 根据题意4π/45°=周长/360°可知周长为32π，故半径为16，即答案为16。

question: The function f is defined by f ( x ) = 56 ( 0.19 ) x . For any positive integer n , the value of f ( n ) is p % less than the value of f ( n − 1 ) . What is the value of p ?
explanations: 根据题意可得f(n)=f(n-1)*(1-p%)，代入函数表达式可得 56 ∗ ( 0.19 ) n = 56 ∗ ( 0.19 ) n − 1 ∗ ( 1 − p % ) ，求解可得p=81，故答案为D。

question: x 2 + ( k − 3 ) x + 42 = 0 In the given equation, k is a constant. The equation has exactly one real solution. What is the value of k ?
explanations: 考查一元二次方程 a x 2 + b x + c = 0 的方程的解的个数；当 b 2 − 4 a c = 0 时，方程只有1个实数解，代入数字可得 ( k − 3 ) 2 − 4 ∗ 1 ∗ 42 = 0 ，计算可得k=171，故选A。

question: x 2 + y 2 = 36 y = m x + b 4 In the given system of equations, m and b are negative constants. In the xy -plane, the graphs of the equations in the given system intersect at the point ( − 5 , y ) , where y < 0 . Which expression represents the value of b ?
explanations: 因为y小于0，所以计算第一个方程可得y=-√11，将该数字代入第二个方程可得 − 5 m + b 4 = − 11 ，计算可得答案为D。

question: A biologist mixed a solution that is 0.3% sodium chloride by mass with a solution that is 0.15% sodium chloride by mass to obtain a new solution, which has a mass of 80 grams and contains 0.21 grams of sodium chloride. How many grams of 0.3% sodium chloride solution did the biologist use?
explanations: 设0.3%浓度的液体体积为x，0.15%浓度的液体体积为y，根据题意可得x+y=80， 0.3% x+0.15%y=0.21，求解该方程组可得x=60，y=20，故答案为C。

question: For data set A , the table summarizes the distribution of the number of pieces of mail received by a business each day during a period of 11 days. The data value 13 is removed from data set A to create data set B , which consists of the remaining 10 data values. Which statement best compares the median of data set A and the median of data set B ?
selections: A. The median of data set B is less than the median of data set A .
B. The median of data set B is greater than the median of data set A .
C. The median of data set B is equal to the median of data set A .
D. There is not enough information to compare the medians of the two data sets.
explanations: 数据移走前后的中值都为4，所以两组数据的中值相等，故选C。

question: x 5 + y 9 = 47 45 An engineer connects resistors in series, where the resistors in the series have a total resistance of 47 45 ohms. In this series, there are x resistors of type A , which each have a resistance of a ohms, and y resistors of type B , which each have a resistance of b ohms. The given equation represents this situation. According to this equation, what is the positive difference between the value of a and the value of b ?
explanations: x表示A电阻的个数，那每个A电阻的大小为1/5，同理每个B电阻的大小为1/9，两种电阻的的大小之差为1/5 - 1/9 =4/45，故选D。

question: 9 x 2 + 8 = n x In the given equation, n is a constant. The equation has exactly one solution. What is the value of n 2 8 ?
explanations: 考查一元二次方程 a x 2 + b x + c = 0 的方程的解的个数；当 b 2 − 4 a c = 0 时，方程只有1个实数解，代入数字可得 n 2 − 4 ∗ 9 ∗ 8 = 0 ，故 n 2 = 4 ∗ 9 ∗ 8 ，那 n 2 / 8 = 36 ，故答案为36。

question: The table gives the areas and perimeters of two similar rectangles, where n is a constant. What is the value of n ?
explanations: 如果两个相似图形的边长之比为1：a，那周长之比为1:a，面积之比为 1 : a 2 。代入题目中的数字可得 a 2 = 2520 / 630 = 4 ，故a=2；故n=210*2=420，所以答案为D。

question: The mass of object A is 444 % of the mass of object B , and the mass of object A is 0.740 % of the mass of object C . If the mass of object C is p % of the mass of object B , what is the value of p ?
Which expression is a factor of y 2 ( x − 3 ) − 25 ( x − 3 ) 3 ?

An environmental scientist needs to collect at least 38 samples of red clay soil for analysis. If r represents the number of samples the scientist collects for analysis, which inequality represents this situation?
explanations: r至少38，那就是r大于等于38，故选D。

question: 7 j = k + 13 m The given equation relates the distinct positive numbers j , k , and m . Which equation correctly expresses j in terms of k and m ?

question:
The following text is adapted from Jhumpa Lahiri’s 2003 novel The Namesake . Ashima and her husband, Ashoke, are traveling from the United States to India.Ashoke puts his hand over hers as the plane begins to gather speed. And then Boston tilts away and they ascend effortlessly over a darkened Atlantic. ©2003 by Jhumpa Lahiri

As used in the text, what does the word “gather” most nearly mean?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文本改编自朱帕·拉希里（Jhumpa Lahiri）2003年的小说《同名人》。艾希玛和她的丈夫艾修克正从美国前往印度。 当飞机开始加速时，艾修克将手搭在她的手上。随后波士顿逐渐远去，他们轻松地升上黑暗的大西洋上空。 中文解析： 文中“gather”描述飞机加速的过程，与“gain”（增加、获得）的含义最为接近，表示速度的累积提升。其他选项“doubt”（怀疑）、“welcome”（欢迎）和“force”（强迫）均不符合语境。因此，选项A为正确答案。
exam_name: 2025年10月北美第1套阅读语法（M2简单，和北美第2套阅读语法重复不录入）

question:

question:
Microbiologist Radamés Cordero and team investigated surface temperatures of a variety of fungus, including Amanita muscaria and a species from the genus Cantharellus , in a study ______  a previous observation: Cordero had taken thermal images of various wild mushrooms while hiking and found that the mushrooms all appeared to be colder than the surrounding environment, raising questions about thermoregulation in fungus.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 翻译题目文本： 微生物学家拉达梅斯·科尔德罗及其团队在一项______先前观察的研究中，调查了包括毒蝇伞和鸡油菌属一个物种在内的多种真菌表面温度：科尔德罗在徒步时拍摄了各种野生蘑菇的热成像图，发现所有蘑菇似乎都比周围环境更冷，这引发了关于真菌体温调节的疑问。 中文解析： 研究是基于科尔德罗徒步时的偶然发现而展开的，因此该研究是“由...引发”的。选项D “prompted by”（由...促使）最能体现这种因果关系。其他选项“released in”（在...发布）、“acknowledged in”（在...承认）和“excluded by”（被...排除）均不符合语境逻辑。

question:
Research on Chaenocephalus aceratus and other icefishes of the Teleostei class has shown that their hearts are pale due to low levels of myoglobin expression, which was once thought to be related to their polar habitats. Recently, researchers have found that some tropical teleost species (such as Sphaeramia nematoptera ) also have pale hearts, raising the possibility that myoglobin deficiency in teleosts could be _____ habitat.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 翻译题目文本： 对冰鱼（Chaenocephalus aceratus）及骨鳔类其他冰鱼的研究表明，由于肌红蛋白表达水平低，它们的心脏呈浅色，这一点曾被认为与它们的极地栖息地有关。最近研究人员发现，一些热带骨鳔类物种（如线纹天竺鲷）也拥有浅色心脏，这提出了骨鳔类肌红蛋白缺失可能______栖息地的可能性。 中文解析： 研究发现热带物种同样存在心脏浅色现象，说明肌红蛋白缺失与栖息地类型（极地或热带）无关。选项A“irrespective of”（与...无关）准确表达了这种独立性。其他选项中，“mediated by”（由...调节）、“predictive of”（可预测...）和“obscured by”（被...掩盖）均与文中“不同栖息地存在相同特征”的论证逻辑不符。
exam_name: 2025年10月北美第1套阅读语法（M2简单，和北美第2套阅读语法重复不录入）

question:
In 2013 Bridie J.M. Allan and colleagues published a study concluding that ocean acidification has a strong effect on the behavior of Pomacentrus amboinensis , a species of fish. However, Allan and colleagues’ study relied on a mean sample size of only about 18 fish. In a 2022 review of various scientists’ conclusions about the impacts of ocean acidification on fish behavior, Josef in Sundin and colleagues caution that relying on such a relatively small sample size can increase the potential for biased analysis. Such analysis, in turn, can contribute to reports of exaggerated effects.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It introduces a detail about Allan and colleagues’ study that is addressed in the sentences that follow.
B. It offers an alternative explanation for the behavior of Pomacentrus amboinensis that is described in the previous sentence.
C. It emphasizes the threat of ocean acidification to Pomacentrus amboinensis that is mentioned in the previous sentence.
D. It states the conclusion reached by Allan and colleagues that is elaborated on in the sentences that follow.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 2013年，布里迪·J·M·艾伦与同事发表了一项研究，认为海洋酸化对安邦雀鲷（Pomacentrus amboinensis）的行为有强烈影响。然而，艾伦团队的研究仅依赖平均约18条鱼的样本规模。在2022年一篇关于多位科学家对海洋酸化影响鱼类行为结论的综述中，约瑟夫·因·桑丁与同事提醒，依赖如此相对较小的样本量可能增加分析偏差的风险，而这种偏差又可能导致夸大影响的报告。 中文解析： 画线句子指出艾伦研究的样本量很小，这一细节在后文被进一步讨论——桑丁等人据此提出小样本可能导致分析偏差和夸大效应。选项A准确描述了该句承上启下的功能。其他选项均不符合：B项“提出替代解释”、C项“强调酸化威胁”和D项“陈述研究结论”均未体现样本量这一细节的引出作用。
exam_name: 2025年10月北美第1套阅读语法（M2简单，和北美第2套阅读语法重复不录入）

question:
Editor Jared Shurin’s 2023 anthology The Big Book of Cyberpunk contains 108 stories, an enormous number when compared to the 1986 cyberpunk anthology Mirrorshades , which has only twelve. Encompassing both early (e.g., Fritz Leiber’s 1950 story “Coming Attraction”) and more recent (e.g., Erica Satifka’s 2021 story “Act of Providence”) contributions, the broad chronological scope of Shurin ’ s volume may make it seem more comprehensive than Mirrorshades , but Mirrorshades ’ s focus is more carefully considered, rendering it the more authoritative anthology of this science fiction subgenre.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It supports the assertion that Leiber and Satifka should be considered essential figures in the cyberpunk movement.
B. It indicates a sensible perception of a cyberpunk anthology that can nonetheless be disputed for a good reason.
C. It suggests that, because they are relatively up to date, more recently published collections of cyberpunk stories are likely to be more inclusive than earlier anthologies.
D. It helps explain why two compilers of anthologies have different ideas regarding which short stories should be labeled as “cyberpunk.”
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 编辑贾里德·舒林2023年的选集《赛博朋克大书》收录了108篇故事，与仅收录12篇的1986年赛博朋克选集《镜片墨镜》相比数量庞大。舒林这本选集的时间跨度很广，既包含早期作品（如弗里茨·莱伯1950年的故事《即将到来的吸引力》），也收录近期作品（如埃里卡·萨蒂夫卡2021年的故事《天意之举》），这或许使其看起来比《镜片墨镜》更全面，但《镜片墨镜》的选题更为审慎，因而成为该科幻子类型更具权威性的选集。 中文解析： 画线部分指出舒林选集因时间跨度广而“看似更全面”，但后文通过“但”进行转折，强调《镜片墨镜》因精选内容而更具权威性。这说明画线部分描述了一种表面合理的认知，但实际存在可争议之处。选项B准确抓住了这种“看似合理实可商榷”的逻辑关系。其他选项均未准确反映这一功能。
exam_name: 2025年10月北美第1套阅读语法（M2简单，和北美第2套阅读语法重复不录入）

question:
Wenheng Zhang and colleagues have explored how convergent evolution— a phenomenon that occurs when the same trait evolves independently in two reproductive separate lineages — can result from a genetic mechanism shared by both lineages. Meanwhile, Patricia J. Wittkopp and colleagues have investigated how convergence occurs through different genetic mechanisms, but the relative prevalence of convergence through shared and different genetic processes is still poorly understood. This motivated biologists Delbert A. Green II and Cassandra G. Extavour to evaluate both types of convergence in a single study for their 2012 paper.

Which choice best states the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It clarifies a concept that the author implies was unclear in the studies mentioned in the text.
B. It provides examples of how a phenomenon was studied by scientists in the field before Green and Extavour's study.
C. It introduces a method of scientific analysis that is discussed in greater detail later in the text.
D. It gives a basic description of a phenomenon that is central to the discussion that follows.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 张文恒与同事探索了趋同进化（当两个生殖隔离的谱系独立演化出相同性状时发生的现象）如何可能由两个谱系共享的遗传机制导致。与此同时，帕特里夏·J·维特科普与同事研究了趋同现象如何通过不同的遗传机制发生，但人们对通过相同与不同遗传过程产生趋同的相对普遍性仍知之甚少。这促使生物学家德尔伯特·A·格林二世与卡桑德拉·G·埃克斯塔沃尔在2012年的论文中对两类趋同进行了统一评估。 中文解析： 画线部分是对“趋同进化”这一核心概念的定义解释，该概念是后文所有研究讨论的基础。选项D准确描述了其作为基础定义的功能。其他选项均不贴切：A项“澄清模糊概念”未体现定义性质；B项“提供前人研究案例”与画线部分定义性质不符；C项“引入分析方法”则混淆了概念定义与方法论述。

question:
Text 1 As part of a study of ungulates (hoofed mammals) native to the Yellowstone River basin, fresh dung samples from identified individuals were collected in the Confederated Salish and Kootenai Tribes Bison Range of Montana. Based on steroidal analysis, on average the bison and elk samples had similar levels of beta-sitosterol and stigmastanol, which distinguished these species' profiles from that of moose. Text 2 Although fecal-steroidal profile alone is not sufficient to distinguish between samples from bison and those from elk, the relative levels of zoostanols (steroids with animal origins), such as coprostanol and 24-ethyl-coprostanol, in sediments at Buffalo Ford Lake in Yellowstone National Park show that bison, elk, or both were the predominant ungulates in the lake‘s watershed for all strata of sediment examined, going as far back as 2,300 years.

Which conclusion about steroid profiles is supported by information in both Text 1 and Text 2?
selections: A. The profiles for bison and elk contain similar concentrations of various steroids.
B. Each of the ungulate species in the Buffalo Ford Lake watershed has a distinctive and unique steroidal profile.
C. Some steroids in the bison and elk profiles are more likely than others to be preserved for long time spans.
D. The profiles of ungulates in and around the Yellowstone basin show that bison and elk have historically been more prevalent than moose in the area.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 文本1 在对黄石河流域本土有蹄类动物（蹄哺乳动物）的研究中，研究人员从蒙大拿州萨利什和库特奈部落野牛保护区采集了已知个体的新鲜粪便样本。基于甾体分析，野牛和麋鹿样本中的β-谷甾醇和豆甾烷醇平均含量相近，这一特征使这两个物种的甾体谱与驼鹿区分开来。 文本2 尽管仅凭粪便甾体谱不足以区分野牛和麋鹿的样本，但黄石国家公园布法罗福特湖沉积物中动物源甾醇（如粪甾醇和24-乙基粪甾醇）的相对水平表明，在追溯至2300年前的所有沉积层中，野牛、麋鹿或两者共同是该湖泊流域的主要有蹄类动物。 中文解析： 文本1明确指出野牛和麋鹿样本在β-谷甾醇和豆甾烷醇含量上相似；文本2进一步承认仅靠甾体谱难以区分两者，间接印证了它们甾体组成的相似性。选项A准确概括了这一共同结论。其他选项均不被双文本支持：B项“独特甾体谱”与文本2的难以区分矛盾；C项“长期保存差异”和D项“历史普遍性比较”均缺乏双文本共同证据。

question:

They placed pieces of pine and oak between 0 and 200 meters away from each shipwreck to collect samples of microbes. They found that pine and oak pieces placed about 125 meters from the shipwrecks had the most species of microbes on them.

According to the text, at what approximate distance from the studied shipwrecks did the researchers observe the most species of microbes on the pine and oak pieces?

question:
Baleen whales eat up to 30 percent of their total body mass in krill (tiny shrimplike creatures) per day. So in one day, a humpback whale weighing 30,000 kg could eat 9,000 kg, while a southern right whale weighing 80,000 kg could ingest a whopping 24,000 kg. Over the last century, baleen whale populations have declined, and contrary to some scientists’ expectations, so have krill populations. Matthew S. Savoca and colleagues resolve this apparent discrepancy by pointing out that baleen whales cycle iron in the ocean, helping support phytoplankton populations, which, in turn, sustain krill populations.

Based on the text, what is one likely effect of the change in baleen whale populations over the last century?
selections: A. The maximum body sizes of humpback and southern right whales have increased over the last century.
B. The quantity of krill needed to support a single southern right whale has increased over the last century.
C. The iron richness of the krill that baleen whales eat has declined over the last century.
D. Populations of phytoplankton that krill feed on have declined over the last century.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 须鲸每天摄食的磷虾（微小的虾状生物）量可达其总体重的30%。因此，一头重30,000公斤的座头鲸每天可吃掉9,000公斤磷虾，而一头重80,000公斤的南露脊鲸每天摄入量高达24,000公斤。过去一个世纪以来，须鲸数量持续下降，但与一些科学家的预期相反，磷虾数量也随之减少。马修·S·萨沃卡与同事通过指出须鲸在海洋中循环铁元素的现象，解释了这一表面矛盾：须鲸能帮助维持浮游植物种群，而浮游植物正是磷虾的食物来源。 中文解析： 文本明确指出须鲸通过铁循环支持浮游植物生长，而浮游植物是磷虾的主要食物。根据逻辑链条，须鲸减少会导致铁循环减弱，进而引发浮游植物减少。选项D与此因果关系完全吻合。其他选项均与文本逻辑相悖：A项“鲸鱼体型增大”、B项“单头鲸需求磷虾量增加”和C项“磷虾含铁量下降”均未在文中提及或推导。

question:
The Age of Innocence is a 1920 novel by Edith Wharton set in New York City in the 1870s. In the novel, Newland Archer attends an opera. Newland compares his intellect favorably to that of other men of New York City society who are in the audience:_____

Which quotation from The Age of Innocence best illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “It surprised [Newland] that life should be going on in the old way when his own reactions to it had so completely changed.”

B. “Newland Archer felt himself distinctly the superior of these chosen specimens of old New York gentility; he had probably read more, thought more, and even seen a good deal more of the world, than any other man of the number.”
C. “No expense had been spared on the setting, which was acknowledged to be very beautiful even by people who shared [Newland’s] acquaintance with the Opera houses of Paris and Vienna.”

question:
Paleontologist Amane Tajika and colleagues analyzed the shells of two marine mollusks called nautilids that were harvested from New Caledonia. The researchers found that samples from shell sections that formed before hatching, including sample F04, formed in 20-22°C water, whereas samples from sections that formed after hatching, including M27, formed in 13-15°C water. These findings are consistent with the temperatures Fijian nautilids encounter during their corresponding stages of development. Because water temperature varies with depth, a biology student hypothesized that the New Caledonian nautilus lay their eggs at approximately the same depth as Fijian nautilus do.

Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the student’s hypothesis?
selections: A. Fijian nautilids generally live at lower depths than New Caledonian nautilids do, though Fijian nautilids migrate to the typical depth of New Caledonian nautilus to lay their eggs.
B. Once a nautilus hatches, it is a very mobile animal, so the temperature values reported by Tajika and colleagues for the adult nautilids are averages over a potentially large range of depths.
C. The water temperature at a given depth tends to be lower in waters near New Caledonia than it is at that depth in waters near Fiji.
D. There are few locations near Fiji with water temperatures of 13-15°C that are suitable for nautilus eggs.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 古生物学家Amane Tajika与同事分析了来自新喀里多尼亚的两只海洋软体动物鹦鹉螺的壳。研究人员发现，孵化前形成的壳层样本（包括样本F04）形成于20-22°C水域，而孵化后形成的壳层样本（包括M27）形成于13-15°C水域。这些发现与斐济鹦鹉螺在相应发育阶段经历的温度一致。由于水温随深度变化，一名生物学学生提出假设：新喀里多尼亚鹦鹉螺的产卵深度与斐济鹦鹉螺大致相同。 中文解析： 学生的假设核心是“相同温度对应相同深度”，但若新喀里多尼亚同深度水温始终低于斐济（选项C），则相同温度实际对应不同深度，直接削弱了深度相同的推论。其他选项均不构成直接削弱：A项承认产卵深度一致；B项讨论成体活动范围，与产卵深度无关；D项仅说明斐济适宜产卵点少，未否定两地深度关联性。

question:
The Mammillaria cactus M. guerreronis occurs naturally only in the state of Guerrero in Mexico, and the smallness of its range makes it especially vulnerable to extinction. The traditional single-species approach to conservation emphasizes the need to focus on individual species most at risk, like M. guerreronis , but recently, conservationists have argued that an ecosystem-based approach that incorporates the many interactions between the climate, terrain, and various species of a given geographical area may lead to better outcomes for all the species in a given location. An ecosystem-based approach to the conservation of M. guerreronis could thus _____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. allow conservationists to better consider how climatic changes affecting Guerrero may reduce the number of species competing with M. guerreronis .
B. identify conservation strategies that may not be exclusively aimed at protecting M. guerreronis but that benefit the species nonetheless.
C. lead to a better understanding of how the distribution of Mammillaria species throughout Mexico has affected their survival.
D. be unable to evaluate whether M. guerreronis would be capable of surviving in habitats outside of Guerrero.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： Mammillaria guerreronis 仙人掌仅自然分布于墨西哥格雷罗州，其狭小的分布范围使其特别容易灭绝。传统的单一物种保护方法强调重点关注像 M. guerreronis 这样的高危物种，但最近保护主义者提出，基于生态系统的保护方法（综合考虑特定地理区域的气候、地形和各种物种之间的多种相互作用）可能为该地区的所有物种带来更好的保护效果。因此，对 M. guerreronis 采取基于生态系统的保护方法可以______ 中文解析： 文本指出生态系统方法关注区域内所有物种及环境因素的相互作用，因此可能制定出非专门针对该仙人掌、但仍能使其受益的保护策略。选项B准确体现了这种“非专属但仍有益”的保护逻辑。其他选项均存在偏差：A项强调减少竞争者，与生态系统方法的整体性相悖；C项讨论墨西哥全境分布，超出该生态系统范围；D项否定评估能力，与该方法提升保护效果的宗旨矛盾。

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 1992年之前，大多数奥运会都设有表演项目，这些项目不颁发奖牌。______1912年斯德哥尔摩夏季奥运会就曾安排过一场格利马（一种北欧传统摔跤）表演。 中文解析： 前文提出“1992年前奥运会有表演项目”的普遍现象，后文用1912年具体案例进行例证。选项A“For example”（例如）能准确建立这种“总述-举例”的逻辑关系。其他选项均不符合语境：“Meanwhile”（与此同时）表示时间并行，“Someday”（将来某天）指向未来，“On the other hand”（另一方面）需引出对比观点，皆无法衔接上下文。
exam_name: 2025年10月北美第1套阅读语法（M2简单，和北美第2套阅读语法重复不录入）

question:
Many places that gained their independence from Spain in the nineteenth century still bear the legacy of the Spanish Empire in their language, including Spanish-speaking Cuba, which left the empire in 1898.______ which ceased to be part of the Spanish Empire in 1648; Spanish is rarely spoken in the Netherlands in the twenty-first century.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
selections: A. This contrast is evident in the Netherlands,
B. Another example is the Netherlands,
C. The reverse is true of the Netherlands,
D. The results can be heard in the Netherlands,
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 许多19世纪从西班牙独立的地方至今仍在语言上保留着西班牙帝国的遗产，包括1898年脱离帝国的西班牙语国家古巴。______荷兰于1648年脱离西班牙帝国；但21世纪的荷兰已很少使用西班牙语。 中文解析： 前文强调“脱离西班牙后仍保留西班牙语”的现象（如古巴），后文则指出荷兰“脱离西班牙后不再使用西班牙语”，形成鲜明对比。选项C“The reverse is true”（相反情况）准确体现了这种语义反转关系。其他选项均不符合逻辑：A项“对比明显”未体现反向关系，B项“另一个例子”与后文事实矛盾，D项“结果可被听到”与后文语言消亡的事实相悖。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·Elizabeth Catlett (1915-2012) was a celebrated African American artist. ·She is best known for creating sculptures and prints that explore the Black experience. ·Catlett’s sculpture Sister is made of bronze. ·She created this sculpture in 1973.

The student wants to specify the year that Elizabeth Catlett created the sculpture Sister . Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Elizabeth Catlett, a celebrated artist, was born in 1915.
B. Celebrated artist Elizabeth Catlett is best known for creating sculptures and prints that explore the Black experience.
C. Elizabeth Catlett was a celebrated artist who created prints as well as sculptures.
D. Elizabeth Catlett created the bronze sculpture Sister in 1973.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一名学生在研究课题时记录了以下笔记： · 伊丽莎白·卡特莱特（1915-2012）是著名的非裔美国艺术家。 · 她以创作探索黑人经历的雕塑和版画而闻名。 · 卡特莱特的雕塑《姐妹》由青铜制成。 · 她于1973年创作了这件雕塑。 该学生想要说明伊丽莎白·卡特莱特创作雕塑《姐妹》的具体年份。 中文解析： 该选项直接整合了笔记中“雕塑名称”“创作年份”及“材质”这三个核心要素，精准实现了题目要求的目标。其他选项均未包含创作年份：A项只提及艺术家出生年份，B项和C项仅描述艺术风格或作品类型，均未满足指定创作时间的具体要求。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·NASA mission expedition 14 took place from September 18, 2006, to April 21, 2007. ·Astronauts Michael López-Alegría and Sunita Williams were crew members of expedition 14. ·January 31, 2007: Lopez-Alegría and Williams performed an extravehicular activity (EVA) to replace instruments on the Hubble Space Telescope. ·An EVA (also known as a spacewalk) is an activity done by astronauts outside the spacecraft. ·The duration of their EVA was 7 hours and 55 minutes. ·Theirs is counted among the longest completed spacewalks to date.

The student wants to emphasize the duration of Lopez-Alegría and Williams’s EVA. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Lopez-Alegría and Williams completed an EVA, also known as a spacewalk, in which they left the spacecraft to replace instruments on the Hubble Space Telescope.
B. Lasting 7 hours and 55 minutes, López-Alegría and Williams’s EVA is one of the longest spacewalks completed to date.
C. During their time as crew members of expedition 14, Lopez-Alegría and Williams completed an EVA.
D. The EVA completed by expedition 14 crew members López-Alegría and Williams took place from September 18, 2006, to April 21, 2007.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一名学生在研究课题时记录了以下笔记： · NASA第14次远征任务于2006年9月18日至2007年4月21日进行 · 宇航员迈克尔·洛佩斯-阿莱格里亚和苏尼塔·威廉姆斯是第14次远征任务的成员 · 2007年1月31日：洛佩斯-阿莱格里亚和威廉姆斯执行舱外活动（EVA），更换哈勃太空望远镜的仪器 · 舱外活动（又称太空行走）是宇航员在航天器外进行的活动 · 他们的舱外活动持续时间为7小时55分钟 · 这次活动被列为迄今完成的最长太空行走之一 该学生想要强调洛佩斯-阿莱格里亚和威廉姆斯舱外活动的持续时间。 中文解析： 该选项开篇即点明“持续7小时55分钟”这一核心数据，并通过“最长太空行走之一”的表述强化时长的显著性，完美实现了强调持续时间的目标。其他选项均未突出时长要素：A项仅描述活动内容，C项只提及完成事实，D项错误使用任务总时间段而非太空行走具体时长。
exam_name: 2025年10月北美第1套阅读语法（M2简单，和北美第2套阅读语法重复不录入）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·Cheryll is the nickname of a Triceratops fossil specimen housed at the Palm Beach Museum of Natural History. ·The Palm Beach Museum of Natural History is located in Wellington, Florida. ·Cheryl lived in the Late Cretaceous period. ·Dio is the nickname of a Triceratops fossil specimen housed at the Royal Ontario Museum. ·The Royal Ontario Museum is located in Ontario, Canada. ·Dio lived in the Late Cretaceous period.

The student wants to contrast the locations of the two specimens. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Cheryl is housed at the Palm Beach Museum of Natural History in Wellington, Florida, while dio is housed at the Royal Ontario Museum in Ontario, Canada.
B. The Triceratops fossil specimen Cheryl is not the only such specimen currently housed in a museum or institute.
C. The Royal Ontario Museum in Ontario, Canada, houses dio, a Triceratops fossil specimen.
D. Like Cheryll, dio is a Triceratops fossil specimen that lived in the Late Cretaceous period.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一名学生在研究课题时记录了以下笔记： · “谢里尔”是保存在棕榈滩自然历史博物馆的一具三角龙化石标本的昵称。 · 棕榈滩自然历史博物馆位于佛罗里达州惠灵顿市。 · 谢里尔生存于白垩纪晚期。 · “迪奥”是保存在安大略皇家博物馆的一具三角龙化石标本的昵称。 · 安大略皇家博物馆位于加拿大安大略省。 · 迪奥生存于白垩纪晚期。 该学生想要对比两具化石标本的存放地点。 中文解析： 该选项通过并列句式直接对比了两具标本的具体博物馆所在地，清晰呈现了“佛罗里达”与“加拿大安大略”的地理差异。其他选项均未实现对比目标：B项仅说明谢里尔非唯一标本，未提具体地点；C项只描述迪奥的存放地；D项强调两者时代相同，与地理位置对比无关。

question:
In addition to the giant stock exchanges in places like London, Mumbai, and Tokyo, there are many smaller exchanges such as the Beirut Stock Exchange in Beirut, Lebanon. Though small, by being dedicated to Lebanon, it can better address factors that help local businesses _____ , and that focus on the success of local businesses benefits investors and the local economy.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 除了伦敦、孟买和东京等地的大型证券交易所外，还有许多小型交易所，例如黎巴嫩贝鲁特的贝鲁特证券交易所。规模虽小，但通过专注于黎巴嫩本土，它能更好地应对有助于本地企业______的因素，而这种对本地企业成功的关注将使投资者和当地经济受益。 中文解析： 后文强调“对本地企业成功的关注”能带来多方受益，因此交易所关注的必然是促进企业“蓬勃发展”的因素。选项A“thrive”（繁荣/兴盛）最符合商业发展的积极语境。其他选项均不符合：“disperse”（分散）、“ebb”（衰退）和“overspend”（过度开支）都无法与“企业成功”及“经济效益”形成逻辑衔接。

question:
The following text is from Rudolfo Anaya's 1972 novel Bless Me, Ultima . Two of the narrator’s adult brothers have decided to move away from home. Another brother has decided not to accompany them. In the morning León and Eugene were gone, but Andrew remained. They had talked long into the night, and finally he had given up the idea of going with them. I think he did not like to follow their ways, and he wanted to please my mother. ©1972 by Rudolfo Anaya

As used in the text, what does the word "follow" most nearly mean?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文本节选自鲁道弗·安纳亚1972年的小说《保佑我，乌尔蒂玛》。叙述者的两个成年兄弟决定离家远行，而另一个兄弟决定不与他们同行。 早晨，莱昂和尤金已经离开，但安德鲁留了下来。他们昨夜长谈，最终他放弃了同去的念头。我认为他不喜欢遵循他们的方式，而且他想让母亲高兴。 中文解析： 文中“follow their ways”指安德鲁不愿“仿效”兄弟们的行事方式，与“imitate”（模仿）的词义高度契合。其他选项均不符合语境：“justify”（证明合理）、“mention”（提及）和“restore”（恢复）都无法与“their ways”（他们的方式）形成合理的动宾搭配。
exam_name: 2025年10月北美第1套阅读语法（M2简单，和北美第2套阅读语法重复不录入）

question:
Wireless headphones and other small electronic devices tend to use batteries that can’t be easily taken out and swapped for new ones. Environmental policy researcher Jean-Pierre Schweitzer warns that when these internal batteries stop working, the devices are usually thrown away, becoming harmful_______

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 翻译题目文本： 无线耳机和其他小型电子设备往往使用无法轻松取出并更换的电池。环境政策研究员让-皮埃尔·施韦策警告说，当这些内置电池停止工作时，设备通常会被丢弃，成为有害的______。 中文解析： 选C。废弃设备会变成有害的"废物"，最符合逻辑。

question:
Corrine Walsh and colleagues tested whether soil microorganisms from ecologically different settings—aspen grove, irrigated pasture, and so on—affect plants’ flavor chemistry. Although they found associations between plants’ glucosinolates (compounds that produce spicy and bitter flavors) and plants’ growth conditions, variations in glucosinolates could not be _____ soil microbes specifically.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 科琳·沃尔什与同事测试了来自不同生态环境（如白杨林、灌溉牧场等）的土壤微生物是否会影响植物的风味化学。虽然他们发现植物的硫代葡萄糖苷（产生辛辣和苦味的化合物）与植物生长环境存在关联，但硫代葡萄糖苷的变化无法______土壤微生物。 中文解析： 前文指出研究发现植物化合物与生长环境存在关联，但通过“无法______土壤微生物”的转折可知，这种变化不能归因于微生物因素。选项C“attributed to”（归因于）准确表达了因果关系不成立的逻辑。其他选项均不符合语境：“forestalled by”（被阻止）、“subverted by”（被颠覆）和“excluded from”（被排除）均无法体现研究试图建立的因果关联性。

question:
The Walt Whitman House in Camden, New Jersey, is the house where Walt Whitman lived for eight years and where he wrote later editions of his poetry collection Leaves of Grass . Now the house is a museum dedicated to Whitman’s life and writings. Visitors travel to this museum to feel more connected to an author they admire. To encourage that sense of connection, the museum’s curators have set up exhibits with furnishings and decor owned by Whitman. Such exhibits help visitors understand day-to-day life in the house where Whitman felt inspired.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To describe a museum focused on Whitman’s life and works
B. To explain why readers enjoy Whitman’s works
D. To compare the Walt Whitman House with other museums
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 位于新泽西州卡姆登的沃尔特·惠特曼故居是惠特曼居住八年并创作后期《草叶集》的地方。如今该故居已成为纪念惠特曼生平与著作的博物馆。游客们慕名而来，希望与这位他们敬仰的作家建立更深的精神联结。为强化这种联结感，策展人陈列了惠特曼使用过的家具与装饰品。这些展品帮助游客理解惠特曼在此获得灵感源泉的日常生活。 中文解析： 全文围绕惠特曼故居博物馆展开，依次介绍了其历史背景、存在意义、展陈特色与游客体验，核心目的在于描述这座专注于惠特曼生平与文学成就的博物馆。其他选项均偏离重点：B项未讨论读者喜好，C项未系统梳理传记，D项未进行博物馆横向对比。
exam_name: 2025年10月北美第1套阅读语法（M2简单，和北美第2套阅读语法重复不录入）

question:
The following text is adapted from Henrik Ibsen's 1899 play When We Dead Awaken (translated by William Archer in 1907). Ulfheim is introducing himself to Professor Rubek, a sculptor. ULFHEIM:I believe I have the honour of addressing no less a person than the great Sculptor Rubek. PROFESSOR RUBEK: ( Nods .) I remember meeting you once or twice—the autumn when I was last at home. ULFHEIM: That’s many years ago, now. And then you weren't so illustrious as I hear you’ve since become.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text?
selections: A. It reveals that Professor Rubek first met Ulfheim many years ago.
B. It emphasizes that Professor Rubek has a distinguished reputation.
C. It suggests that Ulfheim prefers autumn to spring, summer, or winter.
D. It indicates that many other sculptors are more famous than Professor Rubek.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： （以下文本改编自亨里克·易卜生1899年戏剧《当我们死者醒来时》（威廉·阿彻1907年译本）。乌尔夫海姆正在向雕塑家鲁贝克教授自我介绍。） 乌尔夫海姆：我相信我有幸对话的正是鼎鼎大名的雕塑家鲁贝克本人。 鲁贝克教授：（点头）我记得曾见过您一两次——在我上次回故乡的那个秋天。 乌尔夫海姆：那已是多年前的事了。而且当时您还没有像后来传闻的那样声名显赫。 中文解析： 画线句通过“不像后来传闻的那样声名显赫”的对比，暗示鲁贝克如今已获得崇高声望。选项B准确捕捉到这种对声誉的强调作用。其他选项均不符合文意：A项虽提及时间但未触及核心功能；C项的季节偏好纯属过度解读；D项的“更著名雕塑家”与原文凸显鲁贝克个人声望的意图相悖。
exam_name: 2025年10月北美第1套阅读语法（M2简单，和北美第2套阅读语法重复不录入）

question:
Text 1 Brown University and the investment bank Barclays are two of the many institutions offering training programs in entrepreneurship. But what results do such programs produce? In a study of business school graduates in Norway, researchers Lars Kolvereid and Øystein Moen addressed this question and convincingly demonstrated that participants showed strong intentions to become entrepreneurs as a result of receiving entrepreneurial training. Text 2 While studies of entrepreneurial training typically report positive results, a close look at these studies reveals widespread methodological shortcomings. For instance, a 1997 study by Lars Kolvereid and Øystein Moen found benefits of entrepreneurial education for graduates of Norwegian business schools, but the study only collected data on subjects after the training, not before, making it unclear whether the training actually had an effect.

Based on the texts, the author of Text 1 and the author of Text 2 would most likely disagree about the answer to which question?
selections: A. Is the cost of conducting entrepreneurial training programs typically offset by the programs' benefits?
B. Did Kolvereid and Moen's study provide persuasive evidence that its results are attributable to the entrepreneurial training participants received?
C. Did Kolvereid and Moen report that participants who received the entrepreneurial training showed strong intentions to become entrepreneurs?
D. Are there convincing experimental results showing that different types of entrepreneurial training programs are associated with different outcomes?
explanations: 翻译文本： 文本1 布朗大学和投资银行巴克莱等众多机构都开设了创业培训项目。但这类项目效果如何？研究人员拉斯·科尔韦雷和厄斯泰因·穆恩在一项针对挪威商学院毕业生的研究中探讨了该问题，并有力证明参与者在接受创业培训后表现出强烈的创业意向。 文本2 尽管创业培训研究通常报告积极结果，但细究可发现普遍存在方法论缺陷。例如，拉斯·科尔韦雷和厄斯泰因·穆恩1997年的研究发现挪威商学院毕业生从创业教育中受益，但该研究仅收集了培训后的数据，未采集训前数据，因此无法确定培训是否真正产生了效果。 中文解析： 两位作者的核心分歧在于对该研究证据力的判断。文本1作者认为研究“有力证明”培训效果，而文本2作者通过方法论缺陷（缺乏前后对比数据）质疑其因果关系论证。选项B精准捕捉了这一关于“证据是否具说服力”的争议点。其他选项均未体现根本分歧：A项成本问题、C项研究结论本身、D项不同类型项目比较，均非双方争论焦点。
exam_name: 2025年10月北美第1套阅读语法（M2简单，和北美第2套阅读语法重复不录入）

question:
Scientists study the abundance and the activity ratios (AR)—the relative radioactive decay rates of two isotopes—of uranium (U) isotopes in bodies of water to track sediment transport and deposition and to monitor groundwater quality. However, isotope abundance and AR are not always uniform across a single body of water, which may affect the reliability of results if sampling is not sufficiently representative. Chen Zhao et al. analyzed concentrations of the isotope U-238 and the U-234/U-238 AR at multiple depths and locations in two lakes in China, finding no significant variation in values within the same lake.

Information in the text best supports which statement about Zhao et al.’s findings?
selections: A. They illustrate why scientists investigating sediment transport and deposition and groundwater quality ought to evaluate how evenly U abundance and AR are distributed in the bodies of water they are examining.
B. They challenge the assumption that U abundance and AR sometimes vary from lake to lake, since the U-238 concentration and U-234/U-238 AR were consistent across the sampled lakes.

C. They indicate that researchers performing isotopic analysis in the lakes Zhao et al. studied can likely rely on localized sampling within each lake, since values from any one location or depth are representative of the entire lake.

D. They demonstrate that the number of samples Zhao et al. collected from the two lakes is sufficient to yield equally reliable information about sediment transport and deposition and groundwater quality in those two lakes.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 科学家通过研究水体中铀同位素的丰度与活性比（AR，即两种同位素的相对放射性衰变速率）来追踪沉积物迁移与沉积过程，并监测地下水质量。然而，同位素丰度与活性比在单一水体中并非总是均匀分布，若采样不具足够代表性可能影响结果可靠性。陈钊等人分析了中国两个湖泊中不同深度与位置的U-238同位素浓度及U-234/U-238活性比，发现同一湖泊内的数值无显著差异。 中文解析： 文本指出陈钊团队发现同一湖泊内不同位置与深度的铀同位素数值无显著变化，这直接支持了“局部采样能代表全湖”的结论。选项C准确概括了这一发现对采样方法的指导意义。其他选项存在偏差：A项强调评估分布均匀性的必要性，但研究实际证明了均匀性存在；B项误读为湖间一致性，而研究关注的是湖内均匀性；D项过度推断样本数量与可靠性关系，未得到直接支持。

question:
One challenge faced by researchers studying global urbanization is that different countries have different definitions of what constitutes an urban settlement. Many countries define urban settlements based on the number of people living in them. However, countries do not all use the same number; for example, Greenland uses a minimum population of 200, while Benin uses 10,000. Other countries use a combination of population and other factors, like how close buildings are to each other. This variation makes it difficult for researchers to compare aspects of urbanization in different countries.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. It is difficult for researchers to compare aspects of urbanization globally because of the various ways different countries define urban settlements.
B. Even though countries use different methods to define urban settlements, researchers consider any area having a population of at least 10,000 to be urban.
C. Researchers focus on factors other than population when conducting studies on urbanization in Greenland.
D. Urbanization is easily compared between countries when they have similar total populations.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 研究全球城市化的学者面临一项挑战：不同国家对"城市聚落"的定义各不相同。许多国家根据居住人口数量来定义城市聚落，但各国采用的标准人口数并不统一——例如格陵兰以200人为最低标准，而贝宁则要求10,000人。还有些国家综合人口与其他因素（如建筑密度）进行定义。这种差异使得研究人员难以比较不同国家的城市化特征。 中文解析： 全文通过列举格陵兰与贝宁的差异标准等例证，核心论证了"各国定义城市聚落的方式不统一导致全球城市化研究难以比较"的观点。选项A精准概括了这一中心思想。其他选项均存在偏差：B项的"统一认可万人标准"与文中差异事实矛盾；C项片面聚焦格陵兰个案；D项的"人口相似易比较"则与文本强调定义差异造成困难的逻辑完全相反。

question:
Psychologists Gregory Bryant, Dorsa Amir, and colleagues investigated cross-cultural perceptions of spontaneous (real) laughter and volitional (fake or forced) laughter. Study participants from 21 societies, including those in Japan and Turkey, listened to randomized recordings of 18 spontaneous laughs taken from natural conversations between pairs of women and 18 volitional laughs produced separately by 18 different women in response to an instruction to laugh. Analysis of the participants’ evaluations of the laughs prompted the team to conclude that the ability to distinguish between spontaneous and volitional laughter appears to be universal across cultures.

Which potential finding from another study, if true, would most directly strengthen the team’s conclusion?
selections: A. Listeners from both Japan and Turkey tend to be able to determine how well two people know each other based on recordings of their conversation.
B. Spontaneous laughter typically has a recognizable higher pitch than volitional laughter, regardless of what society the speakers in a conversation are from.
C. There is some evidence of correlation between the average size of communities in a society and judgments of spontaneous and volitional laughter by listeners in that society.
D. Acoustic features of spontaneous laughter, such as pitch and intensity, have measurable variations both within and across societies.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 心理学家Gregory Bryant、Dorsa Amir及同事研究了不同文化对自发（真实）笑声与自主（虚假或强迫）笑声的感知。来自21个社会（包括日本和土耳其）的研究参与者随机收听18段取自女性自然对话的自发笑声，以及18段由不同女性按指令单独发出的自主笑声。对参与者笑声评估的分析使团队得出结论：区分自发与自主笑声的能力在不同文化中具有普遍性。 中文解析： 该结论的核心是“跨文化普遍性”，若研究发现不同文化中自发笑声均存在可识别的高音调特征（选项B），则直接为这种普遍辨识能力提供了客观声学依据。其他选项均无法直接强化普遍性：A项仅涉及日土两国且聚焦关系判断；C项强调社会规模差异，反而削弱普遍性；D项指出声学特征变异，与普遍辨识能力相悖。

question:
Certain species, such as Hay's Spring amphipods ( Stygobromus hayi ), lack functional eyes or ocular organs altogether and rely on other mechanisms for navigation. Licheng Yuan and colleagues investigated such mechanisms in the Chinese red-headed centipede ( Scolopendra subspinipes mutilans ), which has no organs with photoreceptors (light-detecting cells) but can sense and avoid sunlight. The researchers placed individual specimens in a clear container (container 1) connected to a container covered in black tape (container 2) and then exposed the containers to simulated sunlight. They observed a rapid increase in the temperature of the centipedes’ antennae with the onset of exposure, followed by the centipedes' escape to container 2. Based on their observations, the researchers concluded that thermal receptors in the antennae are likely responsible for light detection in the centipedes.

Which additional finding from Yuan and colleagues’ study, if true, would best support the researchers' conclusion?
selections: A. When body segments other than the centipedes’ antennae were monitored, the temperature of these body segments were found to increase in the presence of sunlight.
B. The centipedes showed the same tendency to move to container 2 when simulated sunlight was accompanied by artificially reduced temperatures.
C. Chinese red-headed centipedes are more proficient at detecting light than other centipede species are.
D. When their antennae were covered with a reflective material, the centipedes remained exposed in container 1 for longer durations.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 某些物种（如海斯泉钩虾）完全缺乏功能性眼睛或视觉器官，依靠其他机制进行导航。袁立成与同事以中国红头蜈蚣为研究对象探讨此类机制——该蜈蚣虽无含光感受器的器官，却能感知并躲避阳光。研究人员将个体置于连接着黑色胶带覆盖容器（容器2）的透明容器（容器1）中，随后用模拟阳光照射容器。他们观察到蜈蚣触角温度在光照开始后迅速上升，随后蜈蚣逃向容器2。基于观察，研究人员得出结论：触角中的热感受器可能是蜈蚣感光的原因。 中文解析： 若遮蔽触角后蜈蚣停留光照区时间延长（选项D），则直接证明触角是感光的关键器官，通过控制变量强化了“触角热感受器主导感光”的因果推论。其他选项均无支持作用：A项发现其他部位升温却未引发逃避，反而削弱触角重要性；B项低温干扰实验会混淆温度与光照变量；C项跨物种比较与感光机制无关。

question:
Introducing a new species into a delicate ecosystem can often be harmful. The common waxbill and other fruit-eating birds have established themselves on the Hawaiian island of Oahu after being brought there in the last 150 years. Many plant species on the island rely on the activity of fruit-eating birds to maintain and increase their populations. In recent studies, common waxbills have been found to spread seeds of native forest plants that are at risk of extinction, such as the olomea shrub and the alahee tree, suggesting that _____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. non-native birds, such as the common waxbill, are unlikely to eat fruits from non-native forest plants on Oahu.
B. non-native birds have had both positive and negative effects on Oahu's native plants.
C. although non-native birds initially damaged the plants in Oahu's ecosystem, they are now proving useful to them.
D. rather than harming Oahu's ecosystem, some non-native birds provide an important benefit on Oahu.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 将新物种引入脆弱生态系统往往会造成危害。在过去的150年间被引入后，普通梅花雀等食果鸟类已在夏威夷瓦胡岛定居。岛上许多植物物种依赖食果鸟类的活动来维持和扩大种群。最近研究发现，普通梅花雀会传播濒危原生森林植物的种子（如奥洛梅亚灌木和阿拉希树），这表明_____ 中文解析： 前文先承认引入物种通常有害，但通过“研究表明”具体描述梅花雀传播濒危植物种子的行为，形成语义转折，最终指向“某些非本地鸟类能带来生态益处”的结论。选项D以“rather than harming”准确承接这种转折逻辑。其他选项均不契合：A项未提及非本地植物，偏离主线；B项“正负影响”虽客观但未突出后文强调的积极作用；C项“初始破坏”缺乏文本依据。

question:
Many Indigenous songs serve as repositories of ecological knowledge—e.g., Yi songs about the natural environment and O’odham songs about desert plants. In a study by ethnobiologist Dana Lepofsky et al., a song keeper for the Kwakwaka’wakw people provided access to ancient songs referring to the people's creation of terraced intertidal gardens to foster clams for consumption. Cross-references of that information with both archaeological and paleoecological records have revealed significant increases in clam size and productivity concurrent with the most prevalent use of these clam gardens. This finding suggests that researchers should consider ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the strong implication that the beneficial effects are primarily attributable to ecological factors unrelated to the activities of the Kwakwaka’wakw people.
B. the possibility that other songs of other Indigenous peoples transmit ecological information that has useful practical applications.
C. the reliability of archaeological and paleoecological evidence that often underpins conclusions drawn from Indigenous songs.
D. whether the Kwakwaka’wakw people originated the method of cultivation detailed in the songs or adapted methods observed among other groups of Indigenous peoples.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 许多原住民歌曲是生态知识的载体——例如彝族关于自然环境的歌曲和奥哈姆族关于沙漠植物的歌曲。在民族生物学家达娜·莱波夫斯基的研究中，夸夸嘉夸族的一位歌谣守护者提供了古老歌曲的线索，其中提及该民族建造潮间带梯田花园以培育食用蛤蜊。将这些信息与考古及古生态记录交叉比对后，发现蛤蜊体型与产量的显著增长正与这些蛤蜊花园最盛行的时期同步。这一发现表明研究者应考虑______ 中文解析： 文本通过夸夸嘉夸族案例证明原住民歌曲蕴含可验证的实用生态知识，由此自然延伸出“其他原住民歌曲也可能传递类似应用价值”的推论。选项B准确体现了从特殊到普遍的归纳逻辑。其他选项均偏离核心论证：A项否认人类活动作用，与证据矛盾；C项讨论证据可靠性，非文本推导重点；D项探究技术起源，与歌曲的信息传递功能无关。

question:

explanations: 题目文本翻译： 20世纪20年代初，美国地质调查局的研究人员用一种简单方法确定了缅因州的地理中心。他们首先将细绳系在州轮廓纸板模型的中心点并将其悬空。_____他们调整悬挂点直至纸板完全水平悬挂。最终，该点被确定为地理中心。 中文解析： 原文描述了连续的操作步骤：“首先系绳悬挂”与“随后调整至水平”构成时间顺序关系。选项A“Then”（然后）能清晰体现这种先后动作的衔接。其他选项均不符合逻辑：“In other words”（换言之）表示解释说明，“Instead”（相反地）表示替代方案，“First of all”（首先）与上文“First”重复且破坏步骤连续性。

question:

selections: A. Hornsdale Wind Farm has a nameplate capacity of 316 megawatts.
B. Nameplate capacity is another name for a wind farm’s maximum electrical output.
C. Hornsdale, Australia, is home to Hornsdale Wind Farm.
D. Turbines can be used to generate electricity from a renewable energy source: the wind.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一名学生在研究课题时记录了以下笔记： · 风能是一种可再生能源 · 风电场利用涡轮机将风能转化为电能 · 风电场的最大电力输出称为其铭牌容量 · 霍恩斯代尔风电场位于澳大利亚霍恩斯代尔 · 其铭牌容量为316兆瓦 该学生想要强调霍恩斯代尔风电场的位置。 中文解析： 该选项通过“is home to”（是...的所在地）的强调句式，将“澳大利亚霍恩斯代尔”置于句首焦点位置，最有效地突出了风电场的地理位置。其他选项均未实现强调位置的目标：A项强调容量数据，B项解释专业术语，D项说明发电原理，皆与定位信息无关。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·The Wayang Windu geothermal power plant in Indonesia uses a flash steam system to generate electricity. ·Flash steam technology requires geothermal reservoir temperatures above 180°C. ·The use of flash steam systems worldwide is limited because many geothermal reservoirs aren't hot enough. ·The Raft River geothermal power plant in Idaho uses a binary cycle system. ·Binary cycle technology can generate energy from lower-temperature (less than 180°C) geothermal reservoirs. ·Binary cycle systems involve higher maintenance costs than flash steam systems.

The student wants to compare the disadvantages of the geothermal systems used at the Wayang Windu and Raft River plants. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Compared with the system used at the Wayang Windu plant, the system used at the Raft River plant has a notable disadvantage: its cost.
B. Unlike the Raft River plant, the Wayang Windu plant uses a flash steam system, which requires a less common resource: geothermal reservoirs with temperatures above 180°C.
C. The system used at the Raft River plant overcomes the temperature limitations of the Wayang Windu plant’s system but is more costly to maintain.
D. The system at the Wayang Windu plant requires temperatures above 180°C, while the system at the Raft River plant can operate at lower temperatures.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一名学生在研究课题时记录了以下笔记： · 印度尼西亚的瓦扬温杜地热电厂使用闪蒸发电系统 · 闪蒸技术需要地热储层温度高于180°C · 全球范围内闪蒸系统应用受限，因许多地热储层温度不足 · 爱达荷州的筏河地热电厂使用双循环系统 · 双循环技术可利用低温（低于180°C）地热储层发电 · 双循环系统比闪蒸系统维护成本更高 该学生想要对比瓦扬温杜电厂与筏河电厂所用地热系统的缺点。 中文解析： 该选项通过“overcomes...but...”的对比结构，同步指出两个系统的核心缺陷：筏河电厂的双循环系统存在高维护成本缺点，而瓦扬温杜电厂的闪蒸系统存在温度要求高的局限性。其他选项均未完整呈现双方缺点：A项仅提及成本未说明温度限制；B项将温度要求描述为“不常见资源”未直接点明缺陷；D项只对比技术差异未强调缺点。
exam_name: 2025年10月北美第1套阅读语法（M2简单，和北美第2套阅读语法重复不录入）

question:

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between ArcelorMittal Orbit and Čumil the Sewer Worker . Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. ArcelorMittal Orbit and Čumil the Sewer Worker are both on display at public locations.
B. ArcelorMittal Orbit , but not Čumil the Sewer Worker , can be found in London, England.
C. Both ArcelorMittal Orbit and Čumil the Sewer Worker were created by Sir Anish Kapoor and Cecil Balmond.
D. Čumil the Sewer Worker , a bronze sculpture of a man emerging from under a manhole cover, is on display on a public street.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一名学生在研究课题时记录了以下笔记： · “安赛乐米塔尔轨道”是阿尼什·卡普尔爵士和塞西尔·巴尔蒙德的艺术作品 · 这是一座375英尺高的钢塔，配有螺旋楼梯和功能滑梯 · 它在英国伦敦的一个公园公开展示 · “下水道工人楚米尔”是维克多·胡利克的艺术作品 · 这是一尊从井盖下探出身的男子青铜雕塑 · 它在斯洛伐克布拉迪斯拉发的一条街道公开展示 该学生想要强调两件艺术作品的相似之处。 中文解析： 该选项通过“both on display at public locations”（均在公共场所展示）准确概括了两件作品最核心的相似特征——面向公众的展示属性。其他选项均存在事实错误或未突出相似性：B项强调地域差异，与目标相反；C项错误地将雕塑作者归为塔楼创作者；D项仅描述单件作品，未进行对比。

question:
Women like Agnes Meyer Driscoll made important early contributions to the history of US cryptology, a field concerned with secure data communication and storage. Driscoll joined the US Navy and worked in its cryptological office during World War I. She also helped develop early cipher machines. In this way, Driscoll and others like her helped make it possible for more women—such as Maureen Baginski, who currently works in intelligence and supports the FBI—to enter the field of cryptology.

D. Agnes Meyer Driscoll made earlier contributions to a field that Maureen Baginski currently works within.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 像艾格尼丝·迈耶·德里斯科尔这样的女性，为美国密码学史做出了重要的早期贡献，该领域涉及安全的数据通信和存储。德里斯科尔在一战期间加入美国海军并在其密码部门工作，还帮助开发了早期的密码机。就这样，德里斯科尔和其他像她一样的女性，为更多女性——例如目前从事情报工作并支持联邦调查局的莫琳·巴金斯基——进入密码学领域创造了可能。 中文解析： 选项D的earlier contributions对应文本的early contributions，currently works within对应文本的currently works in

question:
The following text is adapted from Daniel Defoe’s 1704 nonfiction book The Storm . If I judge right, ‘tis the duty of an historian to set everything in its own light, and to convey matter of fact upon its legitimate authority, and no other: I mean thus, (for I would be as explicit as I can) that where a story is vouched to him with sufficient authority, he ought to give the world the special testimonial of its proper voucher, or else he is not just to the story: and where it comes without such sufficient authority, he ought to say so; otherwise he is not just to himself.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. The only figures that a historian should quote are those who are widely viewed as credible.
B. It is difficult for historians to be completely accurate, and eventually they will feel remorse for some of their work.
C. Historians should clearly indicate the extent to which each of their sources is trustworthy.
D. Because no memories can be trusted, all historians are forced to admit that some records of events may be, in part, false.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文本改编自丹尼尔·笛福1704年的非虚构作品《风暴》。 如果我的判断正确，历史学家的职责是让一切以其本来面目呈现，并依据其合法权威而非其他方式来传达事实。我的意思是这样的（因为我想尽可能说清楚）：当一个故事有充分权威依据时，他应当向世人提供其特定凭证；否则他对这故事就不公正。而当故事缺乏充分权威依据时，他也应当说明；否则他对自己就不公正。 中文解析： 文本首句提到了convey matter of fact upon its legitimate authority，尾句提到了where it comes without such sufficient authority, he ought to say so对应了选项c的indicate the extent to which each of their sources is trustworthy
exam_name: 2025年10月亚太第3套阅读语法（去重版）

question:
