question:
In 2010, anthropologist Livia Barbosa published a study wherein she documented survey respondents’ perceptions of popular Brazilian foods, such as coxinha and broa. While the data may now be somewhat outdated, scholars in the future interested in tracking changes in food and sociability in Brazilian society ___________ Barbosa’s study useful.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: In the future对应一般将来时态
exam_name: 2025年10月亚太第2套阅读语法(M2-Easy-20道题）

question:
In Puerto Rico, it’s not unusual for a city or town to be known by a nickname that corresponds to one of its notable features, like landscape, climate, famous residents, or chief export. For example, the Puerto Rican municipality of Jayuya is well known for Los Tres Picachos, the mountain that towers above _______ this distinction has earned it a fitting nickname: “the Town of the Three Peaks.”

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 填空出前后有两个句子，需要用逗号+and连接
exam_name: 2025年10月亚太第2套阅读语法(M2-Easy-20道题）

question:
The Eiger, the Mönch, the Jungfrau —Alpine summits like these were little more than wastelands to many Europeans until the eighteenth century, when attitudes toward such intimidating landscapes shifted as part of a broader aesthetic______by Irish philosopher Edmund Burke, this shift framed mountains as sublime objects capable of producing delightful terror.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 填空出前后有两个句子（句子1：Alpine summits....revoltion；句子2：this shift....terror），需要用句号连接
exam_name: 2025年10月亚太第2套阅读语法(M2-Easy-20道题）

question:
While some researchers have identified the planet Teegarden’s Starc as potentially habitable, it’s unlikely that humanity will be able to take advantage of its favorable conditions anytime soon — it’s 12.58 light years away.______ at 1,196 light years away, the planet Kepler-1410b is also inaccessible.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 尽管有研究者认为蒂加登星c行星可能适宜居住，但人类短期内难以利用其优越条件——它距离地球12.58光年。______距离1196光年的开普勒-1410b行星同样无法抵达。 中文解析： 前后句呈现并列递进关系：前句说12.58光年太远，后句说1196光年“同样”无法抵达；“Likewise”准确体现两者在“距离遥远导致不可达”这一属性上的类比关系
exam_name: 2025年10月亚太第2套阅读语法(M2-Easy-20道题）

question:
John Rankin was an outspoken abolitionist whose Ohio home was a stop on the underground railroad (the network of people and places that some enslaved people used to escape to freedom). _______supporters of the railroad were secretive about their antislavery views. Usually, they were vocal abolitionists like Rankin.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 约翰·兰金是一位直言不讳的废奴主义者，他在俄亥俄州的住宅是“地下铁路”（指帮助被奴役者逃往自由的人员与地点网络）的一个站点。_______该铁路的支持者对其反奴隶制观点讳莫如深。通常，他们都像兰金一样公开倡导废奴。 中文解析： 第一句话描述兰金“直言不讳”，第二句话却指出铁路支持者“秘密行动”，第三句话说通常大家会像兰金一样直言不讳。综合第一句话和第三句话来看，第二句话是一些特殊的情况，所以对应B
exam_name: 2025年10月亚太第2套阅读语法(M2-Easy-20道题）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·Angelina Weld Grimke was an African American poet, playwright, and journalist. ·Grimke lived and worked in Washington, DC, for many years. ·“To Miss Harriet E. Riggs” is a poem by Grimke. ·It was published in 1923.

The student wants to indicate the year “To Miss Harriet E. Riggs” was published. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. “To Miss Harriet E. Riggs”was published in 1923.
B. Washington, DC, is where Angelina Weld Grimke lived and worked.
C. Angelina Weld Grimke wrote the poem  “To Miss Harriet E. Riggs”
D. Angelina Weld Grimke was a poet as well as a playwright and journalist.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 学生在研究某一主题时记录了以下笔记： ·安吉丽娜·韦尔德·格里姆克是非裔美国诗人、剧作家和记者 ·格里姆克曾在华盛顿特区生活和工作多年 ·《致哈丽特·E·里格斯小姐》是格里姆克创作的一首诗 ·该诗发表于1923年 中文解析： 题干明确要求“表明诗歌发表年份”，对应A
exam_name: 2025年10月亚太第2套阅读语法(M2-Easy-20道题）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: · One and All is the name of a sailboat. ·Uku Randmaa is an Estonian sailor. ·He sailed One and All on a nonstop, 254-day journey around the world. ·He set sail from Les Sables d’Olonne, France, in July 2018. ·He returned to Les Sables d’Olonne in March 2019.

The student wants to indicate the name of the sailboat Randmaa sailed. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. One and All is the name of the sailboat Randmaa sailed on his journey around the world.
B. After 254 days at sea, Randmaa returned to Les Sables d’Olonne in March 2019.
C. Estonian sailor Uku Randmaa set sail in July 2018 and returned in March 2019.
D. Randmaa set sail from Les Sables d’Olonne, France, in 2018.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 学生在研究某一主题时记录了以下笔记： ·“万众一心”是一艘帆船的名称 ·乌库·兰德马是一名爱沙尼亚水手 ·他驾驶“万众一心”号进行了不间断的254天环球航行 ·他于2018年7月从法国莱萨布勒多洛讷启航 ·他于2019年3月返回莱萨布勒多洛讷 中文解析： 题干明确要求“说明帆船名称”，需直接呈现“One and All”与“Randmaa所驾船只”的关联
exam_name: 2025年10月亚太第2套阅读语法(M2-Easy-20道题）

question: The area of a rectangle is 105 square inches. The length of the longest side of the rectangle is 15 inches. What is the length, in inches, of the shortest side of this rectangle?
explanations: 长方形的面积=长*宽，即105=15*宽，求解可得宽为7，故选A。

question: The function h is defined by h ( x ) = 9 | x | . What is the value of h ( − 8 ) ?
What is an equation of the graph shown?
explanations: 图像无限趋近y=3，故答案应该是C或者D；从图像中找一个点的左边（2,7）代入检验可知正确答案为D。（也可以根据函数是增函数判定答案是D。）

question: If x y = 36 and c x 3 y = 36 , what is the value of c ?
If 8 ( 5 − 2 x ) + 3 = 7 ( 5 − 2 x ) + 18 , what is the value of 5 − 2 x ?
f ( x ) = x 2 − 10 x + 11 What is the minimum value of the given function?
explanations: 考查二次函数标准式与顶点式的转换。 f ( x ) = x 2 − 10 x + 11 = ( x − 5 ) 2 − 14 ，最小值为-14，故选A。

question: A linear function g is defined by g ( x ) = a x + b ，where a and b are constants. If g ( − 1 ) = − 8 and g ( 3 ) = 4 ，what is the value of a ?
explanations: 把点的坐标代入函数式，可得a(-1)+b=-8，a(3)+b=4，求解该方程组可得a=3，故答案为3.

question: 3 | 4 x − 4 | = 17 What is the sum of the solutions to the given equation?
explanations: 3|4x-4|=17，整理可得|x-1|=17/12，计算可得两个解分别为29/12和-5/12，那两根之和为2。故答案为2。

question: The positive number a is 290% of the number b , and a is 60% of the number c . If c is p% of b , which of the following is closest to the value of p ?
The graph of a system of linear equations is shown. What is the solution ( x,y ) to the system?
explanations: 两根直线的交点即为方程组的解，读图可得为（3,2），故选B。

question: x + y = 71 The given equation relates the total number of marble queen pothos stems, x , and the total number of snow queen pothos stems, y , a plant nursery propagates to create pothos plants. If 21 snow queen pothos stems are propagated, how many marble queen pothos stems are propagated?
If 5 + x = 2 ，what is the value of − 15 − 3 x ？
The shaded region shown represents the solutions to which inequality?
explanations: 所有选项斜率相同，无需计算斜率；根据图像得到y-intercept是（0,7），所以直线表达式是y=3x+7；因为阴影区域是在直线的上方，所以是y>3x+7。故答案为A。

question: The function k is defined by k ( x ) = x 3 + 80 . What is the value of k ( x ) when x = 2 ?
Which expression is equivalent to 2 x y + 14 x 2 y + 16 x y 2 ？
explanations: 提取出公因式2xy，剩余的式子与C相同，故答案为C。

question: The ratio s to t is equivalent to the ratio 1 to 3. If the value of s is multiplied by 25, how will the value of t change to maintain this ratio?
selections: A. It will be multiplied by 1.
B. It will be multiplied by 22.
C. It will be multiplied by 25.
D. It will be multiplied by 28.
explanations: s乘以25，想要s/t的比例不变，t应该也要乘25，故选C。

question: Line p is defined by y = 2 x − 9 . Line s is parallel to line p in the xy -plane. What is the slope of line s ?
explanations: 两根直线平行，那这两根直线的斜率相同，故答案为2。

question: Note: Figure not drawn to scale. The figure shown is a right rectangular pyramid, where l =16 units, w =8 units, and h =18 units. What is the surface area, in square units, of the pyramid?
Note：Figure not drawn to scale. What is the value of tan F in the triangle shown?
explanations: 考查三角函数的基本定义，tan等于对边比临边，故tan F=45/75，所以答案为C。

question: x 2 + ( k − 3 ) x + 33 = 0 In the given equation, k is a constant. The equation has exactly one real solution. What is the value of k ?
explanations: a x 2 + b x + c = 0 有一个解，那 b 2 − 4 a c = 0 ，代入数值可得k-3-4*33=0，求解可得k=135，故选A。

question: x 2 + 18 = 18 + x 2 How many distinct real solutions does the given equation have?
explanations: 等号两边的式子完全相同，故有无穷多解，所以答案为D。

question: The table shows three values of x and their corresponding values of y . There is a linear relationship between x and y . What is the y -coordinate of the y -intercept of the line in the xy -plane that represents this relationship?
explanations: y-intercept表示x=0，根据表格，x=0时，y=20，故答案为20。

question: The exponential function g is defined by g ( x ) = 5 ⋅ a x , where a is a positive constant. If g ( 3 ) = 625 ，what is the value of g ( 5 ) ？
explanations: 把g(x)=625代入函数表达式计算可得a=5，所以函数表达式是 g ( x ) = 5 ∗ 5 x 。那 g ( 5 ) = 5 ∗ 5 5 = 15625 。故答案为15625。

question: For two acute angles X and Y , the measure of angle Y is 47∘ and sin ⁡ X cos ⁡ Y = 1 . What is the measure, in degrees, of angle X ?
explanations: X与Y是两个锐角，如果sinX=cosY，那么X+Y=90度。角Y为47度，那X就是90-47=43度，故选D。

question: y > 19 3 x + y < 26 The point ( x ,44) is a solution to the given system of inequalities in the xy -plane. Which of the following could be the value of x ?
explanations: 把y=44代入第二个式子，可得3x+44<26，计算可得x<-6，符合要求的是d，故答案为d。

question: The function f ( x ) = 217 ( 1.030 ) x models the value, in dollars, of a certain bank account from 1957 through 1972, where x is the number of years after the end of 1957. Which of the following is the best interpretation of  "f(5) is approximately equal to 252" in this context?
selections: A. The value of the bank account is estimated to increase by approximately 252 dollars every 5 years between the end of 1957 and the end of 1972 .
B. The value, in dollars, of the bank account is estimated to be approximately 5 times greater at the end of 1962 than at the end of 1957.
C. The value of the bank account is estimated to be approximately 5 dollars greater at the end of 1962 than at the end of 1957.
D. The value of the bank account is estimated to be approximately 252 dollars at the end of 1962.
explanations: x=0表示1957年，所以x=5表示1962年；f(x)表示第x年年末的时候账户金额，据此可知答案为D。

question: ( 4 x + 10 ) ( 2 x + 1 ) − ( 2 x − 14 ) For all values of x , the given expression is equivalent to which of the following? I. 8 x 2 + 22 x + 24 II. 8 x 2 + 24 x + 10 − 2 x − 14
y < 4 x + 12 For which of the following tables are all the values of x and their corresponding values of y solutions to the given inequality?
explanations: 把x=2代入4*2+12=20，此时y<20，只有a是正确的，故选a。<>

question: The function f is defined by f ( x ) = − 1 4 ( x − 13 ) + 4 . For what value of x does f ( x ) = 4 a ，where a is a constant?
explanations: 将f(x)=4a代入函数表达式可得（-1/4）（x-13）+4=4a，计算可得x=-16a+29，故选A。

question: 5 ( 6 x ) + 9 ( 8 y ) = 36 − 5 ( 6 x ) + 9 ( 8 y ) = 36 The solution to the given system of equations is ( x , y ) .  What is the value of 6 x + 8 y ？
explanations: 将两个式子相加可得18（8y）=72，故8y=4；将两个式子相减可得10（6x）=0，故6x=0；所以6x+8y=0+4=0，故选C。

question: 57 x 10 + b x 5 + 26 The given expression, where b is a constant, is equivalent to ( 3 x 5 + q ) ( r x 5 + 2 ) ，where q and r are constants. What is the value of b ?
The scatterplot shows the relationship between two variables, x and y . Which of the following equations is the most appropriate linear model for the data shown?
explanations: 根据图像可知斜率是正的，排除D；随便取两个点计算斜率，取最相近的，可知答案为A。

question: Number of points The histogram summarizes the distribution of an original data set that represents the number of points per game a basketball team has scored in the last 50 games played. If the team scores 18 points in the next game and this game is added to the original data set to create a new data set of 51 values, which of the following must be true? I. The median number of points per game for the new data set is less than the median number of points per game for the original data set. II. The mean number of points per game for the new data set is less than the mean number of points per game for the original data set.
explanations: 新加入的数据18比原始数据小很多，所以平均值会变小，故II是正确的。最初有50个数据，排位第25和26位的平均值是中值，那就是处于50-60的范围内；51个数据的时候，排位第26位是中值，也是处于50-60的范围内；但是具体大小无法辨认，故中值的变化无法确定，I不一定是正确的。综上，答案为B。

question: A model estimates that the population of a state was 4 million in 1980 and increased by 0.041 million each year until 2007. According to the model, what was the estimated population of this state, in millions, 10 years after 1980?
explanations: 根据题意，人数y与时间x的关系是y=0.041x+4。当x=10时，y=0.041*10+4=4.41，故答案为4.41。

question: At what point ( x,y ) do the graphs of the equations y = 3 x + 6 and y = 4 x − 2 intersect in the xy －plane?
explanations: 把两根直线表达式联立为二元一次方程组求解可得答案为C。

question: Note: Figure not drawn to scale. In the figure shown, triangle CAE is similar to triangle CBD . The measure of angle CBD is 57∘, and AE =24( BD ). What is the measure of angle CAE ?
explanations: 相似三角形对应的角相等，故∠CAE=∠CBD=57°，所以答案为B。

question: Quinidra drove her car on a straight road to a certain location. The graph models Quinidra’s distance, in miles, from her home as a function of time, in hours. Which of the following could the model describe?
selections: A. Quinidra drove away from her home at a constant speed for 1 hour, spent 4 hours at the location, then continued to drive away from her home at a constant speed for 1 hour.
B. Quinidra drove away from her home at a constant speed for 1 hour, spent 4 hours at the location, then drove back to her home at a constant speed for 1 hour.
C. Quinidra drove away from her home at an increasing speed for 1 hour, spent 4 hours at the location, then drove back to her home at a decreasing speed for 1 hour.
D. Quinidra drove away from her home at an increasing speed for 1 hour, drove at a constant speed for 4 hours, then drove back to her home at a decreasing speed for 1 hour.
explanations: y=0时表示在家；△y/△x表示速度，据此可知B为正确答案。

question: r ( x ) = p x − 4 + 16 The given equation defines the function r , where p is a positive constant. The graph of y = r ( x ) in the xy －plane is translated 7 units to the left to produce the graph of y = t ( x ) . Which equation defines function t ?
explanations: 考查函数的平移规则：左加右减，上加下减。故选D。

question: The table shows the distribution of the 162 igneous rocks in a certain earth science laboratory by mineral composition and texture. What fraction of the laboratory’s granitic rocks are coarse－grained?
explanations: 考查概率，coarse/granitic=32/（32+19）=32/51，故选A。

question: A researcher observes a sample of a nuclide. An exponential model estimates that the mass, in grams, of the sample decreases by 21% every 19. 72 minutes. Which of the following equations could represent this model, where M is the estimated mass, in grams, of the sample t minutes after the researcher began observing the sample?
explanations: y=ab(x/n)表示x每增长n，y会变成之前的b倍，所以从指数的角度考虑，答案应该是A或者C；减少21%表示1-21%=0.79，所以底数是0.79；故选A。

question: x 2 − 7 x + 8 = 0 The solutions to the given equation can be written in the form 7 ± k 2 ，where k is a constant. What is the value of k ?
explanations: 考查一元二次方程的求根公式 x = − b ± b 2 − 4 a c 2 a ，把数字代入计算可得k=17。所以答案为17。

question: For the function f , the table shows four values of x and their corresponding values of f ( x ) . Which of the following could describe this function?
explanations: 根据表格中的数据可知，x每增大1，y会变成之前的7/10，所以答案选A。

question: Object Z has a mass of 170 grams. The mass of object X is 4,400% of the mass of object Z . The mass of object Z is 20% of the mass of object Y . The sum, in grams, of the mass of object X and the mass of object Y is equal to the product, in grams, of w and the mass of object Z , where w is a constant. What is the value of w ?
The function f ( x ) is defined as 34 more than 5 times a number x . If y = f ( x ) is graphed in the xy -plane, what is the best interpretation of the x -intercept?
selections: A. When f ( x ) = 0 ，the number is − 34 5 .
B. When the number is 0, f ( x ) = 34 .
C. The value of f ( x ) increases by 1 for each increase of 5 in the value of the number.
D. For each increase of 1 in the value of the number, f ( x ) increases by 5.
explanations: 根据题意，f(x)=5x+34。x-intercept表示y=0时的x值，故选A。

question:
The National Heritage Fellowship was created to_______exceptional folk and traditional artists in the United States. One artist who received the fellowship, the taiko drummer Seiichi Tanaka, was chosen for his lifetime contributions to the arts.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 国家遗产奖学金的设立是为了______美国杰出的民间和传统艺术家。其中一位获奖者是太鼓鼓手田中清一，他因对艺术的终身贡献而被选中。 中文解析： 文中提到该奖学金是授予像田中清一这样对艺术有终身贡献的艺术家，其目的是为了“表彰”他们的成就。“overshadow”（使黯然失色）、“begin”（开始）、“distract”（分散注意力）均不符合语境，只有“honor”能准确体现“表彰杰出艺术家”的逻辑。

question:
Broods of periodical cicadas (inch-long winged insects) emerge for six weeks in late spring on a cycle of either 13 or 17 years. In 2024, the emerges of the Great Southern Brood (on a 13-year cycle) and the Northern Illinois Brood (on a 17-year cycle) coincided in the Midwest and Southeast United States, _______that happens only once every 221 years. Sixteen states were covered with a trillion cicadas.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 周期蝉（一种一英寸长的有翅昆虫）在春末出现六周，周期为13年或17年。2024年，大南方群（13年周期）和北伊利诺伊群（17年周期）在美国中西部和东南部同时出现，______这种情况每221年才发生一次。十六个州被上万亿只蝉覆盖。 中文解析： 文中强调两个不同周期的蝉群在2024年“同时出现”，且事件“每221年才发生一次”，说明这是罕见的时间与空间上的重合。“convergence” 专指不同事物在时间或空间上交汇，最符合语境；“division”（分割）、“expiration”（到期）、“succession”（连续）均无法体现“周期性事件同时发生”的含义。

question:
Japanese animator and director Hayao Miyazaki often includes fantasy elements in otherwise realistic settings in his movies, but he tends to _______details and exposition about those elements. Miyazaki simply presents fantastical characters and actions with little backstory or explanation, encouraging viewers to embrace the presence of the extraordinary in everyday life.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 日本动画师和导演宫崎骏经常在他的电影中以现实主义场景为背景加入奇幻元素，但他倾向于______有关这些元素的细节和说明。宫崎骏只是简单地呈现奇幻角色和行动，几乎没有背景故事或解释，以此鼓励观众拥抱日常生活中非凡事物的存在。 中文解析： 后文明确指出宫崎骏“几乎没有提供背景故事或解释”，这与“ withhold details and exposition”（不提供细节和说明）的逻辑完全一致。“invent”（发明）、“combine”（结合）、“celebrate”（庆祝）均与后文“不做解释”的语境相矛盾。

question:
The following text is from Charles Chesnutt’s 1905 novel The Colonel’s Dream . Mr. French and Mr. Kirbywork together. Mr. French, the senior partner, who sat opposite Kirby, was an older man—a safe guess would have placed him somewhere in the debatable ground between forty and fifty; of a good height, as could be seen even from the seated figure, the upper part of which was held erect with the unconscious ease which one associates with military training.

As used in the text, what does the word “good” most nearly mean?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 这段文字选自查尔斯·切斯纳特1905年的小说《上校的梦》。弗伦奇先生和柯比先生是同事。 弗伦奇先生是资深合伙人，坐在柯比对面，年纪较长——凭猜测他大约在四十到五十岁之间；身材好，即使坐着也能看出来，上半身挺直，带着一种让人联想到军事训练的无意识的从容。 中文解析： 这里的“good height”是形容身材“相当高”或“身高不错”，强调其高度值得注意，而非“可靠的”、“有礼貌的”或“有能力的”。“Considerable” 能准确表达“显著、可观”的含义，符合对身高的描述。

question:
Portoviejo, Ecuador, was named a City of Gastronomy by UNESCO in 2019, a title that _______ that Portoviejo has a unique and vibrant food culture worthy of celebration.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 厄瓜多尔波托维耶霍于2019年被联合国教科文组织评为“美食之都”，这一称号______波托维耶霍拥有独特而充满活力的饮食文化，值得庆祝。 中文解析： “美食之都”的称号是对该城市饮食文化的官方认可和象征，需要填入一个表示“代表/意味着”的词。“denotes” 指“标志、表示”，准确体现称号与内涵之间的指代关系；“discovers”（发现）、“renounces”（放弃）、“complains”（抱怨）均不符合逻辑。

question:
Svante Pääbo and other researchers studying the history of organisms have long utilized ancient DNA — DNA recovered from ancient organic material that has been preserved under natural conditions. However, J. Mason Heberling and David J. Burke’s 2019 study of the evolutionary trajectory of arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi instead relied on historical DNA — genomic data incidentally preserved in specimens that are housed in natural history collections — thus capitalizing on the research potential offered by a vast but hitherto relatively underutilized source of insight into the biological past.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It specifies potential applications of the approach that Heberling and Burke used in their study.
B. It explains why the research methodology selected by Heberling and Burke is not widely used.
C. It emphasizes the importance of Heberling and Burke’s findings about the DNA of fungi.
D. It offers commentary on the significance of the approach that Heberling and Burke’s colleagues used for their study.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 斯万特·帕博等研究生物历史的学者长期利用古代DNA——即在自然条件下保存的古代有机材料中提取的遗传物质。而雷雅内·P·奥利维拉团队2017年关于马达加斯加禾本科植物Chasechloa属进化轨迹的研究，则采用了历史DNA——自然历史博物馆标本中偶然保存的基因组数据——从而开发了这个庞大却长期未被充分运用的生物历史研究资源。 中文解析： 划线部分的核心内容是：“利用自然历史馆藏标本中偶然保存的基因组数据，从而开发了一个庞大但此前未被充分利用的研究资源”。这是在评价该研究方法的独特价值（“capitalizing on... underutilized source”）。

question:
Curious about how people visually perceive objects in their dreams, Stephen LaBerge and team recruited lucid dreamers — people aware that they’re dreaming as it’s happening — for a research study. These participants were reliably able to signal when they had entered a dream state; the team then observed participants’ eye movements as they slept. The smoothness with which participants’ eyes tracked objects in their dreams closely matched how sighted people who are awake visually track objects around them , suggesting to the team that the brain perceives dream objects as the product of something other than pure imagination.

Which choice best states the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. To illustrate an important real-world implication of LaBerge and team’s main finding
B. To offer key evidence that undermines LaBerge and team’s initial hypothesis
C. To show the unexpected result that led LaBerge and team to change the focus of their study
D. To identify a comparable circumstance that helps justify LaBerge and team’s conclusion
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 为了研究人们在梦中如何视觉感知物体，斯蒂芬·拉伯格及其团队招募了“清醒梦者”（即在做梦时能意识到自己在做梦的人）参与研究。这些参与者能可靠地发出进入梦境的信号；团队随后观察了他们睡眠时的眼球运动。参与者在梦中追踪物体的眼球运动平滑度，与清醒视障者在现实中视觉追踪周围物体的模式高度吻合，这使团队推测，大脑对梦中物体的感知并非纯想象的产物。 中文解析： 划线部分将“梦中眼球运动”与“清醒者现实中的视觉追踪”进行类比，目的是为研究发现（大脑对梦境的感知机制）提供一个可参照的现实情形。该类比是支持研究推论的关键证据，而非说明现实意义（A）、推翻假设（B）或改变研究焦点（C）。

question:
Text 1 Thomas Piketty’s book Capital in the Twenty-First Century has a more rigorous structure than its sequel, Capital and Ideology . While the first book’s chapters all contribute to bolstering a clear, coherent argument about income inequality, the second book’s digressions on subjects such as an analysis of Hayao Miyazaki’s film The Wind Rises do not just make the book tedious but also muddy its reasoning. Text 2 Capital and Ideology has different aims than Piketty’s earlier books. It should be judged not just in the context of Piketty’s previous work but placed next to books like William T. Vollmann’s Rising Up and Rising Down , in which the stated theme of justifications for violent acts is mainly an excuse for a polymath to map his own mind. Even when sections do not explicitly support the central thesis, they link to each other in intriguing ways. None of them should be considered extraneous.

Based on the texts, the author of Text 1 would most likely agree with the author of Text 2 on which point?
selections: A. Capital and Ideology is notably different in structure from some of Piketty’s earlier work.
B. Capital in the Twenty-First Century is a superior book to Capital and Ideology .
C. The material in Capital and Ideology on The Wind Rises is essential to the book.
D. Capital and Ideology was influenced by the writing of William T. Vollmann.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 文本1： 托马斯·皮凯蒂的《二十一世纪的资本》比其续作《资本与意识形态》结构更为严谨。前者的所有章节都致力于支撑关于收入不平等问题的清晰连贯的论述，而后者不仅因对宫崎骏电影《起风了》等话题的旁征博引显得冗长乏味，更削弱了其论证力度。 文本2： 《资本与意识形态》的写作目标与皮凯蒂早期著作有所不同。评价这部作品时，不仅应将其置于作者既往研究体系中考量，更应将其与威廉·T·沃尔曼的《起义与平定》等著作并置观之——后者以暴力行为辩护为主题，实质却是这位博学者梳理思想脉络的载体。即便书中某些章节未直接支撑核心论点，它们也通过精妙的方式相互关联，没有任何部分可被视为可有可无的章节。 中文解析： 文本1明确指出《资本与意识形态》的结构不如《21世纪资本论》严谨，并举例说明其存在离题内容，这本身就承认了两书在结构上存在差异。文本2开篇即声明《资本与意识形态》与作者早期著作的目标不同，暗示其结构或方法确实存在差异。因此，两位作者最可能同意的观点就是“两书结构不同”。文本1并未直接断言前者“优于”后者（b），也显然不认为关于《起风了》的材料是“必不可少的”（c）。

question:
Musician and astronomer Darsan Swarop Bellie researches gravitational waves. These invisible waves move very quickly through space. They cannot be viewed through a telescope, but they do make sounds that can be detected with special equipment. In his musical composition Dance of the Black Holes , Bellie demonstrates what gravitational waves might sound like as two black holes merge in space. With this composition and others, Bellie hopes to make aspects of science more accessible.

According to the text, what is the subject of Bellie’s research?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 音乐家兼天文学家达桑·斯瓦鲁普·贝利研究引力波。这些不可见的波在空间中快速穿行。它们无法通过望远镜观测，但确实会发出可通过特殊设备探测的声音。在他的音乐作品《黑洞之舞》中，贝利展示了两个黑洞在太空中合并时引力波可能发出的声音。通过这部作品及其他创作，贝利希望让科学的某些方面更易于大众理解。 中文解析： 文本开篇第一句直接点明：“音乐家兼天文学家达桑·斯瓦鲁普·贝利研究引力波”。后文所有内容都是对引力波特性及贝利如何通过音乐展示它们的进一步阐述。其他选项“洋流”、“音乐史”、“太空旅行”在文中均未提及。

question:
The End-Triassic mass extinction happened approximately 201 million years ago, when about 80 percent of species (including many species of bivalves) died off. Researchers have proposed the effects of a sudden release of carbon dioxide as one mechanism that may have brought on this mass extinction. But mass extinctions, while abrupt in geological terms, unfold over thousands or millions of years: it’s likely that multiple factors drove widespread species loss.

Based on the text, the author would most likely agree with which statement about the End-Triassic mass extinction?
selections: A. It likely involved the extinction of more species than is typically believed.
B. It is hard to detect in Earth’s fossil or geological records.
C. It occurred over a long period of time and probably had multiple causes.
D. It was discovered only recently and is poorly understood.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 三叠纪末大灭绝发生在大约2.01亿年前，当时约80%的物种（包括许多双壳类物种）灭绝。研究人员提出，二氧化碳突然释放的影响可能是引发这次大灭绝的一种机制。但是，大灭绝虽然在地质学意义上算是"突然"发生的，其过程却会持续数千年乃至数百万年：广泛的物种灭绝很可能是由多种因素共同造成的。 中文解析： 文中明确指出大灭绝"虽然突然，但过程持续数千年或数百万年"，并总结说"多种因素可能共同导致了物种灭绝"，这与该选项完全对应。其他选项：文中未提及"比通常认为的物种灭绝更多"，也未说"难以在化石或地质记录中检测"，与文本内容不符。

question:
The following text is from Yung Wing’s 1909 memoir My Life in China and America. We landed in New York on the 12th of April, 1847, after a passage of ninety-eight days of unprecedented fair weather. The New York of 1847 was altogether a different city from the New York of 1909. It was a city of only 250,000 or 300,000 inhabitants; now it is a metropolis rivaling London in population, wealth and commerce. The whole of Manhattan Island is turned into a city of skyscrapers, churches and palatial residences.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Yung has experienced significant personal growth in the time since his arrival to New York City in 1847.
B. The journey to New York City was extremely tiring for Yung.
C. The architecture in New York City is more beautiful than that in London.
D. New York City has become more developed and populated since Yung’s arrival in 1847.
explanations: 题目文本翻译: 以下的文本摘自1909年翁同龢的回忆录《我在中国和美国的生活》。 我们于1847年4月12日抵达纽约，经过了九十八天史无前例的晴朗天气的航行。1847年的纽约与1909年的纽约完全是两个不同的城市。那时只有25万至30万居民; 现在它是一个与伦敦在人口、财富和商业上相媲美的大都会。整个曼哈顿岛都变成了一座摩天大楼、教堂和豪华住宅构成的城市。 中文解析: 作者描述了纽约从1847年到1909年的巨大变化，主要强调了人口增长和城市发展（如摩天大楼和富丽堂皇的住宅）。这表明城市在这段时间内变得更加发达和人口更密集。

question:
Memoirs of Elleanor Eldridge is an 1838 historical account by Elleanor Eldridge and Frances Harriet Whipple Green. In the book, the authors assert that all people naturally have an emotional attachment to where they live, writing,_________

Which quotation from Memoirs of Elleanor Eldridg e most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “Let us, dear reader, remember the punishment of idle curiosity, as taught in the true and affecting history [named] ‘Blue Beard;’ and, striving to be content with the facts in the case, seek not to lift the veil, which the sensibility of true love, and feminine delicacy, have alike conspired to draw.”

B. “There is often a kind of [deceptive] light, playing around such [famous] names, calculated to dazzle and mislead, by their false lustre, until the eye can no longer receive the pure light of truth, or the mind appreciate real excellence, or intrinsic worth.”
C. “Home is home, to the lowly as well as the great; and no rank, or color, destroys its sacred character, its power over the mind, and the affections.”
D. “Blessed are the slumbers of the innocent. They are kindlier than balm, and they refresh and gladden the spirit of childhood, like ministerings from a better world.”
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 《埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇回忆录》是埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇与弗朗西丝·哈里特·惠普尔·格林于1838年合作完成的历史传记。书中，作者们主张人类天生会对所居之地产生情感依恋，并写道：________ 中文解析： C选项大意“家就是家，对卑微者和伟人皆是如此：无论身份或肤色，都无法削弱它的神圣性，以及对心灵和情感的支配力。”直接呼应“ an emotional attachment to where they live”

question:
Mean Body Mass of Birds Known to Perform Broken-Wing Display Bird Mean body mass (grams) pied -billed grebe 409 common ringed plover 60 common snipe 126 One antipredator defense that the grey-headed lapwing uses to protect its nest and young chicks is called " broken-wing display"; this form of deceptive defense involves an adult bird pretending to be injured and unable to fly in order to distract an approaching predator. Broken-wing display has been documented in 285 bird species from 13 different avian orders. A student predicts that bird species with mean body masses greater than 150 grams do not use deceptive defenses because larger birds tend to be more more effective than smaller birds at using agressive defenses to protect nests from predators, making defenses unnecessary.

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table that weaken the student's prediction?
selections: A. The common snipe and the common ringed plover both have a mean body mass under 150 grams and use broken-wing display.
B. The common ringed plover uses broken-wing display, but the pied-billed grebe does not.
C. The pied-billed grebe has a mean body mass of 409 grams and is known to perform broken wing display.
D. The ruddy turnstone uses broken-wing display even though it is larger than the swamp palm bulbul.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 灰头鴴（grey-headed lapwing）用来保护巢穴和幼鸟的一种抗捕食者防御方式叫做“假伤翅展示”（broken-wing display）；这种欺骗性防御方式涉及成年鸟类假装受伤，无法飞行，以此来分散接近的捕食者的注意力。假伤翅展示已经在来自13个不同鸟类目中的285个鸟类物种中有所记录。一名学生预测，体重大于150克的鸟类物种不会使用欺骗性防御，因为较大的鸟类通常比较小的鸟类更擅长使用攻击性防御来保护巢穴免受捕食者的侵害，因此不需要使用欺骗性防御。 中文解析： 题目最后的prediction是体重超出150克就不会用deceptive dense，但是根据图表pied-billed grebe的体重达到409g，依旧有Broken-Wing Display由此可以反驳文本最后一句的结论。

question:
Antonia Olivia Dolan and colleagues conducted a study of participants’ preferred listening volume, in decibels (dB), for various audio recordings, including pop music, classic rock music, and nature sounds. The team found that participants listened to recordings they liked most at higher volumes (greater dB) than recordings they liked less and that musicians tended to listen at higher volumes than nonmusicians did. For example, if the favorite recording of both a participating musician and a participating nonmusician was Beyonce’s “Crazy in Love” and the musician played it at 84.8 dB, it was therefore likely that _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the nonmusician would play “Crazy in Love” at greater than 84.8 dB.
B. the musician and nonmusician would both play other music by Beyonce at approximately 84.8 dB.
C. the nonmusician would play “Crazy in Love” at less than 84.8 dB.
D. the musician would not play music in the heavy metal genre at less than 84.8 dB.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 安东尼娅·奥利维亚·多兰和同事进行了一项研究，调查参与者收听不同类型音频（包括流行音乐、经典摇滚乐和自然声音）时偏好的音量（分贝，dB）。研究团队发现，参与者会以更高的音量收听他们最喜欢的录音，而不是那些不太喜欢的；而且，音乐家倾向于比非音乐家以更高的音量收听。例如，如果一位参与研究的音乐家和一位非音乐家最喜欢的录音都是碧昂丝的《Crazy in Love》，并且音乐家以84.8分贝播放它，那么很可能______ 中文解析： 研究的两个核心发现是：1) 人们会用更高音量听更喜欢的音乐；2) 音乐家比非音乐家使用更高音量。例子中，音乐家播放他们最喜欢的歌曲是84.8分贝。由于研究结论是“音乐家比非音乐家使用更高音量”，那么对于同一首最喜欢的歌曲，非音乐家使用的音量理应低于音乐家。

question:
Right-handedness is overwhelmingly prevalent in humans. Among studies of laterality in nonhuman primates, William C. McGrew and colleagues’ 1999 study of wild chimpanzees reported no tendency toward right-handedness, while Mara Aruguete and colleagues’ 1992 study of captive chimpanzees and squirrel monkeys did. However, the latter study included only 27 individuals, and a meta-analysis of primate-laterality studies demonstrated that a minimum sample size of 176 individuals is required to be confident that a finding of population-level handedness is not mere statistical noise. The claim of right handedness in the 1992 study should therefore be treated skeptically given that _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. right-handedness does not occur frequently enough among chimpanzees and squirrel monkeys to reliably appear in a sample of only 27 individuals.
B. the study that did not find right-handedness in chimpanzees was also based on an insufficient population size.
C. the sample size on which the claim is based is far below the threshold identified in the meta-analysis
D. the apparent difference between the two studies’ results may be partly attributable to the 1999 study using a different standard to determine handedness than the 1992 study did.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 右利手在人类中极为普遍。在针对非人灵长类动物偏侧性的研究中，威廉·C·麦格鲁及其同事1999年对野生黑猩猩的研究未报告右利手倾向，而马拉·阿鲁盖特及其同事1992年对圈养黑猩猩和松鼠猴的研究则报告了右利手。然而，后一项研究仅包含27个个体，且一项关于灵长类偏侧性研究的荟萃分析表明，需要至少176个个体的样本量才能确信群体水平的利手性发现并非仅仅是统计噪声。因此，鉴于______，对1992年研究中关于右利手的主张应持怀疑态度。 中文解析： 文本明确指出1992年研究“仅包括27个个体”，而荟萃分析指出“至少需要176个个体”的样本量才能可靠地证明群体水平的利手性。因此，1992年研究的样本量（2个）远未达到所需阈值（176个），这是对其结论产生怀疑的直接逻辑原因。

question:
“What stories like this do for us is make the world just a smidge bigger,” writes Stephen Graham Jones in the foreword to Never Whistle at Night: An Indigenous Dark Fiction Anthology. For Jones, dark fiction does more than entertain readers:_______horror tropes to challenge familiar ways of knowing, blurring the “borders of the real.”

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

question:

question:

Marcel Duchamp’s abstract cubist aesthetic received the most skepticism from critics, as ______represented a radical departure from the more realistic painting style that was popular at the time.
