question:
While dredging sediment on the seafloor of the South Atlantic for specimens of planktonic foraminifera, a team of marine biologists discovered a species that was unknown to the scientific community. ______ the team published the first formal scientific description of the new species, designating it Beella digitata .

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在南海海底挖掘沉积物以寻找浮游有孔虫标本时，一组海洋生物学家发现了一个科学界未知的物种。______ 该团队发表了这种新物种的第一个正式科学描述，将其命名为Beella digitata。 中文解析： 选择B（Subsequently）是因为文本描述了连续事件：先发现新物种，然后发表描述。"Subsequently" 表示"随后"，恰当地表达了时间顺序，使句子过渡自然。其他选项不合理：A（Instead）表示转折；C（By doing so）表示方式，；D（To this end）表示目的。
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套阅读语法M2 Easy-去重版

question:
It’s tempting to think that the comic strips Curtis and The Boondocks have the same main purpose—to amuse—because both feature humorous situations. ______ The Boondocks focuses just as much on challenging readers with sociopolitical commentary as it does on making them laugh.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 人们很容易认为漫画《Curtis》和《The Boondocks》有相同的主要目的——娱乐——因为两者都包含幽默情境。______ 《The Boondocks》在让读者发笑的同时，同样注重通过社会政治评论来挑战读者。 中文解析： 选择A（In reality）是因为文本第一句提出了一个常见的误解（两者目的相同），而第二句则揭示了实际情况（《The Boondocks》还有更深的目的），因此需要表示转折或纠正的过渡词。"In reality" 恰当地表达了这种对比关系，表明第二句是对第一句的修正。
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套阅读语法M2 Easy-去重版

question:
Pink Cone Geyser, found in Yellowstone National Park, is a cone geyser, a type of geyser that forms a mound of silica around the narrow geyser vent as volcanic rock dissolved in the water is deposited during eruptions. ______ Yellowstone’s fountain geysers, such as Rusty Geyser, erupt from larger openings where water collects in a pool.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 黄石国家公园的粉锥间歇泉是一种锥形间歇泉，这种间歇泉在喷发时，溶解在水中的火山岩会沉积下来，在狭窄的喷口周围形成硅华丘。______ 黄石公园的池式间歇泉，如锈色间歇泉，则从更大的开口喷发，水会汇集在一个池中。 中文解析： 选择C（In comparison）是因为文本将“锥形间歇泉”与“池式间歇泉”的结构和喷发方式进行了明确对比。
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套阅读语法M2 Easy-去重版

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ● The Zambezi River is in Africa. ●  It ranks No.32 among the longest rivers in the world. ●  It is 2,740 kilometers long. ●  The Vistula River is in Europe. ●  It ranks No.133 among the longest rivers in the world. ●  It is 1,213 kilometers long.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two rivers. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The Zambezi River, ranked No.32 among the longest rivers in the world, is 2,740 kilometers long.
B. The Vistula River is located in Europe, and it is 1,213 kilometers long.
C. The Zambezi and Vistula rivers are both ranked among the longest in the world.
D. At 1,213 kilometers long, the Vistula River ranks No.133 among the longest rivers in the world.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记： ● 赞比西河位于非洲。 ● 它在世界最长河流中排名第32位。 ● 它长2,740公里。 ● 维斯瓦河位于欧洲。 ● 它在世界最长河流中排名第133位。 ● 它长1,213公里。 中文解析： 选择C是因为它直接指出两条河流都位列世界最长河流之中，这突出了它们的共同特征（即都进入全球排名），符合强调相似性的要求。
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套阅读语法M2 Easy-去重版

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ● Time Matters ... is a 2021 sculpture by German artist Jan Kuck. ●It is crafted from yellow neon lighting that spells out the title phrase (“time matters”). ● Verdurous No.2 is a 2020 sculpture by United States artist Annesta Le. ●It is crafted from green neon lighting that forms an abstract squiggle shape.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two sculptures. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Jan Kuck and Annesta Le are artists who have used neon in their sculptures.
B. Unlike Kuck’s sculpture, which spells out a phrase, Le’s is an abstract squiggle shape.
C. Time Matters. .., like Verdurous No.2 , is a sculpture.
D. Both Kuck’s and Le’s sculptures are crafted from neon lighting.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记： ●《Time Matters...》是德国艺术家Jan Kuck于2021年创作的雕塑。 ●它由黄色霓虹灯制成，拼出标题短语“time matters”。 ●《Verdurous No. 2》是美国艺术家Annesta Le于2020年创作的雕塑。 ●它由绿色霓虹灯制成，形成一个抽象的弯曲形状。 中文解析： 选择B是因为它直接对比了两座雕塑的关键差异：Kuck的作品拼出具体短语，而Le的作品是抽象形状。
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套阅读语法M2 Easy-去重版

question:
Amaranth grain was domesticated in Mexico. Its physical structure is no longer identical to the structure of the wild plant it is descended from. Summer squash also_______its wild ancestor. That ancestor plant had a hard rind and bitter flesh. Indigenous people in eastern North America carefully bred the crop until it had a soft rind and mild-tasting flesh.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 苋属谷物在墨西哥被驯化。其物理结构不再与其野生祖先植物的结构完全相同。西葫芦也_______其野生祖先。该祖先植物具有坚硬的外皮和苦涩的果肉。北美东部的原住民精心培育这种作物，直到它长出柔软的外皮和味道温和的果肉。 中文解析： 注意原文中的also，说明与前文并列，前面第1-2句话指出，文中指出驯化的苋属谷物在结构上已不同于其野生祖先。同理，summer squash也是一样。

question:
The adult io moth appears black, orange, and yellow with large eyespots as a result of pigmented scales that cover its wings and body. Although scales are widely known as the source of a moth’s color and pattern, the_______of these scales goes beyond visual display: they also detach when moths are caught in a spiderweb.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 成年伊蛾因覆盖翅膀和身体的色素鳞片而呈现黑色、橙色和黄色，并带有巨大的眼斑。尽管鳞片被普遍认为是蛾类颜色和图案的来源，但这些鳞片的_______远不止视觉展示：当蛾被蜘蛛网困住时，鳞片也会脱落。 中文解析： 文中强调鳞片（scale）的功能不仅限于形成颜色和图案（视觉展示），还能通过脱落帮助蛾逃脱蜘蛛网，说明其具有实际生存用途。其他选项（A: 吸引力；C: 倾向性；D: 脆弱性）均无法同时涵盖“视觉作用”和“逃脱机制”的双重功能，且与下文“beyond visual display”的逻辑衔接不符。

question:
Despite a growing view among young people and others in South Africa that celebrated anti-apartheid leader Nelson Mandela should have taken greater strides as president to effect more substantive structural changes in the country’s stratified society, years after his death in 2013 Mandela continues to be______by many worldwide.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 尽管南非的年轻人和其他群体中逐渐形成一种观点，认为著名的反 apartheid 领袖纳尔逊·曼德拉在担任总统时本应采取更大步伐，以在该国阶层分化的社会中实现更实质性的结构变革，但在2013年曼德拉去世多年后，他仍然被全世界许多人______。 中文解析： 文中通过“尽管（Despite）”引导的让步状语从句强调部分人对曼德拉的批评，但主句重点落在“他仍然被全世界许多人______”，且上下文提及他是“celebrated anti-apartheid leader”（著名的反种族隔离领袖），因此“赞扬”最符合逻辑，体现其持续受到尊重的现实。

question:
The dinosaur displays at museums such as the Naturmuseum Senckenberg in Frankfurt (which has a life-sized Dipodocus longus statue among its Holdings) are notable for the_______of the research behind them—the museum staff consulted numerous sources to ensure the accuracy of the displays.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 法兰克福森肯贝格自然博物馆（其馆藏中包含一只真大小的长颈 Dipodocus longus 雕像）等博物馆的恐龙展览因其背后研究的_______而引人注目——博物馆工作人员参考了众多资料以确保展览的准确性。 中文解析： 文中明确提到博物馆工作人员“参考了众多资料以确保展览的准确性”（consulted numerous sources to ensure the accuracy），这直接体现了研究过程的周密性和严格性，与“严谨性”完全契合。其他选项（A: 新颖性；B: 浅薄性；D: 模糊性）均与“确保准确性”的语义矛盾，且无法与下文形成逻辑衔接。

question:
The following text is adapted from Eugene O’ Neill’s 1920 play Beyond the Horizon . Andrew and Robert Mayo are brothers who grew up on their family’s farm. ANDREW: Farming ain’t your nature. There’s all the difference shown in just the way us two feel about the farm. You—well, you like the home part of it, I expect; but as a place to work and grow things, you hate it. Ain’t that right? ROBERT: Yes, I suppose it is. For you it’s different. You’re a Mayo through and through. You’re wedded to the soil. You’ re as much a product of it as an ear of corn is, or a tree. Father is the same. This farm is his life-work.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. It describes a place two characters visited on vacation.
B. It illustrates that two characters share a goal.
C. It emphasizes a difference between two characters.
D. It shows how two characters solved a mystery.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文本改编自尤金·奥尼尔1920年的戏剧《天边外》。安德鲁和罗伯特·梅奥是一对在家庭农场长大的兄弟。 安德鲁：务农不是你的天性。我们俩对农场的感受方式就完全体现了这种差异。你——嗯，我猜你喜欢农场中像家的那一部分；但作为一个工作和种东西的地方，你讨厌它。对不对？ 罗伯特：是的，我想是的。对你来说就不一样了。你是个彻头彻尾的梅奥家人。你与土地紧密相连。你就是土地的产物，就像一穗玉米或一棵树一样。父亲也是这样。这个农场是他一生的事业。 中文解析： 对话中安德鲁直接指出兄弟二人对农场的情感存在根本区别（“我们俩对农场的感受方式就完全体现了这种差异”），罗伯特也承认自己厌恶务农，而安德鲁和父亲却与土地密不可分。

question:
In the past, historians who wanted to examine Frederick Douglass’s diary and other personal papers had to visit the Library of Congress in Washington, DC, to view them on microfilm ( film containing scaled-down reproductions of documents ). But traveling to the library often added time and costs to research projects. Now, by going to the library’s website, researchers can access digitized versions of Douglass’s papers without physically going anywhere.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It summarizes an unexpected finding.
B. It describes a debate among historians.
C. It gives information about a famous person.
D. It explains the meaning of a word.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 过去，想要查阅弗雷德里克·道格拉斯日记和其他个人文件的历史学家必须前往华盛顿特区的国会图书馆，在缩微胶卷（含有文档缩小复制品的胶片）上查看它们。但前往图书馆通常会增加研究项目的时间和成本。现在，通过访问图书馆的网站，研究人员可以在不去任何地方的情况下获取道格拉斯文件的数字化版本。 中文解析： 划线部分“film containing scaled-down reproductions of documents”直接对前文提到的“microfilm”（缩微胶卷）进行定义说明，通过括号内的补充描述明确了该术语的具体含义。

question:
Built in the 1970s, Raccoon Mountain is a pumped-storage hydropower facility (a “water-battery”) located in the United States along the Tennessee River. When energy demand is low, excess power from the regional electric utility’s nuclear plants is used to pump water (from a lower reservoir filled from the Tennessee River) up a shaft to the summit lake, where the water is stored as gravitational potential energy. When energy demand peaks, the water drains down from the summit lake, spinning turbines and generating upward of 1,700 megawatts of power—enough to power one million homes for twenty hours.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To discuss the benefits of a new energy technology
B. To encourage regional electric utilities to build energy storage facilities
C. To point out the differences between two methods of energy generation
D. To explain the basics of how a specific energy technology works
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 浣熊山建于1970年代，是一座抽水蓄能水电站（一种“水电池”），位于美国田纳西河沿岸。当能源需求较低时，地区电力公司核电站的过剩电力被用于将水（从田纳西河填充的下水库）通过竖井抽至山顶湖泊，水以重力势能的形式储存于此。当能源需求达到高峰时，水从山顶湖泊排出，驱动涡轮旋转并产生超过1700兆瓦的电力——足以为一百万户家庭供电二十小时。 中文解析： 全文通过分步描述（抽水蓄能、能量储存、发电过程）具体说明了浣熊山抽水蓄能设施的运行机制，且未涉及技术比较（C）、推广建设（B）或新技术优势（A）等内容，核心目的是客观解释该技术如何运作。

question:
Text 1 The Roadmender , The Life of Martin R. Delany , and twenty-three other works of the late 1800s and early 1900s were rereleased in 2020 as publicity for a prestigious prize for women writers of fiction. Recognizing that women long had to use male pseudonyms for their works to be granted serious consideration (by publishers and readers alike), the campaign restored the authors’ given female names in place of such pseudonyms and brought visibility to identities that should not have been hidden. Text 2 The belief that women historically were barred from publishing under names perceived as female is persistent. That it is also an overgeneralization becomes obvious when considering writers such as Elizabeth Barrett Browning, who published Poems and many other works under her own name in the 1800s, and Mary Mackay, who elected to use the female pseudonym Marie Corelli for her novels and stories in the late 1800s.

Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the overall characterization in Text 1 of the publicity campaign?
selections: A. By acknowledging that the circumstances of publication for Barrett Browning and Mackay differed from those for the authors whose works are the focus of Text 1, given that Barrett Browning and Mackay each published multiple works

B. By asserting that while it is clearly inappropriate to conclude that Barrett Browning was motivated by the same set of factors as the authors of the works discussed in Text 1 to publish under the names they did, it is appropriate to conclude that Mackay was

C. By agreeing that the authors of The Roadmender , The Life of Martin R. Delany , and the other works referred to in Text 1 were not afforded the same opportunities as Barrett Browning and Mackay to shape their own representations when publishing
D. By suggesting that Barrett Browning and Mackay are among the historical examples that challenge the assumption about the historical use of pseudonyms by female writers that is presented in Text 1
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 文本1 《修路工》《马丁·R·迪拉尼的一生》以及其他23部19世纪末至20世纪初的作品于2020年重新出版，作为一项针对女性小说作家的著名奖项的宣传活动。该活动认识到女性长期以来不得不使用男性笔名才能使作品得到（出版商和读者的）认真对待，因此恢复了作者的本名（女性名字）以替代此类笔名，并使这些本不应被隐藏的身份得到关注。 文本2 一种普遍观点认为，历史上女性无法使用被视为女性化的名字出版作品。但这种观点显然是一种过度概括——只需考虑诸如伊丽莎白·巴雷特·勃朗宁（19世纪以本名出版《诗集》等多部作品）和玛丽·麦凯（19世纪末选择使用女性笔名玛丽·科雷利出版小说和故事）等作家即可知。 中文解析： 文本1的核心观点是“女性曾被迫使用男性笔名”，而文本2直接反驳这一假设的普遍性，并以勃朗宁（用本名）和麦凯（主动选择女性笔名）作为反例，说明历史情况复杂，并非所有女性都面临相同限制。选项A、B、C均未准确体现文本2对文本1假设的质疑立场。

question:
When people think of dinosaurs with feathers, they typically think of winged dinosaurs, such as the four-winged Microraptor . However, many dinosaurs that didn’t have wings also had feathers on their bodies. For instance, research indicates that the wingless, speedy Ornithomimus likely had feathers.

Which choice best states the main topic of the text?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 当人们想到有羽毛的恐龙时，他们通常会想到有翅膀的恐龙，例如四翼的小盗龙。然而，许多没有翅膀的恐龙身上也有羽毛。例如，研究表明，没有翅膀、行动迅速的似鸟龙很可能就有羽毛。 中文解析： 全文围绕“有羽毛的恐龙”展开：首句提及人们对此类恐龙的常见联想（有翅膀的物种），接着通过“然而”转折强调“许多没有翅膀的恐龙也有羽毛”，并以似鸟龙为例进一步佐证。

question:
The following text is from Maria Amparo Ruiz de Burton’s 1885 novel The Squatter and the Don. Don Mariano Alamar was silently walking up and down the front piazza of his house at the rancho; his hands listlessly clasped behind and his head slightly bent forward in deep thought. He had pushed away to one side the many arm-chairs and wicker rockers with which the piazza was furnished. He wanted a long space to walk. That his meditations were far from agreeable, could easily be seen by the compressed lips, slight frown, and sad gaze of his mild and beautiful blue eyes.

Based on the text, why does Don Mariano push aside the furniture on the piazza?
selections: A. He is making his home more comfortable for his family.
B. He feels that walking an uninterrupted path will help him think through a difficult issue.
C. He wishes to create the impression that he often receives important guests at his home.
D. He wants to make space so that he can engage in vigorous exercise.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文本选自玛丽亚·安帕罗·鲁伊斯·德伯顿1885年的小说《占地者与唐》。 唐·马里亚诺·阿拉马尔正在牧场家中的前廊默默来回踱步；他双手无力地扣在身后，头微微前倾，陷入沉思。他将走廊上摆放的许多扶手椅和柳条摇椅推到一边。他需要一段长长的空间来走路。从他紧抿的嘴唇、微皱的眉头以及那双温和而美丽的蓝眼睛中悲伤的目光，可以轻易看出他的沉思远非愉快。 中文解析： 文中明确提到他推开家具是为了“需要一段长长的空间来走路”（wanted a long space to walk），且上下文强调他正处于“不愉快的沉思”（meditations far from agreeable）中，表明这一行为与专注思考相关。

question:
Average Hours Worked Person per Year in 1950 and 2017 Country 1950 2017 Change in hours Percent change in hours United Kingdom 2,184 1,670 -514 -24% Australia 2,178 1,731 -447 -21% Germany 2,427 1,354 -1,074 -44% Mexico 2,432 2,255 -177 -7% Calculations may be inexact due to rounding. A student in an economics course is examining the decline since 1950 in average hours worked per person per year in various nations due to both increased productivity and the adoption of policies that limit working hours. The first task in this investigation is to determine how the decline in the United Kingdom compares to that in other countries. The student finds that________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
selections: A. though the percent decrease in hours worked in the United Kingdom was greater than that in Germany and Mexico, it was less than that in Australia.
B. while the number of hours worked rose in the United Kingdom from 1950 to 2017, it declined in Germany, Australia, and Mexico.
C. the decline in number of hours worked was greater in the United Kingdom than it was in Germany, Australia, or Mexico.
D. though the percent decrease in hours worked in the United Kingdom was less than that in Germany, it was greater than that in Australia and Mexico.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一名经济学课程的学生正在研究自1950年以来，由于生产力提高和工作时长限制政策的推行，各国人均年工作小时数的下降情况。此项研究的首要任务是确定英国的下降幅度与其他国家的对比。该学生发现______ 中文解析： 因此英国下降百分比 低于德国（24% < 44%），但高于澳大利亚（24% > 21%）和墨西哥（24% > 7%），与选项D完全吻合。

question:
Impact of Three Key Industries on Oklahoma Economy in 2017 The nearly forty tribes located in Oklahoma, including the Osage Nation and the Seminole Nation, operate numerous businesses, employ tens of thousands of people, and generate billions of dollars in revenue. A student in an economics class is researching the tribes’ collective activity as a single industry. The student wants to compare that industry’s role in Oklahoma in 2017 with the roles of other industries in the state. Looking at a table with information about three industries, the student finds that compared with the other two industries, tribal economic activity_______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the comparison?
selections: A. made the lowest total contribution by industry.
B. made the highest average economic contribution per employee.
C. ranked highest in all three economic measures listed in the table.
D. employed the same number of people as construction.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 俄克拉荷马州近四十个部落（包括奥塞奇族和塞米诺尔族）经营众多企业，雇佣数万人，并产生数十亿美元的收入。一名经济学课程的学生正在研究部落集体活动作为一个单一产业的情况。该学生希望将该产业2017年在俄克拉荷马州的作用与该州其他产业的作用进行比较。通过查看包含三个产业信息的表格，该学生发现与其他两个产业相比，部落经济活动______。 中文解析： 根据表格数据：部落经济活动的人均贡献值为 $141,510，制造业为 $130,403，建筑业为 $87,994。因此部落经济活动的人均贡献值明显高于其他两个产业。

question:
A creole language is an amalgam of a lexifier, or primary contributor of grammar and vocabulary, with one or more substrates, or secondary contributors. English-lexifying creoles in North America, such as Afro-Seminole Creole, rely on West African substrates, while Hawaiian Pidgin relies on Ōlelo Hawai’i, the Polynesian language of the Native Hawaiian people, with further contributions from Korean and other East Asian languages, Portuguese, and Spanish. This is a heterogeneous history, even for a creole language. Moreover, numerous similarities are found among the East Asian substrates, as well as between Portuguese and Spanish. Thus, it can be challenging to credit certain words or features of grammar or pronunciation to any one substrate.

Which statement, if true, would best illustrate the challenge described in the text?
selections: A. As is also the case with some first-language speakers of Afro-Seminole Creole, many first-language speakers of Hawaiian Pidgin align their pronunciation, word choice, and syntax more closely with English in certain conversational contexts than in others.

B. Stative structures in which verbs modify subjects and serve a descriptive function comparable to that of adjectives are hallmarks of Hawaiian Pidgin as well as of East Asian languages such as Korean, yet the syntax of Hawaiian Pidgin’s stative structures confirms their origin in Ōlelo Hawai’i.

C. Hawaiian Pidgin’s substitution of “d” for the voiced “th” consonant (as used in “that”) and of “t” for the unvoiced “th” consonant (as used in “thick”) can be credited to the absence of “th” consonants in Ōlelo Hawai’i, though most other Polynesian languages lack “th” consonants too.

D. The usage of the Hawaiian Pidgin verb “ste” to convey a temporary state, as in the statement “da watah ste cold” (the water is cold), most nearly resembles that of the Ōlelo Hawai’i verb noho , though the Portuguese verb ficar and the Spanish verb estar have similar usages and may also exert an influence on “ste.”
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 克里奥尔语是一种由词汇主要提供者（即语法和词汇的主要贡献者）与一种或多种底层语言（即次要贡献者）融合而成的语言。北美以英语为词汇基础的克里奥尔语（如非裔塞米诺尔克里奥尔语）依赖西非底层语言，而夏威夷皮钦语则依赖夏威夷原住民的波利尼西亚语——Ōlelo Hawai'i，并进一步受到韩语等东亚语言、葡萄牙语和西班牙语的影响。即使对克里奥尔语而言，这也是一段异质化的历史。此外，东亚底层语言之间以及葡萄牙语和西班牙语之间存在诸多相似性。因此，将某些词汇、语法或发音特征归因于任一特定底层语言可能具有挑战性。 中文解析： D) 夏威夷皮钦语中动词“ste”表示临时状态（如“da watah ste cold”）的用法最接近Ōlelo Hawai'i动词noho，但葡萄牙语动词ficar和西班牙语动词estar也有类似用法，并可能对“ste”产生影响。该选项直接体现了文本核心挑战：多种底层语言（Ōlelo Hawai'i、葡萄牙语、西班牙语）在语法特征上高度相似，导致难以确定某一具体特征的单一来源。其他选项未同时涉及多重底层语言的贡献与归因困境：A) 仅讨论语言使用场景变化，与底层语言来源无关；B) 明确确认语法结构来源（Ōlelo Hawai'i），回避了归因挑战；C) 将发音特征归因于单一底层语言（Ōlelo Hawai'i），未体现多语言相似性带来的困难。

question:
The great egret and the wood stork are long-legged birds that live in wetlands, like the Everglades in Florida. Laura D’ Acunto and colleagues wanted to know how these birds choose an area in which to live. They looked at features of the birds’ habitats, such as the extent of tree-canopy coverage in the area and how deep the water is during the birds’ breeding season. They found that great egrets prefer areas with deep water during breeding season, but that was not true for wood storks. The researchers concluded that water management strategies that increase the depth of water in potential wetland bird habitats during breeding season are therefore more likely to______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. extend the average lifespan of great egrets already in the area than they are to attract a greater number of those birds to the area.
B. attract birds that don’t typically live in wetlands to the area than they are to attract great egrets or wood storks to the area.
C. attract great egrets to the area than they are to attract wood storks to the area.
D. decrease the area’s appeal to both great egrets and wood storks than they are to increase the appeal to either.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 大白鹭和林鹳是长腿鸟类，栖息于湿地，如佛罗里达大沼泽地。Laura D’Acunto及其同事想了解这些鸟类如何选择栖息地。他们研究了鸟类栖息地的特征，例如区域的树冠覆盖程度以及繁殖季节的水深。他们发现大白鹭偏好繁殖季节水深较深的区域，但林鹳并非如此。研究人员因此得出结论：在繁殖季节增加潜在湿地鸟类栖息地水深的水管理策略，更有可能______ 中文解析： 文本明确说明研究发现“大白鹭great egrets偏好繁殖季深水区，但林鹳wood storks并非如此”，因此增加水深的策略更可能对大白鹭great egrets（其偏好与策略目标一致）产生吸引力，而对林鹳wood storks（其偏好与策略无关）效果有限。

question:
Filtration is a widely used method for removing microplastics-plastics with a width less than 5 millimeters (mm) — from waterways. However, filtration systems are typically unable to capture very small microplastics. Menake Piyasena and Nelum Perera designed a device that applies sound waves to water as it flows through a metal tube. The sound waves cause microplastics in the water to gather in the middle and along the sides of the tube. The microplastics can then be separated out by channeling polluted and clean water though different outlets. Testing indicated that the system removes even tiny microplastics, including ones as small as 10 microns, or 0.01 mm, wide. This result suggests that _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the sound wave treatment system may help solve a problem associated with filtration of microplastics.
B. combining filtration with sound waves is likely the most efficient method for removing microplastics from water.
C. directing water through filtration tubes with multiple outlets reduces microplastic pollution.
D. unlike sound waves, filters have the ability to remove large microplastics from polluted waterways.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 过滤是一种广泛使用的从水道中去除微塑料（宽度小于5毫米的塑料）的方法。然而，过滤系统通常无法捕获非常小的微塑料。Menake Piyasena和Nelum Perera设计了一种装置，当水流经金属管时对其施加声波。声波使水中的微塑料聚集在管道的中间和两侧。然后，通过将污染水和清洁水引导至不同的出口，可以分离出微塑料。测试表明，该系统甚至可以去除微小的微塑料，包括小至10微米（即0.01毫米）宽的微塑料。这一结果表明_______ 中文解析： 文本开头指出过滤法的缺陷（无法捕获极小的微塑料），随后详细介绍声波技术如何有效去除这些微小颗粒（小至0.01mm），恰好弥补了过滤法的不足。因此，声波系统直接针对并可能解决了过滤法的局限性。

question:
A senior data scientist at Apple, Kate Niehaus works on developing artificial intelligence technology, with a specific focus on trustworthy machine______ machine learning involves teaching computer algorithms to be accurate, safe, and fair.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 前后是两个独立的句子，应该用句号连接。

question:
The Tuskegee University Archives’ collection includes an original 1957 photograph of Martin Luther King Jr. addressing a group of Tuskegee civil rights activists. Taken by P.H. Polk, the photo _______King in profile, the glow of a stage light casting his silhouette onto the curtains behind him.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: The photo需要一个谓语动词，因此选C。

question:
Sociologist Alton Okinaka sits on the review board tasked with adding new sites to the Hawaii Register of Historic Places, which includes Menehune Fishpond and the Wailuku School. However, Okinaka doesn’t make such decisions ________all historical designations must be approved by a group of nine other experts from the fields of architecture, archaeology, history, and Hawaiian culture.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 前后是两个独立的句子，应该用分号连接。

question:
Most of the ice found on Earth is ice Ih, distinguished by a crystalline structure in which molecules form a hexagonal pattern. Amorphous ice, on the other hand, constitutes most of the ice in the ultrafrigid environment of outer space. Defined by a disorganized molecular structure,_________

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. ice Ih contains crystals, whereas amorphous ice, which lacks the thermal energy to form them, does not.
B. amorphous ice lacks the thermal energy to form the crystals found in ice Ih.
C. the lack of thermal energy in amorphous ice explains its inability to form the crystals found in ice Ih.
D. ice Ih differs from amorphous ice in that it possesses the thermal energy to form crystals.
explanations: 这里考察得失逻辑主语一致，前面的defined by a disorganized molecular structure应该修饰的Amorphous ice，所以对应B

question:
When, in 2018, scientists in Germany discovered a fossilized brittle star with three thick, spine-studded arms positioned opposite three thin, undeveloped ones, they found something never before seen in the fossil ______clonal fragmentation, a type of asexual reproduction, an animal splits itself in two, each half then regrowing its missing limbs—just what the brittle star was doing.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. record. Evidence of cloning in
B. record: evidence of cloning. In
C. record — evidence of cloning in
D. record, evidence of cloning, in
explanations: evidence of cloning修饰前面的fossil record，它们之间用冒号。这个题目的空前后分别有一个独立的句子，所以应该用句号隔开，那么这个句号应该放在evidence of cloning后面。

question:
Typically, upon detecting the scent of another animal, a leopard will open its mouth._______the leopard allows the scent to reach sensory receptors on the roof of its mouth. These sensors help the leopard interpret the source of the scent.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 通常，在察觉到其他动物的气味时，豹子会张开嘴巴。_______豹子让气味到达口腔上颚的感官受体。这些传感器帮助豹子解读气味的来源。 中文解析： 前句描述豹子“张开嘴巴”的行为，后句解释这一行为的直接目的（让气味到达感官受体）。选项D“通过这样做”清晰地建立了前因后果的逻辑关系，表明后句是前句动作的具体实现方式。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·The human tongue contains taste receptors for a rich, savory flavor called umami. ·Umami is triggered by the compounds in a variety of foods, including anchovies and mushrooms. ·Participants in a study tasted a sample of sea palm, a type of brown seaweed. ·They rated its umami intensity as moderate. ·The participants tasted a sample of ma-konbu, another type of brown seaweed. ·They rated its umami intensity as high.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two seaweeds. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Participants in a research study found sea palm, a type of brown seaweed, to have moderate umami intensity, while ma-konbu’s umami was more intense.
B. Both sea palm and ma-konbu are types of brown seaweed.
C. Sea palm and ma-konbu both contain umami flavor, which can also be triggered by compounds in anchovies and mushrooms.
D. Some types of brown seaweed, like sea palm and ma-konbu, trigger umami flavor in human taste buds.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记： ·人类舌头含有一种名为“鲜味”（umami）的浓郁 savory 风味的味觉受体。 ·鲜味由多种食物中的化合物触发，包括凤尾鱼和蘑菇。 ·一项研究的参与者品尝了海棕榈（一种褐藻）样本。 ·他们将其鲜味强度评为中等。 ·参与者品尝了另一种褐藻真昆布（ma-konbu）的样本。 ·他们将其鲜味强度评为高。 中文解析： A选项直接对比了两种海藻的鲜味强度（海棕榈“中等” vs. 真昆布“更浓郁”）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·NoViolet Bulawayo is an acclaimed writer. ·Her first published work of fiction was a short story. ·It was called “Hitting Budapest.” ·It first appeared in Boston Review in 2010.

The student wants to identify the title of NoViolet Bulawayo’s first published short story. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. NoViolet Bulawayo’s first published short story was called “Hitting Budapest.”
B. In 2010, a short story by NoViolet Bulawayo appeared in Boston Review .
C. NoViolet Bulawayo’s first published work of fiction appeared in 2010.
D. Acclaimed writer NoViolet Bulawayo’s first published work of fiction was a short story.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记： ·NoViolet Bulawayo 是一位备受赞誉的作家。 ·她首次出版的虚构作品是一篇短篇故事。 ·该作品名为《Hitting Budapest》。 ·它于2010年首次发表在《Boston Review》上。 中文解析： A选项直接整合了笔记中的关键信息：1. “首次出版的短篇故事”（对应第二点）；2. 明确标题“Hitting Budapest”（对应第三点）。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·The El Tigre Mountains are a mountain range located in northwestern Mexico. ·The range is one of the dozens of “sky islands” in the southwestern US and northwestern Mexico. ·A sky island is an isolated mountain range whose environment differs drastically from that of the surrounding lowlands. ·The US Forest Service (USFS) said, “The mountains are ‘islands’ surrounded by deserts that are ‘seas.’” ·The USFS said, “Each Sky Island is a unique ecosystem.”

The student wants to provide an example of a sky island. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Sky islands are isolated mountain ranges whose environments differ drastically from that of the surrounding lowlands; as the USFS puts it, “the mountains are ‘islands’ surrounded by deserts that are ‘seas.’”
B. The USFS considers each of the sky islands, whose environments differ drastically from that of the surrounding lowlands, to be a “unique ecosystem.”
C. In the southwestern US and northwestern Mexico, there are dozens of sky islands: isolated mountain ranges whose environments differ drastically from that of the surrounding lowlands.
D. There are dozens of sky islands in the southwestern US and northwestern Mexico, such as the El Tigre Mountains.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记： ·埃尔蒂格雷山脉（El Tigre Mountains）是位于墨西哥西北部的山脉。 ·该山脉是美国西南部和墨西哥西北部数十个“天空岛屿”（sky islands）之一。 ·天空岛屿是指孤立的山脉，其环境与周围低地截然不同。 ·美国林务局（USFS）表示：“这些山脉是‘岛屿’，被沙漠的‘海洋’所包围。” ·美国林务局（USFS）表示：“每个天空岛屿都是独特的生态系统。” 中文解析： D选项直接明确地以“例如”（such as）引出具体实例“埃尔蒂格雷山脉”，完美符合“提供例子”的要求。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·Ike Taiga (1723-1776) was a Japanese painter. ·Li Bai (701-762) was a Chinese poet. ·Taiga created the artwork titled Landscape and Couplet of Chinese Verse. ·The artwork is made up of two scrolls. ·Scroll 1 features a painting of a lone figure walking among tall, narrow mountains. ·Scroll 2 features a poem from Li Bai that is about being in nature.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two scrolls. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Ike Taiga created Landscape and Couplet of Chinese Verse , which is made up of two scrolls that each depict nature.
B. Made up of two scrolls that each depict nature, Landscape and Couplet of Chinese Verse was created by Li Bai.
C. In Landscape and Couplet of Chinese Verse , one scroll features a painting, while the other scroll features a poem.
D. One of the twoscrolls that make up Landscape and Couplet of Chinese Verse features mountains, and one features a portrait of poet Li Bai.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记： ·池大雅（Ike Taiga，1723-1776）是一位日本画家。 ·李白（Li Bai，701-762）是一位中国诗人。 ·池大雅创作了名为《山水和汉诗对联》（Landscape and Couplet of Chinese Verse）的艺术作品。 ·该作品由两幅卷轴组成。 ·卷轴1描绘了一个孤独的人物在高耸狭窄的山脉中行走的绘画。 ·卷轴2展示了李白的一首关于置身于自然中的诗。 中文解析： C选项直接对比了两幅卷轴的核心差异：一幅是视觉艺术（绘画），另一幅是文字艺术（诗歌），完美契合笔记内容（卷轴1为画，卷轴2为诗）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·Dame Ellen McArthur is a British sailor who completed a true circumnavigation of the globe in 2001. ·One of the requirements of a true circumnavigation is that the journey must begin and end in the same port. ·McArthur’s circumnavigation began and ended in the port of Les Sables d’ Olonne, France. ·On her journey, McArthur passed the three great capes of the Southern Ocean. ·Her journey took 94 days.

The student wants to provide evidence that McArthur’s journey was a true circumnavigation. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. To be considered a true circumnavigation, a journey must begin and end in the same port, and McArthur’s lasted 94 days.
B. McArthur is a British sailor who completed a true circumnavigation that ended in Les Sables d’ Olonne, France.
C. McArthur began and ended her trip in the same port (Les Sables d’ Olonne, France), one of the requirements for a true circumnavigation.
D. A true circumnavigation, McArthur’s journey also passed the three great capes of the Southern Ocean.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记： ·艾伦·麦克阿瑟女爵士（Dame Ellen McArthur）是一位英国航海家，于2001年完成了真正的环球航行。 ·真正环球航行的要求之一是旅程必须始于并终于同一港口。 ·麦克阿瑟的环球航行始于并终于法国莱萨布勒多洛讷港（Les Sables d’Olonne）。 ·在旅程中，麦克阿瑟经过了南大洋的三大岬角。 ·她的旅程耗时94天。 中文解析： C选项直接引用笔记中“真正环球航行”的核心定义（要求同一港口），并用麦克阿瑟的具体事实（起点和终点均为法国莱萨布勒多洛讷港）作为证据，完美符合“提供证据”的目标。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·In the 1800s, some actors also managed theaters. ·They were known as actor-managers. ·William Charles Macready managed the Covent Garden Theatre (London) from 1837 to 1839. ·He starred in a production of Henry V there in 1838. ·Laura Keene managed Laura Keene’s Theatre (New York) from 1856 to 1863. ·She starred in a production of The Seven Sisters there in 1860.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between Macready and Keene. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Macready managed a London theater, whereas Keene managed one in New York.
B. Both Macready and Keene were managers of the Covent Garden Theatre in London, where they also starred in various plays.
C. As actor-managers, both Macready and Keene managed theaters where they also performed.
D. In the 1800s, some actors (such as Keene) also managed theaters; they were thus considered actor-managers.
explanations: 在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记： ·19世纪，一些演员同时经营剧院。 ·他们被称为“演员经理人”（actor-managers）。 ·威廉·查尔斯·麦克里迪（William Charles Macready）于1837至1839年管理伦敦科文特花园剧院（Covent Garden Theatre）。 ·他于1838年在该剧院主演了《亨利五世》。 ·劳拉·基恩（Laura Keene）于1856至1863年管理纽约劳拉·基恩剧院（Laura Keene’s Theatre）。 ·她于1860年在该剧院主演了《七姐妹》（The Seven Sisters）。 中文解析： C选项直接概括了两人最核心的共同点：兼具“剧院管理者”和“演员”的双重身份（管理剧院并在其中主演），完美呼应笔记中“actor-managers”的定义及具体事例。B) 事实错误（基恩管理的是纽约剧院，非科文特花园）。

question:
The following text is adapted from the 1895 poem “Shadow River” by Emily Pauline Johnson (Tekahionwake). The speaker is looking at the reflections of plants in a river. The little fern-leaf, bending Upon the brink, its green reflection greets, And kisses soft the shadow that it meets With touch so fine, The border line The keenest vision can’t define ; So perfect is the blending.

As used in the text, what does the word “define” most nearly mean?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文本改编自艾米莉·波琳·约翰逊（泰卡琼瓦克）1895年的诗歌《影子河》。 说话者正在观察植物在河中的倒影。 纤纤蕨叶，弯垂水涯 轻吻邂逅之影，以细腻触须 致边界模糊 极锐之目亦难界定； 交融如此完美。 中文解析： 诗歌描述蕨叶倒影与实体的交界线难以被“define”，结合上下文“极锐之目亦难”的表述，此处强调视觉上的辨识困难，因此“define”在此语境中最接近“清晰感知/辨别”之意，而非其他选项的“缩写”“重述”或“解释”等抽象含义。

question:
Text corpora such as the Bank of English are enormous collections of electronically stored texts that can be used for empirical testing of hypotheses regarding the frequency of typical word usage. For example, a linguist who assumes that the word “life” is _______ in written English could find evidence supporting that assumption in a corpus: “life” is the ninth most commonly used noun.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 像“英语银行”这样的文本语料库是电子存储文本的巨大集合，可用于对典型词汇使用频率的假设进行实证测试。例如，若语言学家认为“life”一词在书面英语中是_______的，则可在语料库中找到支持该假设的证据：“life”是第九最常用名词。 中文解析： 语料库数据显示“life”是第九常用名词，证明其使用频率极高、广泛存在，与“无处不在”的含义直接契合；其他选项均与高频使用这一核心证据无关（“权威性”“减少”或“误用”均无法由排名数据推导）。

question:
New and interesting research conducted by Suleiman A. Al-Sweedan and Moath Alhaj is inspired by their observation that though studies of the effect of high altitude on blood chemistry are _______, the effect on blood chemistry of living in locations below sea level, such as the California towns of Niland and Thermal, has received comparatively little notice.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 苏莱曼·A·阿尔斯威丹和莫斯·阿尔哈吉进行了一项新颖有趣的研究，其灵感来自他们的观察：尽管关于高海拔对血液化学影响的研究_______，但对于低于海平面地区（如加利福尼亚州的尼兰和瑟默尔镇）生活对血液化学的影响，却相对较少受到关注。 中文解析： 文中通过“though”形成对比逻辑 — 后半句指出低海拔研究“较少受到关注”，因此前半句应强调高海拔研究“数量众多”，copious（大量的）恰好呼应这种对比；其他选项均与语境矛盾（“初步”“零星”或“模棱两可”无法与“较少关注”构成有效对比）。

question:
One way to evaluate the importance of a scholar’s research is to _______ other scholars’ references to that research. For example, a count of other scholars’ citations shows that Cornell University economist Francine Blau, who studies labor economics, is referenced frequently, indicating that her work has been significant in the field.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 评估一位学者研究重要性的一种方法是_______其他学者对该研究的引用。例如，对其他学者引用次数的统计显示，研究劳动经济学的康奈尔大学经济学家Francine Blau被频繁引用，这表明她的工作在该领域具有重要意义。 中文解析： 后文举例提到“a count of other scholars’ citations”（对其他学者引用次数的统计），直接对应enumerate（列举、计数）的含义；其他选项均与“统计引用次数”这一量化评估方式无关（“删减”“调换”或“规避”均无法体现评估重要性所需的客观数据支持）。

question:
High-speed rail systems, in which trains can move at great speeds, are expanding in many countries because high-speed rail can reduce the number of automobiles on the road and ultimately conserve energy. In Denmark, for instance, 56 kilometers of high-speed rail lines are in operation as of 2023, and 717 kilometers are under construction.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. The text rejects a long-held belief and then proposes a different interpretation.
B. The text questions a course of action and then suggests alternatives to that action.
C. The text summarizes an argument and then offers a challenge to that argument.
D. The text notes a general trend and then cites an example of that trend.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 高速铁路系统（列车可高速运行）正在许多国家扩展，因为高铁能减少道路上汽车的数量并最终节约能源。例如在丹麦，截至2023年已有56公里高铁线路投入运营，另有717公里正在建设中。 中文解析： 文本首先概括了高铁在全球扩张的普遍现象（总体趋势），随后以丹麦的具体数据（运营及建设里程）作为实例佐证，符合“趋势+案例”的结构

question:
In 1965, poet and scholar Dudley Randall founded Broadside Press in Detroit, Michigan. With the goal of making the work of Black poets widely available to the public, Randall published and distributed broadsides: individual poems printed on single sheets of paper. Since these broadsides became associated with the innovative aesthetics of the Black Arts Movement (1965 – 1975), Randall’s publication format may likewise seem to have been pioneering, but, in fact, broadside poetry had also flourished in seventeenth-century London, where single-sheet popular ballads flooded the marketplace.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It undermines the argument that Randall’s method for publishing poetry was a largely novel one.
B. It identifies a reason for a possible misconception regarding Randall’s publication of broadsides.
C. It explains why Randall’s broadsides were important to the Black Arts Movement.
D. It provides context for Randall’s decision to publish work by Black poets as broadsides.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 1965年，诗人兼学者达德利·兰德尔在密歇根州底特律创立了Broadside Press。为了让黑人诗人的作品广泛传播，兰德尔出版并发行了单页诗（broadsides）：即印在单张纸上的独立诗作。既然这些单页诗与黑人艺术运动（1965-1975）的创新美学相关联，兰德尔出版形式可能看似具有开创性，但实际上，单页诗在17世纪的伦敦也曾盛行，当时市场上充斥着单页流行的民谣。 中文解析： 划线句通过“Since...”建立了因果关系：正是因为单页诗与黑人艺术运动的创新美学关联，才容易让人误以为这种形式是全新的。

question:
In their meta-analysis of research on advergames (video games developed to promote products or services), Zeph M. C. van Berlo et al. confirm that such games, though they can elicit player interest, may not facilitate subsequent recall of product and brand information. This phenomenon can be explained by the finite nature of cognitive capacity as it is articulated in Annie Lang’s limited capacity model of motivated mediated message processing. In this case, players’ cognitive resources are directed foremost toward the advergame’s mechanics, leaving little or no capacity for encoding and storing the information the advertiser intends to be salient.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. The limited capacity model of motivated mediated message processing developed by Lang provides a means of explaining the finding by van Berloet al. that players may not readily recollect the brand and productinformation embedded in advergames.
B. The meta-analysis by van Berlo et al. reveals that higher engagement in advergame mechanics is linked to lower effectiveness in persuading players to purchase particular brands and products.

C. Research by van Berlo et al. corroborates Lang’s conclusion that because people predominantly focus on game mechanics when playing video games, it is difficult for advergames to communicate brand and product information in ways that are highly memorable.

D. Although the limited capacity model of motivated mediated message processing developed by Lang suggests otherwise, advergames can succeed as marketing tools, provided that they achieve a balance between game mechanics and the promotion of a brand or product.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在Zeph M. C. van Berlo等人对广告游戏（为推广产品或服务而开发的视频游戏）研究的元分析中，他们确认此类游戏虽能引发玩家兴趣，但可能无助于后续对产品和品牌信息的回忆。这一现象可用Annie Lang提出的动机性媒介信息处理有限容量模型中阐明的认知能力有限性来解释：玩家的认知资源首先集中于广告游戏的机制，几乎无余力编码存储广告商希望突出的信息。 中文解析： A的意思是Lang提出的动机性媒介信息处理有限容量模型，为解释van Berlo等人的发现（玩家不易回忆广告游戏中嵌入的品牌和产品信息）提供了方法。该选项精准捕捉了文本核心逻辑链——van Berlo的实证发现（回忆困难）与Lang的理论模型（认知资源分配机制）之间的解释关系

question:
Broken-Wing Display in Various Bird Species Species name Common name Order Performs brokenwing display? Gallinago paraguaiae Grus South American snipe Charadriiformes No Grus canadensis sandhill crane Gruiformes Yes Zenaida meloda West Peruvian dove Columbiformes No Actitis hypoleucos common sandpiper Columbiformes Yes Coccyzus americanus yellow-billed cuckoo Gruiformes Yes While observing birds for a biology class, a group of students noticed a Westernsandpiper ( Calidris mauri ), a bird of the order Charadriiformes (shorebirds), slowly move away, make loud noises, and feign an injured wing as the group approached the bird’s ground nest. Researching this behavior, the students learned that this phenomenon is commonly referred to as “broken-wing display” and is meant to lure predators away from the nesting site and toward a seemingly vulnerable adult bird. Upon learning of other birds that also exhibit the behavior they had observed, the students hypothesized that the phenomenon is exclusive to shorebirds.

Which choice best describes data from the table that weaken the students’ claim?
selections: A. Unlike the common sandpiper, the South American snipe is not known to perform broken-wing display, even though both are in the order Charadriiformes.
B. Neither the West Peruvian dove nor the South American snipe is known to perform broken-wing display.
C. The common sandpiper, in the order Charadriiformes, is known to perform broken-wing display, and the West Peruvian dove, in the order Columbiformes, is not.
D. Both the yellow-billed cuckoo and the sandhill crane are known to perform broken-wing display.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在为生物课观察鸟类时，一组学生注意到，当他们接近一只西部鹬（Calidris mauri，属于鸻形目鸟类）的地面巢穴时，这只鸟缓慢移动、发出响亮叫声，并假装翅膀受伤。通过研究这一行为，学生们了解到这种现象通常被称为“断翅表演”，旨在将捕食者从巢穴引开，转向一只看似脆弱的成鸟。在了解到其他鸟类也表现出他们观察到的行为后，学生们提出假设：这种现象是鸻形目鸟类所独有的。 中文解析： 学生的假设是“断翅行为仅为鸻形目独有”，但D选项指出两种非鸻形目鸟类（鹤形目的沙丘鹤和黄嘴美洲鹃）也存在该行为，直接削弱了“目级分类独占性”的结论。

question:
Organic Compounds Detected in Sequential Extracts from A0106 Solvent (sequence #) Alkanes Dimethyl sulfides Naphthalene Hexane (1) present absent absent Dichloromethane only (2) present absent present Methanol only (3) absent present present Dichloromethane and methanol (4) present absent present After sample A0106 was retrieved from the asteroid Ryugu, a portion of it was subjected to an extraction protocol in which small amounts of pulverized material were rinsed, sequentially, with hexane, dichloromethane, methanol, and finally a mixture of dichloromethane and methanol. Each rinse created a separate extract suitable for spectral analysis. Based on the table, both alkane and dimethyl sulfide compounds must have been present in the pulverized sample before the methanol-only extraction, because _______

Which choice uses data from the table to effectively complete the text?
selections: A. the third extract in the sequence contains dimethyl sulfides and the fourth contains alkanes.
B. the second extract in the sequence contains alkanes but no dimethyl sulfides.
C. three of the four extracts contain alkanes but only one of the four contains dimethyl sulfides.
D. the fourth extract in the sequence contains alkanes but no dimethyl sulfides.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 从小行星“龙宫”回收样本A0106后，对其部分进行了提取操作：依次用己烷、二氯甲烷、甲醇，以及二氯甲烷与甲醇的混合物冲洗少量粉碎材料。每次冲洗产生一个独立提取物用于光谱分析。根据表格，烷烃和二甲基硫醚化合物必定在单独甲醇提取前已存在于粉碎样本中，因为______。 中文解析： 题目需要证明烷烃和二甲基硫醚这两种化合物在第三次提取（仅甲醇）之前就已经存在于样本中。选项A直接提供了这两个关键证据：第三次提取含二甲基硫醚dimethyl sulfides（证明其存在于第三次前）；第四次提取含烷烃alkanes（证明烷烃在第三次后仍有残留，故第三次前必存在）。

question:
In medieval England, singers and minstrels made livings as traveling performers, but the pieces they performed have been a mystery, thought to be lost or never committed to paper at all. Recently, however, James Wade has argued that a manuscript collection compiled in the fifteenth century by Richard Heege contains three pieces likely copied from a repertoire book belonging to a minstrel working in the area around Heege’s home. Wade cites features of the texts indicative of live performance, such as directly appealing to the audience, extensive use of repetition (allowing for easy memorization), and requests for tips (payment) from listeners.

Which statement, if true, would most strongly support Wade’s argument?
selections: A. Heege’s collection contains the earliest examples of the three pieces in question, but each of those pieces occurs in other manuscript collectionscompiled after Heege’s.
B. Traveling minstrels are thought to have performed mainly for elite audiences, and other parts of Heege’s collection reflect his interest in works with popular appeal.
C. Features like repetition also occur in other texts from the period that were widely read but are not known to have been performed for live audiences.
D. The three pieces in question contain references that presume that the audience is familiar with Radford and other small villages near where Heege lived.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在中世纪英格兰，歌手和吟游诗人以巡回表演为生，但他们表演的曲目一直是个谜，被认为已失传或从未被记录成文。然而，詹姆斯·韦德最近提出，15世纪理查德·希格编纂的手稿集包含三首可能抄自希格家乡附近某吟游诗人剧目簿的曲目。韦德引用了文本中体现现场表演的特征，如直接呼吁观众、大量使用重复（便于记忆）以及向听众索取小费（报酬）。 中文解析： D选项直接强化了韦德的核心论点——曲目源自当地吟游诗人：提及只有当地观众才熟悉的地名，证明这些曲目是为本地现场表演而创作，与“抄自当地吟游诗人剧目簿”的结论高度吻合。

question:
Economists have demonstrated that herding — in which individuals converge on the same action by imitating the economic decisions of one or more peers —occurs among investors. Investigating whether herding also occurs among nations in matters of economic policy, Maru Etta-Nkwelle examined changes in the foreign currency reserves of emerging economies in various world regions in the years following the widespread financial crisis of 1997. Etta-Nkwelle posited that herding would manifest in regional peer countries converging on the same foreign currency accumulation rate regardless of each country’s observable circumstances. She found that Asian countries showed evidence of herding but African countries did not.

Based on the text, which finding, if true, would best account for the discrepancy Etta-Nkwelle observed?
selections: A. The majority of the currency held in reserves by the African countries was foreign currency, whereas the majority of the currency held in reserves by the Asian countries was domestic currency.
B. The African countries tended to accumulate a variety of foreign currencies for their reserves, whereas the Asian countries tended to favor a single foreign currency for their reserves.

C. Most of the African countries belonged to international economic unions that set individual foreign-currency accumulation policies for each member, whereas the Asian countries were largely free to set their own policies.

D. The 1997 financial crisis resulted in immediate declines in many of the African countries’ foreign currency reserves, whereas the crisis had few short-term effects on the foreign currency reserves of most of the Asian countries.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 经济学家已证实，投资者中存在“羊群效应”（即个体通过模仿一个或多个同行的经济决策而采取相同行动）。为研究国家在经济政策中是否也存在羊群效应，Maru Etta-Nkwelle 考察了1997年广泛金融危机后几年内各世界地区新兴经济体外币储备的变化。Etta-Nkwelle 假设羊群效应会表现为：区域内的peer国家会趋同于相同的外币积累率，而忽略各国可观察的具体情况。她发现亚洲国家存在羊群效应证据，但非洲国家没有。 中文解析： C直接解释了差异根源：非洲国家受外部制度约束（联盟设定个体政策），无法自由模仿同行决策，从而抑制了羊群效应；亚洲国家自主决策权大，更易出现政策趋同。

question:
Introducing a new species into a delicate ecosystem can often be harmful. The hwamei and other fruit-eating birds have established themselves on the Hawaiian island of Oahu after being brought there in the last 150 years. Many plant species on the island rely on the activity of fruit-eating birds to maintain and increase their populations. In recent studies, hwameis have been found to spread seeds of native forest plants that are at risk of extinction, such as the kawau tree and the alahee tree, suggesting that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. non-native birds have had both positive and negative effects on Oahu’s native plants.
B. although non-native birds initially damaged the plants in Oahu’s ecosystem, they are now proving useful to them.
C. rather than harming Oahu’s ecosystem, some non-native birds provide an important benefit on Oahu.
D. non-native birds, such as the hwamei, are unlikely to eat fruits from non-native forest plants on Oahu.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 将新物种引入脆弱生态系统通常有害。画眉（hwamei）等食果鸟类在近150年被带到夏威夷瓦胡岛后已在此定居。岛上许多植物物种依赖食果鸟类的活动来维持和增加种群。近期研究发现，画眉会传播濒危本土森林植物（如kawau树和alahee树）的种子，这表明______ 中文解析： 文本明确指出来自外地的画眉鸟传播了濒危本土植物的种子，直接支持了“非本地物种可能带来生态益处”的结论，与C选项（一些非本地鸟类并未危害瓦胡岛生态系统，反而为其提供了重要益处）逻辑完全吻合

question:
Lichens lack root systems, so they must absorb water directly from the air, dew, and even tree bark and retain it in their bodies. A team of scientists recently used computer simulations to evaluate the importance of water stored in tree bark (bark water) for lichens in the Mediterranean region. In the control simulation, lichens had access to all water sources; in the experimental simulation, lichens had access to all sources except bark water. Compared to the control, the experimental simulation predicted a decrease in the lichens’ overall biomass production of 21%. The experimental simulation (but not the control simulation) also predicted a decrease in the survival of certain species of lichen during the summer due to evaporative water loss, suggesting that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. only some specialized lichen species are able to absorb bark water during long periods of high evaporation.
B. access to bark water may help offset the effects of seasonal water loss for some lichen species.
C. although lichens can absorb water from multiple sources, most of the water they absorb is bark water.
D. bark water absorption reduces biomass production in lichens but makes them more resistant to seasonal changes in conditions.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 地衣没有根系，因此必须直接从空气、露水甚至树皮中吸收水分并储存在体内。一个科学家团队最近使用计算机模拟评估了树皮水分（bark water）对地中海地区地衣的重要性。在对照组模拟中，地衣可获取所有水源；在实验组模拟中，地衣可获取除树皮水分外的所有水源。与对照组相比，实验组模拟预测地衣整体生物量产量减少21%。实验组模拟（而非对照组）还预测某些地衣物种在夏季会因蒸发失水而存活率下降，这表明______ 中文解析： 实验组模拟中，禁止获取树皮水分导致生物量下降及夏季存活率降低，而对照组（可获取树皮水分）无此现象，直接证明树皮水分能补偿蒸发造成的水分流失

question:
Key-value pairs are an important aspect of JavaScript Object Notation (JSON), an electronic file format for storing and transmitting data. Keys function as labels, while values contain the actual information. In a JSON file storing data about fire belly ______instance, you could encounter a key such as “species” with the associated value of “ Cynops orientalis .”

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 考察句内标点，for instance可以看到插入语，和in引导的介词短语用逗号隔开

question:
Released in 1992, the Hewlett-Packard PA-7100 microchip contained a single CPU, or core, to execute commands. As processing speeds of single-core chips increased over time, so too did the heat the chips generated. _______ a “power wall” in which more heat was produced than could be efficiently dissipated led developers to invent the dual-core chip in the early 2000s.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 考察主语的正确形式，应该用doing sth去做主语。

question:
Should the United Kingdom cut taxes? As of 2017, the United Kingdom’s top tax rate (59%) was lower than the highest point on the country’s Laffer curve. A theoretical relationship between tax rates and revenues, the curve can be used to determine whether tax cuts will ultimately increase a country’s tax revenue, according to some _______ 2017 data suggested that the United Kingdom was below the threshold for a tax cut.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: The curve can be used...economists是第一个句子，the 2017 data suggested that...是第二个句子，两个句子之间用句号连接。

question:
A 2024 study by archaeologist Guadalupe Romero Villanueva and colleagues _______ that comb-shaped motifs painted on the walls of Argentina’s Cueva Huenul (a cave in northern Patagonia) are approximately 8,200 years old offers compelling geochronological evidence that humans had been visiting the cave for more than 3,000 years before abandoning it around 5,100 years ago.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子主干是a 2024 study offers compelling evidence，其中by+archaeologist Guadalupe Romero Villanueva and colleagues后面应该接一个非谓语形式，对应D

question:
Obsidian hydration dating (OHD), an artifact-dating technique that measures the thickness of the rind that forms on the surface of obsidian (a volcanic glass), can be used to estimate when prehistoric humans used the sharp glass to shape stone tools. The use of OHD requires careful calibration based on a sample’s climatic context and _______ temperature fluctuations, variations in water vapor pressure, and differences in glass chemistry are known to affect the rate of rind growth.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 空前后是有两个完整的主谓宾，根据句子连接的规则，我们可以排除AC，第二句话和第一句话是转折关系，第三句话是对第二句话的具体解释。所以选B

question:
Stephanie Shonekan of the University of Missouri, along with researchers George Starks of Drexel University and Tyron Cooper of Indiana University, ________ on the advisory team for the Timeline of African American Music, an interactive digital resource that explores African American musical history from the 1600s to the present day.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

question:
A senior research scientist at Coda Metrix, Cansu Sen works on developing artificial intelligence technology, with a specific focus on natural language _____ language processing involves teaching computers to understand the way humans write and speak.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

question:
The Sheringham Shoal, an offshore wind farm located off the coast of England, produces about 315 megawatts (MW) of electricity per year. ______ England’s Hornsea Project One offshore wind farm, which generates the most power of any single offshore farm, produces 1,218 MW of electricity.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 英格兰海岸线的舍林汉姆浅滩海上风电场每年发电约315兆瓦（MW）。______ 英格兰的霍恩西一号海上风电场（单个海上风电场中发电量最大）发电量为1,218兆瓦。 中文解析： 前句描述较小发电量（315MW），后句提供显著更高的发电量（1,218MW）作为对比，两者形成明显的比较关系。

question:
Since 1941, the South Side Community Art Center in Chicago, Illinois, has cultivated a multigenerational community of Black creatives—from writer Gwendolyn Brooks, to musician Nat King Cole, to visual artists like Espi Eph and Barbara Jones-Hogu. _______ it has garnered a reputation as a hub of Black art and culture in Chicago.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 自1941年以来，伊利诺伊州芝加哥的南城社区艺术中心培育了跨越几代人的黑人创意群体——从作家格温多林·布鲁克斯、音乐家纳特·金·科尔，到视觉艺术家埃斯皮·埃夫和芭芭拉·琼斯-霍古。_______ 它已成为芝加哥黑人艺术与文化中心的代名词。 中文解析： 前句强调艺术中心长期培养众多杰出黑人艺术家，后句指出它因此（accordingly）获得声誉，两者构成明确的因果关系。

question:
Despite her considerable body of work, the writer Ann Batten Cristall (1769–1848) was largely overlooked by twentieth-century scholars of British Romantic poetry, whose research tended to focus on the Romantic era’s most prominent figures (such as William Wordsworth, the author of “Composed upon Westminster Bridge” and other well-known poems). _______ a 2020 analysis of Cristall’s poems by scholar Stefanie John helps illuminate Cristall’s significant contributions to Romanticism.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
selections: B. In accordance with these scholars,
C. In addition to this research,
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 尽管作品颇丰，作家安·巴滕·克里斯特尔（Ann Batten Cristall，1769–1848）却几乎被20世纪英国浪漫主义诗歌学者所忽视，这些学者的研究往往聚焦于浪漫主义时期最杰出的人物（如《威斯敏斯特桥上》等名诗的作者威廉·华兹华斯）。_______ 学者斯蒂芬妮·约翰2020年对克里斯特尔诗歌的分析，有助于阐明克里斯特尔对浪漫主义的重要贡献。 中文解析： 前文指出克里斯特尔长期被学者忽视，后文则提到新研究旨在揭示其贡献，两者之间存在“纠正先前疏忽”的直接逻辑关系。

question:
The names of geological eras uniformly describe phases in Earth’s evolutionary history (e. g., Phanerozoic means “abundant life”). Names given to geological periods, ______ are of diverse origins. The Permian period is named after the historical region of Perm in Russia, for example, while the Silurian period takes its name from the Celtic tribe the Silures.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 地质年代的名称统一描述了地球演化史的各个阶段（例如，“显生宙”意为“丰富的生命”）。而地质纪元的命名______则来源多样。例如，二叠纪以俄罗斯的彼尔姆历史地区命名，而志留纪的名称来自凯尔特部落西卢尔人。 中文解析： 前句强调地质年代名称的“统一性”（uniformly），后句则指出地质纪元名称的“多样性”（diverse origins），两者形成直接对比关系。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·Artistic works made readily accessible to the general public are categorized as public art. ·Artist Marco Cianfanelli’s metal sculpture Release is on display at a public memorial in Howick, South Africa. ·This work of public art depicts the first democratically elected president of South Africa, Nelson Mandela. ·Artist Douglas Coupland’s metal sculpture Digital Orca is on display at a public convention center in Vancouver, Canada. ·This work of public art depicts a whale formed from black and white cubes.

The student wants to contrast the two sculptures. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In contrast to Cianfanelli’s Release , Coupland’s Digital Orca is displayed in a public place.
B. Release by Cianfanelli and Digital Orca by Coupland are two examples of public art.
C. Cianfanelli’s Release , unlike Coupland's Digital Orca , depicts a human subject.
D. Coupland’s sculpture Digital Orca , which depicts a whale formed from black and white cubes, is on display in Vancouver, Canada.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究某个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记： ·面向大众开放的艺术作品被归类为公共艺术。 ·艺术家马可·钱法内利的金属雕塑《释放》陈列于南非豪维克的公共纪念区。 ·这件公共艺术作品描绘了南非首位民主选举的总统纳尔逊·曼德拉。 ·艺术家道格拉斯·库普兰的金属雕塑《数字虎鲸》陈列于加拿大温哥华的公共会议中心。 ·这件公共艺术作品描绘了一条由黑白立方体构成的鲸鱼。 中文解析： C选项直接对比了两件雕塑的核心差异：一方描绘真实人物（曼德拉），另一方描绘抽象动物（立方体鲸鱼）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·US states are the primary regulators of federal and state elections and bear much of the responsibility to establish voting rights. ·All fifty state constitutions contain clauses that confer the right to vote on eligible citizens. ·Thirty state constitutions also include some form of a free-elections clause. ·These clauses more broadly mandate that elections be conducted in a fair manner. ·Further guidance with regard to voting rights and conducting elections is legislated by state lawmakers.

The student wants to make a generalization about free-elections clauses in state constitutions . Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Although all states constitutions have clauses conferring the right to vote, free and fair elections aren’t mandated with the same consistency.
B. Every state constitution has some form of a free-elections clause, by which a state confers voting rights on eligible citizens.
C. States bear most of the responsibility for establishing voting rights and conducting fair elections.
D. In addition to constitutional provisions such as free-elections clauses, state lawmakers provide election guidance by means of legislation.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究某个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记： ·美国各州是联邦和州选举的主要监管者，并承担确立投票权的大部分责任。 ·所有50个州的宪法都包含赋予合格公民投票权的条款。 ·其中30个州的宪法还包含某种形式的自由选举条款。 ·这些条款更广泛地要求以公平方式进行选举。 ·关于投票权和选举实施的进一步指导由州立法者通过立法规定。 中文解析： A 准确概括了笔记的核心信息：所有州宪法均赋予投票权（第二点），但仅30个州包含自由选举条款（第三点），说明对“公平选举”的强制要求存在范围差异。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·The 1988 exhibition Deconstructivist Architecture at the Museum of Modern Art (MoMA) in New York City featured projects by seven architects. ·The exhibition was influential in popularizing deconstructivist design principles in the late twentieth century. ·It included architectural plans for The Peak , a 1983 project by Iraqi British architect Zaha Hadid featuring jagged geometric forms jutting out from an artificial cliff. ·It included a model of Gehry House , a 1978–88 project by US architect Frank Gehry featuring jagged geometric forms extending from a Dutch colonial exterior. ·Curators Philip Johnson and Mark Wigley describe the exhibition’s projects as subverting conventional assumptions “about order, harmony, stability, and unity.”

The student wants to emphasize a historical similarity between Hadid’s and Gehry’s respective projects. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The popularization of deconstructivist design in the late twentieth centuryowes much to the architects featured in MoMA’s 1988 exhibition, Hadid and Gehry among them.
B. Hadid’s and Gehry’s respective projects date to 1978, a decade before MoMA’s influential 1988 exhibition Deconstructivist Architecture .
C. With their jagged geometric forms, The Peak and Gehry House both subvert conventional assumptions “about order, harmony, stability, and unity” (Johnson and Wigley).
D. The Peak and Gehry House were featured in an influential 1988 MoMA exhibition that popularized deconstructivist design principles in the late twentieth century.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究某个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记： ·1988年纽约现代艺术博物馆（MoMA）举办的“解构主义建筑”展览展出了七位建筑师的项目。 ·该展览在20世纪末推广解构主义设计原则方面具有影响力。 ·展览包括伊拉克裔英国建筑师扎哈·哈迪德1983年的项目“The Peak”的建筑方案，其特点是锯齿状几何形态从人工悬崖突出。 ·展览包括美国建筑师弗兰克·盖里1978-88年的项目“盖里住宅”的模型，其特点是锯齿状几何形态从荷兰殖民风格外观延伸而出。 ·策展人菲利普·约翰逊和马克·威格利称展览中的项目颠覆了“关于秩序、和谐、稳定和统一”的传统假设。 中文解析： 因为题目问的是historical similarity…respective projects，问题的关键是这两个作品本身的相似性。C选项描述两个作品都有jagged geometric forms，并且说到了两个作品都颠覆了传统

explanations: 考查一次函数的解释。 x 是植物的数量，那4 x 就是给植物浇水的时间，那剩下的60就是修割草坪的时间。故选C。

question: A company has a customer loyalty program. In January 2018, there were 300 customers enrolled in the loyalty program. Which equation gives the total number of customers, c , enrolled in the company’s loyalty program m months after January 2018, where m ≤ 24 ?

question: 6 x + 4 > y For which of the following tables are all the values of x and their corresponding values of y solutions to the given inequality?
explanations: 考查不等式，把选项代入式子检验即可。X=0时，6x+4=4>y，故此时y应该比4小，符合该要求的只有D，其他不用检验。

question: A machine fills bags with approximately 15 ounces of sugar. To test the accuracy of the filling process, 343 bags of sugar were selected at random and weighed. Based on the sample, it is estimated that the average weight of all bags of sugar filled by the machine in an 8 -hour period is 14.88 ounces, with an associated margin of error of 0.19 ounce. Which of the following is the best interpretation of this estimate?
selections: A. Plausible values for the average weight of all bags of sugar filled by the machine are between 14.69 ounces and 15.07 ounces.
B. Plausible values for the average weight of all bags of sugar filled by the machine are less than 14.69 ounces or greater than 15.07 ounces.
C. The average weight of all bags of sugar filled by the machine is greater than 14.99 ounces.
D. The average weight of all bags of sugar filled by the machine is less than 14.99 ounces.
explanations: 考查边缘误差。整体的比例很可能在样本误差加减边缘误差的范围内。故选A。
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套数学去重版（M2只有19道题）

question: A container is in the shape of a right rectangular prism that is 2.0 centimeters (cm) wide, 19.0 cm long, and 25.0 cm tall. Which of the following is closest to the number of fluid ounces that are required to completely fill the container? (Use 1.0 cubic centimeter = 0.034 fluid ounces)
explanations: 考查棱柱的体积=长*宽*高，代入数字2.0*19.0*25.0=950 cm 3 =950*0.034 fluid ounce=32.3，故选A。
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套数学去重版（M2只有19道题）

question: In the xy -plane, line ℓ passes through the point ( 0 , 0 ) and is parallel to the line represented by the equation y = 6 x + 3 . If line ℓ also passes through the point ( 8 , d ) , what is the value of d ?
explanations: 考查线性函数，根据题意可以得到line l的表达式是y=6x。代入（8,d）得到d=6*8=48。
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套数学去重版（M2只有19道题）

question: x ( x + 6 ) − 112 = 3 x ( x − 8 ) What is the sum of the solutions to the given equation?
explanations: 考查韦达定理。整理方程得到 2 x 2 − 30 x + 112 = 0 ，根据韦达定理，两根之和就是-（-30）/2=15。故选D。
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套数学去重版（M2只有19道题）

question: Data set A consists of 10 positive integers less than 60. The list gives 9 of the integers from data set A . 42, 46, 44,42, 38, 39, 40, 47, 40 The mean of these 9 integers is 42. If the mean of data set A is an integer that is greater than 42, what is the value of the largest integer from data set A ?
explanations: 给出的9个数字的平均值是42，如果第10个数字也是42，那这10个数字的平均值依旧是42。平均值是整数，现在让平均值加1，也就是平均值变为42+1=43，相当于每个数字都加了1，那整体就需要加10，那第10个数字就变成42+10=52，如果平均值再加1，也就是整体再加10，最后一个数字就是52+10=62，超过了60的限制，就不和要求了，所以第10个数字最大只能是52。
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套数学去重版（M2只有19道题）

question: x 2 − 40 x + c = 0 In the given equation, c is a constant. The equation has no real solutions if c > n . What is the least possible value of n ?
explanations: 考查一元二次方程解的个数。 a x 2 + b x + c = 0 ，当 b 2 − 4 ac 小于0时，该方程没有实数解。代入本题数字就是 ( − 40 ) 2 − 4 C < 0 ，求解出c>400，那n最小应该是400。
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套数学去重版（M2只有19道题）

question: Note: Figure not drawn to scale. In the figure, line m is parallel to line n , and lines AE and CD intersect at point B . Which additional piece of information is sufficient to prove that triangle ABC is congruent to triangle EBD ?
selections: B. A B = 16 and E B = 16
C. Triangles ABC and EBD are isosceles.
D. No additional information is necessary to determine that the two triangles are congruent.
explanations: 考查三角形全等。因为m平行于n，所以∠D=∠C，∠E=∠A，所以三角形对应的三个角分别相等，只要给出对应的边相等，那就可以根据ASA定理证明两个三角形全等，即DE和BC，或者AB和EB，或者DB和CB。故选B。
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套数学去重版（M2只有19道题）

question: f ( x ) = 25 ( 1.20 ) x 4 For the given function f , the value of f(x) increases by p% for every increase of x by 8. What is the value of p ?
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套数学去重版（M2只有19道题）

question: A right square pyramid has a surface area of 100 + 20 146 square inches, which includes a base area of 100 square inches. What is the height, in inches, of this pyramid?
explanations: 查立体图形的表面积。正方形的底部面积是100，那边长是10。侧面是2个相同的等腰三角形，总共的面积是20√146，那一个侧面的面积就是5√146；根据侧面面积=（1/2）*底部边长*斜高可以计算出斜高是√146； 斜高√146是直角三角形的斜边，底边的一半5是一条直角边，该图形的高是另外一条高，根据勾股定理可以计算出高是11。
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套数学去重版（M2只有19道题）

question: The graph of the linear function y = f ( x ) + 17 is shown. If c and d are positive constants, which equation could define f ?
selections: A. f ( x ) = − d − c x
B. f ( x ) = d + c x
C. f ( x ) = d − c x
D. f ( x ) = − d + c x
explanations: 考查一次函数。直线左高右低，所以slope小于0；根据图像，y=f(x)+17的y-intercept是（0，6），那f(x)的y-intercept是（0，-11），也是负数。因为c、d是整数，所以根据slope和y-intercept都是负数选A。
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套数学去重版（M2只有19道题）

question: A circle in the xy -plane has its center at ( − 2 , 2 ) . Line t is tangent to this circle at the point ( 7 , − 5 ) . Which of the following points also lies on line t ?
explanations: 圆的圆心和切点确定的直线垂直于该点的切线。 圆的圆心和切点确定的直线的斜率是（-5-2）/（7-(-2)）=-7/9；那么切线的斜率就是9/7。 因为切线也通过（7，-5），所以可以计算出切线的表达式是：y=(9/7)x-14，代入点的左边检验可以知道答案是C。
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套数学去重版（M2只有19道题）

question: Which of the following expressions has a factor of x + 2 b , where b is a positive integer constant?
explanations: 考查因式分解。 2 x 2 分解出了一个x，那另外一个factor就是2x；18b分解出了一个2b，那另外一个factor就是9，所以对应的式子就是（x+2b）（2x+9），整理出来就是 2 x 2 + ( 4 b + 9 ) x + 18 b 。 因为b是一个正整数，所以一次项的系数(4b+9)减掉9后，可以被9整除，得到一个正整数。代入选项检验，可以选出D。
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套数学去重版（M2只有19道题）

question: A rectangular region of land is divided into 88 square lots of equal area A , in square units. The length of the region is 5.5 times the width of the region. If the length of the region is x A units, what is the value of x ?
explanations: 土地分成88等份，每份面积是A，那总面积是88A。长是x√A，那宽就是（x√A）/5.5，长乘宽可以得到面积是 ( x 2 A ) / 5.5 。根据 ( x 2 A ) / 5.5 = 88 A 可以计算出x=22。
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套数学去重版（M2只有19道题）

question: The table shows three values of x and their corresponding values of y , where y = f ( x ) + 4 and f is a quadratic function. What is the y -coordinate of the y -intercept of the graph of y = f ( x ) in the xy -plane?
explanations: 根据题意可以找出f(x)的三个点的坐标分别是 f(25)=f(29)，25和29的中点事27，所以（27,5）是该函数的顶点。 可以设该函数的表达式是 y = a ( x − 27 ) 2 + 5 ，代入（25，-15）得到a=-5。那该函数的表达式就是 y = − 5 ( x − 27 ) 2 + 5 。代入x=0，可以求出y-intercept的y-coordinate是-3640。
exam_name: 2025年9月第2套数学去重版（M2只有19道题）

question:
The following text is from Rudolfo Anaya’s 1972 novel Bless Me, Ultima . The young narrator and his friend Cico are staring into the water of a stream in rural New Mexico. The golden fish swam by gracefully, cautiously, as if testing the water after a long sleep in his subterranean waters. His powerful tail moved in slow strokes as he slid through the water towards us. ©1972 by Rudolfo Anaya

As used in the text, what does the word “testing” most nearly mean?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 那条金色的鱼优雅而谨慎地游过，仿佛在长久蛰伏于地下水域后试探着水温。它强有力的尾巴缓缓摆动，在粼粼波光中朝着我们游来。 （译自鲁道弗·安亚1972年作品《保佑我， Ultima》） 中文解析： 文中 “testing” 描述鱼在长期休眠后对水域的试探行为，强调尝试与适应而非消耗或对抗。Trying out（尝试）最贴合这种试探性的动作，而其他选项均与语境不符。

question:
A number of recording artists ______ Indigenous music with other musical styles. For example, Wolastoq musician Jeremy Dutcher incorporated traditional Wolastoq songs into experimental pop on his album Wolastoqiyik Lintuwakonawa , and Tuscarora/Taíno singer-songwriter Pura Fé combined Indigenous rhythms and vocals with R&B on her album Sacred Seed .

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 许多录音艺术家将 Indigenous 音乐与其他音乐风格 ______。例如，Wolastoq 音乐家 Jeremy Dutcher 在他的专辑《Wolastoqiyik Lintuwakonawa》中将传统的 Wolastoq 歌曲融入实验性流行乐中，而 Tuscarora/Taíno 唱作歌手 Pura Fé 在她的专辑《Sacred Seed》中将 Indigenous 的节奏、人声与 R&B 相结合。 中文解析： 文中通过两个具体例子说明艺术家如何将 Indigenous 音乐元素与其他风格融合，强调创造性结合而非单纯分析或获取。A 项 "fuse"（融合）精准对应后文 "incorporated...into" 与 "combined...with" 的语境逻辑，而其他选项无法体现这种有机混合的关系。

question:
While modern composers may often get inspiration from past greats like Ludwig van Beethoven, the extent of their influences is broad. The music of Ernesto Lecuona, for example, can be said to ______ elements of both the classical European tradition and the social, political, and cultural landscape of his native Cuba.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 虽然现代作曲家常常从贝多芬等过往大师那里获得灵感，但他们受到的影响范围其实非常广泛。例如，埃内斯托·莱库纳的音乐可以说______欧洲古典传统与其祖国古巴的社会、政治和文化背景的元素。 中文解析： 文中明确指出莱库纳的音乐同时受到欧洲古典传统和古巴社会文化的影响，因此需要填入能体现“包含、呈现”之意的词语。D项“exhibit”（展现）准确表达了音乐中同时存在两种元素的特点，而A（抗拒）、B（忽略）、C（预示）均与语境中“融合多方影响”的逻辑不符。

question:
Though most hoaxes perpetrated as jokes by mischievous users of Wikipedia, an online encyclopedia that almost anyone can freely edit, have quickly been detected and removed, a few invented entries, such as those for the town of Stone Ridge, Maryland, and the Civil War general George K. Broomhall, persisted on the site for many years before they were finally recognized as _____ and deleted.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 尽管维基百科（一个几乎任何人都能自由编辑的在线百科全书）上由恶作剧用户作为玩笑而制造的大多数恶作剧都能被迅速发现并删除，但少数虚构条目——例如马里兰州斯通里奇镇和内战将军乔治·K·布鲁姆霍尔的条目——在被最终认定为______并删除之前，已在网站上存续多年。 中文解析： 文中明确指出这些条目是“被发明出来的”（invented）且属于“恶作剧”（hoaxes），因此需要填入能准确描述其“虚假、不真实”性质的词语。A项“fictitious”（虚构的）直接对应前文“invented entries”的核心含义，而B（尽责的）、C（直接的）、D（深刻的）均与“恶作剧式虚构”的语境逻辑不符。

question:
The following text is from Angeline Boulley’s 2021 novel Firekeeper’s Daughter . The narrator is an Ojibwe teenager who runs in the morning before going to school. Levi is her younger brother. My brother complains about my lengthy warm-up routine whenever he runs with me. I keep telling Levi that my longer, bigger, and therefore vastly superior muscles require more intensive preparation for peak performance. The real reason, which he would think is dorky, is that I recite the correct anatomical name for each muscle as I stretch. ©2021 by Angeline Boulley

According to the narrator, what does her brother complain about?
selections: A. A song she sings while she runs in the morning
B. The late hour when she prefers to run
C. The lengthy warm-up routine she does before running
D. Fellow students she has befriended
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文本选自安杰琳·布莱2021年的小说《守火者之女》。叙述者是一名奥吉布瓦族青少年，她每天早晨上学前都会跑步。利维是她的弟弟。 每当弟弟和我一起跑步时，他都会抱怨我冗长的热身流程。我一直告诉利维，我更长、更大、因此也优越得多的肌肉需要更充分的准备才能达到最佳状态。而真正的理由（他会觉得这很呆）是，我在拉伸时会默念每块肌肉的正确解剖学名称。 中文解析： 文中首句直接说明弟弟抱怨的是“my lengthy warm-up routine”（我冗长的热身流程）

question:
Animals use many objects as tools to achieve goals more easily. Such goals include grooming, finding food, and protecting themselves. For a long time, people thought tool use was unique to primates. Octopuses and other animals, though, have busted the myth that tool use requires hands. Inventively, octopuses use two halves of a seashell to provide protection or a place to hide. Palm cockatoos also get creative. They use leaves to pad their beaks when opening nuts.

According to the text, what do octopuses use to protect themselves?
selections: C. Two halves of a seashell
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 动物会利用许多物体作为工具来更轻松地达成目标，例如梳理毛发、寻找食物和保护自身。长期以来，人们认为工具的使用是灵长类动物的独有行为。然而，章鱼和其他动物打破了“使用工具需要手”的迷思。章鱼创造性地利用两半贝壳来提供保护或藏身之处。棕榈凤头鹦鹉也很有创意，它们在敲开坚果时用树叶衬垫自己的喙。 中文解析： 文中明确写道“章鱼创造性地利用两半贝壳来提供保护或藏身之处”，直接对应题目所问的“章鱼用什么保护自己”。C项“两半贝壳”是原文信息的直接复现，其他选项在描述章鱼的部分均未出现。

question:
Many people use the trademark “Frisbee” to refer generally to flying disc toys rather than specifically to products made by Wham-O, the company that owns the trademark. As many legal experts note, this may pose a problem for Wham O. In the US, courts can cancel a trademark if they decide that its meaning is no longer specific to the trademark owner’s products. If “Frisbee” were judged to be a generic term, as “escalator” was, other companies would be free to use it to promote similar products, making it harder for Wham-O to stand out from competitors.

Based on the text, what do many legal experts believe about the trademark  “Frisbee”?
selections: A. It may be at risk of being canceled.
B. It is not especially memorable.
C. It has multiple unrelated meanings.
D. It is unlikely to be judged a generic term.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 许多人使用商标“Frisbee（飞盘）”来泛指飞盘玩具，而非特指拥有该商标的Wham-O公司生产的产品。许多法律专家指出，这可能给Wham-O带来问题。在美国，如果法院判定某个商标的含义不再专属于商标所有者的产品，就可以取消该商标。如果“Frisbee”像“escalator（自动扶梯）”一样被判定为通用名称，其他公司将可以自由使用它来推广类似产品，从而使Wham-O更难在竞争对手中脱颖而出。 中文解析： 文中明确指出法律专家认为这种泛化使用“可能带来问题”，并进一步解释美国法院可能因此取消商标。

question:
Commedia dell’arte was a type of theater that emerged in Italy in the 1500s. It became popular throughout Western Europe. In commedia dell’arte, actors didn’t have a script. Instead, they created their dialogue and actions onstage in the moment. Actors in these plays also usually wore stylized masks. In a research paper, a student argues that doing so affected how the actors portrayed their characters.

Which quotation from a historian would most directly support the student’s argument?
selections: A. “Since their faces were hidden by masks, actors in commedia dell’arte used hand gestures and other movements of their bodies to display emotions.”
B. “The use of masks in commedia dell’arte can be traced directly to the theater of ancient Rome.”
C. “After almost vanishing in the 1800s, commedia dell’arte once again became popular in Italy and Great Britain for a brief period in the 1960s and 1970s.”
D. “Masks are also worn in the traditional theater of China, India, and Maya communities in Mexico and Central America.”
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 即兴喜剧（Commedia dell’arte）是16世纪在意大利出现的一种戏剧形式，后来在整个西欧流行。在即兴喜剧中，演员没有剧本，而是在舞台上即兴创作台词和动作。这些剧目的演员通常还佩戴风格化的面具。一名学生在研究论文中提出，这样做影响了演员对角色的塑造。 中文解析： 学生的论点是“佩戴面具影响了演员塑造角色的方式”。A项引述明确指出“由于面具遮住了脸，演员使用手势和其他身体动作来展示情绪”，这直接证明了面具如何改变了演员的表演方式，从而支持了学生的论点。

question:
Sunita Williams, a US astronaut, has gone on seven spacewalks. During ______ spacewalks, Williams performed important tasks outside the spacecraft, such as installing new equipment.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: these指代前面seven spacewalks

question:
NASA’s Opportunity rover first touched down on Mars on January 25, 2004. The rover spent over fourteen years gathering information about Mars’s rocky surface. Scientists playfully______one of the rocks it found Edmund.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 考察时态，用一般过去时态

question:
Most people are familiar with the song “Happy Birthday” because_______Few, however, may know the song’s origin. The tune began as “Good Morning to All,” a song written by sisters Mildred and Patty Hill in the early 1890s.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. it is the most frequently sung song in the English language?
B. it is the most frequently sung song in the English language.
C. is it the most frequently sung song in the English language.
D. is it the most frequently sung song in the English language?
explanations: 空格前是连词“because”，其后应接一个陈述句作为原因状语从句，且该从句本身不是疑问句，因此应使用正常语序（主语+谓语）且句末用句号。

question:
Following her debut album release in 2002, Mexican singer-songwriter Natalia Lafourcade quickly shot to fame. By 2023, she ______ one of the most celebrated musicians in Latin America, having released twelve albums and won seventeen Latin Grammy awards—more than any other female artist in history.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: “By 2023”（到2023年为止），描述的是在此时间点之前已完成的状况。B项“had become”是过去完成时，准确表达了“在2023年之前已成为”这一先于过去时间点完成的动作。

question:
