question:
Assessing the role of forests as sinks for airborne microplastics that would otherwise continue to disperse in the atmosphere, Akane Miyazaki and her team measured concentrations of plastic particulates on leaves from konara oak trees in Japan. The team used three separate extraction methods: an ultrapure water rinse, a rinse combined with ultrasonic waves, and an alkaline solution treatment that removes epicuticular wax (a surface coating on most land plants to which particles can adhere). The concentrations of particulates recovered were 7.6 percent for water extraction, 38.4 percent for ultrasonic extraction, and 53.8 percent for alkaline extraction, leading the team to conclude that previous assessments have likely underestimated forest canopies’ capacity as sinks.

Which detail, if true, would most directly support the team's conclusion?
selections: A. Most studies of microplastic accumulation on leaves have utilized extraction methods that do not have a substantial effect on epicuticular wax.
B. Most studies of microplastic accumulation on leaves have focused on forests with diverse tree species that exhibit varying levels of epicuticular wax.
C. Most studies of microplastic accumulation on leaves have found particulate concentrations that greatly exceeded 53.8 percent.
D. Most studies of microplastic accumulation on leaves have involved the application of alkaline treatments before water and ultrasonic treatments rather than after them.
explanations: 中文解析： 研究团队发现用不同方法从树叶上提取的微塑料浓度不同：纯水冲洗：7.6%；超声波冲洗：38.4%；碱性溶液处理（去除植物表皮蜡质）：53.8%。他们的结论：过去的研究可能低估了森林树冠吸附微塑料的能力（因为传统方法可能没彻底提取附着在蜡质上的微塑料）。A. 大多数关于树叶微塑料积累的研究使用的提取方法对表皮蜡质影响不大。这个选项直接支持团队的结论：因为团队发现蜡质上附着大量微塑料（碱性提取法最高），而过去方法对蜡质无效，导致低估。如果大多数研究没用能去除蜡质的方法，正好说明他们测得的微塑料量偏低，支持“低估”的结论。好得分的老师认为这是一道难度高的题目，后面sat师生说的公众号会出详细推文。 题目文本翻译： 为评估森林对空气中微塑料颗粒的截留作用（否则这些颗粒将持续在大气中扩散），赤岭茜团队测量了日本小楢树叶面塑料微粒的浓度。研究采用三种提取方法：超纯水冲洗法、超声波辅助冲洗法以及能去除表皮蜡质层的碱性溶液处理法（绝大多数陆地植物表面这层蜡质会吸附微粒）。三种方法提取出的微粒浓度分别为：水洗法7.6%、超声法38.4%、碱解法53.8%。这表明此前研究很可能低估了森林冠层对微塑料的截留能力。

question:
Mariana Lopes Barata and Pedro Simões Coelho collected data from 324 music-streaming service users to identify factors that influence users to opt for paid (premium) versions of music streaming services, like Apple Music. They hypothesized that hedonic motivation (the enjoyment that a consumer perceives to be associated with using a service) would be positively correlated with users’ intentions to adopt premium versions. The researchers asked participants to rate statements such as “Using paid music streaming services is pleasant.” They found that, indeed, hedonic motivation positively influences the intention to adopt premium streaming service versions, which suggests that _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. it may be advantageous for music streaming companies to try to influence the extent to which potential users perceive the premium version as pleasant to use.
B. participants who strongly agreed with the statement “ Using paid music streaming services is pleasant ” were more likely to express loyalty to Apple Music than to other streaming services.
C. the statement “ Using paid music streaming services is pleasant ” is not a reliable measure of hedonic motivation.
D. users' intentions to pay for premium streaming services are probably unaffected by factors other than hedonic motivation.
explanations: 中文解析： 研究人员发现，“享乐动机”（即用户觉得付费音乐服务“用起来很愉悦”） 会 正面影响 用户升级付费版的意愿。因此，合理推断出公司如果强化用户对“愉悦感”的认知（比如优化体验、广告宣传），可能促进付费转化。对应A。 题目文本翻译： 玛丽安娜·洛佩斯·巴拉塔与佩德罗·西芒·科埃略通过324名音乐流媒体用户的调研数据，探究用户选择付费订阅（如Apple Music会员）的影响因素。研究假设享乐动机（消费者感知到的使用愉悦感）与付费意愿呈正相关。参与者需对"使用付费音乐流媒体服务令人愉悦"等陈述进行评分。结果证实享乐动机确实能促进付费订阅意愿，这表明_______

question:
On August 15, 2013, the Navajo Times _______ a profile of Manuelito Chapter ( Kin Hózhóní ), which is one of the 110 chapters of the Navajo Nation ( Naabeehó Bináhásdzo ). The article was later included in a book series called Exploring the Navajo Nation Chapter by Chapter .

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 考察时态，2013对应一般过去时。

question:
According to the original text of the US Constitution, written in 1787, the presidential candidate receiving the second-most Electoral College votes becomes vice president. The12th amendment, ratified in _______ separated the elections for the two offices.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: Ratified in 1804做插入语，前后用逗号把主语和谓语隔开

question:
The colors of Navajo (Diné) weaver Melisa Cody’s work World Traveler (2014) recall both the Germantown revival, a weaving style developed by Navajo Nation _______ ago, and the color palette of the video games that Cody played as a child.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 全部用名词复数，不算在“...的”所有格使用

question:
The editors of Home Ground: A Guide to the American Landscape turned to Luis Alberto Urrea, a poet, to craft the entry for “atarque,” a term referring to a watering hole formed by a natural or artificial dam. For “muskeg,” however, the editors chose the _______ author of Of Landscape and Longing .

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: essayist限定修饰Carolyn Servid中间不加标点，author of Of Landscape and Longing 是句末同位语，和前面用标点隔开。

question:
A groundbreaking visual artist of her day, _______ including artists Vasily Kandinsky and Piet Mondrian.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. Hilma af Klint, well before many of her contemporaries, explored abstract modes of painting,
B. Hilma af Klint explored abstract modes of painting well before many of her contemporaries,
C. well before many of her contemporaries, Hilma af Klint explored abstract modes of painting,
D. the explorations of Hilma af Klint into abstract modes of painting occured well before those of many of her contemporaries,
explanations: 逻辑主语一致，排除D。再看句子最后的including artists，说明句末应该是跟艺术家相关的表达，那么排除A和C，均以painting结尾,所以选B.

question:
The small celestial body known as 2010 BL4 is expected to have a relatively short lifetime in the outer solar system. Within just a few million years, 2010 BL4 is likely to migrate into the inner solar system or be destroyed, according to ________ trajectory.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. astronomers modeling of the objects
B. astronomer’s modeling of the object’s
C. astronomers’ modeling of the object’s
D. astronomers modeling of the object’s
explanations: 天文学家前面没有仍和冠词和定冠词，所以应该用复数，另外，这里表示天文家“的”模型，所以是s’。后面是这个天体“的”轨道，天体又是单数，所以选择’s。这类题目做不好的同学建议在www.hdfedu.com做名词、代词、形容词专项练习

question:
Many works of the Roman scholar Varro (1st century BCE), including his history of Rome, De gente populi Romani , have been lost to time. Scholars wishing to read a work written by the Roman scholar needn’t _______ they can still procure a copy of Varro’s Rerum rusticarum libra tres , a treatise on agriculture.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: Scholars needn't despair是一个独立的句子，they can still procure是另一个独立的句子，根据句子连接规则，排除AB。另外，though属于文本中第一句话和第二句话之间的转折，放在第二句话内，所以选C。

question:
Using LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) technology, Tulane University archaeologists scanned and mapped the ancient Mayan city of Tikal, which lies deep in the Guatemalan rainforest. Some of Tikal’s old stones are intertwined with the roots of surrounding trees, rendering parts of the complex physically inaccessible to researchers. _______ the LiDAR’s penetrating light waves were the only way to reveal some previously unknown aspects of the Mayan city.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 中文解析： 前面一句话说建筑石材与周围树根盘错交织，后面一句话LiDAR是唯一的穿透方式，前后两句为因果关系。对逻辑词把握不准的同学，可以找到sat_1600领取逻辑100词资料。 题目文本翻译： 杜兰大学考古学家利用激光雷达（LiDAR）技术对危地马拉雨林深处的玛雅古城蒂卡尔进行了扫描测绘。由于部分古建筑石材与周围树根盘错交织，研究人员难以实地考察建筑群某些区域。_______ 激光雷达的穿透性光波成为揭示这座玛雅古城未知风貌的唯一手段。

question:
Imagine a magazine that a reader has thrown away. This magazine is post-consumer waste, as it became waste after reaching the consumer. _______ the paper scraps left over from printing the magazine are pre-consumer waste, as they became waste before reaching the consumer.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 中文解析： 前后两句话，一个说的是post-consumer waste，另外一个说的是pre-consumer waste形成了一个对比关系。 题目文本翻译： 设想读者丢弃了一本杂志——这本杂志属于消费后废品，因其在到达消费者手中后才成为废弃物。_______ 印刷该杂志时产生的边角料则属于消费前废品，因其在接触消费者前就已沦为废料。

question:
One proposed boundary between Earth’s atmosphere and outer space is the Kármán line, 100 km above sea level. Based on the work of physicist Theodore von Kármán, this line marks the theoretical height at which an aircraft no longer remains aloft using the force of lift. _______ an aircraft sustains flight past this altitude primarily by its velocity, reaching a speed sufficient to maintain an orbit but not to generate enough lift from the thin air.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 中文解析： Instead后面增加新信息，让大家更加了解飞行器超过一定高度是如何维持飞行的。 题目文本翻译： 地球大气层与外太空的拟议分界线之一是以海拔100公里为界的卡门线，该理论源自物理学家西奥多·冯·卡门的研究。这条界线标志着飞行器依靠升力维持飞行的理论极限高度。_______ 当飞行器越过此高度后，主要依靠自身速度维持飞行——此时稀薄大气已无法产生足够升力，但达到轨道运行所需速度。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·The Schomburg Center for Research in Black Culture is a research library in New York City. ·It was named for Arturo Alfonso Schomburg. ·It was founded in 1925.

The student wants to indicate the year the Schomburg Center was founded. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The Schomburg Center was named for Arturo Alfonso Schomburg.
B. The Schomburg Center is a research library.
C. The Schomburg Center was founded in 1925.
D. The Schomburg Center is located in New York City.
explanations: 中文解析： 题目要求找到Schomburg Center 建立在哪一年，根据notes可以看到是1925年。 题目文本翻译： 学生在研究某一课题时整理了以下笔记： ·朔姆堡黑人文化研究中心是位于纽约市的研究型图书馆 ·该机构以阿图罗·阿方索·朔姆堡命名 ·创立于1925年

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·Brussels sprouts are vegetables that contain ascorbic acid, an essential nutrient for humans. ·Apples are fruits that contain ascorbic acid. ·There is 80 milligrams (mg) of ascorbic acid in every 100 grams (g) of brussels sprouts. ·There is 6 mg of ascorbic acid in every 100g of apple. ·Humans cannot make ascorbic acid in their bodies, so they must get it from foods, including fruits and vegetables. ·Ascorbic acid is also known as vitamin C.

The student wants to compare the vitamin C content of brussels sprouts and apples. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Brussels sprouts contain vitamin C (also known as ascorbic acid) —80 mg in every100g, to be exact.
B. Brussels sprouts and apples both contain vitamin C, but brussels sprouts contain more.
C. Brussels sprouts are vegetables, and apples are fruits.
D. Humans cannot make ascorbic acid in their bodies, but they can get it from brussels sprouts.
explanations: 中文解析： 题目要求compare brussels sprouts和apples的vc含量，所以选B。好得分老师提示notes题目一定要注意题干要求。 题目文本翻译： 学生在研究某一课题时整理了以下笔记： ·孢子甘蓝是含有抗坏血酸（人体必需营养素）的蔬菜 ·苹果是含有抗坏血酸的水果 ·每100克孢子甘蓝含80毫克抗坏血酸 ·每100克苹果含6毫克抗坏血酸 ·人类无法自体合成抗坏血酸，必须通过果蔬等食物摄取 ·抗坏血酸即维生素C

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·Merle Oberon (1911–1979) was an actress born in Mumbai (then known as Bombay), India. ·She was of Indian, Maori, and Irish heritage. ·She was the first Indian-born actress to be nominated for an Academy Award. ·Early in her career, she played many nameless, uncredited roles, such as her role in T he Three Passions (1928). ·Later, she played many named, credited roles, such as Empress Josephine in Désirée (1954).

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two films. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The Three Passions and Désirée are both films that include Merle Oberon, the first Indian-born actress to be nominated for an Academy Award.
B. The Three Passions (1928) was released early in actress Merle Oberon’s career, whereas Désirée (1954) came out later.
C. In The Three Passions (1928), actress Merle Oberon played a nameless, uncredited role; however, in Désirée (1954), she played a credited role that of Empress Josephine.
D. Early in her career, Merle Oberon wasn’t listed in some film credits, such as the credits for the film The Three Passions, where she played a nameless, uncredited role.
explanations: 中文解析： 题目要求强调两个电影的相似性，A提到了两个电影中Merle Oberon都有参演，所以选A. 题目文本翻译： 学生在研究某一课题时整理了以下笔记： ·梅尔·奥勃朗（1911–1979）是出生于印度孟买（当时称Bombay）的女演员 ·她拥有印度、毛利和爱尔兰血统 ·她是首位获得奥斯卡奖提名的印度出生女演员 ·早期职业生涯中，她常出演无名无姓的龙套角色，如《三情》（1928） ·后期则担纲重要署名角色，如《拿破仑情史》（1954）中的约瑟芬皇后

question:
The Apalachicola River delta in Florida is where the river flows into the Gulf of Mexico. As the river reaches the gulf, it forms smaller channels where sediments carried by the river are deposited and form many deltaic lobes, or wetland formations. The shape and size of the delta are _______ by the gulf’s tides, which shift sediments along the coast and reshape the deltaic lobes over time.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 中文解析： 原文讲的是墨西哥湾的潮汐如何改变河流沉积物的分布，从而塑造三角洲的形状和大小。所以选择C 题目文本翻译： 佛罗里达州的阿巴拉契科拉河三角洲是河流汇入墨西哥湾的入海口。当河流抵达海湾时，会形成多条小型水道，河水携带的沉积物在此堆积，形成许多三角洲裂瓣（即湿地构造）。三角洲的形态与规模_______墨西哥湾潮汐的影响——潮汐会推动沿岸沉积物移动，并逐渐重塑这些三角洲裂瓣。

question:
Lisa Linn Kanae is a celebrated contemporary Hawaiian author whose work is ________ by a rich literary history. From the traditional stories of the Kanaka Maoli , or Native Hawaiian people, to the works of writers such as David Malo, the literary heritage of Hawai’i is distinctive and vibrant.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 中文解析： 文本表达了Lisa Linn Kanae是当代著名的作家。同时第二句话说到了夏威夷的heritage是独具特色的。两者都是用了积极词汇描述，那么Lisa Linn Kanae是heritage的一部分。所以句子想表达的是：Lisa Linn Kanae的作品受到夏威夷丰富文学传统的影响，preceded在这里表示她的创作是建立在夏威夷悠久文学历史的基础上，符合语境。好得分老师认为这是一道难题，关注SAT师生说查看更多详细解析。 题目文本翻译： 丽莎·林·卡纳埃是当代著名的夏威夷作家，其作品由深厚的文学传统________。从卡纳卡·毛利人（即夏威夷原住民）的古老传说，到大卫·马洛等作家的作品，夏威夷的文学传承独具特色且充满活力。

question:
Archaeologists have identified a plethora of beads fashioned from Tritia gibbosula shells in many Middle Stone Age (MSA) sites across western North Africa, including El Mnasra Cave, Morocco. In a 2021 paper, El Mehdi Sehasseh et al. attribute these artifacts’ ________ to the evolution and propagation of symbolic behavior (e.g., use of personal ornaments) in humans and the availability of T. gibbosula during the MSA.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 中文解析： plethora表示很多，across表示跨越整个西部非洲。所以选择C无处不在。expediency有用，可取。fecundity新颖，多产。ubiquity无处不在。heterogeneity多种多样。可以找到sat_6688领取sat真题词汇1600和难词200，攻克词汇难题。 题目文本翻译： 考古学家在北非西部多个中石器时代遗址（包括摩洛哥的El Mnasra洞穴）中发现了大量由Tritia gibbosula贝壳制成的珠子。El Mehdi Sehasseh等学者在2021年的论文中指出，这些工艺品的________与人类象征性行为（如个人装饰品的使用）的演化传播，以及中石器时代T. gibbosula贝类的可获得性密切相关。

question:
Svante Pääbo and other researchers studying the history of organisms have long utilized ancient DNA—DNA recovered from ancient organic material that has been preserved under natural conditions. However, Reyjane P. Oliveira and colleagues’2017 study of the evolutionary trajectory of the Malagasy grass genus Chasechloa instead relied on historical DNA — genomic data incidentally preserved in specimens that are house d in natural history collections — thus capitalizing on the research potential offered by a vast but hitherto relatively underutilized source of insight into the biological past.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It specifies potential applications of the approach that Oliveira and colleagues used in their study.
B. It offers commentary on the significance of the approach that Oliveira and colleagues used for their study.
C. It emphasizes the importance of Oliveira and colleagues’ findings about the DNA of flora.
D. It explains why the research methodology selected by Oliveira and colleagues is not widely used.
explanations: 中文解析： 划线部分的核心内容是：“利用自然历史馆藏标本中偶然保存的基因组数据，从而开发了一个庞大但此前未被充分利用的研究资源”。这是在评价该研究方法的独特价值（“capitalizing on... underutilized source”），而非单纯描述应用（A）、强调植物DNA发现（C）或解释方法为何不常用（D）。 题目文本翻译： 斯万特·帕博等研究生物历史的学者长期利用古代DNA——即在自然条件下保存的古代有机材料中提取的遗传物质。而雷雅内·P·奥利维拉团队2017年关于马达加斯加禾本科植物Chasechloa属进化轨迹的研究，则采用了历史DNA——自然历史博物馆标本中偶然保存的基因组数据——从而开发了这个庞大却长期未被充分运用的生物历史研究资源。

question:
Established knowledge of prehistoric societies primarily stems from analysis of durable historical artifacts, including stone tools, but Mercedes Murillo-Barroso and team have contributed new insights with a unique analysis of plant-based items. Plant-based artifacts, including straw baskets, are seldom studied due to their perishable nature. This relative scarcity made it all the more exciting when the team examined remains of well-preserved organic artifacts discovered in a cave in Spain and determined that they dated even further back than previously thought.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It suggests that the researchers did not fully achieve a goal outlined earlier in the text.
B. It describes the uncertain nature of a discovery by the researchers mentioned earlier in the text.
C. It distinguishes between the two types of historical artifacts discussed earlier in the text.
D. It refers to a challenging situation presented earlier in the text.
explanations: 中文解析： “This relative scarcity”（这种相对稀缺性）指代的是前文提到的内容：植物制品因其易腐性而很少被研究。因此它凸显了研究难度，为后文的突破性发现铺垫。所以对应D。 题目文本翻译： 关于史前社会的既定认知主要源于对石器等耐久性历史文物的分析，而梅赛德斯·穆里略-巴罗索团队通过对植物制品的独特研究提供了新视角。由于易腐特性，草编篮筐等植物制品鲜少被研究。当团队检测西班牙某洞穴发现的保存完好的有机文物并确定其年代比此前认为的更久远时，这一发现显得尤为珍贵。

question:
In 2023 Nobel Prize-winning physicist Giorgio Parisi published In a Flight of Starlings , a collection of essays on scientific subjects. Acclaimed author Sam Kean, who uses the form of nonfiction narrative to explore scientific discoveries, is interested in the collection less for its aesthetic merit than for its focus on “the false starts... and mistakes that beset real scientific research every day.” Kean argues that all too often, scientists omit this “human stuff” from written accounts of their research and thus ultimately “fail to explain how science really gets done.”

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. It explores a subtle difference between Kean’s and Parisi’s respective objections to scientific research methods.
B. It outlines an area of agreement between Parisi and Kean in how they think about the work of science.
C. It describes Kean’s view that nonfiction narrative is an effective way for Parisi to share his accomplishments.
D. It presents Kean’s claim that Parisi is too modest about his own achievements as a scientist.
explanations: 中文解析： Parisi的书中提到了科学研究中的“false starts and mistakes”（错误开端和失误）。Kean认为科学家通常忽略这些“human stuff”（人性化内容），导致无法真实展现科学如何运作。好得分的老师提示大家，这里代表两人的关注点一致：科学研究的真实过程（包括失误）比美化后的成果更重要。 题目文本翻译： 2023年诺贝尔物理学奖得主乔治·帕里西出版的科学随笔集《椋鸟飞行时》中，纪实文学作家山姆·基恩对这本著作的关注点并非其文学价值，而在于它聚焦"真实科研中无处不在的失败开端与错误"。基恩指出，科学家在论文中往往刻意省略这些"人性化细节"，导致"最终未能阐明科学发现的真实过程"。

question:
The following text is from William Shakespeare’s circa 1611 play The Winter’s Tale. Camillo has been away from his home in Sicily and serves in the court of Polixenes, the king of Bohemia. He has asked Polixenes for permission to return to Sicily. POLIXENES: I pray thee, good Camillo, be no more importunate. Tis a sickness denying thee anything, a death to grant this. CAMILLO: It is fifteen years since I saw my country. Though I have for the most part been aired abroad, I desire to lay my bones there. Besides, the penitent king, my master, hath sent for me, to whose feeling sorrows I might be some allay— or I o’erween [presume] to think so — which is another spur to my departure.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It bolsters the idea that Camillo ’ s primary motivation to return home is his concern for the king of Sicily ’ s well-being in his absence.
B. It suggests that Camillo feels compelled to persuade Polixenes that Camillo ’ s decision to leave the court is justified.
C. It establishes Camillo ’ s hope that Polixenes will be comforted knowing that Camillo is ’ t departing at his own discretion.
D. It conveys Camillo ’ s recognition that one benefit his presence may afford the king of Sicily is merely speculative.
explanations: 中文解析： 先梳理这个诗歌中的核心人物关系：Polixenes：波西米亚国王（当前雇主，Camillo请求离开的对象）。西西里国王：Camillo的故主（my master）召唤他回国。Camillo要离开说了两个原因：主要动机：思乡（15年未归，想落叶归根）。附加理由：西西里国王召唤他，且他或许（might）能缓解国王的悲伤——但立刻谦虚地表示"可能高估了自己"（o’erween）。所以对应D选项。好得分的老师认为这就像离职或者分手时为了不伤害对方说的一些“官方理由”。这道题很难。 题目文本翻译： 以下文字选自威廉·莎士比亚约1611年剧作《冬天的故事》。卡米洛远离西西里故乡，在波希米亚国王波力克希尼斯宫廷任职。他正向国王请求返回西西里。 波力克希尼斯： 善良的卡米洛，请别再纠缠不休。 拒绝你令我痛苦不堪， 应允此事更如要人性命。 卡米洛： 阔别故国已十五寒暑。 虽常年漂泊异域， 仍盼叶落归根。况且 我那忏悔的主人——国王陛下 已传召我归去，或许 我能稍解他沉痛哀思 （若此念不算僭越）， 这更催我启程。

question:
The following text is from Narcíso Tondreau’s 1898 poem “Yesterday and To-Day” (translated by Agnes Blake Poor in 1918). The poem is about an old statue of the Greek goddess Venus, which now lies on the ground in a state of disrepair. How long ago, by summer breezes fanned, Here stood the newborn Venus, fresh and fair; All palpitating from the master’s hand, The last touch of his chisel lingering there. “And surely this shall last!” he proudly thought; “Fixed in immortal marble is my fame!” Just here, where human hand has surely wrought, Some crumbling letters may have spelled his name.

In the text, what does the speaker say that the artist believed about his sculpture?
selections: A. It would be praised for its intricate details that he carefully chiseled.
B. It would be carefully repaired when it inevitably begins to deteriorate.
C. It would bring him enduring fame by withstanding time.
D. Its beauty would be recognized as surpassing that of other images of Venus.
explanations: 中文解析： 艺术家想这个作品将永存（“And surely this shall last!”）和我的名字将永存在玉石上（“Fixed in immortal marble is my fame!”）都代表了他觉得自己的作品将永世流传。 题目文本翻译： 以下文字选自纳西索·通德罗1898年诗作《昨日与今朝》（艾格尼丝·布莱克·普尔1918年英译）。诗歌描绘一尊破损的希腊维纳斯女神像如今倾颓于地的景象。 曾几何时，夏风轻拂的此处 屹立着初诞的维纳斯，鲜妍明媚 大理石犹震颤着大师的余温 雕凿的最后一凿尚留痕 "此作必当永存！"匠人傲然思忖 "不朽的汉白玉将镌刻吾名！" 而今在这人工雕琢之处 唯有剥落的字母或许曾拼写他的姓名

question:
Ranking of Environmental and Sociocultural Benefits of Urban Agriculture (scale of 1 to 25; 1= highest) Social or ecological service Project leaders Stakeholders General public provision of medicinal plants 22 21 5 enhancement of pollination 1 7 12 enhancement of carbon sequestration 17 22 21 preservation of cultural knowledge and heritage 8 15 13 prevention of soil erosion 13 11 23 Esther Sanyé-Mengual, Kathrin Specht, and their team surveyed three groups of people in Bologna, Italy — leaders of urban agriculture projects, stakeholders in urban agriculture (e.g., food researchers and urban farming associations), and the general public — to compare their views about the extent to which urban agriculture contributes to 25 social or ecological services that the team identified. The researchers used these ratings to rank the services for each group, with a ranking of 1 indicating that a group perceives that urban agriculture benefits that service the most. Using only the rankings shown in the table, a city planner in Bologna who is promoting a new urban agriculture project concludes that advertisements aimed at stakeholders should emphasize the project’s benefit to the enhancement of pollination.

Which choice best describes data in the table that support the city planner’s conclusion?
selections: A. The enhancement of pollination was ranked higher for stakeholders than were the other four services.
B. The prevention of soil erosion was ranked lower for stakeholders than it was for project leaders.
C. The enhancement of pollination was ranked higher for the general public than it was for stakeholders.
D. The enhancement of carbon sequestration was ranked higher for stakeholders than was the enhancement of pollination.
explanations: 中文解析： 结论是面向利益相关方的宣传应重点强调项目对提升授粉服务的效益。图表中授粉服务的评分是几项服务中评分最高的，所以符合结论。 题目文本翻译： 埃斯特·桑耶-蒙瓜尔与凯瑟琳·施佩希特团队在意大利博洛尼亚调研了三类人群——都市农业项目负责人、相关利益方（如食品研究员与都市农协）及普通市民——对比他们对25项社会生态服务的贡献度认知。研究人员根据评分对各群体进行服务排序，排名第1表示该群体认为都市农业对该项服务贡献最大。仅依据表格排名数据，一位推广新都市农业项目的城市规划者得出结论：面向利益相关方的宣传应重点强调项目对提升授粉服务的效益。

question:
In an international collaboration, Elaine Ostrander, Alan K. Outram, and other researchers probed the evolutionary history of size variation in modern dogs. Scientific consensus held that early dogs had large body mass and that a genetic driver of smaller size in some breeds (e.g., bulldogs) developed only within the last 20,000 years as a result of selective breeding for characteristics favored by humans. Ostrander et al. assert that this explanation is flawed, having discovered that a mutation responsible for variants of IGF1 , a gene found in many mammals that regulates production of insulin-like growth factor 1, is ubiquitous in domestic dog breeds.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers' assertion?
selections: A. IGFI has been isolated in genetic material from fossils more than 20,000 years old of the red wolf ( Canis rufus ) and certain other species related to dogs.
B. An additional mutation related to IGFI affects the development of characteristics other than body size in smaller dog breeds like bulldogs.
C. The mutation related to IGFI influences body size is found in 53,000-year-old genetic material from fossils of Siberian wolves ( Canis lupus campestris) , an ancestor of dogs.
D. One variant of IGFI is found only in smaller dog breeds like bulldogs and appears to have emerged no more than 20,000 years ago.
explanations: 中文解析： 传统观点认为，小型犬的基因突变是近2万年人类选育的结果。但Ostrander团队认为这一解释有误，因为他们发现IGF1基因突变在家犬中普遍存在（即可能更早出现）。需要证明IGF1突变在更早的犬科祖先中就已存在（直接反驳“近2万年才出现”的传统观点）。C选项提到：该突变影响体型（直接关联研究主题）。在5.3万年前的西伯利亚狼（犬科祖先）化石中发现（证明突变远早于2万年）。 题目文本翻译： 在一项国际合作研究中，伊莱恩·奥斯特兰德、艾伦·K·奥特拉姆等学者探究了现代犬类体型差异的演化史。传统科学观点认为早期犬类体型庞大，而某些品种（如斗牛犬）的小型化基因特征仅在过去两万年间因人类偏好性选育才出现。研究团队发现调控胰岛素样生长因子1的IGF1基因突变普遍存在于家犬品种中，由此指出现有理论存在缺陷。

question:
Callie W. Babbitt, Hema Madaka, and colleagues assembled a database of materials used in consumer electronics by studying products in the lab and by gathering data from similar product studies. The team gave each of these studies a rating for level of detail (with a higher rating for reported data with more detail) and for level of traceability (with a higher rating for clearer descriptions of procedures). Based on these ratings, a second research team concluded that a study by Greg L. Kozak and Gregory A. Keoleian provided more specificity in its data than a study by Oguchi Masahiro and colleagues did.

Which finding, if true, would most directly challenge the second research team’s conclusion?
selections: A. The study by Kozak and Keoleian had a lower detail rating than the study by Oguchi and colleagues did.
B. The study by Kozak and Keoleian had a lower traceability rating than the study by Oguchi and colleagues did.
C. The study by Kozak and Keoleian had a high detail rating and a high traceability rating.
D. The study by Oguchi and colleagues had a low detail rating and a low traceability rating.
explanations: 中文解析： 好得分的SAT师生说的公众号曾写过这个题目，specificity详细程度对应detail rating，这道题的关键在此。评分越高Kozak团队的detail rating（数据细节）低于Oguchi团队，直接反驳“数据更具体”的结论。 题目文本翻译： 卡莉·W·巴比特与赫玛·马达卡团队通过实验室产品检测及同类研究数据整合，建立了消费电子产品材料数据库。研究团队为每项数据来源设定了详细程度评级（数据越详尽评分越高）和可追溯性评级（实验流程描述越清晰评分越高）。基于该评级体系，另一研究团队判定格雷格·L·科扎克与格雷戈里·A·基奥莱安的研究数据比小口正弘团队的研究具有更高精确度。

question:
Soil thawing in Alaska has been accelerating as a result of climate changes, potentially enabling increased carbon dioxide (CO₂) absorption through greater productivity of artic bramble (Rubus arcticus) plants and other vegetation, but also potentially enabling increased CO₂output through greater heterotrophic respiration (CO₂ generated by the activity of soil microorganisms). Hydrologist Yonghong Yi and her colleagues developed a model incorporating numerous inputs—— years of soil temperature and snow cover data among them — to evaluate the effects of climate changes on the CO₂ balance in Alaska, concluding that net CO₂ is likely to increase if seasonal snow cover arrives earlier relative to the onset of soil surface freezing.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers’ conclusion?
selections: A. The effect of soil temperature on the growth of vegetation and on the rate of heterotrophic respiration is stronger during the period of seasonal snow cover than during the period without snow cover.
B. Relatively early snow cover reduces the amount of soil moisture available for the growth of plant species such as R. arcticus and lowers the rate of heterotrophic respiration.

C. Seasonal snow cover tends to persist longer in areas of relatively low vegetation growth and high heterotrophic respiration than in areas of relatively high vegetation growth and low heterotrophic respiration.
D. The soil insulation provided by snow cover enables heterotrophic respiration to continue during a period in which plant species such as R. arcticus are typically not growing.
explanations: 中文解析： 结论是二氧化碳的净含量增加，所以snow cover带来更多的是heterotrophic respiration而不是 greater productivity of plants，从而释放更多二氧化碳。所以对应D积雪对土壤的保温作用使得在北极悬钩子等植物通常不生长的时期，heterotrophic 呼吸作用仍能持续进行。好得分老师提示这是一道旧题。 题目文本翻译： 阿拉斯加土壤解冻因气候变化加速，一方面可能通过北极悬钩子等植被增产增强二氧化碳吸收，另一方面也可能因土壤微生物活动加剧（异养呼吸作用）增加二氧化碳排放。水文学家易永宏团队建立的综合模型纳入多年土壤温度与积雪覆盖等数据，评估气候变化对当地二氧化碳平衡的影响，结论显示：若季节性积雪相对于地表冻结期提前到来，二氧化碳净排放量很可能增加。

question:
Over 600 languages are spoken in New York City in addition to English — one can find Bambara spoken in the neighborhood of Kingsbridge, or Ghale in Jackson Heights. Most speakers of Chinese languages reside in the neighborhood of Flushing (part of New York City’s borough of Queens), where the dominant Chinese language is Mandarin, and in Chinatown, in the borough of Manhattan, where the dominant Chinese languages are Cantonese and Fuzhounese. Mandarin is widely spoken in north China, while Cantonese and Fuzhounese are widely spoken in south China. It can therefore be inferred that _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. Chinese immigrants who emigrated to New York City many years ago are more likely to speak several Chinese languages than are more recent Chinese immigrants.
B. people who emigrate from north China tend to settle in Queens, while people who emigrate from south China tend to settle in Manhattan.
C. taken together, there are more Cantonese and Fuzhounese speakers among Chinese immigrants in New York City than there are Mandarin speakers.
D. Chinese immigrants regularly change their residences between Queens and Manhattan after they emigrate, rather than staying in one borough.
explanations: 中文解析： Queens说普通话的多，Manhattan说广东话的多，中国北方人说普通话多，南方人说广东话的多，所以推断出来Queens的北方移民多，Manhattan南方移民多。 题目文本翻译： 纽约市除英语外还流通着600多种语言——国王桥社区能听到班巴拉语，杰克逊高地则通行加莱语。华语使用者主要聚居在皇后区法拉盛（当地以普通话为主）和曼哈顿唐人街（以粤语和福州话为主）。鉴于普通话在中国北方通用，而粤语与福州话盛行于南方，由此可推断_______

question:
David Mitchell’s 2006 novel Black Swan Green contains elements drawn from Mitchell’s own life — there are many parallels between the experiences of the novel’s protagonist, Jason Taylor, and those of Mitchell — and as a result Black Swan Green is regularly described as an autobiographical novel. This characterization can be useful, but it also presents drawbacks in terms of how the work is perceived, given the high value placed on creativity and imagination in artistic endeavors. Readers who take this characterization to mean that Mitchell merely fictionalized actual events may conclude that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. Black Swan Green is not as worthy of praise as it might have been if it had no basis in fact.
B. critics disagree about whether Black Swan Green shows greater originality than works without autobiographical elements.
C. the real-world counterparts of other characters in Black Swan Green are hard to identify.
D. Mitchell should not have claimed that Black Swan Green is based on real events.
explanations: 中文解析： 文章中提到了作品中其实有很大的创作性和想象力，但是读者可能忽视，那么产生的结果就是他们会觉得这个作品抛开事实依据就没那么好。对应的是A。好得分网站上www.hdfedu.com 有这道旧题。 题目文本翻译： 大卫·米切尔2006年小说《黑天鹅绿》融入了作者自身经历——主人公杰森·泰勒与米切尔的遭遇存在诸多相似——因而常被归为自传体小说。这种界定虽有参考价值，却因艺术创作崇尚独创性与想象力而产生认知偏差。若读者据此认为米切尔仅对真实事件进行小说化处理，便可能推断_______

question:
Since the nineteenth century, Egyptologists have commonly divided ancient Egyptian history into three primary ________ Old Kingdom (2700-2200 BCE), the Middle Kingdom (2050-1800 BCE), and the New Kingdom (1550-1100 BCE). Some historians, however, criticize the names of these periods for revealing more about the culture of the mainly European Egyptologists than that of ancient Egypt itself.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 三个国王时期属于平行并列，对于前面的periods进行解释，所以用冒号连接。

question:

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

question:

question:
The Lyrid meteor shower’s brightness typically surpasses that of the Puppid-Velid meteor shower due to the interplay of three main factors — namely, the size and composition of the ______ velocity upon entering Earth’s mesosphere, with higher-velocity meteoroids releasing more energy; and atmospheric fluctuations, such as changes in humidity.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 考察的是三者的复合平行结构，平行结构之间（the size and composition 、their velocity、atmospheric fluctuations）用分号连接，因为平行结构的组成成分内有逗号（with和such前面的逗号）。关注sat师生说公众号获取更多sat备考信息。

question:
In Hafez’s Divān , the writer muses on love, faith, and protest. So impactful is this particular work by Hafez, a Persian lyric poet whose authorial perspective was at once mystical and critical, that its ruminations on fourteenth-century Persian life ________ Iranian society hundreds of years later.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: Its ruminations是从句的主语，从句的谓语动词应该用原形形式

question:
In 2018, the Contessa Gallery in Miami, Florida, exhibited the work of Slovak _______ who aptly describes her photos as “minimalistic but also futuristic.”

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

question:
Instead of sleeping on soft pillows, ancient Egyptians slept on hard, elevated headrests, their design _______ airflow, protection from insects, and hairstyle maintenance over comfort.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主语是ancient egyptians，谓语是slept，后面their design这个部分是独立主格部分，动词用非谓语形式，所以选择C

question:
French mathematician Michel Talagrand has shown that over large numbers of trials, variables that appear to be independent and random are in fact extremely likely to cluster around an average. _________ according to Talagrand’s research, if you flip a coin 1,000 times, there is a 99.7% probability that the coin will land heads side up between 450 and 550 times.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 中文解析： 前面是一个规律，后面是一个具体的例子来支持这个规律，所以选择C，注意找sat_1600领取sat逻辑词真题难题70题练习。 题目文本翻译： 法国数学家米歇尔·塔拉格兰德证明：在大量试验中，看似独立随机的变量实际上极可能围绕平均值聚集。_________ 根据其研究，抛硬币1000次时，出现450至550次正面的概率高达99.7%。

question:
Topographic maps show the elevation of landforms above sea level. Bathymetric maps, ______ show the elevation of landforms below the sea, providing valuable information to marine geophysicists like Claudia Flores, who studies seismic data from the northeastern Caribbean.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 中文解析： 一个研究海上地貌一个研究海下地貌，所以用by contrast来连接。 题目文本翻译： 地形图展示的是海拔以上的地貌高程，而等深图______则呈现海底地貌的深度，为克劳迪娅·弗洛雷斯等研究加勒比海东北部地震数据的海洋地球物理学家提供关键信息。

question:

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 中文解析： 前面提到Edge modeling是artist的常用工具，后面提到artists用它来干什么，属于是给出了一个具体的情况，所以选B。 题目文本翻译： 边缘建模是数字艺术家为电子游戏开发视觉效果时采用的工艺之一。_______数字艺术家通过边缘建模将分离的图形拼接成游戏中的三维物体。

question:
In the Southeast Asian country of Indonesia, the percentage of the population living in cities rose from 53. 3% to 56. 6% between 2015 and 2020. _______ urbanization rates climbed across Southeast Asia as a whole, rising 2. 8 percentage points in that five-year period.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 中文解析： 前后句子分别说了印度尼西和整个东南亚从15年到20年之间城市人口增加情况。两者之间是同时发生的事情，所以选D。concurrently属于新出现的逻辑词，好得分（HDF）老师提醒大家可以记一下。 题目文本翻译： 东南亚国家印度尼西亚的城市人口占比从2015年的53.3%升至2020年的56.6%。_______整个东南亚地区的城市化率在这五年间攀升了2.8个百分点。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·Linguistic typologists classify and compare languages according to their structural features. ·One such structure is word order, or the way subjects (S), verbs (V), and objects (O) are typically arranged in a sentence. ·English employs an SVO word order (e. g. , Cows eat grass). ·Bengali employs an SOV word order (e. g. , Cows grass eat). ·Filipino employs a VSO word order (e. g. , Eat cows grass). ·87% of the world’s languages are classified as either SVO or SOV.

The student wants to make a generalization about how word order is employed across languages. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Word order is one of the structural features by which linguistic typologists classify and compare the world ’ s languages.
B. Linguistic typologists analyze and compare how word order is employed across languages.

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·Producing the nutrient-rich cyanobacterium L. maxima at industrial scale requires high-quality samples of L. maxima DNA. ·Yirlis Yadeth Pineda-Rodriguez and a team of researchers at the University of Córdoba, Colombia, evaluated the quantity and purity of L. maxima DNA extracted using three different DNA extraction kits. ·CTAB 2X (kit 1) had a DNA yield of 2, 134 nanograms per microliter (ng/μL) and a purity ratio of 2. 2. ·Pbact (kit 2) had a DNA yield of 157 ng/μL and a purity ratio of 1.6. ·Pplant (kit 3) had a DNA yield of 12. 5 ng/μL and a purity ratio of 1.5. ·According to the researchers, Pbact was the most effective because it was the only one with both a sufficiently high yield and a purity rate close to the ideal of 1.8.

The student wants to emphasize the significance of a similarity between two of the kits.Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. CTAB 2X and Pplant both had a DNA yield above 10 and a purity ratio above 1.4.
B. Due to their insufficient yield or purity, CTAB 2X and Pplant were deemed by the researchers to be less effective than Pbact.
C. With the ideal purity ratio being 1.8, CTAB 2X and Pbact were equal in purity, according to the researchers.
D. Compared to CTAB 2X, which had a DNA yield of 2,134 ng/ut, both Pbact and Pplant had insufficient yields; Pplant, in particular, was ineffective due to its low yield.
explanations: 中文解析： 因为题目问的是significance而不是similarity。根据笔记信息：CTAB 2X 和Pplant 要么yield不行，要么purity不行，所以它俩这个共同点体现了它俩不如Pbat有效，less effective就是significance。 题目文本翻译： 学生在研究某一课题时整理了以下笔记： ·工业化生产富含营养的蓝藻L.maxima需要高质量DNA样本 ·哥伦比亚科尔多瓦大学伊尔利斯·亚德思·皮内达-罗德里格斯团队评估了三种DNA提取试剂盒的效果 ·CTAB 2X（试剂盒1）DNA产量2134纳克/微升，纯度比值2.2 ·Pbact（试剂盒2）DNA产量157纳克/微升，纯度比值1.6 ·Pplant（试剂盒3）DNA产量12.5纳克/微升，纯度比值1.5 ·研究显示Pbact效果最佳，因其在产量达标的同时纯度最接近理想值1.8

question: A right rectangular prism has a base area of 56t square centimeters (cm²). The length of the base of the rectangular prism is 14 3 cm , and the height of the rectangular prism is 3 cm. Which expression represents the surface area, in cm², of the right rectangular prism?

question:
The National Heritage Fellowship was created to _________ exceptional folk and traditional artists in the United States. One artist who received the fellowship, the Mexican American rodeo tailor Manuel Cuevas, was chosen for his lifetime contributions to the arts.

explanations: 中文解析： National Heritage Fellowship 是一个奖项，目的是为了奖励积极的行为， 后文提到 Manuel Cuevas 因终身贡献而获奖，说明该奖项是为了表彰杰出艺术家，honor符合要求。 题目文本翻译： 国家遗产奖旨在_________美国杰出的民间和传统艺术家。墨西哥裔美国牛仔服装师曼努埃尔·奎瓦斯因对艺术的终身贡献而获此殊荣。

question:
Some cities estimate where sidewalks are located using road maps, which is not very accurate. The program’s performance was _________ to that of the road-map method: it more accurately identified sidewalks, and it even distinguished between cobblestone and brick.

explanations: 中文解析： 道路地图的方法not very accurate，对比计算机程序more accurately，因此，程序的表现比道路地图更好，选择superior。 题目文本翻译： 一些城市使用道路地图来估算人行道的位置，这种方法并不十分准确。Maryam Hosseini及其团队训练了一个计算机程序，通过曼哈顿的航空图像识别人行道，并将其应用于布鲁克林的图像。该程序的表现_________道路地图方法：它能更精确地识别出人行道，甚至可区分鹅卵石路面与砖砌路面。

question:
The following text is from Charles Chesnutt’s 1905 novel The Colonel’s Dream . Mr. French and Mr. Kirby work together. Mr. French, the senior partner, who sat opposite Kirby, was an older man—a safe guess would have placed him somewhere in the debatable ground between forty and fifty; of a good height, as could be seen even from the seated figure, the upper part of which was held erect with the unconscious ease which one associates with military training.

As used in the text, what does the word “good” most nearly mean?
explanations: 中文解析： good height描述的是弗伦奇先生的身高，后文提到他即使坐着也能看出上半身挺直，说明他身材较高，considerable height指相当高的，符合语境。 题目文本翻译： 以下文本出自查尔斯·切斯纳特1905年的小说《上校的梦》。弗伦奇先生与柯比先生是工作伙伴。 年长的合伙人弗伦奇先生坐在柯比对面——若作保守推测，他应身处四十岁到五十岁之间的模糊地带；其身材高挑，即使坐着也能看出端倪，上半身笔挺的姿态带着一种人们会联想到军事训练的无意识从容。

question:
Often, the Nobel Prize in Chemistry is given to a single person, such as George de Hevesy in 1943. But recognition isn’t restricted to _________ individuals. Instead, success in fields like chemistry is usually achieved through collaboration with other experts, as was the case for Max Ferdinand Perutz, who was among those awarded for “their studies of the structures of globular proteins.”

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 中文解析： 前文说诺奖通常给一个人，但后文强调成功需要合作collaboration。空白处应表达不限于单独获奖者的意思。solitary（单独的） 与collaboration（合作）形成对比，逻辑通顺。 题目文本翻译： 通常，诺贝尔化学奖会授予单独一人，例如1943年的乔治·德海韦西。但认可并不局限于_________个人。相反，在化学等领域取得成就通常需要与其他专家合作，正如马克斯·费迪南德·佩鲁茨的情况——他因"对球状蛋白质结构的研究"而成为获奖者之一。

question:
The Apollo Moon landings (1969–1972) brought atmospheric sensors and soil sensors to the Moon and produced large amounts of data, much of which was stored on outdated technologies. A data-transfer project is making the data available again, thereby ________ the Apollo data’s usefulness, as the data are used to study the geology of the Moon.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 中文解析： 数据原本因技术过时而无法使用，现在通过项目重新可用（made available again），这些数据现在被用于研究月球地质，说明其价值被重新激活，renewing符合要求。 题目文本翻译： 阿波罗探月计划（1969–1972）向月球输送了大气传感器与土壤传感器并产生了大量数据，其中大部分存储在过时的技术设备上。某个数据传输项目正在重新启用这些数据，由此________阿波罗数据的使用价值——这些数据正被用于研究月球地质。

question:
Text 1 In 2019 Belo Horizonte, Brazil, was named a City of Gastronomy by UNESCO in recognition of the city’s unique food culture. The honor is well known among residents of the city as well as tourists who visit. It’s obvious that the selection of Belo Horizonte by UNESCO has brought awareness to local recipes, cooking practices, and chefs and has provided a boost to the city’s tourism industry. Text 2 Many people in Belo Horizonte’s restaurant industry hoped that food tourism would increase after the city was chosen as a City of Gastronomy in 2019. However, as researcher Eerang Park and colleagues argue, cities must still create effective marketing strategies to benefit fully from being named a City of Gastronomy. Without an intentional effort to promote the city’s food scene, many current and potential visitors to Belo Horizonte may not even be aware that it’s home to uniquely delicious food.

Based on the texts, what would the author of Text 2 most likely say in response to the underlined claim in Text 1?
selections: A. Many people worked together to help Belo Horizonte be recognized by UNESCO, but chefs deserve the most credit for Belo Horizonte’s selection as a City of Gastronomy.
B. Belo Horizonte may have benefited from being selected by UNESCO, but tourism can likely be further increased by making more potential visitors aware of the city’s status as a City of Gastronomy.
C. The naming of Belo Horizonte as a City of Gastronomy was long overdue, given the city’s unique and delicious food.
D. The benefits of being named a City of Gastronomy extend well beyond tourism.
explanations: 中文解析： Text 2 的作者会认为，虽然评选带来了一定好处（如 Text 1 所述），但若不主动宣传，旅游业增长潜力尚未完全释放。B选项Belo Horizonte可能从评选中受益，但通过让更多潜在游客了解其“美食之都”的地位，旅游业可能会进一步增长。完全符合 Text 2 的观点，就是当前受益有限，需主动营销才能充分提升旅游业。 题目文本翻译： 文本1 2019年巴西贝洛奥里藏特被联合国教科文组织命名为"美食之都"，以表彰该市独特的饮食文化。这一荣誉在当地市民和到访游客中广为人知。显然，联合国教科文组织的评选提高了人们对当地食谱、烹饪方法和厨师的认识，并为该市旅游业提供了发展助力。 文本2 贝洛奥里藏特餐饮业的许多从业者曾希望，自2019年该市获评"美食之都"后美食旅游能有所增长。但正如研究人员Eerang Park及其同事所言，城市仍需制定有效的营销策略才能充分受益于"美食之都"称号。若没有有意识地努力推广城市美食景观，许多现有和潜在游客可能根本不知道贝洛奥里藏特拥有独特美味的美食。

question:
In Hoocąk, an Indigenous language from the Midwest region of what is now the United States, zi means “yellow,” whereas zizi means “yellow in spots.” This phenomenon, in which an element of a root word is repeated, sometimes with modification, within another word that is related to the root word, is called reduplication. In this case, the entire word zi gets repeated in zizi . There are many examples of this type of reduplication in Hoocąk.

The text makes which point about Hoocąk?
selections: A. It is one of the only languages in the world that makes use of reduplication.
B. It is closely related to another language from the Midwest region of what is now the United States that also makes use of reduplication.
C. It contains many instances of the type of reduplication seen in the words zi and zizi .
D. It has a wide variety of reduplicated words and phrases that mean “yellow.”
explanations: 中文解析： zi 表示“黄色”，zizi 表示“斑驳的黄色”，这种现象称为“重叠”（reduplication），即通过重复词根，来构成新词，文中提到，Hoocąk语言中有许多这样的重叠例子。 题目文本翻译： 在霍昌卡语（Hoocąk）——一种源自现今美国中西部地区的原住民语言中，"zi"表示"黄色"，而"zizi"则意为"斑点状的黄色"。这种现象被称为"重叠构词法"，即词根中的某个元素在相关词汇中被重复使用（有时伴随形态变化）。此案例中，整个单词"zi"在"zizi"中被完整重复。霍昌卡语中存在大量此类重叠构词法的范例。

question:
The Federalist Papers are a collection of 85 essays written by Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison. Their publication (under a single pen name) was divided among the Daily Advertiser and other New York newspapers in 1787-88. The essays argue that New Yorkers should vote to ratify the proposed United States Constitution. Though the authorship of most of the individual essays is certain, that of a few is in question: for instance, while No. 6, “Concerning Dangers from Dissensions between the States,” was surely penned by Hamilton, No. 62, “The Senate,” may have been written by either Hamilton or Madison.

Based on the text, what do the essays “Concerning Dangers from Dissensions between the States” and “The Senate” have in common?
selections: A. They were both written by one of the three authors of the Federalist Papers, but which of the authors wrote either is not entirely clear.
B. They were both published sometime during 1787 or 1788.
C. They were both collaborative efforts between Alexander Hamilton and James Madison.
D. They were both published in the Daily Advertiser .
explanations: 中文解析： 在SAT师生说（公众号）推文里也讲过这个题目是个旧题改编，这次题目问第6篇和第62篇有什么共同点？B选项正确，文中提到所有文章都在1787-88年发表，这一点适用于这两篇。第6篇作者明确是汉密尔顿，只有第62篇不确定，于是A错了。第6篇明确是汉密尔顿单独写的，于是C也错了，文中只说文章发表在《每日广告报》和其他报纸，未指定这两篇的具体发表处，D也错了。 题目文本翻译： 《联邦党人文集》是由亚历山大·汉密尔顿、约翰·杰伊和詹姆斯·麦迪逊共同撰写的85篇文集。这些文章（以共同笔名发表）于1787至1788年间分散刊登于《每日广告报》及其他纽约报刊。该系列文章旨在呼吁纽约民众投票批准拟议的《美利坚合众国宪法》。尽管大部分单篇文章的作者身份明确，但仍有少数存在争议：例如第六篇《论各州间纷争之隐患》确为汉密尔顿执笔，而第六十二篇《论参议院》则可能出自汉密尔顿或麦迪逊之手。

question:
Employment in Agriculture, Hunting, and Forestry in the Czech Republic and Austria, 1995-2013 A student is using the graph for a class presentation on historic employment trends in the agriculture, hunting, and forestry sectors in two European countries. The student notes that from 1995 to 2007 ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the example?
selections: A. the majority of employees in Austria were working in these sectors.
B. the number of employees working in these sectors decreased in the Czech Republic while remaining relatively steady in Austria.
C. employment in these sectors remained stable in both Austria and the Czech Republic.
D. the number of employees working in these sectors increased in the Czech Republic.
explanations: 中文解析： 根据图表，捷克共和国这些行业的从业人数有所下降，而奥地利则保持相对稳定，B正确。 题目文本翻译： 捷克共和国和奥地利农业、狩猎和林业的就业情况，1995-2013 一名学生正在使用该图表进行关于两个欧洲国家农业、狩猎和林业部门历史就业趋势的课堂展示。该学生指出，从1995年到2007年 ________

question:
Volcanoes in Ecuador Name of volcano Year of last eruption Volcano type Wolf 2022 CE shield Imbabura 5550 BCE compound Chacana 1773 CE caldera Tungurahua 216 CE stratovolcano A student is researching volcanoes in Ecuador. The student claims that Ecuador is home to several different types of volcanoes.

Which choice best describes information from the table that supports the student’s claim?
selections: A. Wolf is a shield volcano, Tungurahua is a stratovolcano, Imbabura is a compound volcano, and Chacana is a caldera volcano.
B. Wolf, Tungurahua, and Imbabura are all stratovolcanoes, whereas Chacana is the only caldera volcano.

question:
Memoirs of Elleanor Eldridge is an 1838 historical account by Elleanor Eldridge and Frances Harriet Whipple Green. In the book, the authors assert that all people naturally have an emotional attachment to where they live, writing, ________

Which quotation from Memoirs of Elleanor Eldridge most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “This little book is published for the express purpose of giving a helping hand to suffering and persecuted merit.”

B. “To give some idea of the high esteem in which the subject of the following narrative is held, and the strong interest her misfortunes have excited, a few, from the great number of recommendations in her possession, are selected.”
C. “Blessed are the slumbers of the innocent! They are kindlier than balm, and they refresh and gladden the spirit of childhood, like ministerings from a better world.”
D. “Home is home, to the lowly as well as the great: and no rank, or color, destroys its sacred character, its power over the mind, and the affections.”
explanations: 中文解析： D选项大意“家就是家，对卑微者和伟人皆是如此：无论身份或肤色，都无法削弱它的神圣性，以及对心灵和情感的支配力。”直接呼应“ an emotional attachment to where they live” 题目文本翻译： 《埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇回忆录》是埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇与弗朗西丝·哈里特·惠普尔·格林于1838年合作完成的历史传记。书中，作者们主张人类天生会对所居之地产生情感依恋，并写道：________

question:
Chemists M. H. Gamble, P. Rice, and J. D. Selman studied the mass and heat transfer processes that occur when foods, such as the Indian snacks malapua and puri bhaji, are oil fried. During frying, water in the crust evaporates, leaving voids that oil (a pure fat) can fill. As the process continues, water from the food’s center moves to the crust as long as the crust remains permeable. Therefore, it is likely that, all other things being equal, sections of a food that lose less moisture during the frying process ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. will develop a thicker crust during the frying process than sections that lose more moisture.
B. will have a lower fat content after frying is completed than sections that lose more moisture.
C. will have a crust that loses its permeability less quickly during the frying process than sections that lose more moisture.
D. will have a higher temperature after frying is completed than sections that lose more moisture.
explanations: 中文解析： 根据文本逻辑，水分流失少，油脂填充少，脂肪含量低，于是B符合要求，脂肪含量更低 直接对应“水分流失少 ，油脂填充少”的逻辑。 题目文本翻译： 化学家 M. H. Gamble、P. Rice 和 J. D. Selman 研究了印度小吃马拉普阿（malapua）和普里巴吉（puri bhaji）等食物在油炸过程中发生的传质与传热过程。油炸时，外壳中的水分蒸发后会留下空隙，油（一种纯脂肪）便能渗入这些空隙。只要食物外壳保持渗透性，随着油炸持续进行，食物中心的水分会不断向外壳迁移。因此可以推断，在其他条件相同的情况下，在油炸过程中失去较少水分的食物部位 ________

question:
Ants and aphids are known to be mutualistic: ants feed on the honeydew produced by aphids, while aphids benefit from ants’ protection against predators. If aphid colonies—which generally require relatively stable surfaces, such as trees or other woody plants, to thrive— are too small to produce significant volumes of honeydew, however, ants will prey on aphids. Researcher Tae-Sung Kwon examined ant and aphid abundance in two habitats in South Korea, one on the mainland and one on Jeju Island. Though the habitats differed in some important respects, both were predominantly grassland, which could help explain why Kwon observed ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. different ant and aphid species on the mainland compared to those on the island.
B. a positive correlation between aphid diversity and abundance on both the mainland and the island.
C. a negative correlation between ant and aphid abundance on both the mainland and the island.
D. diminished ant and aphid abundance on the mainland compared to that on the island.
explanations: 中文解析： 根据公众号SAT师生的推断类题目分析，关键点是草地和树木地要区分开，在草地环境下aphids难以大量繁衍，群体较小 ，蚂蚁可能捕食蚜虫aphids，因此蚂蚁和蚜虫的数量可能呈现负相关（蚂蚁多时蚜虫少）。 题目文本翻译： 蚂蚁和蚜虫被认为存在互利共生关系：蚂蚁以蚜虫分泌的蜜露为食，而蚜虫受益于蚂蚁对捕食者的抵御。然而，若蚜虫群体（通常需要树木或其他木本植物等相对稳定的表面才能繁盛）规模过小导致蜜露产量不足时，蚂蚁则会捕食蚜虫。研究员Tae-Sung Kwon考察了韩国两地（一处大陆区域与一处济州岛区域）的蚂蚁与蚜虫数量。尽管两地栖息地在某些重要方面存在差异，但均以草地环境为主，这可能有助于解释为何Kwon观察到________

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. award; for a person of letters,
B. award for a person of letters;
C. award: for a person of letters
D. award for a person of letters:
explanations: for介词和宾语间不分开，冒号后 the Nobel Prize in Literature解释前面的award

question:
The Grootbos florilegium in South Africa contains a collection of botanical paintings, with each painting depicting a local plant species in exquisite detail. The florilegium includes a vignette painting by contributing artist Sibonelo Chiliza. Unlike most paintings in the florilegium, ________

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. Chiliza contextualizes a plant within an ecosystem in his vignette.
B. the contextualization of a plant within an ecosystem occurs in Chiliza’s vignette.
C. a plant’s ecosystem is contextualized in Chiliza’s vignette.
D. Chiliza’s vignette contextualizes a plant within an ecosystem.
explanations: 根据most paintings...，需要画来充当句子的主语，于是D符合

question:
For scientists to produce new iron nanoparticles of a specific size or strength, they must first be able to monitor reactions between oxygen and existing iron nanoparticles at a near-atomic level of detail. Fortunately, chemistry ________ and his colleagues at Temple University recently developed a new approach that does just that.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 人物身份与名字间修饰关系，不用符号分开

question:
Motion capture is one tool digital artists employ while developing visuals for video games._______ digital artists use motion capture to digitally capture real-life movements and convert them to 3D game animatons.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 中文解析： 第一句话提到“动作捕捉是数字艺术家使用的一种工具”，而后一句则详细说明了数字艺术家如何使用这一工具，所以应该选C. 题目文本翻译： 动作捕捉是数字艺术家在开发视频游戏视觉效果时使用的一种工具。_________数字艺术家使用动作捕捉技术来捕捉现实生活中的动作，并将其转换为3D游戏动画。

question:
Analyses of Rembrandt’s seventeenth-century painting The Night Watch , citing its richly saturated colors and stark contrasts between light and shadow, often characterize the work as an exemplar of the Baroque-era style. Many art historians, however, challenge the very notion of a distinct Baroque era. They claim that the so-called Baroque aesthetic was, ________ just an extension of the stylings of the Renaissance era.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 中文解析： in reality表示事实上，前面说质疑so-called Baroque aesthetic，后文说just an extension of the stylings of the Renaissance era，前后意义一直，in reality起到了补充强调作用，需要更多练习请选用好得分SAT逻辑词 70难题合集 题目文本翻译： 对十七世纪伦勃朗画作《夜巡》的分析，援引其浓烈的色彩和明暗之间的鲜明对比，常将该作品描述为巴洛克时期风格的典范。然而，许多艺术史学家质疑所谓独特的巴洛克时期这一概念本身。他们声称，所谓的巴洛克美学不过是文艺复兴时期风格的延伸。

question:
Physicist Walter Massey led numerous scientific organizations over his long career. His most prominent appointment came in 1990, when Massey was named director of the National Science Foundation. ________ Massey had served as the first president of the National Society of Black Physicists.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 中文解析： 主句讲1990年Massey担任NSF主任（较晚事件）,后句讲他更早的职位（首任黑人物理学家协会主席）,需体现时间先后（先担任协会主席，后成为NSF主任）,previously符合要求 题目文本翻译： 物理学家沃尔特·马西在其漫长职业生涯中领导过众多科学组织。他最重要的任命出现在1990年，当时马西被任命为美国国家科学基金会主任。________ 马西此前曾担任美国黑人物理学家协会首任主席。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·Soap forms as the result of a chemical reaction between fats and either sodium or potassium hydroxide. ·One end of a soap molecule is hydrophobic (water repelling), and one end is hydrophilic (water attracting). ·The hydrophobic ends of soap molecules adhere to hydrophobic surface contaminants, such as dirt and oils. ·The soap molecules form circular structures (micelles) around contaminants. ·The hydrophilic ends of the molecules encase the micelles in water, lifting the micelles and contaminants off surfaces.

The student wants to explain how soap removes a surface contaminant. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Surface contaminants like dirt and oils are hydrophobic, not hydrophilic— meaning they repel water rather than attract it.
B. Micelles are circular structures created when soap molecules attach themselves to dirt or oils.

C. To remove dirt from a surface, soap molecules form a circular structure, or micelle, around the contaminant; next, the molecules encase the micelle in water, lifting it —and the dirt — off the surface.

D. Dirt, an example of a hydrophobic surface contaminant, can be removed from a surface by soap, which forms as the result of a chemical reaction between fats and either sodium or potassium hydroxide.
explanations: 中文解析： 题目要求explain how soap removes a surface contaminant，C选项满足，肥皂分子先围绕污垢形成胶束，再用水包裹胶束，从而将污垢从表面剥离，完整还原去污流程：形成胶束（疏水端吸附污垢），亲水端包裹胶束（使污垢溶于水），最终剥离 题目文本翻译： 在研究某一主题时，某学生记录了以下要点： · 肥皂是脂肪与氢氧化钠或氢氧化钾发生化学反应生成的产物。 · 肥皂分子一端具有疏水性（排斥水），另一端具有亲水性（吸引水）。 · 肥皂分子的疏水端会附着于疏水性表面污染物（如灰尘和油脂）。 · 肥皂分子围绕污染物形成环状结构（胶束）。 · 分子的亲水端将胶束包裹在水中，使胶束与污染物从物体表面脱离。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·The human tongue contains taste receptors for a rich, savory flavor called umami. ·Umami is triggered by the compounds in a variety of foods, including tuna and blue cheese. ·Participants in a study tasted a sample of sea palm, a type of brown seaweed. ·They rated its umami intensity as moderate. ·The participants tasted a sample of bull kelp, another type of brown seaweed. ·They rated its umami intensity as high.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two seaweeds. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Some types of brown seaweed, like sea palm and bull kelp, trigger umami flavor in human taste buds.
B. Sea palm is a type of brown seaweed, but so is bull kelp.
C. While sea palm and bull kelp contain umami flavor, umami can also be found in tuna and blue cheese.
D. After tasting two types of brown seaweed, sea palm and bull kelp, participants in a study found bull kelp’s umami flavor to be the more intense of the two.
explanations: 中文解析： 题目要求对比两种seaweed差异，于是研究参与者品尝两种褐藻后，认为bull kelp的鲜味比sea palm更浓，D符合要求。 题目文本翻译： 在研究某一课题时，某学生记录了以下信息： · 人类舌部具有感知鲜味（umami）的味觉感受器； · 鲜味由多种食物所含化合物激发，包括金枪鱼和蓝纹奶酪； · 研究参与者品尝了褐藻类植物海棕榈的样本； · 他们评定其鲜味强度为中等； · 参与者随后品尝了同为褐藻的牛昆布样本； · 他们评定其鲜味强度为高等。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: ·The Polytechnic in Gdansk, Poland, is home to a Foucault pendulum. ·The pendulum consists of a weighted ball that swings at the end of a roughly 26-meter-long cable. ·Like all Foucault pendulums, it dangles from a fixed point that ensures the swing path of the pendulum doesn’t change. ·To an observer, the swing path of a Foucault pendulum appears to change over time because Earth rotates beneath it. ·Foucault pendulums are used as a simple way to provide evidence of Earth’s rotation.

The student wants to specify the parts of a Foucault pendulum. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The Foucault pendulum at the Polytechnic in Gdansk, Poland, includes a cable that is roughly 26 meters long.
B. With a swing path that appears to change over time, a Foucault pendulum provides evidence of Earth’s rotation.
C. Dangling from a fixed point, the Foucault pendulum at the Polytechnic consists of a cable with a weighted ball at the end.
D. The swing path of the Foucault pendulum at the Polytechnic appears to change over time.
explanations: 中文解析： 题目要求specify the parts，C选项买哦书挂于固定点，由缆绳和末端的配重球组成。完整列出三部分：固定点、缆绳、配重球。 题目文本翻译： 在开展课题研究时，某学生记录了以下信息： · 波兰格但斯克理工大学设有一座傅科摆装置。 · 该摆锤由末端悬挂重球的约26米长缆索构成。 · 与所有傅科摆相同，该装置悬挂于固定支点，确保摆锤运动轨迹恒定。 · 观测者视角中，傅科摆运动轨迹随时间变化的现象源自地球在其下方的自转运动。 · 傅科摆是验证地球自转现象的直观实证装置。

question:
Postcranial skeletal pneumaticity (PSP) refers to the presence of extensions of an animal’s lungs and air sacs inside its bones. Though such structures do not typically fossilize, they are believed to have been present in Tyrannosaurus, Euhelopus , and other Cretaceous theropods and sauropods. To _______ PSP from fossils, researchers look for indicators such as large foramina (holes in bones).

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 中文解析： PSP是软组织结构，无法直接化石保存，研究者通过间接证据holes in bones,来推测其存在。 题目文本翻译： 颅后骨骼气腔性（Postcranial skeletal pneumaticity，PSP）指动物肺部与气囊在骨骼内部的延伸结构。尽管此类结构通常不会形成化石，但研究者认为霸王龙（Tyrannosaurus）、盘足龙（Euhelopus）及其他白垩纪兽脚类与蜥脚类恐龙具备该特征。为从化石中_______颅后骨骼气腔性，研究者会寻找大型骨孔（骨骼表面的孔洞）等标志性证据。

question:
In 2017, Belgium, which has strong democratic institutions, experienced an inflation rate of 2. 12%, much higher than the 0. 74% rate seen in Equatorial Guinea, which has relatively weak democratic institutions. Such a result is ________, however: Raj Desai et al. have shown that democratic institution strength tends to restrain inflationary pressures.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 中文解析： 研究结论说民主制度强，通胀压力低；实际数据显示民主强的比利时通胀更高与理论相反，需填入一个词描述 “与预期结论矛盾” 的现象。D. anomalous 意为“反常的”，符合要求，这是一个旧题改编，具体参考好得分的SAT真题。 题目文本翻译： 2017 年，民主制度强大的比利时经历了 2. 12% 的通货膨胀率，远高于民主制度相对薄弱的赤道几内亚 0. 74% 的比率。这样的结果却________：然而 Raj Desai 等人已证明民主制度的力量往往会抑制通胀压力。

question:
Some robots such as Saika (developed in 1996) and Poppy (developed in 2013) are designed to resemble humans so that people will find it easier to interact with them. To that end, certain features such as bipedal locomotion can help to _________ the effect of the more unnatural aspects of a robot’s appearance, but a robot that looks too human can fall into the “uncanny valley,” meaning that its appearance unintentionally unsettles those who encounter it.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 中文解析： 通过人类特征减轻机器人外观的不自然感，但是过度像人反而会引发恐怖谷效应。help to... the effect of unnatural aspects，需填入缓解负面影响的动词ameliorate 意为改善、减轻，符合语境 题目文本翻译： 有些机器人如Saika（1996年开发）和Poppy（2013年开发）被设计成模仿人类，以便人们能更轻松地与它们互动。为此，双足运动等特定特征有助于_________机器人外观中非自然元素带来的影响，但过于类人的机器人可能陷入"恐怖谷"效应，即其外观会无意中令接触者感到不安。

question:
Demosthenes, a prominent fourth-century BCE Athenian orator, is said to have been _______ of parrhesia , or speaking freely and openly to ensure productive civic deliberation. He is noted for characterizing parrhesia in several public addresses as the foundation of democracy in classical Athens rather than, more simply, as a facilitator of the political system.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 中文解析： Parrhesia（直言自由）是德摩斯梯尼积极倡导的民主核心价值。他将其定义为民主基石，说明他是理念的支持者/倡导者。characterizing... as the foundation 体现主动推广的立场。 a proponent 表示支持者/倡导者，契合他推广Parrhesia的行为。 题目文本翻译： 据说，公元前 4 世纪雅典著名的演说家德摩斯梯尼，一直_______ “直言”，即自由、坦诚地发表意见，以确保公民审议富有成效。他在几次公开演讲中指出，“直言”是古典时期雅典民主的基础，而不仅仅是政治体制的促进因素。

question:
Roy McLendon’s Moonlit St. Lucie , a riverscape featuring the silhouette of a single palm tree against the backdrop of shimmering water and a brilliant moonlit sky, is typical of paintings by the Florida Highwaymen, loosely affiliated landscape artists mainly active in Fort Pierce, Florida, during the 1950s and ‘60s. Some art historians suggest that Highwaymen paintings played a role in shaping popular perceptions of the state that persist today: the natural iconography that McLendon and colleagues constantly revisited— placid inland rivers, windswept palm trees— is now seen as classically Floridian.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To describe the historical circumstances in which paintings by the Florida Highwaymen experienced a resurgence in popularity
B. To explain that a particular painting by Roy McLendon has had greater influence on the broader culture of the state of Florida than is generally acknowledged
C. To contrast the public’s reaction during the 1950s and ‘60s to a particular painting by Roy McLendon with more recent reactions to it
D. To present the argument that paintings by the Florida Highwaymen likely helped to create a particular widespread impression of Florida
explanations: 中文解析： 公路画家的画作可能塑造了人们对佛罗里达的特定印象。文本核心是探讨画作意象与佛罗里达形象之间的关联，D选项精准捕捉这一论点，指出画作中的自然意象（河流、棕榈树）成为佛罗里达的经典符号，引用艺术史学家的观点，说明画作对公众认知的潜在影响。 题目文本翻译： 罗伊·麦克伦登的《圣露西月夜》是一幅河景画，画面中一棵棕榈树的轮廓映衬在波光粼粼的水面和明亮的月光下。这幅画是佛罗里达州“公路画家”们的典型作品。这些画家是松散结盟的风景画家，主要活跃于 20 世纪 50 年代和 60 年代的佛罗里达州皮尔斯堡。一些艺术史学家认为，“公路画家”的作品在塑造如今人们对佛罗里达州的普遍认知方面发挥了作用：麦克伦登及其同事反复描绘的自然意象——宁静的内陆河流、被风吹拂的棕榈树——如今被视为典型的佛罗里达州景象。

question:
Chorioactis geaster , a species of mushroom that makes a distinctive hissing sound when it releases its spores, is an elusive fungus that has been observed only in Texas and Oklahoma in the US and in the Miyazaki and Nara Prefectures in Japan. Scientists aren’t entirely sure why C. geaster is distributed in this way (genetic analysis reveals that the US and Japanese strains diverged 19 million years ago), but the mushroom appears to be very selective: it is typically found on the decaying stumps and roots of only a few tree species that are abundant in these areas.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It provides an explanation for the relationship between C. geaster and its habitats.
B. It highlights the negative impact C. geaster has on the trees on which it’s found.
C. It emphasizes the uncertainty about C. geaster alluded to earlier in the text.
D. It elaborates on a characterization of C. geaster presented earlier in the text.
explanations: 中文解析： 冒号后解释冒号前selective这个特质。前文提到这种蘑菇仅分布在特定地区，而这句话说明它只生长在少数树种上，且这些树种恰好在这些地区丰富。因此，它间接解释了为什么C. geaster的分布如此局限，因为它的宿主树木只在这些地方常见。 题目文本翻译： 地星裂杯菌（Chorioactis geaster）是一种在释放孢子时会发出独特嘶嘶声的真菌。这种稀有真菌目前仅分布于美国得克萨斯州、俄克拉荷马州，以及日本宫崎县和奈良县。科学家尚未完全明确其特殊分布格局的成因（基因分析显示，美国和日本的地星裂杯菌种群在1900万年前便已分化），但该真菌对生长环境表现出高度选择性——通常只生长于这些地区常见的少数几种树木的腐烂树桩和根部。

question:
In Egypt, use of solid fuel (e.g., coal, wood) as a share of total household fuel use fell by more than 90 percent between 2000 and 2015; such shifts are often explained by appeal to the energy ladder, a model holding that fuel choice is mediated mainly by household income (specifically, high-technology fuels displace solid fuels as incomes rise). Alemu Mekonne n and Gunnar Köhlin’s study of fuel use in Ethiopia shows this model to be reductive, however: household fuel use was heterogeneous, flexible, and influenced by several factors, including the local availability of different fuel sources.

Which choice best describes the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To contrast patterns in household fuel use in two countries
B. To account for the effect of fuel use on household income
C. To critique a frequently used model of changes in household fuel prices
D. To challenge a common explanation for households’ fuel choices
explanations: 中文解析： 文章先介绍埃及固体燃料使用减少的现象，并提到常用解释是能源阶梯，，认为收入增加会导致燃料升级。however转折，通过埃塞俄比亚的研究证明这个理论太简单化，实际影响因素更多，挑战了常见的energy ladder理论，D符合要求。 题目文本翻译： 在埃及，2000 年至 2015 年间，固体燃料（如煤、木柴）在家庭燃料使用总量中的占比下降了 90% 以上；这种转变通常被解释为能源阶梯模型的作用，该模型认为燃料选择主要受家庭收入的影响（具体而言，随着收入的增加，高科技燃料会取代固体燃料）。然而，阿莱穆·梅孔内和贡纳尔·科林对埃塞俄比亚燃料使用情况的研究表明，这种模型过于简化：家庭燃料使用情况是多样化的、灵活的，并受到多种因素的影响，包括当地不同燃料来源的可获得性。

question:
The following text is adapted from Fanny Burney’s 1778 novel Evelina . The text is an excerpt from a letter by Lady Howard to Evelina’s guardian, Reverend Villars, in which Lady Howard discusses an upcoming trip to London planned by her daughter Mrs. Mirvan’s family. It is very earnestly [the Mirvans’] wish to enlarge and enliven their party by the addition of your amiable ward, who would share, equally with her own daughter, the care and attention of Mrs. Mirvan. Do not start at this proposal; it is time that [Evelina] should see something of the world. When young people are too rigidly sequestered from it, their lively and romantic imaginations paint it to them as a paradise of which they have been beguiled; but when they are shown it properly, and in due time, they see it such as it really is, equally shared by pain and pleasure, hope and disappointment.

Based on the text, Lady Howard would most likely agree with which statement about Reverend Villars?
selections: A. Although the manner in which he has raised Evelina is in many ways exemplary, he has been misguided in shielding her from the influence of other young people.
B. Although his desire to guard Evelina from unscrupulous people is commendable, his general mistrust has led him to be unduly wary of the Mirvans.
C. He is overly protective of Evelina, who would likely benefit from a greater variety of experiences than she has had thus far
D. He has imparted to Evelina his own idealistic view of the world, which results in her being unprepared to face inevitable disappointments.
explanations: 中文解析： Lady Howard 的核心观点是牧师过度保护导致Evelina缺乏现实认知，而伦敦之行能提供必要的生活体验，于是批评了牧师的过度保护，希望Evelina更多接触世界，和C选项的表述一致。 题目文本翻译： 以下文本改编自范妮·伯尼（Fanny Burney）1778年的小说《埃夫琳娜》（Evelina）。该文本摘自霍华德夫人（Lady Howard）写给埃夫琳娜监护人维拉尔牧师（Reverend Villars）的一封信，霍华德夫人在信中讨论了她的女儿米尔凡夫人（Mrs. Mirvan）一家计划前往伦敦的旅行。 米尔凡一家非常诚挚地希望通过增添您温柔的监护人，使他们的聚会更加丰富多彩。她将与自己的女儿平等地分享米尔凡夫人的关心和照顾。不要对这个提议感到惊讶；是时候让埃夫琳娜见识一下这个世界了。当年轻人被过于严格地隔离时，他们活泼而浪漫的想象力会将世界描绘成一个被欺骗的乐园；但当他们在适当的时机被正确地展示出来时，他们会看到世界的真实面貌——痛苦与快乐、希望与失望并存。

question:
Many music streaming services also function as social media platforms: by giving users the option to follow friends and share curated playlists or information about their listening history, these platforms allow people to convey their music preferences and listening activities directly to their social networks. In a 2023 study, researcher Michael James Walsh interviewed frequent users of a popular music streaming platform to investigate how its social media dimensions shape their listening habits. Walsh found that these dimensions tended to make study participants feel more mindful of how their listening activities may be perceived, which in turn influenced how they managed those activities.

Which quotation from a music streaming platform user would best illustrate Walsh’s finding?
selections: A. “Listening to music through a streaming platform feels a lot more passive, since I don’t need to make any deliberate choices about what music I’m going to consume, like I do when buying digital downloads or records and CDs.”

B. “When I create playlists or choose songs to listen to, I often pick songs that I think the friends who are following me might be interested in listening to, rather than what I might actually prefer listening to in that moment.”
C. “Because the predictions the platform makes about what new songs I might like depend on my past listening habits, at times its recommendations can feel overly repetitive and unvarying.”
D. “The social aspects of music streaming make it really easy to create a sense of a shared listening experience with my friends, even if we aren’t in the same room.”
explanations: 中文解析： Walsh的研究表明，用户会因为社交功能的存在而更在意自己的听歌行为如何被他人看待feel more mindful of how their listening activities may be perceived（HDF），进而影响他们的听歌选择。B选项直接体现用户因关注朋友的看法而选择歌曲因为pick songs that friends might like，就是在意别人的看法 题目文本翻译： 许多音乐流媒体服务也作为社交媒体平台运作：通过让用户可以关注朋友并分享精心策划的播放列表或他们的听歌历史信息，这些平台使人们能够直接向他们的社交网络传达自己的音乐偏好和听歌活动。在一项2023年的研究中，研究员迈克尔·詹姆斯·沃尔什采访了一个流行音乐流媒体平台的频繁用户，以调查其社交媒体维度如何影响他们的听歌习惯。沃尔什发现，这些维度往往使研究参与者更加关注他们的听歌活动可能会被如何看待，这反过来又影响了他们如何管理这些活动。

question:
A student is writing a research paper on the history of irrigation in the southwestern United States, situating the development of Searsville Lake (a man-made body of water created in San Mateo County, California, in 1890) in a larger historical context. The student claims that some modern-day irrigation methods used in southwestern states, such as California, Arizona, and New Mexico, have a lineage that long predates the completion of Searsville Lake.

Which quotation from a historian best supports the student’s claim?
selections: A. “The irrigation system developed by the Hohokam people in what is now central Arizona in the 7th century CE was simple but made use of hydraulic engineering design principles that are still utilized by today’s engineers.”
B. “The importance of the development of irrigation infrastructure in the American Southwest today cannot be overstated, since it is the most common means of conveying water for food production.”
C. “In the decades following the Second World War, irrigation of arid areas for agriculture increased to such a degree that it now accounts for roughly 70% of the world’s water usage.”

D. “Sprinkler irrigation systems, which were developed in the late 20th century, are a convenient technique of irrigating that makes use of machinery in order to spray water in all directions. Many areas of the Southwestern United States are currently irrigated by this method.”
explanations: 中文解析： 需要找到证明"西南部灌溉技术有古老起源"的历史学家论述。直接提到7世纪霍霍坎人(Hohokam)的灌溉系统，并指出其设计原理至今仍被使用，完全匹配"lineage that long predates"的要求。 题目文本翻译： 一名学生正在撰写一篇关于美国西南部灌溉历史的研究论文，将塞尔斯维尔湖（一个于1890年在加利福尼亚州圣马特奥县创建的人造水体）的发展置于更大的历史背景中。该学生声称，现代西南各州（如加利福尼亚州、亚利桑那州和新墨西哥州）使用的一些灌溉方法，其渊源早于塞尔斯维尔湖的完工。

Properties of TRAPPIST-1 Exoplanets Compared to Earth’s Properties Planet Orbital period (days) Planet radius (Earth radii) Earth 365.26 1 TRAPPIST-1b 1.51 1.09 TRAPPIST-1d 4.05 0.77 TRAPPIST-1e 6.1 0.92 TRAPPIST-1f 9.21 1.04 TRAPPIST-1 is a planetary system with a central red dwarf star and several Earth-sized exoplanets. question:
The Clouds is a 423 BCE play by Aristophanes, originally written in ancient Greek. At the time, professional intellectuals called sophists taught customers rhetorical techniques to use in public speaking, along with providing instruction in other subjects. In the play, Aristophanes satirizes sophists as having an exaggerated sense of their own wisdom, as seen when the character _______

Which choice most effectively uses a quotation from a translation of The Clouds to illustrate the claim?
selections: A. Socrates, a sophist, says to a customer, “You talk nonsense. Begone; I can’t teach you any longer.”

B. Strepsiades says of a sophist business, “There dwell men who in speaking of the heavens persuade people that it is an oven, and that it encompasses us, and that we are the embers. These men teach, if one give them money, to conquer in speaking, right or wrong.”
C. Strepsiades encourages his son to learn to be a sophist, saying, “Go, I entreat you. dearest of men, go and be taught.”
D. Socrates, a sophist, says to a new customer, “Come, then, take care that, whenever I propound any clever dogma about abstruse matters, you [seize] immediately.”
explanations: 中文解析： Exaggerated sense of their own wisdom 可以理解为"对自身智慧的自负夸大认知"，也就是自负，对应了D选项，苏格拉底（一位诡辩家）对新顾客说："那么来吧，注意了，每当我提出关于深奥问题的精妙教条时，你要立即掌握。自己觉得自己提出的都是clever dogma，还让别人立即学习，体现了了自负。 题目文本翻译： 《云》是阿里斯托芬创作于公元前 423 年的一部古希腊语戏剧。当时，被称为智者学派（sophists）的职业知识分子向顾客传授公共演讲的修辞技巧，同时还教授其他学科。剧中，阿里斯托芬讽刺这些智者们过分夸大自己的智慧，正如剧中人物_______时表现的那样

question:
Highest Major Summits in India Summit Elevation (meters) Mountain range Prominence (meters) Rimo I 7,385 Rimo Karakoram 1,438 Nanda Devi 7,816 Himalayas 3,139 Panchchuli II 6,904 Garhwa l Himalaya 1,614 Saser Kangri I/K22 7,672 Saser Karakoram 2,304 Langpo 6,965 Sikkim Himalaya 560 Mountain summits are often described in terms of their elevation, or height above sea level. But a summit’s elevation may not be as good an indication of how high the mountain appears to observers as is the summit’s prominence, or its height above its surroundings, and these values can differ significantly. For example, the Indian mountain of _______

selections: A. Saser Kangri I/ K22 has an elevation of 7,672 meters and is considered the highest mountain from the Saser Karakoram range.
B. Nanda Devi has a much higher prominence than does Langpo.
C. Nanda Devi has a high prominence but is from a different mountain range than Rimo I, which has a lower prominence.
