question:
The parks of Chicago, Illinois, seem to be making people happier. In a 2022 study, researchers studying connections between the physical location in which a social media post was ________ analyzed geotagged social media posts from various locations in Chicago. They found that posts from the city’s parks contained more words associated with happiness than other posts did.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. created and the post’s content
B. created, and the post’s content
C. created and the post’s content,
D. created, and the post’s content,
explanations: 句子主语是researchers，谓语是analyzed，主语和谓语之间不加逗号，studying做researchers的后置定语。connection between the physical location and the post’s content 两个事物并列，不用逗号，只用and 即可

question:
With an installed capacity of 35 megawatts, the Platanares geothermal power plant in Honduras offers a dependable source of renewable energy. Power plants like Platanares supply only a small fraction of Honduras’s ________ the scarcity of sites with the necessary combination of high-temperature geothermal reservoirs and fractured rock limiting the widespread development of such systems.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 后面填空所在句子的主语是power plants，谓语是supply，其他部分均为修饰成分，所以，空前后不应该有分号。排除A/B，though表达的第一句话和第二句话对比时，放在第二句话中间，做插入语，前后都需要加逗号。

question:
The album Irreversible .. .2012 by La Arrolladora Banda El Limón De René Camacho received much critical attention and praise for its contribution to the banda genre, a form of regional Mexican music featuring large ensembles of wind instruments and drums that first developed in southern and central Mexico in the mid-nineteenth century. ________ few were surprised when the album won the Best Banda Album award at the 2012 Latin Grammys.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 专辑《Irreversible...2012》由拉阿罗约达乐队（La Arrolladora Banda El Limón De René Camacho）发行，因其对班达音乐（banda genre）的贡献而受到广泛的关注和赞誉。班达音乐是一种区域性的墨西哥音乐，特色是使用大型的铜管乐器和鼓乐队，在十九世纪中叶首次在墨西哥南部和中部发展。因此，当该专辑在2012年拉丁格莱美奖中获得最佳班达专辑奖时，几乎没有人感到惊讶。 中文解析： 前面说这个album饱受赞誉，后面说大家不惊讶其获奖，前后一致，用因果关系therefore

question:
In 1920, the US Geological Survey determined the geographic center of Rhode Island using only a cardboard cutout of the state and a piece of string. ________ this apparently crude technique yielded a relatively close approximation: when the 1920 center was compared to a center determined by a computer program nearly a hundred years later, the two diverged by just a few miles.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在1920年，美国地质调查局仅使用一个纸板剪影和一根绳子确定了罗德岛的地理中心。________ 这种看似粗糙的技术却产生了相对接近的近似值：当1920年的中心与近百年后由计算机程序确定的中心进行比较时，二者仅相差几英里。 中文解析： 前面的方式很简单（crude），但是结果很精准（close approximation），前后对比用still

question:
In an ekphrastic poem, a poet explores a work of visual art, such as a drawing, sculpture, or painting. Elizabeth Alexander’s 2011 poem “Walking,” for example, meditates on Charles Alston’s 1963 painting Walking ; Cornelius Eady’s 2001 poem “Jacob Lawrence: Summer Street Scene,” ________ takes a painting as its subject: Jacob Lawrence’s 1948 work Summer Street Scene in Harlem .

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在一首描绘艺术作品的诗中，诗人探讨一件视觉艺术作品，例如绘画、雕塑或画作。例如，伊丽莎白·亚历山大的2011年诗作《散步》沉思于查尔斯·奥尔斯顿1963年的画作《散步》；而科尼利厄斯·伊迪的2001年诗作《雅各布·劳伦斯：夏日街景》，________ 以一幅画作为主题：雅各布·劳伦斯1948年的作品《哈莱姆的夏日街景》。 中文解析： 两个相近类型的例子之间用likewise，文中是一首诗歌分别思考了一副画作，又一首诗歌思考了一副画作（旧题变体）

question:
• Cinematographers work with cameras and lighting. • They help translate film directors’ ideas into visual images. • Frida (2002) was directed by Julie Taymor. • Rodrigo Prieto was the film’s cinematographer.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to provide an example of a film Prieto worked on?
selections: A. Cinematographer Rodrigo Prieto worked with director Julie Taymor.
B. The 2002 film Frida is one example of Rodrigo Prieto’s work as a cinematographer.
C. In filmmaking, directors work with others to translate their ideas into the visual images that we encounter on the screen.
D. As cinematographer, Rodrigo Prieto works with cameras and lighting to translate the film director’s ideas into visual images.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： • 摄影师与摄影机和灯光工作。 • 他们帮助将电影导演的想法转化为视觉图像。 • 《弗里达》（Frida，2002）由朱莉·泰默执导。 • 罗德里戈·普列托是该影片的摄影师。 中文解析： 题目需要一个电影的具体例子，根据第三条note，是Frida（2002），于是B选项正确

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • The Arabic word “dinar” comes from the Latin word “denarius.” • Today, nearly a dozen different national currencies are referred to as “dinars.” • Bahrain’s currency is known as the Bahraini dinar.

The student wants to provide an example of a country that uses the word “dinar” in the name of its currency. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The Latin word “denarius” is the origin of the Arabic word “dinar.”
B. Today, several countries use the word “dinar” in naming their currencies.
C. Bahrain uses the Bahraini dinar as its national currency.
D. Bahrain does not refer to its currency by the Latin word “denarius.”
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，学生做了以下笔记： • 阿拉伯语中的“第纳尔”一词源于拉丁语“德纳里乌斯”。 • 目前，近十种不同的国家货币被称为“第纳尔”。 • 巴林的货币被称为巴林第纳尔。 中文解析： 题目要求提供一个国家例子，根据第三条note们就是Bahrain，于是选择C

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • The ratio of the total mass of an element to the combined mass of all elements in a given environment is called the mass fraction. • The mass fraction of chromium (Cr) on Earth is 4,700 parts per million (ppm). • This indicates that the relative abundance of chromium on Earth is 0.47%. • The ratio of the total number of atoms of an element to the total number of all atoms in a given environment is called the mole fraction. • The mole fraction of chromium on Earth is 2,300,000 parts per billion (ppb). • This indicates that the relative abundance of chromium on Earth is 0.23%.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between mass fraction and mole fraction. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. On Earth, the mass fraction of chromium is 4,700 ppm, or 0.47%, and the mole fraction is 2,300,000 ppb, or 0.23%.
B. While mass fraction is a measure of relative mass and mole fraction is a measure of relative atom count, both indicate the relative abundance of elements on Earth.
C. Both mass and mole fraction express the relative abundance of chromium on Earth as a ratio of the total mass of chromium to the combined mass of all atoms.
D. The mass fraction of chromium indicates its relative mass; in addition, the element’s mole fraction indicates the relative number of chromium atoms.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记： • 元素的总质量与给定环境中所有元素的总质量之比称为质量分数。 • 地球上铬（Cr）的质量分数为4700百万分之一（ppm）。 • 这表明地球上铬的相对丰度为0.47%。 • 元素的总原子数与给定环境中所有原子总数之比称为摩尔分数。 • 地球上铬的摩尔分数为2300000十亿分之一（ppb）。 • 这表明地球上铬的相对丰度为0.23%。 中文解析： 题目要求强调mass fraction and mole fraction的相似性，于是B符合，它们都可以用来描述元素相对的量（relative abundance）

question: One of the factors of 2 x 3 + 44 x 2 + 234 x is x + b , where b is a positive constant. What is the smallest possible value of b ?
explanations: 约去2x得 x 2 + 22 x + 117 ，因式分解或者通过求解可得因式为（x+9）（x+13），取最小值9

question: A model estimates that at the end of each year from 2015 to 2020, the number of rabbits in a population was 170% more than the number of rabbits in the population at the end of the previous year. The model estimates that at the end of 2016, there were 216 rabbits in the population. Which of the following equations represents this model, where n is the estimated number of rabbits in the population t years after the end of 2015 and t ≤ 5 ?
explanations: 根据题意，170%more than得变化率为1+1.7=2.7，2016年数值216，反推2015年值为216/2.7=80，故选B

question: Note: Figure not drawn to scale. The figure shows a rectangular pool surrounded by a concrete path that is x feet (ft) wide on all sides. The pool is 21 ft long and 13 ft wide. The area of the concrete path is 240 f t 2 . What is the value of x ?
explanations: 根据题意大长方形长21+2x，宽13+2x，得（13+2x）（21+2x）-13*21=240，解此二次方程得x=3 or -20，排除负数得x=3，选A

question: The table shows three values of x and their corresponding values of y , where s is a constant. There is a linear relationship between x and y . Which of the following equations represents this relationship?
explanations: 代入选项验证得B

question: In a set of four consecutive odd integers, where the integers are ordered from least to greatest, the first integer is represented by x . The product of 28 and the third odd integer in the set is at most the value of 50 less than the sum of the first and fourth odd integers in the set. What is the greatest possible value of x ?
explanations: 连续4个奇数，第一个为x，后三个分别是x+2，x+4，x+6，代入题目表述的计算规则，28*（x+4）不大于第一第四个的和减50，故为28（x+4）≤x+x+6-50，解得x≤-6，因为x为奇数故只能为-7

question: A square map has a side length of 30 inches, and 1 inch on the map represents an actual distance of 17 miles. A smaller version of the same map is printed as a square with the side length 65% shorter than the side length of the previous map. On the smaller map, which of the following is closest to the actual distance, in miles, represented by 1 inch?
explanations: 1inch表示17mile，之后相同地图比例缩小65%，意味着0.35inch就表示17mile，所以每inch表示17/0.35=48.57mile，选D

question: The functions f and g are defined by the equations shown, where a and b are integer constants, a < b and b < 0 . If y = f ( x ) and y = g ( x ) are graphed in the xy -plane, which of the following equations displays, as a constant or coefficient, the y -coordinate of the y- intercept of the graph of the corresponding function? I. f ( x ) = a ( 2.1 ) x + b II.  g ( x ) = a ( 2.1 ) x + b
explanations: f ( 0 ) = a ( 2.1 ) b , g ( 0 ) = a + b ，这连个值都不是对应的a constant or coefficient（只有a或者b是），故选D

The following text is from Lilliam Rivera’s 2020 novel Never Look Back . The text describes the narrator arriving at his father’s apartment. “Pops, I’m here!” I drop my bag and set my guitar case against a wall. I place my keys on the bowl right next to the ceramic elephant Pops got me on one of his trips to Santo Domingo when I was a little kid. ©2020 by Lilliam Rivera

As used in the text, what does the word “place” most nearly mean?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文本来自莉莉安·里维拉（Lilliam Rivera）2020年的小说《永不回头》。文本描绘了叙述者到达他父亲公寓的情景。 “老爸，我到了！”我放下背包，把吉他盒靠在墙上。我把钥匙放在一个碗里，就在波普斯在我小时候去圣多明各旅行时给我买的陶瓷大象旁边。 ©2020 Lilliam Rivera 中文解析： place...on...将...放置之上, put意义一致

question:
One way to ________ the importance of a scholar’s research is to track how often other scholars refer to that research. For example, Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland economist Loretta J. Mester, who studies central banking, is among the world’s most frequently cited researchers in her field, indicating that her work has been quite significant.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一种评估学者研究重要性的方法是追踪其他学者引用该研究的频率。例如，研究中央银行的克利夫兰联邦储备银行经济学家洛雷塔·J·梅斯特是她所在领域中被引用频率最高的研究者之一，这表明她的工作相当重要。 中文解析： 衡量学术研究的意义用measure the importance

question:
Though most hoaxes perpetrated as jokes by mischievous users of Wikipedia, an online encyclopedia that almost anyone can freely edit, have quickly been detected and removed, a few fictitious entries, such as those for the American punk rock band The Deadweights and the 17th-century legislator Nicholas Burkhart, persisted on the site for many years before they were finally recognized as ________ and deleted.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： “尽管大多数捣蛋的维基百科用户作为玩笑而制造的恶作剧很快就被发现并删除，但一些虚构条目，比如美国朋克摇滚乐队The Deadweights和17世纪立法者尼古拉斯·伯克哈特的条目，在网站上存在多年，直到最终被认定为______并被删除。” 中文解析： prank表示玩笑，虚假，恶作剧和第一句的表意基本一致 （旧题重考）

question:
There are many famous examples of election pollsters making inaccurate predictions in presidential elections. But neuroscientist and election pollster Sam Wang has said that these prediction failures should not lead campaigns to ________ election polling entirely. Polling is about more than just predicting the winner; throughout campaigns, it helps strategists identify where their efforts are most likely to be effective.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 关于总统选举，许多著名的选举民意调查者做出了不准确的预测。但神经科学家兼选举民意调查员山姆·王表示，这些预测失败不应导致竞选活动完全______选举民意调查。民意调查不仅仅是为了预测赢家；在整个竞选过程中，它帮助策略师确定他们的努力最有可能有效的地方。 中文解析： 根据最后it helps ....说明polling是有一定帮助作用的，于是不应该被完全忽略should not neglect是合适的选择

question:
The following text is adapted from Virginia Woolf’s 1919 novel Night and Day . Katharine is the granddaughter of a celebrated poet. [Katharine’s] descent from [a celebrated poet] was no surprise to her, but matter for satisfaction, until, as the years wore on, certain drawbacks made themselves very manifest . Perhaps it is a little depressing to inherit not lands but an example of intellectual virtue; perhaps the conclusiveness of a great ancestor is a little discouraging to those who run the risk of comparison with him.

As used in the text, what does the word “manifest” most nearly mean?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文本改编自维吉尼亚·伍尔夫（Virginia Woolf）1919年的小说《夜与昼》。凯瑟琳是位著名诗人的孙女。 凯瑟琳对自己是这位著名诗人的后代并不感到惊讶，而是感到满意，直到随着岁月的流逝，某些缺点逐渐显现出来。或许，继承的不是土地，而是一种智力美德的典范，这让人感到有些沮丧；或许，伟大祖先的确凿性对那些面临与他比较风险的人来说也有些令人气馁。 中文解析： 大意是表达随着时间的推移，缺点越发明显，manifest在这里是明显的，evident是合适的选择。

question:
What is a city? The answer depends on where you live! Many countries define an area as a city based on how many people live there. However, not every country uses the same numbers. Albania defines a city as an area with a population of at least 400, while Greece defines a city as having a minimum population of 10,000. Some countries even define cities using other factors, like the number of buildings in the area.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It lists the number of cities in one country, then compares that number to the number of cities in another country.
B. It poses a question, then explains why the question has many answers.
C. It describes two locations, then explains why only one of the locations is considered a city.
D. It offers a recommendation, then provides reasons for that recommendation.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 什么是城市？这个问题的答案取决于你居住的地方！许多国家根据居民人数来定义一个地区为城市。然而，并不是每个国家使用相同的标准。阿尔巴尼亚将人口至少为400的地区定义为城市，而希腊则将人口最低为10,000的地区定义为城市。一些国家甚至使用其他因素来定义城市，比如该地区的建筑数量。 中文解析： 文本第一句提出了一个问题，这个问题的答案取决于你住在哪里，因为不同国家对“城市”的定义不同，解释了为什么这个问题有很多答案，

question:
The following text is from Bram Stoker’s 1911 novel The Lair of the White Worm . Adam is meeting his great-uncle Richard at a port. The meeting so auspiciously begun proceeded well. Adam, seeing that the old man was interested in the novelty of the ship, suggested that he should stay the night on board, and that he would himself be ready to start at any hour and go anywhere that the other suggested. This affectionate willingness to fall in with his own plans quite won the old man’s heart. He warmly accepted the invitation, and at once they became not only on terms of affectionate relationship, but almost like old friends.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. It describes why Adam and his great-uncle Richard are excited for their upcoming journey on the ship.
B. It contrasts great-uncle Richard’s wary first impressions of Adam with his ultimate affection toward him.
C. It showcases how Adam’s flexibility and consideration strengthen his relationship with his great-uncle Richard.
D. It states the reasons why Adam and his great-uncle Richard decide to sleep on the ship rather than finding lodging on land.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文本来自布拉姆·斯托克（Bram Stoker）1911年的小说《白色蠕虫的巢穴》。亚当正在港口与他的曾叔祖理查德见面。 这次开局颇为顺利的会面进行得很顺利。亚当看到老人对船的新奇感兴趣，便建议他留宿船上，并表示自己随时准备出发，去任何老人所建议的地方。这种愿意顺应老人计划的深情态度深深打动了老人。他热情地接受了邀请，立刻两人不仅建立了亲密的关系，几乎还像老朋友一样亲近。 中文解析： Adam注意到Richard对船的新奇感兴趣，主动建议Richard在船上过夜，并表示自己愿意随时出发，配合Richard的计划。Adam的这种灵活体贴和愿意配合的态度赢得了Richard的好感，两人迅速建立了亲密的关系，几乎像老朋友一样，C符合这个意义。

question:
A team of researchers discovered that Matabele ants can identify an infected wound in a member of the colony and then treat the infection by covering the wound with antimicrobial secretions that the ants produce. The team found that the mortality rate for Matabele ants with infected injuries was reduced by 90% with this treatment, and they are hopeful that this discovery could aid in the development of new antibiotics for human use.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It identifies an issue concerning Matabele ants and then proposes a solution to address the issue.
B. It summarizes research findings on Matabele ants and then identifies an area for further research.
C. It describes unique properties of Matabele ants and then speculates on how those properties evolved.
D. It introduces a study of Matabele ants and then explains the research methods used in the study.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一组研究人员发现，马塔贝尔蚂蚁能够识别出群体中成员的感染伤口，然后通过用蚂蚁自身产生的抗菌分泌物覆盖伤口来治疗感染。研究团队发现，通过这种治疗，感染伤口的马塔贝尔蚂蚁的死亡率降低了90%，他们对这一发现能够帮助开发新的用于人类的抗生素感到 hopeful。 中文解析： 文本开头提到研究人员发现，Matabele蚂蚁能够识别同伴的感染伤口，并用自身产生的抗菌分泌物治疗伤口。接着说明，这种治疗方法将感染伤口的蚂蚁死亡率降低了90%，最后提到，这一发现可能有助于开发人类使用的新型抗生素。按顺序概括文本的结构是：先总结研究发现，然后指出这一发现可能带来的进一步应用。

question:
Archaeologists have observed similarities in the tools, such as bidirectional blades, uncovered at the Neolithic-period Mesopotamian settlement of Çayönü Tepesi and those uncovered at roughly contemporaneous settlements elsewhere in Southwest Asia, including those in the South Levant, Central Anatolia, and Central Zagros. Although similarities in tools could be attributed to imitative behavior or trade, Nefize Ezgi Altınışık et al. found evidence of genetic affinity among the populations of Çayönü Tepesi, Central Anatolia, the South Levant, and—to a lesser extent—Central Zagros.

Information in the text best supports which statement about the finding made by Altınsțik et al.?
selections: A. It suggests that in the Neolithic period, people in the South Levant and Central Anatolia imitated tool designs originating in Çayönü Tepesi more frequently than people in Central Zagros did.
B. It helps explain why contemporaneous Neolithic peoples in Southwest Asia had similar tools but lacked other obvious cultural similarities.
C. It raises the possibility that similarities in the design of tools found at Neolithic settlements in Southwest Asia emerged due to population blending between those settlements.
D. It implies that people and tools likely arrived in ÇayönüTepesi from settlements in Central Anatolia and the South Levant at an earlier time than they did from settlements in Central Zagros.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 考古学家观察到，在新石器时代美索不达米亚定居点Çayönü Tepesi出土的工具（如双向刀片）与在西亚西南部其他大致同时期的定居点出土的工具之间存在相似性，包括南黎凡特、中安纳托利亚和中扎格罗斯的定居点。尽管工具的相似性可能归因于模仿行为或贸易，但Nefize Ezgi Altınışık等人发现了Çayönü Tepesi、中安纳托利亚、南黎凡特，以及在较小程度上中扎格罗斯的人群之间存在的遗传亲缘关系的证据。 中文解析： 考古学家在其他西南亚地区的新石器时代遗址中发现了相似的工具（如双向刀片）。虽然这些相似性可能归因于模仿行为或贸易，但Nefize Ezgi Altınışık等人的研究发现，Çayönü Tepesi居民之间存在遗传上的亲缘关系。它提出了一个可能性，即在西南亚新石器时代遗址中发现的工具设计相似性可能是由于这些遗址之间的人口混合所致。毕竟工具和基因都相似

question:
The following text is from Mark Haber’s 2022 novel Saint Sebastian’s Abyss . The narrator and Schmidt are both art critics. When my first wife admitted to Schmidt over dinner that she didn’t find art, painting in particular, especially compelling, Schmidt winced, set down his fork, and sighed dramatically; he then excused himself, explaining an appointment he’d forgotten about had suddenly and inexplicably been remembered, while making it abundantly clear there was no appointment at all. ©2022 by Mark Haber

Based on the text, what is notable about Schmidt’s behavior?
selections: A. Schmidt is only given to theatrical behavior when in the company of the narrator and his first wife.
B. Schmidt conveys his feelings about one of his dining companions without explicitly stating them.
C. Schmidt’s absentmindedness regarding his schedule is uncharacteristic of him.
D. Schmidt’s departure is occasioned by the resumption of a previous disagreement with the narrator’s first wife about a particular painting.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文本来自马克·哈伯（Mark Haber）2022年的小说《圣塞巴斯蒂安的深渊》。叙述者和施密特都是艺术评论家。 当我的第一任妻子在晚餐时向施密特承认她并不觉得艺术，尤其是绘画，特别吸引人时，施密特皱了皱眉，放下了叉子，戏剧性地叹了口气；然后他借口有个他忘记了的约会突然莫名其妙地被想起，离开了，同时明确表示根本没有任何约会。 ©2022 马克·哈伯 中文解析： Schmidt通过夸张的动作反应和找借口离开，清楚地表达了他对叙述者第一任妻子（one of dining companions）对艺术看法的失望，尽管他没有直接说出来(without stating them)。

question:
Dos Mujeres ( Salvadora y Herminia ) is a painting by Frida Kahlo, dated 1928. It’s part of the full collection of the Museum of Fine Arts, Boston, in Boston, Massachusetts. A digital image of it can also be found in an online collection. In a paper, a student claims that people usually spend more time viewing a work of art in a museum than they do online.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the underlined claim?
selections: A. Most people spend about three minutes viewing Dos Mujeres ( Salvadora y Herminia ) at the museum and only about one minute viewing it online.
B. Dos Mujeres ( Salvadora y Herminia ) isn’t the only work of art by Frida Kahlo that has been put online.
C. Most people who go to museums in Boston are visiting from other places.
D. More than one museum has works of art by Frida Kahlo in its full collection.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 《两位女性》（Salvadoray Herminia）是弗里达·卡洛（Frida Kahlo）于1928年创作的一幅画作。它是马萨诸塞州波士顿美术馆的完整收藏的一部分。该作品的数字图像也可以在网上收藏中找到。在一篇论文中，一名学生声称，人们在博物馆中观看艺术作品的时间通常比在线上观看的时间要长。 中文解析： 一位学生声称人们在博物馆观赏一幅艺术作品时通常会花费比在线观赏更多的时间，于是A选项的3分钟和1分钟时间数据最直接支持学生的说法。（旧题重考）

question:
Poems is an 1895 collection of poetry by Frances E. W. Harper. In one of Harper’s poems, the speaker suggests that those who mistreat people with less privilege will eventually receive divine judgment for it, saying, ________

Which quotation from Poems most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “Men may tread down the poor and lowly, / May crush them in anger and hate, /But surely the mills of God’s justice/ Will grind out the grist of their fate.” (from “An Appeal to My Countrywomen”)
B. “When ye plead for the wrecked and fallen, / The exile from far-distant shores, /Remember that men are still wasting/ Life’s crimson around your own doors.” (from “An Appeal to My Countrywomen”)
C. “Say not the age is hard and cold——/I think it brave and grand; / When men of diverse sects and creeds/ Are clasping hand in hand.” (from “The Present Age”)
D. “God help our native land, / Bring surcrise to her strife, / And shower from thy hand/A more abundant life.” (from “God Bless Our Native Land”)
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 《诗集》是弗朗西斯·E·W·哈珀（Frances E. W. Harper）于1895年出版的一部诗歌集。在哈珀的一首诗中，发言者暗示，那些虐待较少特权的人最终会受到神圣的审判，并说：______ 中文解析： 题目要求支持“那些虐待弱势群体的人最终会受到神圣审判”这一观点的引文。选项A. “Men may tread down the poor and lowly, / May crush them in anger and hate, / But surely the mills of God’s justice / Will grind out the grist of their fate.”大意是：尽管人们可能践踏穷人和弱者，但上帝的正义之磨终将磨出他们的命运，直接呼应了“神圣审判”的主题。符合要求

question:
To measure whether countries in free trade agreements (FTAs) —agreements among nations to reduce tariffs, duties, and other trade barriers—experience changes in total agricultural exports, economist Kayode Ajewole and colleagues calculated average export growth rates for several countries over the five years before and the five years after entering an FTA with the United States. The graph shows the results for three countries in the study. Consulting the graph, a student claims that joining an FTA increases the rate of growth of a country’s total agricultural exports.

Which choice best describes data from the graph that weaken the student’s claim?
selections: A. All the countries shown had positive growth in agricultural exports over the five years after joining their respective FTAs, but their rates of export growth varied.
B. Although agricultural exports from Jordan decreased over the five years before JOFTA, a reversal in this trend was observed over the five years after Jordan joined JOFTA.

C. Over the five years after Costa Rica joined CAFTA-DR, agricultural exports from Costa Rica grew at a rate of about 13.5 percent, which is higher than the rate over the five years before Costa Rica joined the agreement.
D. Although agricultural exports from Morocco grew over the five years after Morocco joined MAFTA, their growth rate was even higher in the five years before MAFTA.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 为了衡量签署自由贸易协议（FTA）的国家——即各国之间减少关税、税费和其他贸易壁垒的协议——是否经历了总农业出口的变化，经济学家凯奥德·阿杰沃勒（Kayode Ajewole）及其同事计算了多个国家在与美国签署自由贸易协议前五年和后五年的平均出口增长率。图表显示了研究中三个国家的结果。根据图表，一名学生声称，加入自由贸易协议会增加一个国家总农业出口的增长率。 中文解析： 文本的最后一句结论时说加入FTA会增加growth rate，但是Morocco加入前的增长率更高，于是可以反驳这个结论，选择D选项。（旧题重考）

question:
Born in Chile in 1917, artist and ethnomusicologist Violeta Parra was a pioneer in the nueva canción chilena (Chilean New Song) movement that emerged in the late 1950s and then spread throughout Latin America, Portugal, and Spain as nueva canción . Parra traveled all over Chile compiling extensive records of authentic folk music as well as recipes, proverbs, and other facets of cultural history. These records formed the foundation for the early movement’s revival of traditional Chilean folk forms in new songs that represented modern realities of the working class and strongly advocated for social change. As the movement spread beyond Chile, the breadth of musical traditions incorporated into its foundation also expanded.

Which detail about songs associated with nueva canción , if true, would best illustrate the underlined claim?
selections: A. Many feature political commentary addressing contemporary issues that stemmed from shared experiences of European colonization in Latin American countries.
B. Many demonstrate the stylistic influence of corrido , a genre of narrative songs from Mexico that had come to be characterized by political themes in the early 1800s.
C. Many were produced by Argentinian artists in the late 1950s, with others by artists in additional Latin American countries first emerging soon after.
D. Many were written with parts meant to be played on the quena , a traditional flute used across Andean countries, including Chile.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 出生于1917年的智利艺术家和民族音乐学家维奥莱塔·帕拉（Violeta Parra）是20世纪50年代末兴起的智利新歌运动（nueva canción chilena）的先驱，该运动随后传播到整个拉丁美洲、葡萄牙和西班牙，统称为新歌（nueva canción）。帕拉在智利各地旅行，广泛收集真实民间音乐的记录，以及食谱、谚语和其他文化历史的方面。这些记录为早期运动复兴传统智利民间形式的新歌曲奠定了基础，这些歌曲代表了工人阶级的现代现实，并强烈倡导社会变革。随着这一运动超越智利扩展，其基础所融入的音乐传统的广度也随之扩大。 中文解析： 划线部分的意思是，随着新歌运动（nueva canción）传播到智利以外，其音乐传统的基础也变得更加广泛，B符合要求提到许多歌曲展示了墨西哥叙事歌曲“corrido”的风格影响，这种歌曲在19世纪初就以政治主题为特征。直接说明新歌运动融入了墨西哥的元素，支持了音乐传统基础扩展的说法。

question:
Cy Twombly, a US painter and sculptor, created many large-scale abstract works, such as his 10-painting series Fifty Days at Iliam . In these works, Twombly’s artistic style is exemplified by his use of graffiti-like ________ often incorporate words or phrases from poetry and mythology.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: that引导定语从句修饰前面的scribbles（涂鸦，乱花），不用符号分割

question:
Kizomba, a genre of dance that originated in Angola, has become an international ________ 2022, the Indian dance duo known as Elvis and Namrata defeated performers from around the world to win the annual Olympiads of Kizomba competition held in Paris, France, becoming the first ever Asian winners.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 前后完整的句子连接，需要用句号

question:
While some computer scientists, such as Michael Running Wolf, are optimistic about the use of large language models (LLMs) to preserve endangered Indigenous languages, researchers like Aliya Bhatia of the Center for Democracy and Technology ________ that from an archival standpoint, English-based LLMs may do more harm than good, given their propensity for error.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主语是researchers，谓语不能用三单形式，于是选择fear

question:
As a leader of the National Woman Suffrage Association in the late 1800s, Olympia Brown of ________ an important role in the campaign to secure voting rights for US women.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主语Olympia Brown of Connecticut和谓语played之间不用符号分割

question:
In astrophysics, a ring of debris orbiting a larger object within the object’s Roche limit is expected to persist as a ring, whereas a ring of debris orbiting outside this limit would likely accrete into a satellite (e.g., a moon). Bruno Morgado and colleagues, ________ detected a dense ring of material orbiting the trans-Neptunian object Quaoar at a distance of 2,500 miles, well outside the calculated Roche limit of 1,100 miles, that has remained intact.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在天体物理学中，围绕较大物体在其罗氏极限（Roche limit）内运行的 debris 环预计会保持为环状，而在这一极限之外运行的 debris 环则可能会聚集成卫星（例如，月球）。布鲁诺·莫尔加多（Bruno Morgado）及其同事 ________ 发现了一圈密集的物质环绕着越过海王星的天体夸奥尔（Quaoar）以2,500英里的距离运行，这一距离远远超出了计算得出的1,100英里的罗氏极限，并且该环保持完好。 中文解析： 一个在较大物体的Roche limit内绕其运行的碎片环预计会保持为环状，而在这个极限外绕行的碎片环则可能会聚集成卫星（例如，月亮）。布鲁诺·莫尔加多（Bruno Morgado）及其同事发现了一个密集的物质环，它绕海王星外天体夸奥尔（Quaoar）运行，距离为2,500英里，远超出计算的1,100英里的洛希极限，但这个环却仍然保持完整。矛盾点在于我们认为这些环绕的碎片会聚集成卫星，但是发现确实完整的环状，于是用though连接表示对比。

question:
A team led by Portuguese researcher Isabel C. E. R. Ferreira found that many species of mushrooms contain chemicals called phenolic compounds, such as protocatechuic acid and biochanin. ________ Ferreira detected protocatechuic acid in Agaricus bisporus mushrooms and biochanin in Ganoderma lucidum mushrooms.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 由葡萄牙研究员伊莎贝尔·C·E·R·费雷拉（Isabel C. E. R. Ferreira）领导的团队发现，许多种类的蘑菇含有称为酚类化合物的化学物质，例如原儿茶酸（protocatechuic acid）和生物香豆素（biochanin）。 ________ 费雷拉在双孔蘑菇（Agaricus bisporus）中检测到了原儿茶酸，在灵芝（Ganoderma lucidum）中检测到了生物香豆素。 中文解析： 第一句整体讲在菌类中有酚类化合物的化学物质，第二局则是具体的蘑菇中发现的具体酚类化合物，前后是普遍到具体的举例关系。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • Hina Hanta is an online archive curated by the Choctaw Nation of Oklahoma. • It features images of cultural artifacts relevant to the history of the Choctaw people. • It features household items, including a cup ( isht ishko in Choctaw ) made from clay. • The cup was made in 1891. • Hina Hanta features sports apparel, including a stickball collar ( innuchi ) made from horsehair. • The stickball collar was made in 2016.

The student wants to make a generalization about the Hina Hanta archive. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The Choctaw name for the clay cup is isht ishko .
B. Included in the Hina Hanta online archive is a clay cup.
C. The horsehair stickball collar( innuchi ) was made in 2016.
D. Not all artifacts in the Hina Hanta archive are from the 1800s.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记： • Hina Hanta 是由俄克拉荷马州乔克托族（Choctaw Nation）策划的在线档案馆。 • 它展示了与乔克托人民历史相关的文化艺术品的图像。 • 其中包括家居用品，如用粘土制成的杯子（在乔克托语中称为 isht ishko）。 • 该杯子于1891年制作。 • Hina Hanta 还展示了运动服装，包括用马毛制成的棒球领（在乔克托语中称为 innuchi）。 • 该棒球领于2016年制作。 中文解析： 题目要求a generalization about the Hina Hanta archive，于是只有D符合not all artifacts are from 1800s 是generalization的表达，其它选项都是要么和Hina Hanta不相关，要么是细节

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • Most of the plant and bird species in Oahu, Hawaii, are non-native. • In a 2019 study, researchers wanted to know what role non-native birds play in dispersing plant seeds in Oahu. • Researchers catalogued plant seeds found in fecal samples from non-native birds. • Clermontia kakeana , a flowering shrub, was one of fifteen native species catalogued. • Ardisia elliptica, a tree, was one of twenty-nine non-native species catalogued. • Researchers concluded that non-native birds play a vital role in dispersing the seeds of native and non-native plants.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two plants. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Seeds from Clermontia kakeana and Ardisia elliptica plants were found in the fecal samples of non-native Hawaiian birds, according to a 2019 study.
B. A 2019 study catalogued plant seeds found in bird fecal samples in Oahu, Hawaii, to determine what role non-native birds play in seed dispersal.
C. Most plant species found in Oahu, Hawaii, like Ardisia elliptica , are non-native.
D. Though Clermontia kakeana and Ardisia elliptica can both be found in Oahu, Hawaii, only the former plant is native.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记： • 夏威夷瓦胡岛（Oahu）的大多数植物和鸟类物种都是外来物种。 • 在2019年的一项研究中，研究人员想知道外来鸟类在瓦胡岛传播植物种子中发挥了什么作用。 • 研究人员对从外来鸟类的粪便样本中发现的植物种子进行了分类。 • Clermontia kakeana（一种开花灌木）是被分类的十五种本土物种之一。 • Ardisia elliptica（一种树木）是被分类的二十九种外来物种之一。 • 研究人员得出结论，外来鸟类在传播本土和外来植物种子方面发挥了重要作用。 中文解析： emphasize a difference between the two plants，于是D选项指出一个是native，另一个是non-native，符合要求

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • Gianpaolo Bellini is an Italian particle physicist. • Particle physicists study subatomic particles. • Neutrinos are some of the least understood subatomic particles. • Neutrinos were first discovered in the mid-twentieth century. • Bellini is known for his research on solar and geoneutrinos.

The student wants to provide an example of a particle physicist whose research focuses on neutrinos. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Neutrinos are a type of subatomic particle that particle physicists are still trying to understand.
B. By studying solar and geoneutrinos—to name just one example—particle physicists can learn more about neutrinos.
C. Particle physicist Gianpaolo Bellini is known for his research on solar and geoneutrinos.
D. The research done on solar and geoneutrinos exemplifies the work particle physicists do to advance our understanding of subatomic particles.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记： • 贾帕洛·贝利尼（Gianpaolo Bellini）是一位意大利粒子物理学家。 • 粒子物理学家研究亚原子粒子。 • 中微子是一些最不为人知的亚原子粒子。 • 中微子首次是在20世纪中叶被发现的。 • 贝利尼因其对太阳中微子和地球中微子的研究而闻名。 中文解析： 题目要求provide an example of a particle physicist，A满足要求，因为有具体的人Gianpaolo Bellini（旧题重考）

question:
Text corpora such as the Brown Corpus are enormous collections of electronically stored texts that can be used for empirical testing of hypotheses regarding the frequency of typical word usage. For example, a linguist who assumes that the word “know” appears quite often in written English could ________ that assumption with data from a corpus: “know” is the eighth most commonly used verb.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 文本语料库，如布朗语料库，是存储大量文本的电子集合，可以用于实证检验关于典型单词使用频率的假设。例如，假设一位语言学家认为“know”这个词在书面英语中出现得非常频繁，他可以通过语料库中的数据来验证这一假设：“know”是第八常用的动词。 中文解析： substantiate表示证实，语料库的数据可以用来证实语言学家关于“know”使用频率的假设，因为数据支持了这一假设。（旧题变体重考）

question:
Gertrude Ederle, who was the first woman to swim across the English Channel, and Wanda Rutkiewicz, who was the first woman to summit K2 (the second tallest mountain in the world), are ensured lasting places in our historical memory. No matter what others may do in the future, nobody can ever ________ these women as the first to accomplish these feats.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 格特鲁德·埃德尔（Gertrude Ederle），她是第一位游泳横渡英吉利海峡的女性；还有旺达·鲁特基维奇（Wanda Rutkiewicz），她是第一位登顶K2（世界第二高峰）的女性，这些人都在我们的历史记忆中占据了持久的位置。无论其他人未来会做什么，没有人能够 ________ 这两位女性，作为完成这些壮举的第一人。 中文解析： supplant表示取代，因为无论未来其他人做什么，都无法取代Gertrude Ederle和Wanda Rutkiewicz作为首位完成这些壮举的女性。（旧题变体重考）

question:
During the 2007-2010 financial crisis, the United States furnished billions of dollars to selected countries’ central banks via mechanisms called swap lines. Aditi Sahasrabuddhe found that countries’ policy environments seem to have been ________ swap-line decisions: the probability that banks would be granted swap lines was 0.20 in countries open to foreign-capital inflows and 0.03 in countries with policies restricting such inflows.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在2007-2010年的金融危机期间，美国通过一种称为互换协议的机制向特定国家的中央银行提供了数十亿美元。阿迪蒂·萨哈斯拉布德（Aditi Sahasrabuddhe）发现，国家的政策环境似乎影响了 ________ 互换协议的决定：在对外资流入持开放态度的国家，银行获得互换协议的概率为0.20，而在限制此类流入的国家，这一概率仅为0.03。 中文解析： 较少人知晓material可以做形容词，表示对...至关重要， 词组be material to在描述policy environment 对于swap line（货币互换额度）产生重要的影响，前面是原因，后面是结果；如果用B或D选项大意表示基于...依赖，会导致因果颠倒，C选项decouple表示分割，断开

question:
The Darlington is just one of approximately three million known historical shipwrecks spread throughout the world’s oceans, and their impact on sea life and underwater ecosystems is of great interest to researchers. Rachel Moseley and colleagues were particularly curious about the effects of wooden shipwrecks on seafloor microbial communities. The researchers studied two wooden shipwrecks in the Gulf of Mexico by placing pieces of pine and oak between zero and 200 meters away from each shipwreck to collect samples of three kinds of microbes: bacteria, archaea, and fungi. They found that across the three microbial communities, peak diversity and richness was observed on pine and oak samples placed approximately 125 meters from the shipwrecks.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It introduces a study of microbial communities near shipwrecks that has received significant scholarly attention, summarizes the results of that study, and then describes a research team’s reaction to the study.
B. It states the number of known shipwrecks, describes the historical significance of one of those shipwrecks, and then comments on the various microbes found at the shipwreck site.
C. It names a famous historical shipwreck, describes the type of wood used to build that ship, and then explains how that wood type influences underwater microbial communities.
D. It notes a general scientific interest in shipwrecks’ ecological effects, describes a specific study related to that interest, and then states one of the study’s findings.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 达林顿号（The Darlington）只是全球约三百万个已知历史沉船中的一个，这些沉船遍布世界海洋，它们对海洋生物和水下生态系统的影响引起了研究人员的极大兴趣。瑞秋·莫斯利（Rachel Moseley）及其同事特别关注木质沉船对海底微生物群落的影响。研究人员在墨西哥湾研究了两艘木质沉船，通过在离每艘沉船零到200米的范围内放置松木和橡木的样本，以收集三种微生物的样本：细菌、古菌和真菌。他们发现，在这三种微生物群落中，约在距沉船125米的位置，松木和橡木样本的多样性和丰富度达到了最高峰。 中文解析： 在这个问题中，首先介绍了一个受到学术界关注的研究，然后是具体的研究，最后描述了研究团队的发现。这个选项最准确地概括了文本的整体结构。（旧题重考）

question:
The following text is from Yung Wing’s 1909 memoir My Life in China and America. Yung Wing was the first person from China to graduate from a US university. Little did I realize when in 1845 I wrote, while in the Morrison School, a composition on “An Imaginary Voyage to New York and up the Hudson,” that I was to see New York in reality. This incident leads me to the reflection that sometimes our imagination foreshadows what lies uppermost in our minds and brings possibilities within the sphere of realities.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It indicates Yung’s unwillingness to distinguish between reality and fantasy as a child.
B. It foreshadows Yung’s future difficulties in publishing his writings.
C. It describes an event in Yung’s life that exemplifies a phenomenon.
D. It illustrates the sense of adventure that Yung developed as a child.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文字摘自容闾（Yung Wing）于1909年所著的回忆录《我在中国和美国的生活》（My Life in China and America）。容闾是第一位从中国毕业于美国大学的人。 我在1845年于莫里森学校（Morrison School）写下关于“想象中的纽约之旅及沿哈德逊河”的作文时，完全没有意识到我将会亲自看到纽约。这一事件让我反思，有时我们的想象会预示出心中最深处的想法，并将可能性带入现实的领域。 中文解析： 第一句话的功能是描述生活中的一个事件，这个事件例证了第二句话中的一种现象，即想象可能预示未来并成为现实。

question:
Paintings by the Florida Highwaymen—an informal collective of prolific landscape artists active in Florida during the 1950s and ’60s—are recognizable by their reiteration of the same general compositional structures and subjects: moonlit waters and poinciana trees, to name two. But there was room for individuation: Al Black’s Sunset Backwater Scene with Egrets , for example, may resemble other Highwaymen paintings at first glance, but his works stand out for their comparative bleakness and minimalism.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It describes an aesthetic framework shared by a particular group of artists and then makes and illustrates the claim that individuals introduced variations within that framework.
B. It describes the common perception that a particular group of artists’ works are derivative and then provides a specific piece of evidence that reinforces that perception.
C. It explains how a particular group of artists began collaborating and then recounts how one member of that group became especially influential among them.

D. It offers historical context that accounts for a particular group of artists’ shared style and then indicates the circumstances under which several members of that group began exploring more unconventional themes.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 佛罗里达公路艺人（Florida Highwaymen）是一个非正式的集体，活跃于1950年代和1960年代，成员们是高产的风景画家。他们的作品因重复相同的一般构图结构和主题而易于识别，例如月光下的水面和法兰西树（poinciana）。但在作品中仍然有个性化的空间：例如，阿尔·布莱克（Al Black）的《夕阳下的湿地场景与白鹭》（Sunset Backwater Scene with Egrets）乍一看可能与其他公路艺人的画作相似，但他的作品因其相对的阴郁感和极简主义而脱颖而出。 中文解析： 先描述一个highwaymen艺术家群体共享的美学框架，然后提出并举例说明个体艺术家在这一框架内引入了变化，尤其需要注意but转折和for example举例（旧题变型重考）。

question:
Text 1 is adapted from E. M. Forster’s 1910 novel Howards End . Text 2 discusses Howards End . King’s Cross and St. Pancras are adjacent railway terminals in London from which trains travel to the countryside. Text 1 To Margaret the station of King’s Cross had always suggested Infinity. Its very situation—withdrawn a little behind the facile splendours of St. Pancras—implied a comment on the materialism of life. Those two great arches, colourless, indifferent, shouldering between them an unlovely clock, were fit portals for some eternal adventure, whose issue might be prosperous, but would certainly not be expressed in the ordinary language of prosperity. Text 2 The interplay between opposing ideological positions in Howards End is broadly articulated in the novel’s organization of geographic space. On the one hand, the modern metropolis of London represents capitalism’s emphasis on pragmatism and the accumulation of material wealth; on the other; the English countryside, accessible via King’s Cross, fosters an idealism that values tradition, authentic personal connection, and the aesthetic—what the novel calls “the infinite.”

Based on the texts, the author of Text 2 would most likely agree with which statement about King’s Cross, as it is depicted in Text 1?
selections: A. As a point of connection between London and the countryside, King’s Cross suggests to Margaret the possibility of acquiring the intangible abundance promised by the kinds of authentic engagements that the novel’s rural spaces seem to offer.

B. Because it is situated at the beginning of Margaret’s journey from the city to the country, King’s Cross emblematizes the intrusion of the forces of materialism and modernity into the rural spaces that the novel associates with idealism and tradition.

C. The austerity conveyed by King’s Cross’s appearance mirrors Margaret’s disillusionment with the prospect of having authentic connections with other people in a world that chiefly values more conventional forms of prosperity.

D. King’s Cross has a relatively unassuming appearance whose sharp contrast with the more aesthetically pleasing appearance of St. Pancras suggests to Margaret the ascendancy of the pragmatic capitalistic outlook among London’s inhabitants.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 文本1摘自E. M.福斯特（E. M. Forster）于1910年出版的小说《霍华德庄园》（Howards End）。文本2讨论了《霍华德庄园》。国王十字车站（King’s Cross）和圣潘克拉斯车站（St. Pancras）是伦敦相邻的铁路终点站，从这里出发的列车通往乡村。 文本1 对于玛格丽特来说，国王十字车站总是让她联想到无穷无尽。它的地理位置——略微远离圣潘克拉斯的华丽辉煌——暗示了对物质生活的评论。那两座巨大的拱门，毫无色彩、漠不关心，肩负着一座丑陋的钟表，恰如其分地成为某种永恒冒险的门户，尽管结果可能是繁荣的，但肯定不会以普通的繁荣语言来表达。 文本2 《霍华德庄园》中对立意识形态之间的相互作用在小说的地理空间组织中得到了广泛的体现。一方面，现代大都市伦敦代表了资本主义对务实和物质财富积累的重视；另一方面，通过国王十字车站通往的英格兰乡村则孕育了一种理想主义，重视传统、真实的人际联系和美学——小说称之为“无限”。 中文解析： 第二篇尤其是末尾句回应了第一篇开头句；Margaret 认为 King’s Cross 车站象征着“无限”（Infinity），第二篇提到通过 King’s Cross 可以到达的英国乡村则代表理想主义，重视传统、真实的个人联系和美学即“无限” （infinity）。 A选项的基本意义是作为伦敦与乡村的连接点，King’s Cross 向 Margaret 暗示了获得乡村空间所承诺的无形丰富性的可能性。符合 Text 1 和 Text 2，King’s Cross 象征从物质主义到理想主义的过渡，与乡村的“无限”相联系。

question:
Though John Crowley, author of Engine Summer , is perhaps not as well known as the most commercially successful American writers of the past fifty years, his work has had several influential champions, including the poet John Hollander and the literary critic Harold Bloom. According to journalist Graeme Wood, Bloom claimed to have read Crowley’s novel Little , Big at least forty-six times, and in his posthumously published afterword to a 2022 edition of the book, Bloom rhetorically asked: “How many living authors of prose romance are universally relevant? Only Crowley.”

What is the main topic of the text?
selections: A. The similarities between the prose of John Crowley and the poetry of John Hollander
B. The characteristics of John Crowley’s work that make it universally relevant
C. The reason why the work of John Crowley is not as commercially successful as it deserves to be
D. The reception of the work of John Crowley
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 虽然《引擎夏季》（Engine Summer）的作者约翰·克劳利（John Crowley）或许没有过去五十年中最成功的美国作家那么知名，但他的作品却得到了几位有影响力的支持者，包括诗人约翰·霍兰德（John Hollander）和文学评论家哈罗德·布鲁姆（Harold Bloom）。据记者格雷姆·伍德（Graeme Wood）报道，布鲁姆声称自己至少读过克劳利的小说《小小大》（Little, Big）四十六次，并在他为该书2022年版后记中发表的遗作中反问道：“有多少当代散文小说的作者是普遍相关的？只有克劳利。” 中文解析： 讨论了John Crowley的作品如何受到像约翰·霍兰德和哈罗德·布鲁姆这样的影响力人物的评价，强调了布鲁姆Bloom对克劳利小说，特别是《小大》一书的钦佩,尤其是最后的反问句表达了对于Crowley的高度认可。（旧题变体）

question:
Minimum and Maximum Depths of Stony Coral Species in Caribbean and Indo-Pacific Waters Species Minimum depth ( meters ) Maximum depth ( meters ) Agaricia grahamae 20 115 Acropora striata 10 25 Danafungia scruposa 1 27 Acropora anthocercis 5 10 Some scientists have suggested that as ocean temperatures rise, many fish and corals found in the shallow zone (less than 30 meters below the surface) could take refuge in the cooler; darker mesophotic zone (30 to 150 meters below the surface). However, it isn’t clear that all such species will be able to tolerate mesophotic conditions. In 2018, Hudson Pinheiro and colleagues studied stony corals in the two zones in Caribbean and Indo-Pacific waters. Based on the depths at which those corals are now found, the species that seems least suited to a full migration to the mesophotic zone is ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
selections: A. Agaricia grahamae , because its minimum depth of 20 meters is in the shallow zone.
B. Acropora anthocercis , because its maximum depth of 10 meters is furthest from the mesophotic zone.
C. Acropora striata , because its maximum depth of 25 meters is close to but doesn’t reach the mesophotic zone.
D. Danafungia scruposa , because its minimum depth of 1 meter is the shallowest of those listed.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一些科学家建议，随着海洋温度的上升，许多生活在浅水区（距离水面30米以下）中的鱼类和珊瑚可能会躲避到较冷、较暗的中光带（距离水面30到150米）中。然而，目前尚不清楚所有这些物种是否都能适应中光带的条件。2018年，哈德森·皮尼罗（Hudson Pinheiro）和同事们在加勒比海和印度-太平洋水域研究了这两个区域的硬珊瑚。根据这些珊瑚目前所处的深度，似乎最不适合完全迁移到中光带的物种是______。 中文解析： 在问题中提到，根据这些石珊瑚目前被发现的深度，有些物种可能无法完全迁移到深层区域。因此，Acropora anthocercis最深区域才10 meters都不能接近mesophotic zone。（旧题变体）

question:
Rafael Núnez and colleagues studied how members of the Yupno, an Indigenous group in Papua New Guinea, conceptualize time in both spoken language and gestures. The researchers recorded Yupno speakers explaining certain temporal words and phrases, such as jare , a past-oriented expression that translates to “day before yesterday,” and coded each speaker’s manual gestures. Previous research has found a tendency in many cultures to make temporal distinctions along imagined linear axes: for instance, Hebrew speakers often refer to the right/ left axis to describe events in time. Some researchers believe this tendency is universal, but Nüñez and colleagues claim this is not the case.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support Núnez and colleagues’ claim?
selections: A. Yupno speakers typically use their left hand to make temporal gestures regardless of whether the gestures are past oriented or future oriented.
B. Future-oriented gestures used by Yupno speakers do not, on average, point in the opposite linear direction of past-oriented gestures.
C. Some Yupno grammatical structures used when talking about time are also used in Hebrew.
D. Yupno speakers were observed making temporal gestures both indoors and outdoors, though with greater frequency when indoors.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 拉斐尔·努涅斯（Rafael Núñez）及其同事研究了巴布亚新几内亚的土著群体尤普诺（Yupno）如何在口头语言和手势中概念化时间。研究人员记录了尤普诺语使用者解释某些时间词汇和短语的过程，例如“jare”，一个面向过去的表达，翻译为“前天”，并对每位说话者的手势进行了编码。先前的研究发现，许多文化中存在沿着想象的线性轴进行时间区分的倾向：例如，希伯来语使用者常常使用左右轴来描述时间中的事件。一些研究人员认为这种倾向是普遍存在的，但努涅斯及其同事声称情况并非如此。 中文解析： 这个题目需要反驳this tendency is universal, this tendency指的是temporal distinctions along imagined linear axes，B选项说明没有distinction on linear axes (like left/right axis),于是反驳了了文本的结论。

question:
Researchers investigated how enjoyment of a story is affected when it has been spoiled (when the reader has foreknowledge of an important plot development). As part of the study, participants rated their enjoyment of one story that was spoiled before they read it and one story that was unspoiled. For each story, participants who had been given a spoiler reported greater enjoyment than did those who hadn’t received a spoiler. But the degree of this difference varied across the stories, as is best illustrated by the enjoyment ratings for ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement?
selections: A. “Owl Creek Bridge” and “A Chess Problem.”
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 研究人员调查了故事被剧透（即读者对重要情节发展有先前了解）时，享受程度如何受到影响。作为研究的一部分，参与者评价了一个在阅读之前被剧透的故事和一个未被剧透的故事的享受程度。对于每个故事，收到剧透的参与者报告的享受程度高于那些没有收到剧透的参与者。但是，这种差异的程度在不同故事中有所不同，最能说明这一点的是对______的享受评级。 中文解析： 文本最后要求表述degree of difference varied,于是看柱状图差异最小的，和差异较大的就能符合要求，Owl Creek Bridge" and "A chess Problem符合要求，前者差异小，后者差异大，证明了varied

question:
Piezoelectric harvesters convert kinetic energy (resonance) to electrical energy, precluding the need for external electrical sources. The vibration of a spacecraft, for example, can provide sufficient energy to power many of its sensors piezoelectrically. A newly designed piezoelectric harvester incorporating a highly conductive carbon-fiber-reinforced polymer (CFRP) electrode has been shown to provide steady energy loads during resonance, an absolute prerequisite for wireless communication devices to be powered piezoelectrically.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the text’s claim about wireless communication devices?
selections: A. Intermittent or unpredictable electrical supply undermines the efficacy of wireless communication devices.
B. The near-constant kinetic vibration of a spacecraft makes it possible to power its wireless communication devices using only non-CFRP piezoelectric harvesters.
C. The CFRP electrode is incompatible with most wireless communication devices.
D. The high conductivity of the CFRP is what makes the energy output from a piezoelectric harvester sufficient for wireless communication devices.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 压电能量收集器将动能（共振）转化为电能，从而无需外部电源。例如，航天器的振动可以提供足够的能量，以压电方式为其许多传感器供电。一种新设计的压电能量收集器结合了高导电性的碳纤维增强聚合物（CFRP）电极，已被证明在共振期间能够提供稳定的能量负载，这是无线通信设备通过压电方式供电的绝对前提。 中文解析： 支持最后一句的claim，就需要突出CFRP电极的高导电性重要的前提意义，CFRP的作用是provide steady energy loads during resonance，也就是让sufficient energy be steady成为重要的前提，于是A选项正确，因为A指出不稳定就会undermine efficacy，也就是说稳定才是前提。

question:
Like many other genera of wild bees, bumblebees have in recent decades experienced population collapse caused by, among other factors, habitat destruction and climate variation. Bumblebees are also one of the most researched bee genera, second only to honeybees. As a result, ecologists have gained much of their insight about wild-bee declines from bumblebees. In a 2021 paper, zoologist Guillaume Ghisbain notes that bumblebees are among the relatively few wild-bee genera that display social behaviors and dietary generalism (ability to obtain nectar and pollen from a diversity of plant species), two traits that are associated with increased resilience to some specific environmental changes. Ghisbain therefore contends that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. because bumblebees and other bees with generalist diets are less negatively affected by environmental stress than bees with specialized diets are, they are less likely to experience major population changes in the future than bees with specialized diets are.

B. although bumblebees have been more extensively studied than most wild bees, researchers should not use bumblebees to draw conclusions about the decline of other wild bees, even ones with feeding patterns and levels of sociability that are similar to those of bumblebees.

C. although bumblebees and many other wild bees have experienced similar population declines in the past, compared with other wild bees, bumblebees are likely at greater risk of being harmed by climate variation than by habitat destruction.

D. because the responses of bumblebees and other wild bees to environmental threats are not always comparable, researchers need to exercise caution when extrapolating information about wild-bee population declines from bumblebees.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 像许多其他野生蜜蜂属一样，最近几十年来，蜜蜂（大黄蜂）经历了因栖息地破坏和气候变化等多种因素导致的人口崩溃。大黄蜂也是研究最多的蜜蜂属，仅次于蜜蜂。因此，生态学家从大黄蜂中获得了关于野生蜜蜂减少的许多见解。在2021年的一篇论文中，动物学家吉约姆·吉斯班（Guillaume Ghisbain）指出，大黄蜂是相对少数表现出社会行为和饮食广泛性（能够从多种植物物种中获取花蜜和花粉）的野生蜜蜂属，这两种特征与对某些特定环境变化的增加适应性相关。因此，吉斯班认为______。 中文解析： 这段文字讨论了大黄蜂在研究野生蜜蜂种群下降中的重要性，强调了它们的社会行为和多样化饮食使其在环境变化中更具韧性。选项D的意思是，由于大黄蜂和其他野生蜜蜂对环境威胁的反应可能不同，因此在将关于大黄蜂的研究结果推广到其他野生蜜蜂时，研究人员需要谨慎。（旧题重考）

question:
Microbial fuel cells (MFCs) capitalize on the ability of some species of bacteria to metabolize metal, liberating electrons. The bacteria form a dense biofilm on the surface of an electron-collecting anode, but moving the electrons from the bacterial cytoplasm to an external electrode requires that the electrons pass through a series of inefficient oxidation-reduction (redox) reactions. Accordingly, MFC power output rarely exceeds a density of 0.30 milliwatts per square centimeter (mW/cm²). In an experiment, researchers added silver nanoparticles to carbon paper covering the anode in an MFC. The resulting power density was 0.66 mW/cm². Since metals such as silver exhibit high electrical conductivity, the researchers hypothesized that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. silver nanoparticles may increase the metabolic processes of the bacteria, thereby increasing the number of free electrons available to transfer to the electrode.
B. as the density of the biofilm increases, the series of redox reactions may accelerate independent of the presence of the silver nanoparticles.
C. silver nanoparticles may allow electrons to bypass the series of redox reactions and transfer directly to the electrode.
D. electrons may be conducted directly to the electrode before the silver nanoparticles catalyze the redox reactions.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 微生物燃料电池（MFCs）利用某些细菌代谢金属的能力，从中释放电子。这些细菌在电子收集阳极的表面形成了密集的生物膜，但将电子从细菌细胞质转移到外部电极需要通过一系列低效的氧化还原反应。因此，MFC的功率输出很少超过0.30毫瓦每平方厘米（mW/cm²）。在一项实验中，研究人员在覆盖阳极的碳纸上添加了银纳米颗粒。由此产生的功率密度为0.66 mW/cm²。由于银等金属具有高电导率，研究人员假设______。 中文解析：根 据文本需要解释银纳米颗粒如何提高MFC的功率输出。银的高导电性可能使电子绕过低效的氧化还原反应，直接传递到电极。银纳米颗粒可能使电子绕过氧化还原反应，直接传递到电极。于是C正确

question:
The ratio of methane to other atmospheric constituents——represented by a measure called the methane mole fraction—influences a variety of meteorological phenomena, notably precipitation and humidity. For Titan, Saturn’s largest moon, the observational data that exist are too sparse and discrepant to fully constrain the range of the methane mole fraction at various atmospheric levels. Juan Lora and colleagues point out that outputs of the IPSL atmospheric model of Titan, which track closely to observations in some respects, reflect how the model’s developers responded to this challenge: by prescribing a uniform methane mole fraction for the lowest level of the atmosphere. It is therefore important to note that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. some disagreements between the model’s simulations of Titan’s precipitation and humidity and the moon’s actual precipitation and humidity are to be expected.
B. even though the model’s outputs sometimes agree with observational data, Titan’s real methane mole fraction is likely higher than the methane mole fraction used in the model.
C. further observations of Titan may clarify the moon’s methane mole fraction sufficiently for the model to employ a single value rather than a range.
D. inconsistencies across the model’s simulations of Titan’s precipitation and humidity could be attributable to variations in the moon’s methane mole fraction.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 甲烷与其他大气成分的比率——通过一种叫做甲烷摩尔分数的测量来表示——影响着多种气象现象，特别是降水和湿度。对于土星最大的卫星泰坦，目前的观测数据过于稀疏且存在差异，无法充分约束不同大气层中甲烷摩尔分数的范围。胡安·洛拉（Juan Lora）及其同事指出，IPSL泰坦大气模型的输出在某些方面与观测结果密切相关，反映了模型开发者如何应对这一挑战：通过为大气最低层规定一个统一的甲烷摩尔分数。因此，重要的是要注意______。 中文解析： 文本提到，由于观测数据稀疏且不一致，IPSL 大气模型在模拟 Titan 大气时采用了统一的甲烷摩尔分数。因此，模型对 Titan 降水和湿度的模拟与实际情况之间可能存在一些不一致，这是可以预期的。选项 D 最符合这一逻辑。

question:
An emulsifier is a type of compound that serves to stabilize an emulsion——a mixture of two or more liquids that otherwise would not easily blend together. In the cosmetics industry, emulsifiers such as cetyl hydroxyethylcellulose ________ to blend oil and water into homogeneous formulations, like lotions and perfumes.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子需要谓语，且是被动语态，于是选A

question:
Proto-Nilotic is a hypothesized ancestor of the Nilotic family of languages, and, as such, its theoretical linguistic properties ________ those traits common among its fifty-five Nilotic descendants, traits identified and compiled by way of comparative analyses.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子需要谓语，于是选B，其它都不能充当谓语

question:
At the Actors Gymnasium in Chicago, Illinois, students can study the Meisner technique. Developed in the mid-1900s by acting instructor Sanford Meisner, the technique emphasizes spontaneous reaction to an actor’s environment, and ________ methodology includes repetitive improvisation exercises to refine an actor’s natural responses.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 指代technique，单数的物主代词，于是选择its

question:
Author Jeffrey Auerbach disputes claims that London’s Great Exhibition of 1851 was a show of Victorian-era England’s economic ________ citing previously unpublished records of the exhibition’s planning commission, Auerbach makes the compelling argument that the event was foremost an attempt to boost a stagnating economy, not celebrate its supremeary.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 完整句子连接需要用分号，citing是分词作状语，逻辑主语是Auerbach

question:
Although P/2019 LD2 (Atlas) and 121725 Aphidas are both classified as centaur objects—outer solar system bodies in unstable orbits——they exhibit striking differences in ________ object P/2019 LD2 (Atlas) is considered an active centaur, showing sporadic comet-like activity (such as clouds of dust and gas on its surface),121725 Aphidas, showing no such activity, is considered dormant.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 冒号后解释冒号前，可以前后都是完整句子，while是从句，最后121725 Aphidas is considered dormant是主句。

question:
The parks of Dallas, Texas, seem to be making people happier. In a 2022 study, researchers studying connections between the physical location in which a social media post was ________analyzed geotagged social media posts from various locations in Dallas. They found that posts from the city’s parks contained more words associated with happiness than other posts did.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. created, and the post’s content
B. created and the post’s content
C. created, and the post’s content,
D. created and the post’s content,
explanations: 句子主语是researchers，谓语是analyzed，主语和谓语之间不加逗号，studying做researchers的后置定语。connection between the physical location and the post’s content 两个事物并列，不用逗号，只用and 即可

question:
Kyudō, a form of archery that originated in Japan, was not a medal sport at the 1964 Tokyo Summer Olympic Games. ________ kyudō was featured at the Games as a demonstration sport. Demonstration sports have been featured at past Olympics to showcase lesser-known or regionally significant sports.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 弓道，起源于日本的一种射箭形式，在1964年东京夏季奥运会上并不是正式的比赛项目。________弓道作为表演项目出现在奥运会上。表演项目曾在过去的奥运会上被用来展示较少人知晓或在某个地区具有重要意义的运动。 中文解析： 第一句说不是medal sport，第二句说是demonstration sport，用rather来连接，表示“而是”。

question:
As can be seen in the case of “Publius”—a pseudonym adopted by a trio of writers that included Alexander Hamilton—historians have deduced the likely authorship of many pseudonymous political essays published in the years following the American Revolutionary War; pen names such as “Democritus” and “Obadiah Spriggins,” ________remain as elusive as they once were to eighteenth-century audiences.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 正如“Publius”这一笔名的案例所示——这是由包括亚历山大·汉密尔顿在内的三位作家所采用的——历史学家们推测了许多在美国独立战争后发表的匿名政治散文的可能作者；诸如“Democritus”和“Obadiah Spriggins”等笔名，________对十八世纪的观众而言依然显得扑朔迷离。 中文解析： 前面是讲推断出了一些笔名的对应作者身份，后面举例的则是18世纪那些很难推断出来的一些笔名（elusive），前后对比，选择though

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • Documentary TV programs in the slow TV genre consist of uninterrupted broadcasts of ordinary events in real time. • Flâmsbana: Minutt for Minutt (running time:1 hour) is a Norwegian slow TV program that aired in 2010. • It documented a train ride from Myrdal station down to Flăm. • Hihna 247 (running time:12 hours) is a Finnish slow TV program that aired in 2017. • It documented a supermarket checkout aisle of the Prisma Kaari grocery store.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two TV programs. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. While Flâmsbana: Minutt for Minutt depicts a train ride from Myrdal station down to Flầm, Hihna 247 depicts a supermarket checkout aisle of the Prisma Kaari grocery store.
B. Documenting ordinary events in real time, Flâmsbana : Minutt for Minutt and Hihna 247 are both documentary programs in the slow TV genre.
C. Compared to the 12-hour-long Hihna 247, the slow TV program Flâmsbana: Minutt for Minutt is relatively short, at 1 hour.
D. A prime example of the slow TV genre can be seen in Flâmsbana: Minutt for Minutt , a 1-hour Norwegian TV documentary program documenting a train ride from Myrdal station down to Flâm.

E. López and C. Vaughan tested 125 Piper sancti-felicis seeds that had not been ingested by chestnut short-tailed bats. • Of these, 88 seeds (70%) germinated.

The student wants to describe the study’s research methodology. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记： • 在2004年的一项研究中，研究人员豪尔赫·E·洛佩斯和C·沃恩希望探讨蝙蝠摄食对Costa Rica地区Piper sancti-felicis种子发芽的影响。 • 研究团队测试了125颗被栗色短尾蝙蝠摄食的Piper sancti-felicis种子。 • 其中，82颗种子（66%）发芽了。 • 作为对照，J·E·洛佩斯和C·沃恩测试了125颗未被栗色短尾蝙蝠摄食的Piper sancti-felicis种子。 • 其中，88颗种子（70%）发芽了。 中文解析： 题目要求methodology，于是只有C用了control group来进行实验，是本实验的methodology方法。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • Modularity of mind is the notion that the mind is at least partly composed of innate neural structures (modules) that perform fast, necessary tasks. • 1983: cognitive scientist Jerry A. Fodor hypothesized that low-level cognitive systems (e.g., perception, language) are modular. • In Fodorian modularity, high-level systems (e. g. , reasoning) are not modular. • 2003: cognitive scientist Peter Carruthers proposed the massive modularity hypothesis (MMH). • MMH expands modularity to include all cognitive systems.

The student wants to compare Fodor’s hypothesis with Carruthers’s. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In considering some but not all cognitive systems modular, Fodorian modularity is not as expansive in its definition of modularity as MMH is.
B. Following Fodor’s 1983 hypothesis, Carruthers proposed that modularity of mind includes all cognitive systems.
C. The hypotheses of Fodor and Carruthers differ in whether they consider low-level cognitive systems, such as perception and language, modular
D. In 2003, Carruthers proposed the massive modularity hypothesis, disagreeing with Fodor’s earlier hypothesis that the mind is composed of innate neural structures.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记： • 心智的模块化是指心智至少部分由先天的神经结构（模块）组成，这些模块执行快速且必要的任务。 • 1983年：认知科学家杰瑞·A·福多假设低级认知系统（例如，感知、语言）是模块化的。 • 在福多的模块化理论中，高级系统（例如，推理）不是模块化的。 • 2003年：认知科学家彼得·卡鲁瑟斯提出了大规模模块化假说（MMH）。 • MMH将模块化扩展到包括所有认知系统。 中文解析： Fodorian modularity 猜想只包含了low-level cognitive systems, 但是Peter Carruthers的MMH猜想则包括了all cognitive systems, 正如A选项所讲Fodorian modularity is not as expansive as definition of MMH (Carruther’s)

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • Digital Light Synthesis (DLS) is a form of additive manufacturing that utilizes light to rapidly cure liquid resin into high-quality, 3D objects. • Step 1: Ultraviolet (UV) light images are projected up into a pool of liquid resin, where the object’s first layer takes shape. • Step 2: The partially cured resin object is raised, leaving a thin space (a “dead zone”) beneath it for oxygen and liquid resin to flow through. • Step 3: The UV light passes through the dead zone—maintaining the flow of resin—and partially cures additional layers of the object. • Step 4: When the resin object is complete, it is baked in an oven to complete the curing.

The student wants to describe how DLS cures 3D objects. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. DLS cures 3D objects by passing through a “dead zone,” adding layers to the object, then curing the object in an oven.
B. In DLS, UV light is projected into layers of liquid resin until the resin solidifies and passes through a “dead zone,” wherein the curing is completed.
C. In DLS, UV light images are projected into a liquid resin pool to cure a 3D object layer by layer; once solidified, the object is baked in an oven.
D. DLS is a form of additive manufacturing that creates a “dead zone” in which UV light solidifies layer by layer before being baked in an oven, creating a high-quality, 3D object.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记： • 数字光合成（DLS）是一种增材制造形式，利用光快速固化液态树脂，形成高质量的3D物体。 • 第一步：紫外线（UV）光图像被投射到液态树脂池中，物体的第一层开始成型。 • 第二步：部分固化的树脂物体被抬起，下面留出一个薄空间（“死区”），使氧气和液态树脂能够流动。 • 第三步：UV光穿过死区——保持树脂的流动——并部分固化物体的额外层。 • 第四步：当树脂物体完成后，将其放入烤箱中进行烘烤，以完成固化。 中文解析： 根据具体的步骤，UV光将图像投射到液态树脂池中，形成物体的第一层。部分固化的树脂物体被提升，留下“dead zone”供氧气和液态树脂流动。UV光穿过dead zone，维持树脂流动并部分固化更多层。最后，树脂物体在烤箱中完全固化。

question:

B. Is the increase in Mo in that portion indicative of an increase in atmospheric oxygen dating to the same time?
C. Did chemically analyzing bulk samples lead to a false impression that there is an increase in Mo in that portion?
D. Does the increase in Mo in that portion suggest that atmospheric oxygen levels were not negligible before 2.5 Ga?
explanations: 题目文本翻译: 文本1 通过化学分析来自澳大利亚麦克雷页岩的岩心样品，Ariel Anbar等人发现，在大约25亿年前（Ga）对应的一个时间点，钼（Mo）出现了短暂但显著的增加。在地球上，Mo主要通过矿物的氧化风化释放。因此，Anbar等人得出结论，25亿年前大气中的氧气曾短暂增加，然后又回到之前微不足道的水平。 文本2 Sarah Slotznick等人重新审视了麦克雷页岩的岩心。由于化学分析大宗样品可能掩盖细节，Slotznick等人还采用了高分辨率显微镜，揭示了大约25亿年前的火山碎屑——已知的Mo宿主，以及周围基质中的微裂缝。研究人员主张，流体可能通过这些微裂缝到达碎屑，并在碎屑沉积很久之后启动氧化风化。 中文解析： Text 2指出Mo的增加可能是由火山碎屑和微裂缝中的流体引起的氧化风化作用，且这种风化作用可能在碎屑沉积很久之后才发生，因此不一定与25亿年前的大气氧气水平直接相关。于是好得分指出B选项符合题目要求，即该部分中Mo的增加是否表明同一时期大气氧气的增加？两篇文章对于这个题目会彼此有不同看法（disagree）

question:
In Brazil, use of solid fuel (e. g. , coal, wood) as a share of total household fuel use fell by around 70 percent between 2000 and 2019; such shifts are typically explained by appeal to the energy ladder, a model holding that fuel choice is mediated mainly by household income (specifically, high-technology fuels displace solid fuels as incomes rise). Alemu Mekonne n and Gunnar Köhlin’s study of fuel use in Ethiopia shows this model to be reductive, however: household fuel use was heterogeneous, flexible, and influenced by several factors, including households’ cooking habits.

Based on the text, how would an advocate of the energy ladder model most likely explain the change observed in Brazil?

B. Beginning in 2000, high-technology fuels became more readily available in Brazil, enabling households of various income levels to shift away from solid fuels.
C. Solid fuel use declined in Brazil between 2000 and 2019 because changes in household income during that period made solid fuels more expensive relative to income.
D. Household incomes in Brazil rose from 2000 to 2019, which weakened the association between income and household fuel choice.

question:
Although Eastern North Pacific (ENP) gray whales generally migrate between their wintering waters along the coast of Mexico and their foraging waters in the Arctic, a subset of this population—known as the Pacific Coast Feeding Group (PCFG) —forages along the coastlines of Northern California (USA) and British Columbia (Canada) instead. Researchers hypothesize that this difference may be an adaptation to distinct resource opportunities in the PCFG foraging range.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers’ claim regarding the size of PCFG whales?

B. The average body size of PCFG whales observed along the coasts of Northern California and British Columbia has remained relatively steady in recent decades, while the average body size of ENP whales in the main group has slightly decreased.

C. When present along the coasts of Northern California and British Columbia, PCFG whales tend to forage in rocky kelp beds at shallow depths inaccessible to whales as large as those in the ENP main group.

question:
Chesapeake Bay seagrass meadows constitute crucial habitats for many aquatic species. Historically, eelgrass has been predominant, but widgeon grass is proving better suited to recent increases in sea temperature, tolerating heat better and growing faster than eelgrass does. Although the increase in widgeon grass has been associated with a substantial increase in total seagrass coverage in the bay, researchers caution that the latter change does not necessarily make the seagrass ecosystem as a whole more resilient to environmental shocks.

Which statement, if true, would account for data shown in the graph and would illustrate the point made by the researchers?
selections: A. In early 2019, unusually heavy rains washed excessive nutrients into the bay, leading to algal blooms that prevented sunlight from reaching many seagrass species.
B. In early 2018, a fungal infection that affects widgeon grass and eelgrass but does not affect other types of seagrass spread through the bay.
C. Between 2012 and 2017, the total area covered by widgeon grass and the total area covered by all types of seagrass increased as water temperatures in the bay increased.

D. Water temperatures in the bay increased slowly from 2012 to 2018, but in early 2019 there was an unprecedently large increase in temperatures, which reached levels that can be tolerated by few seagrass species other than widgeon grass.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 切萨皮克湾的海草草甸是许多水生物种的重要栖息地。历史上，鳗草占主导地位，但随着海温的上升，鸳鸯草似乎更适应这些变化，能够更好地耐热且生长速度比鳗草更快。尽管鸳鸯草的增加与湾内海草覆盖面积的显著增加有关，但研究人员警告说，这一变化并不一定使整个海草生态系统对环境冲击的抵御能力更强。 中文解析： A选项中，unusually heavy rains对应environmental shock，图表中19年total of all types of seagrass下滑严重，说明ecosystem受到影响了，就说明不resilient，整个选项意思（阻止光照射seagrass）也匹配图表和原文，所以选A。

question:

Other studies track annual round-trip distance (RTD), which is equal to double the distance separating the two habitats a population migrates between each year. A researcher argues that since GPS records all of an animal’s movements, using the GPS method to track a population would result in significantly higher recorded travel distances than using the RTD method would. For example, it’s very likely that the distance reported for the ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the example?
selections: A. Tibetan antelope would be less than 700 kilometers if the GPS method had been used.
B. caribou would be less than 4,868 kilometers if the RTD method had been used.
C. caribou would be greater than 1,325 kilometers if the RTD method had been used.
D. Tibetan antelope would be greater than 4,868 kilometers if the GPS method had been used.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 一些关于迁徙动物的研究通过为个体安装GPS追踪项圈来测量动物在一年内的迁徙距离。其他研究则跟踪年度往返距离（RTD），这一距离等于每年一个种群在两个栖息地之间迁徙的距离的两倍。一位研究者认为，由于GPS记录了动物的所有活动，使用GPS方法追踪一个种群将导致记录的迁徙距离显著高于使用RTD方法的结果。例如，报告的______的距离很可能会更大。 中文解析： 关于迁徙动物的研究通过给个体安装GPS追踪项圈来测量动物一年内旅行的距离。其他研究则追踪年往返距离（RTD），即一个种群每年迁徙的两个栖息地之间距离的两倍。好得分教师根据文本研究人员最后一句的华语，由于GPS记录了动物的所有移动，使用GPS方法追踪种群将导致记录到的旅行距离显著高于使用RTD方法的结果。HDF田老师结合表格的数据，发现Caribou GPS数据是4,868,自然推断RTD要少于这个数字。

B. Graphite and carbon nanotubes are allotropes composed of stacked or wrapped graphene sheets, but carbon can exist in several distinct structural forms.

D. The graphene sheets in graphite are stacked, whereas in carbon nanotubes, they form a cylinder.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记： • 碳可以以几种不同的结构形式存在，这些形式被称为同素异形体。 • 石墨是一种碳的同素异形体。 • 石墨由堆叠的石墨烯片组成。 • 每个石墨烯片由以平坦的蜂窝状排列的碳原子构成。 • 碳纳米管是碳的同素异形体。 • 它们由一个或多个石墨烯片卷曲成圆柱形构成。 中文解析： 题目要求强调difference，好得分希望同学们注意到D选项的whereas前后就是对比，直接对比了石墨和碳纳米管的结构差异：石墨是石墨烯片堆叠而成，而碳纳米管是石墨烯片卷成圆柱形，对应了第三条和最后一条note

question:
Io is among Jupiter’s four largest moons and was discovered in 1610 by Galileo. Advances in space exploration and imaging technologies have since enabled scientists to discover even more moons orbiting Jupiter. For example, scientists used the Voyager 1 space probe to discover Adrastea in 1979. And more recently, researchers discovered 12 moons using the Dark Energy Camera at the Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory in Chile. As of 2023, the number of confirmed moons orbiting Jupiter was 95, and scientists think further exploration will reveal more.

According to the text, in which year was Adrastea discovered?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： Io是木星四大卫星之一，由伽利略于1610年发现。随着太空探索和成像技术的进步，科学家们发现了更多围绕木星运行的卫星。例如，科学家们使用旅行者1号太空探测器于1979年发现了阿德拉斯提亚卫星。更近期，研究人员利用位于智利的塞罗托洛洛洲际天文台的暗能量相机发现了12颗卫星。截至2023年，已确认围绕木星运行的卫星数量为95颗，科学家们认为随着进一步的探索，还会发现更多卫星。 中文解析： 通过Adrastea定位到原文找到答案1979
exam_name: 2025年3月第3套阅读语法（只录新题）

question:
Founded in 1991, the Museo de Las Americas showcases art from Latin America, including the art of Indigenous peoples. It is located in Denver and has more than 4,800 objects in its collection. Since 2000, a number of other institutions devoted to Latino cultures have opened in the United States. A notable example is LA Plaza de Cultura y Artes in Los Angeles. It opened in 2011 and focuses on Mexican American art and culture.

Which contrast does the text draw between the Museo de Las Americas and LA Plaza de Cultura y Artes?
selections: A. LA Plaza de Cultura y Artes is visited by more people.
B. LA Plaza de Cultura y Artes has more objects in its collection.
C. LA Plaza de Cultura y Artes is housed in a larger building.
D. LA Plaza de Cultura y Artes opened more recently.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 1991年成立的美洲博物馆展示了来自拉丁美洲的艺术作品，包括土著人民的艺术。该博物馆位于丹佛，馆内藏品超过4800件。自2000年以来，许多专注于拉美文化的机构在美国开设。一个显著的例子是位于洛杉矶的LA Plaza de Cultura y Artes。该博物馆于2011年开馆，专注于墨西哥裔美国人的艺术与文化。 中文解析： 根据原文可以看到Museo de Las Americas 是1991成立的， LA Plaza de Cultura y Artes是2011年开张的，所以对应D
exam_name: 2025年3月第3套阅读语法（只录新题）

question:
To help combat the growing rate of microplastic pollution, a team of researchers developed a synthetic sponge that can soak up microplastic particles from liquid. The sponge, composed mainly of starch and gelatin, does this by trapping the tiny particles within its pores. Guoqing Wang, one of the researchers, says that the formula for the sponge can be adjusted to best suit the size of particle the sponge is intended to trap, making it versatile in its potential applications. Chemist Christian Adlhart, however, claims that this sponge would be difficult to mass-produce.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support Adlhart’s claim?
selections: A. Textiles are one of the largest sources of microplastic pollution in our oceans.
B. The sponge created by Wang and his team has a relatively light weight for its volume, making it potentially easy to ship to different locations.
C. The absorption capabilities of the sponge created by Wang and his team varied depending on the liquid solution used in the team’s experiments.
D. The worldwide supply of starch and gelatin is in high demand from the food industry, so those substances would be difficult to source in significant quantities.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 为了应对日益严重的微塑料污染问题，一组研究人员开发了一种合成海绵，可以从液体中吸收微塑料颗粒。这种海绵主要由淀粉和明胶组成，通过在其孔隙中捕捉微小颗粒来实现这一功能。研究人员之一郭庆·王（Guoqing Wang）表示，海绵的配方可以调整，以最佳适应要捕捉的颗粒大小，使其在潜在应用中具有多功能性。然而，化学家克里斯蒂安·阿德哈特（Christian Adlhart）声称，这种海绵将难以实现大规模生产。 中文解析： Adlhart 的观点是这种海绵难以大规模生产。如果 D 选项为真，即淀粉和明胶的全球供应因食品行业的高需求而难以大量获取，这将直接支持 Adlhart 的论点，因为大规模生产需要大量原材料，而原材料的短缺会阻碍生产。
exam_name: 2025年3月第3套阅读语法（只录新题）

question:
Life Among the Paiutes is an 1882 autobiographical narrative by Sarah Winnemucca Hopkins, a Northern Paiute author, educator, and activist. In the work, Winnemucca directly addresses the reader to explain certain customs, writing ________

Which quotation from Life Among the Paiutes most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “We would all go in company to see if the flowers we were named for were yet in bloom, for almost all the girls are named for flowers.”
B. “Nothing happened during the day, and after a while mother told us not to say a word about why we left, for grandpa might get mad with us.”
C. “Now, my dear reader, there is no word so endearing as the word father, and that is why [my people] call all good people father or mother.”
D. “But how can I describe the scene that followed? Some of you, dear readers, can imagine.”
