question:
Textile artist Amber Joy Greenidge-Sabral wanted to avoid using harsh synthetic dyes that could be damaging to the environment. ________ she began experimenting with more environmentally friendly natural dye methods, using organic materials like Texas paintbrush and madder root for their natural brown and red colors.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 纺织艺术家安柏·乔伊·格林吉奇-萨布拉尔希望避免使用可能对环境造成损害的强烈合成染料。______，她开始尝试使用更环保的天然染色方法，利用有机材料，如德克萨斯州画笔和茜草根，来提取自然的棕色和红色。 中文解析： “考虑到这一点”作为一个逻辑过渡是因为它表明了对环境友好的天然染料方法实验的关注，它连接了前述关于想要避免使用刺激性的合成染料的陈述与纺织艺术家所采取的行动，强调了她决定的理由。
exam_name: 2024年12月第8套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • In a 2021 study, researchers showed participants an unaltered image of a popular character or logo alongside two slightly altered versions. • Fred Flintstone is a cartoon man in a spotted tunic. • In the first alteration, the tunic had a striped pattern. • In the second alteration, the tunic had no pattern. • Participants were asked to identify the correct version. • 86.9% of participants selected the unaltered image, and 13.1% selected an altered version.

The student wants to emphasize how many participants selected an altered version of Fred Flintstone. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. When participants were asked to identify the correct version of Fred Flintstone, 86.9% selected the unaltered image.
B. A 2021 study showed participants an unaltered image of Fred Flintstone, who is a cartoon man in a spotted tunic, alongside two altered versions.
C. Participants were asked to identify the correct version of Fred Flintstone, who is a cartoon man in a spotted tunic.
D. When shown three versions of Fred Flintstone and asked to select the correct one, 13.1% of participants chose an altered version.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，学生做了以下笔记： • 在一项2021年的研究中，研究人员向参与者展示了一个流行角色或标志的未修改图像以及两个稍微修改过的版本。 • 弗雷德·弗林斯通是一个穿着斑点外衣的卡通男人。 • 在第一次修改中，外衣的图案是条纹状的。 • 在第二次修改中，外衣没有任何图案。 • 参与者被要求识别正确的版本。 • 86.9%的参与者选择了未修改的图像，13.1%的参与者选择了一个修改过的版本。 中文解析： 题目问多少人选择了altered version，根据notes最后一条，13.1%选择了，对应了D选项
exam_name: 2024年12月第8套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • The human tongue contains taste receptors for a rich, savory flavor called umami. • Umami is triggered by the compounds in a variety of foods, including tuna and garlic. • Participants in a study tasted a sample of North Pacific konbu, a type of brown seaweed. • They rated its umami intensity as moderate. • The participants tasted a sample of arame, another type of brown seaweed. • They rated its umami intensity as high.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two seaweeds. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Although North Pacific konbu and arame are types of brown seaweed, the latter’s umami flavor is more intense.
B. Some types of brown seaweed, like North Pacific konbu and arame, trigger umami flavor in human taste buds.
C. While North Pacific konbu and arame contain umami flavor, umamic an also be found in tuna and garlic.
D. North Pacific konbu is a type of brown seaweed, but so is arame.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一位学生做了以下笔记： • 人类的舌头含有感知一种丰富、鲜美味道的味觉受体，这种味道被称为“鲜味”（umami）。 • 鲜味是由多种食物中的化合物触发的，包括金枪鱼和大蒜。 • 一项研究中的参与者品尝了北太平洋昆布（konbu）的样本，这是一种褐色海藻。 • 他们将其鲜味强度评为中等。 • 参与者还品尝了另一种褐色海藻——阿拉梅（arame）的样本。 • 他们将其鲜味强度评为高。 中文解析： 题目要求emphasize a difference，只有A选项比较了两种brown seaweed flavor，用umani衡量了arame比konbu更加intense。
exam_name: 2024年12月第8套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • Hadramphus tuberculatus is an insect species. • It was believed to be extinct until a living specimen was identified in New Zealand in 2004. • Catagonus wagneri is a mammal species. • It was believed to be extinct until a living specimen was identified in Argentina in 1974. • They are considered Lazarus species. • “Lazarus species” is a term for living species of organisms that were once believed to be extinct.

The student wants to specify where Hadramphus tuberculatus was identified. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In 1974, a living specimen of Catagonus wagneri was found in Argentina.
B. A living specimen of Hadramphus tuberculatus , once believed to be extinct, was identified in 2004.
C. Previously believed to be extinct, a living specimen of Hadramphus tuberculatus was identified in New Zealand.
D. Examples of Lazarus species can be found in Hadramphus tuberculatus as well as Catagonus wagneri .
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记： • Hadramphus tuberculatus 是一种昆虫物种。 • 它曾被认为已经灭绝，直到2004年在新西兰发现了一只活体标本。 • Catagonus wagneri 是一种哺乳动物物种。 • 它曾被认为已经灭绝，直到1974年在阿根廷发现了一只活体标本。 • 它们被视为“拉撒路物种”。 • “拉撒路物种”是指曾被认为灭绝的生物种类，但实际上仍然存在的生物物种。 中文解析： 题目要求specify 地点，根据notes第二条，本以为Hadramphus tuberculatus灭绝了，知道一个发现在新西兰
exam_name: 2024年12月第8套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
• Herpetology is primarily the study of amphibians and reptiles. • Mary Cynthia Dickerson was an American herpetologist born in1866. • She is known for her research on frogs. • Biochemistry is primarily the study of the chemical makeup and activity of organisms. • Muriel Wheldale Onslow was a British biochemist born in 1880. • She is known for her research on the basis of petal color in dragon flowers.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to emphasize a similarity between Dickerson and Onslow?
selections: A. Mary Cynthia Dickerson conducted research on frogs; Muriel Wheldale Onslow, by contrast, is known for her research on the basis of petal color in dragon flowers.
B. Herpetology and biochemistry are just two examples of the myriad fields in which scientists can specialize.
C. Like herpetologist Mary Cynthia Dickerson, biochemist Muriel Wheldale Onslow dedicated her scientific career to the study of living organisms.
D. The herpetologist Mary Cynthia Dickerson was born in 1866, but biochemist Muriel Wheldale Onslow was born later, in 1880.

question:
Benjamin Prud’homme and colleagues have explored how convergent evolution— a phenomenon that occurs when the same trait evolves independently in two reproductively separate lineages —can result from a genetic mechanism shared by both lineages. Meanwhile, Patricia J. Wittlopp and colleagues have investigated how convergence occurs through different genetic mechanisms, but the relative prevalence of convergence through shared and different genetic processes is still poorly understood. This motivated biologists Delbert A. Green II and Cassandra G. Extavour to evaluate both types of convergence in a single study for their 2012 paper.

Which choice best states the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It provides examples of how a phenomenon was studied by scientists in the field before Green and Extavour’s study.
B. It gives a basic description of a phenomenon that is central to the discussion that follows.
C. It clarifies a concept that the author implies was unclear in the studies mentioned in the text.
D. It introduces a method of scientific analysis that is discussed in greater detail later in the text.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 本杰明·普吕多姆和他的同事们探讨了趋同演化这一现象——当相同的特征在两个生殖上独立的谱系中独立演化时会发生——如何可能源自两个谱系共享的遗传机制。同时，帕特里夏·J·维特洛普及其同事们研究了趋同是如何通过不同的遗传机制发生的，但通过共享和不同遗传过程的趋同相对普遍性仍然不太明确。这促使生物学家德尔伯特·A·格林二世和卡桑德拉·G·埃克斯托进行了一项研究，以评估这两种类型的趋同，并在他们2012年的论文中进行了探讨。 中文解析： 画线句谓语破折号之间，是对前面convergent revolution的解释，也是文章讨论的核心话题
exam_name: 2024年12月第7套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
In Ojibwe, an Indigenous language from the Great Lakes region of what are now the United States and Canada, wása means “far,” whereas wa-wása means “far apart.” This phenomenon, in which an element of a root word is repeated, sometimes with modification, within another word that is related to the root word, is called reduplication. In this case, the element “wā” in wāsa gets repeated in wa-wāsa . There are many examples of this type of reduplication in Ojibwe.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It describes the relationship between Ojibwe and several other languages, raises a question about the nature of that relationship, and then answers that question.

B. It identifies the most frequently occurring words in Ojibwe, explains why it is difficult to translate those words into English, and then provides examples of languages other than English into which those words can be translated.
C. It presents some specific words in Ojibwe, describes the general linguistic phenomenon exemplified by those words, and then states that this phenomenon occurs frequently in Ojibwe.
D. It explains the phenomenon of reduplication, discusses why reduplication has been controversial among scholars, and then argues that an analysis of Ojibwe could help resolve that controversy.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在北美五大湖地区的土著语言奥吉布瓦语中，“wása”意为“远”，而“wa-wása”则意为“相隔很远”。这种现象称为重叠，即在与某个根词相关的另一个词中，根词的某个元素被重复，有时会有所修改。在这个例子中，“wā”这个元素在“wása”中被重复到了“wa-wása”中。奥吉布瓦语中有许多这种类型的重叠例子。 中文解析： 文本先介绍ojibwe中的语言现象，再概括这种重复代表复数的整体特征，最后说这个特征很普遍，于是正确答案是C
exam_name: 2024年12月第7套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
Text 1 Uisdean Nicholson and his team have discovered evidence in seismic data of a 40-kilometer-wide subsurface crater beneath nearly a kilometer of water off the coast of West Africa that is consistent with a 400-meter-wide asteroid striking the seafloor. This structure, which the team named Nadir, exhibits all the telltale signs of a high-velocity impact crater: an elevated rim, a circular shape, a terraced floor, and a pronounced area of uplift at its center Text 2 Both carbonate dissolution and subsurface salt withdrawal can cause craterlike depressions without the need for a high-velocity impact. However, carbonate dissolution is very unlikely to have occurred in the vicinity of Nadir, and although subsurface salt withdrawal could have plausibly occurred in this area and would result in a depression with a terraced floor or a circular shape, it would not exhibit the area of central uplift seen at Nadir.

Which choice best describes a difference between the approach of Text 1 and the approach of Text 2?
selections: A. Text 1 dispassionately describes Nicholson and colleagues’ findings and conclusions, whereas Text 2 attempts to convey the researchers’ excitement on discovering Nadir.
B. Text 1 focuses on features Nadir lacks, whereas Text 2 indicates features it shares with other geological depressions.
C. Text 1 discusses a single plausible cause of Nadir, whereas Text 2 evaluates two possible causes.
D. Text 1 emphasizes the evidence supporting an asteroid impact as the cause of Nadir, whereas Text 2 argues against that explanation.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 文本1 乌伊斯丁·尼科尔森及其团队在西非海岸近一公里水深处的地震数据中发现了一种证据，表明存在一个宽达40公里的地下陨石坑，这与一个直径400米的陨石撞击海床相一致。该结构被团队命名为“纳迪尔”，展现出高速度撞击陨石坑的所有典型特征：隆起的边缘、圆形的形状、分层的底部以及中央明显的隆起区域。 文本2 碳酸盐的溶解和地下盐的抽取都可以在没有高速撞击的情况下造成类似陨石坑的凹陷。然而，碳酸盐溶解在纳迪尔附近发生的可能性非常小，尽管地下盐抽取在该地区可能发生，并会导致具有分层底部或圆形形状的凹陷，但它不会表现出纳迪尔所见的中央隆起区域。 中文解析： Text1分析了crater的形成原因是收到物体的高速撞击，Text2从carbonate dissolution and subsurface salt withdrawal的角度分析但是这两个解释无法适用在Nadir，因此选C，第一篇只讨论一个可能原因，第二篇评估两个原因
exam_name: 2024年12月第7套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
The following text is from Julia Alvarez’s 2000 novel In the Name of Salomé. The narrator and her sister, daughters of a famous poet, are being tutored by Alejandro Román. Our tutor, Alejandro Román, brought his younger brother, Miguel, to class one day. By now I was eighteen and had learned everything Alejandro had to teach me, so I was glad for a new face. Miguel was an aspiring poet, and he had heard from his brother that the Urena girls were none other than the daughters of Nicolás Ureña, and they were smart as clockwork. Miguel was hoping not only to meet us but to make the acquaintance of the poet himself at Mamá’s house. ©2000 by Julia Alvarez

Based on the text, why does Miguel accompany his brother to the sisters’ house one day?
selections: A. Miguel has learned all his brother can teach him and now desires to be taught by the sisters.
B. Miguel has not received formal instruction in poetry and wants to ask the sisters’ famous father to be his mentor.
C. Miguel wants to recite his poems to the sisters and inquire about their perspectives on his work.
D. Miguel anticipates having the opportunity to be introduced to both the sisters and their father.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文本来自于朱莉亚·阿尔瓦雷斯的2000年小说《以萨罗梅的名义》。叙述者和她的姐妹是著名诗人的女儿，由亚历杭德罗·罗曼担任家庭教师。 我们的老师亚历杭德罗·罗曼有一天带来了他的小弟弟米格尔上课。那时我已经十八岁，学会了亚历杭德罗所能教我的一切，因此我很高兴能见到一个新面孔。米格尔是一位有抱负的诗人，他从哥哥那里听说乌雷纳姐妹正是尼古拉斯·乌雷纳的女儿，而且她们聪明得像钟表一样。米格尔希望不仅能见到我们，还能在妈妈的家里结识这位诗人本人。 中文解析： 根据文本尤其是最后Miguel听说了Nicolás Ureña的女儿们聪明，来的目的不仅仅是渐渐女孩们，也希望见到Nicolás Ureña诗人本人，和D选项一样
exam_name: 2024年12月第7套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
Motivated to sell as many paintings as possible, Alfred Hair, an influential figure among the landscape artists known as the Florida Highwaymen, pioneered “fast painting,” which in part involved working across multiple canvasses at once. That many of Hair’s acolytes, including Isaac Knight, imitated the technique accounts in part for the impressionistic qualities that are now synonymous with the group’s shared aesthetic. But not all Highwaymen fully embraced this approach; for instance, though Willie Reagan was also prolific, his paintings were executed with greater attention to detail.

What does the text most strongly suggest about paintings by Knight?
selections: A. Because of the manner in which they were created, they likely have visual qualities that are regarded as more typical of Florida Highwaymen paintings than the qualities in works by Reagan are.
B. Although it is evident that Knight adopted some of Hair’s preferred techniques, Knight’s works are less derivative of works by Hair than is typically acknowledged.
C. The lack of precision with which they were executed suggests that they are inferior to works by either Hair or Reagan.
D. Knight’s reliance on the technique of fast painting likely accounts for his works being more aesthetically interesting than works by Reagan are.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 阿尔弗雷德·海尔（Alfred Hair）是一位在被称为佛罗里达公路艺术家（Florida Highwaymen）中的风景画家，出于尽可能多地出售画作的动机，他开创了“快速绘画”技法，这部分涉及同时在多个画布上作画。海尔的许多追随者，包括艾萨克·奈特（Isaac Knight），模仿了这一技法，这在一定程度上解释了如今与该团体共同审美风格相符的印象派特征。然而，并非所有公路艺术家都完全接受这种方法；例如，尽管威利·里根（Willie Reagan）同样高产，但他的画作表现出更高的细节关注。 中文解析： Knight受Alfred Hair影响，创作快速，qualities that are now synonymous with the group’s shared aesthetic，说明more typical，而最后提到的Reagan等则更加细腻注重细节
exam_name: 2024年12月第7套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
Vancouver has high pedestrian traffic, but other cities cannot increase their pedestrian traffic simply by replicating a single feature of Vancouver—e.g., its high number of pedestrian amenities —that is associated with walkability. As urbanist Mariela Alfonzo argues, many factors influence people’s decision-making about whether to walk: some studies have shown the importance of demographic characteristics, others have shown the importance of average commuting distance, and so on, and it is clear that none of these factors in isolation fully explains pedestrian habits in a given city.

Based on the text, the author would most likely agree with which statement about Vancouver’s “high number of pedestrian amenities”?
selections: A. It may increase walkability in Vancouver but is known to reduce walkability in other cities.
B. It is better understood as an effect of the high level of pedestrian traffic in Vancouver than as a cause of that pedestrian traffic.
C. It affects walking decisions in Vancouver less than demographic characteristics and average commuting distance do.
D. It should be understood as just one of several factors that influence pedestrian activity in Vancouver.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 温哥华的人流量很大，但其他城市不能仅仅通过复制温哥华的单一特征——例如，众多的步行设施——来增加它们的步行交通，因为这些特征与步行友好性相关。正如城市规划专家玛丽埃拉·阿丰索（Mariela Alfonzo）所指出的，许多因素影响人们是否选择步行的决策：一些研究显示了人口特征的重要性，另一些则表明了平均通勤距离的重要性等等，很明显，单独考虑这些因素并不能完全解释某个城市的步行习惯。 中文解析： 划线句是walkability的一个原因，但是还有很多别的因素，于是选择D
exam_name: 2024年12月第7套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
Numbers of the 23 Non-native Tree Species Reported and the Insect and Fungus Threats to Them Country Trees Fungi Insects Great Britain 18 290 120 Hungary 1 18 13 Switzerland 11 43 78 Elisabeth Potzelsberger and colleagues gathered data on 23 non-native tree species grown in Europe. They analyzed reports from Great Britain, Switzerland, and Hungary about the number of these species grown in those countries as well as the numbers of insect and fungus species that damage those trees. The researchers concluded that Great Britain had a greater number of damaging fungus species than either of the other countries did.

Which choice best describes data from the table that support Pötzelsherger and colleagues’ conclusion?
selections: A. Hungary reported 18 damaging fungus species but only 13 damaging insect species.
B. Great Britain reported 290 damaging fungus species, whereas Switzerland reported 78 damaging insect species.
C. Great Britain reported 290 damaging fungus species, which is more than either Switzerland or Hungary reported.
D. Switzerland and Hungary reported 11 and 1 damaging fungus species. respectively, which is far fewer than Great Britain reported.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 伊丽莎白·波茨尔斯贝格（Elisabeth Potzelsberger）及其同事收集了在欧洲种植的23种外来树种的数据。他们分析了来自英国、瑞士和匈牙利的报告，记录了这些国家种植的树种数量以及损害这些树木的昆虫和真菌种类数量。研究人员得出结论，英国的有害真菌种类数量超过了其他两个国家。 中文解析： 根据文本最后的结论是说英国的fungi要比其它两个国家多，于是C描述指出290的数据比其它两国多，是正确的
exam_name: 2024年12月第7套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
Poems is an 1895 collection of poetry by Frances E. W. Harper. In one of Harper’s poems, the speaker criticizes activists who champion humanitarian causes in other countries while overlooking local concerns, saying, ________

Which quotation from Poems most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “Men may tread down the poor and lowly,/May crush them in anger and hate,/But surely the mills of God’s justice/Will grind out the grist of their fate.” (from “An Appeal to My Countrywomen”)
B. “When ye plead for the wrecked and fallen,/The exile from far-distant shores,/Remember that men are still wasting/Life’s crimson around your own doors.” (from “An Appeal to My Countrywomen”)
C. “God bless our native land,/Land of the newly free,/Oh may she ever stand/For truth and liberty.” (from “God Bless Our Native Land”)
D. “Let me make the songs for the people,/Songs for the old and young;/Songs to stir like a battle-cry/Wherever they are sung.” (from “Songs for the People”)
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 《诗集》是弗朗西斯·E·W·哈珀（Frances E. W. Harper）于1895年出版的一部诗歌合集。在哈珀的一首诗中，讲述者批评那些在其他国家倡导人道主义事业的活动家，同时忽视本地问题，指出…… 中文解析： B选项的大意“当你们为那些遇难的、倒下的、从遥远海岸被放逐的人们恳求时，请记住，人们还在浪费生命的鲜红，就在你们家门口。”(选自《致我的农村妇女》)，这句诗对应了题目里who champion humanitarian causes in other countries while overlooking local concerns。
exam_name: 2024年12月第7套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
Many plants have leaves that are larger on one side of their long central axis than the other, a phenomenon known as asymmetrical orientation. University of California, Berkeley biologist Clera Martinez and colleagues examined several species of grapevines and closely related plants, which have leaves that grow in pairs, to see if both leaves in a pair tend to be oriented toward the same side (that is, have more tissue on the same side) or not. They found that opposite-side orientation was much more common than same-side orientation; in the Amur grape, for example, approximately ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the example?
selections: A. 150 leaf pairs show opposite-side orientation, whereas approximately 60 pairs show same-side orientation.
B. 110 leaf pairs show opposite -side orientation, whereas approximately 45 pairs show same-side orientation.
C. 650 leaf pairs show opposite-side orientation, whereas no pairs show same-side orientation.
D. 110 leaf pairs show opposite-side orientation, whereas no pairs show same-side orientation.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 许多植物的叶子在其长中央轴的一侧比另一侧大，这种现象被称为不对称取向。加利福尼亚大学伯克利分校的生物学家克莱拉·马丁内斯（Clera Martinez）及其同事研究了几种葡萄藤及其近亲植物，这些植物的叶子成对生长，旨在观察一对叶子是否倾向于朝同一侧取向（即同一侧的组织较多）。他们发现，叶子朝对侧取向的情况远比朝同侧取向的情况更为普遍；以阿穆尔葡萄为例，约有______。 中文解析： 根据图表Amur grape对应的柱状图，opposite site是150，same side是60，于是A正确
exam_name: 2024年12月第7套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
Mooseberry ( Viburnum edule ) plants are native to Alaska, where harsh conditions have historically impeded potential invasive species. As the boreal climate has warmed in recent decades, however, common knotgrass ( Polygonum aviculare ) plants have established themselves in Alaska. It has been suggested that warming-induced delays in the onset of subfreezing temperatures in autumn can benefit invasives more than native species; to evaluate this possibility, biologists Christa Mulder and Katie Spellman tracked V. edule and P. aviculare , along with other native and invasive species, over several years, concluding that invasives are advantaged by delays in subfreezing temperature onset in Alaska.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support Mulder and Spellman’s conclusion?
selections: A. Although V. edule and P. aviculare both tended to produce leaves later into autumn in years with late subfreezing temperature onset, the extension was much greater for P. aviculare than for V. edule.

B. Although significant interannual variations in subfreezing temperature onset were observed during the study, neither P. aviculare nor V. edule showed any significant interannual variation in the cessation of leaf production.

C. Although V. edule and P. aviculare tended to stop producing leaves at about the same time in years with historically typical temperature patterns, P. aviculare stopped producing leaves sooner than V. edule did in years with late subfreezing temperature onset.

D. Although V. edule and P. aviculare both tended to produce more leaves overall in years with late subfreezing temperature onset than they did in years with historically typical temperature patterns, the years with late subfreezing temperature onset also had early growing season onset in spring.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 浆果树（Viburnum edule）植物原产于阿拉斯加，那里严酷的环境历来阻碍了潜在入侵物种的生存。然而，随着近年来寒带气候的变暖，常见的结缕草（Polygonum aviculare）植物已在阿拉斯加扎根。有人提出，因变暖导致的秋季低于冰点温度的推迟，可能对入侵物种的益处超过对本土物种的益处；为了评估这一可能性，生物学家克里斯塔·穆尔德（Christa Mulder）和凯蒂·斯佩尔曼（Katie Spellman）在数年间跟踪了浆果树和结缕草以及其他本土和入侵物种，得出的结论是，入侵物种在阿拉斯加的低温到达时间延迟中受益。 中文解析： 根据文本最后的结论invasive species获利更多，于是两种植物都produce leaves later into autumn，但是extension was greater for P. aviculare than for V. edule，p植物是入侵物种，V植物是本土物种，于是A选项支持了入侵物种获利更多
exam_name: 2024年12月第7套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
Northeastern Kansas’s Jefferson County is among the most rural counties in the United States: the US Census Bureau classified it as 98.8% rural in 2010. Researchers studying populations of counties like Jefferson often struggle to recruit and retain participants. Melissa Valerio and colleagues tested whether a method called snowball sampling could improve recruitment and retention. Working in two rural counties, the researchers identified a small number of people who had the characteristics desired for a proposed study and asked them to recruit additional participants from their social networks. Valerio and colleagues found that participants recruited via snowball sampling showed a much higher retention rate than did people recruited by strangers, suggesting that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. being recruited to participate in a study by someone with whom one is socially connected may impart a feeling of obligation to persist with participation in the study.
B. people with relatively small social networks are inherently less likely to be recruited to participate in a study via snowball sampling than are people with relatively large social networks.
C. snowball sampling is more likely to improve retention rates among rural participants than among nonrural participants.
D. social networks can become large enough that two people can share a network but nevertheless regard each other as strangers.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 东北堪萨斯州的杰斐逊县是美国最乡村的县之一：美国人口普查局在2010年将其列为98.8%的乡村地区。研究像杰斐逊县这样的地区人口的研究人员往往在招募和留住参与者方面面临困难。梅丽莎·瓦莱里奥（Melissa Valerio）及其同事测试了一种叫做滚雪球抽样（snowball sampling）的方法，看看是否能改善招募和留存情况。在两个乡村县，研究人员确定了一小部分具备所需特征的人，并请他们从自己的社交网络中招募额外的参与者。瓦莱里奥和同事发现，通过滚雪球抽样招募的参与者的留存率明显高于通过陌生人招募的参与者，这表明 ________。 中文解析： 文本表述participants recruited via snowball sampling showed a much higher retention rate，于是A选项解释了背后的原因是认识的人会让我们感到obligation，从而能够留下的时间更久
exam_name: 2024年12月第7套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

Miniature Self-Portrait (1556) is one of dozens of remaining works by Sofonisba Anguissola. Currently, her painting ________ at the Museum of Fine Arts in Boston, where visitors can view the Italian Renaissance artist’s work on display.

question:

question:
John Thomson employed the pseudonym “Gracchus”—the name of an ancient Roman politician—in political essays he wrote in 1795, a choice that accomplished far more than simply concealing his authorship. ________ it wasn’t an arbitrary pen name but rather a complex rhetorical strategy through which Thomson aligned his political views with the venerated republican ideals of the ancient world, thereby bolstering the authority of his writing.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 约翰·汤姆森（John Thomson）在1795年撰写的政治文章中使用了“格拉古斯”（Gracchus）这一笔名——这是古罗马一位政治家的名字。这个选择的意义远不止于简单地隐瞒作者身份。______ 这并不是一个随意的笔名，而是一种复杂的修辞策略，汤姆森通过这一策略将自己的政治观点与古代世界受尊敬的共和理想相结合，从而增强了他写作的权威性。 中文解析：前面说more than concealing authorship，后面指出这个名字的选择意义与作用，前后一致，后面更加强调出来名字的意义，于是选择indeed
exam_name: 2024年12月第7套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
In Annie Dillard’s Pilgrim at Tinker Creek —where, early on, the author marvels at a single goldfish’s delicate fins but later winces when imagining a horde of goldfish laying and eating their own eggs—Dillard struggles to reconcile the complicated juxtapositions of the natural world. ________ nature’s mesmerizing intricacy and pitiless harshness prove inextricably linked for Dillard, like “two branches of the same creek.”

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在安妮·迪拉德（Annie Dillard）的《在丁克溪的朝圣者》（Pilgrim at Tinker Creek）中，作者在开篇时惊叹于一条金鱼那精致的鳍，但随后又在想象一群金鱼产卵并吃掉自己卵子的场景时感到不适，迪拉德努力调和自然世界中复杂的对立情境。______ 对迪拉德来说，自然的迷人复杂性与无情的严酷性密不可分，就像“同一条小溪的两条分支”。 中文解析： 在这段文字中，作者安妮·迪拉德struggles to reconcile the complicated juxtapositions of the natural world.。接着，文中提到“自然的复杂性和无情的严酷性对于迪拉德来说是密不可分的”，这说明作者最终理解到自然中的美丽与残酷是紧密相连的，所以选A.
exam_name: 2024年12月第7套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • The Galápagos penguin is a species of bird that can be found on the Galápagos Island of Floreana. • It has an average weight of 2.5 kilograms. • The grey warbler finch is a species of bird that can be found on the Galápagos Island of Floreana. • It has an average weight of 9 grams.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the Galápagos penguin and the grey warbler finch. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. On average, the Galápagos penguin weighs 2.5 kilograms, while the grey warbler finch weighs 9 grams.
B. The grey warbler finch, which weighs 9 grams on average, can be found on the Galápagos Island of Floreana.
C. The grey warbler finch and the Galapagos penguin can both be found on the Galápagos Island of Floreana.
D. The Galápagos Island of Floreana is home to several bird species, one of which is the Galápagos penguin.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究某个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记： • 加拉帕戈斯企鹅是一种鸟类，可以在加拉帕戈斯群岛的弗洛雷纳岛发现。 • 它的平均体重为2.5千克。 • 灰色莺雀是一种鸟类，可以在加拉帕戈斯群岛的弗洛雷纳岛发现。 • 它的平均体重为9克。 中文解析： 题目要求两个动物的similarity，共同点就是它们的生活地点，于是选择C
exam_name: 2024年12月第7套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • The Mohs scale of mineral hardness is a ten-point scale that orders minerals by hardness based on their ability to scratch other minerals. • Minerals with larger numbers are harder than minerals with smaller numbers and can leave visible scratches on them. • Minerals with smaller numbers are softer than minerals with larger numbers and cannot leave visible scratches on them. • The mineral fluorite has a Mohs scale number of 4. • The mineral orthoclase has a Mohs scale number of 6. • The mineral corundum has a Mohs scale number of 9.

The student wants to emphasize orthoclase’s Mohs scale number. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In the Mohs scale of mineral hardness, corundum (9) is ranked higher than fluorite (4).
B. Orthoclase has a Mohs scale number of 6, which means that it is harder than fluorite (4) but softer than corundum (9).
C. Orthoclase, fluorite, and corundum can be ordered by their ability to leave visible scratches on other minerals.
D. Corundum, which has a Mohs scale number of 9, can scratch both fluorite and orthoclase.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究某个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记： • 摩氏硬度计是一个十级的矿物硬度等级，根据矿物划伤其他矿物的能力对矿物进行排序。 • 数字较大的矿物比数字较小的矿物更硬，并且可以在其上留下可见划痕。 • 数字较小的矿物比数字较大的矿物更软，无法在其上留下可见划痕。 • 矿物萤石的摩氏硬度等级为4。 • 矿物正长石的摩氏硬度等级为6。 • 矿物刚玉的摩氏硬度等级为9。 中文解析： 题目要求emphasize orthoclase’s Mohs scale number，B选项不仅回答了具体的数值6，还能够和另外两种进行比较硬度
exam_name: 2024年12月第7套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • Zora Neale Hurston was an acclaimed writer. • Her first published work of fiction was a short story. • It was called “John Redding Goes to Sea.” • It first appeared in Stylus in 1921.

The student wants to identify the title of Zora Neale Hurston’s first published short story. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Zora Neale Hurston’s first published work of fiction appeared in 1921.
B. Zora Neale Hurston’s first published short story was called “John Redding Goes to Sea.”
C. In 1921, a short story by Zora Neale Hurston appeared in Stylus.
D. Acclaimed writer Zora Neale Hurston’s first published work of fiction was a short story.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究某个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记： • 佐拉·尼尔·赫斯顿（Zora Neale Hurston）是一位备受赞誉的作家。 • 她的第一部发表的小说是一个短篇故事。 • 这个故事的名字叫《约翰·雷丁出海》（“John Redding Goes to Sea”）。 • 它首次发表于1921年的《Stylus》杂志上。 中文解析： 题目要求identify the title，于是B选项具体描述了title name “John Redding Goes to Sea.”
exam_name: 2024年12月第7套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • Body positions are a fundamental aspect of dance. • In Vaganova method ballet, there is a position for the dancer’s arms called first position. • In the position, both arms are rounded to roughly align the fingers with the navel. • In Royal Academy of Dance ballet, there is a position for the dancer’s arms called demi-seconde position. • In this position, both arms are out to the sides but angled downward.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two positions. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. First position in Vaganova method ballet and demi-seconde position in Royal Academy of Dance ballet are both positions for the dancer’s arms.
B. Both first position and demi-seconde position are positions in Royal Academy of Dance ballet.
C. In first position, both arms are rounded to roughly align the fingers with the navel, in contrast to demi-seconde position, where both arms are out to the sides but angled downward.
D. In Vaganova method ballet, there are a number of positions, including first position.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究某个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记： • 身体姿势是舞蹈的基本要素。 • 在瓦甘诺娃（Vaganova）芭蕾舞法中，有一个舞者的手臂位置叫做第一位置（first position）。 • 在这个位置中，两只手臂呈圆形，大致使手指与肚脐对齐。 • 在皇家舞蹈学院（Royal Academy of Dance）芭蕾舞中，有一个舞者的手臂位置叫做半侧位置（demi-seconde position）。 • 在这个位置中，两只手臂伸展到两侧，但向下倾斜。 中文解析： 题目要求两种positions的共同点，于是A表达了都是关于dances’ arms positions，这就是共同点
exam_name: 2024年12月第7套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • Save Me is a 2018 sculpture by American artist Olivia Steele. • It is a pink neon sign that spells out the title phrase. • Nean signs became popular with advertisers in the 1920s and began to decline in popularity in the 1960s. • Neon signs became popular with artists in the 1960s and continue to be popular today. • Writer Sarah Archer says, “[Neon signs] must be made by hand because there’s no cost-effective way to mass-produce them.”

The student wants to connect the sculpture to the history of neon in art. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Neon signs like Save Me are popular with advertisers and artists alike, though they must, as Archer notes, be made by hand, as they cannot be easily mass-produced.
B. With Save Me , Steele joins the decades-long lineage of artists who have helped make neon a popular artistic medium since the 1960s.
C. Continuing from the 1920s to today, neon lighting has been a popular material, both as an advertising tool and an artistic medium.
D. The pink neon sign Save Me nods to the rich history of a material whose artistic popularity has long been in decline.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究某个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记： • 《拯救我》（Save Me）是美国艺术家奥利维亚·斯蒂尔（Olivia Steele）于2018年创作的雕塑。 • 这是一块粉色霓虹灯标志，拼写出标题短语。 • 霓虹灯标志在1920年代开始受到广告商的欢迎，但在1960年代开始逐渐失去人气。 • 霓虹灯标志在1960年代受到艺术家的青睐，并且至今仍然受欢迎。 • 作家莎拉·阿彻（Sarah Archer）说：“[霓虹灯标志]必须手工制作，因为没有经济高效的方法进行大规模生产。” 中文解析： 题目要求sculpture结合neon signs history，于是B选项save me是具体的sculpture，decades-long lineage等描述则是neon sign history
exam_name: 2024年12月第7套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
The following text is from Kenneth Grahame’s 1908 novel The Wind in the Willows. The Mole is returning home after a visit to Mr. Badger’s house. As he hurried along, eagerly anticipating the moment when he would be at home again among the things he knew and liked, the Mole saw clearly that he was an animal of tilled field and hedge-row, linked to the ploughed furrow, the frequented pasture, the lane of evening lingerings, the cultivated garden-plot.

As used in the text, what does the word “anticipating” most nearly mean?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 当他匆匆前行，满怀期待地想着自己即将回到那个熟悉且喜爱的家园时，鼹鼠清楚地意识到，他是一个与耕种的田野和篱笆相连的动物，他与犁过的泥土、常常经过的牧场、傍晚时分常停留的小路以及精心耕耘的花园紧密相连。 中文解析： Anticipating这里表达了Mole期待回家见到熟悉的一切，于是选择looking forward
exam_name: 2024年12月第6套阅读语法（注：第5套均为旧题，不录入第5套）

question:
A microgenre is a specialized genre consisting of a comparatively small number of stylistically similar artists. The microgenre of electronic music known as hyperpop emerged in the 2010s, with American singer Dorian Electra as an early exponent. Their combination of lush synthesizer arrangements and propulsive beats with vocals electronically shifted in pitch below their natural range exemplifies the hyperpop sound. More recently, Japanese-British recording artist Rina Sawayama has contributed to the microgenre by incorporating pop melodies into hyperpop songs.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It anticipates an objection to the text’s endorsement of hyperpop.
B. It notes an exception to the text’s description of hyperpop.
C. It defines a term used in the text’s discussion of hyperpop.
D. It states that the text’s intended audience mainly consists of hyperpop fans.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 微型流派是一种由风格相似的少数艺术家组成的专门流派。电子音乐中的微型流派——超流行（hyperpop）——在2010年代兴起，美国歌手多里安·埃莱克特拉（Dorian Electra）是该流派的早期代表之一。他们将华丽的合成器编曲和富有推动力的节奏与经过电子处理的、人声音高低于自然音域的演唱相结合，展现了超流行的音效。近年来，日英混血的录音艺术家铃木里奈（Rina Sawayama）通过将流行旋律融入超流行歌曲，进一步推动了这一微型流派的发展。 中文解析： 第一句是给microgenre下定义，这一概念随后用来描述hyperpop于是C选项正确
exam_name: 2024年12月第6套阅读语法（注：第5套均为旧题，不录入第5套）

question:
Cuttlefish and toads see in three dimensions (3D) by combining two images in their brains, one from each eye. This produces a sense of depth, helping the animals judge how close or far away an object is. Researchers have investigated 3D vision in praying mantises as well. In one study, Vivek Nityananda and his team fitted mantises’ faces with two different color filters, one covering each eye, much like the filters in 3D glasses once worn at movies. By observing the mantises’ reaction to projected images, the team confirmed that mantises do indeed have 3D vision, but it’s unlike that of other animals.

Which choice best states the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It identifies a potential problem that the researchers faced while studying the praying mantises.
B. It offers a comparison meant to aid understanding of the praying mantis study.
C. It emphasizes a difference between the research on praying mantis vision and research on other animals’ vision.
D. It describes an earlier use of a tool the researchers used in the praying mantis study.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 乌贼和蟾蜍通过将来自每只眼睛的两幅图像在大脑中结合起来，从而实现三维（3D）视觉。这种方式产生了深度感，帮助这些动物判断物体的远近。研究人员也对 praying mantis（螳螂）的三维视觉进行了研究。在一项研究中，Vivek Nityananda 和他的团队为螳螂的面部装上了两种不同颜色的滤光片，每只眼睛覆盖一个滤光片，就像曾在电影院里戴过的 3D 眼镜中的滤光片一样。通过观察螳螂对投影图像的反应，研究团队确认了螳螂确实具有三维视觉，但这种视觉与其他动物的三维视觉不同。 中文解析： 为了帮助读者更好的理解这个实验里的装置filters，用3D glasses来做比喻

question:
Text 1 The island of Grande Terre split from the former supercontinent Gondwana around 80 million years ago, carrying Gondwanan specie s from a variety of clades with it. The island was periodically submerged until 37 million years ago, but some researchers suggest that its current biota includes species from clades predating the split that took refuge on islands near Grande Terre during submergence events and then returned. Text 2 Thomas R. Buckley et al. found that the crown age—the age of the most recent common ancestor of all species in the clade (i.e., the clade’s founder) —of Grande Terre’s clade of stick insects is 41.1 million years, which is among the oldest clade crown ages of species inhabiting the island today. Nearly all of Grande Terre’s living species belong to clades that originated much more recently: for example, the crown age of the island’s clade of Goodeniaceae plants is 2.0 million years.

Based on the texts, the author of Text 2 would most likely agree with which statement about the “Gondwanan species” discussed in Text 1?
selections: A. Most of them began recolonizing Grande Terre from nearby islands around 2.0 million years ago.
B. Clades to which they belong originated no earlier than 41.1 million years ago.
C. Few if any of them were members of a clade that includes species currently inhabiting Grande Terre.
D. Although most of them have living descendants on Grande Terre, the stick insects and Goodeniaceae plants do not.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 文本 1 Grande Terre岛大约在8000万年前从曾经的超级大陆冈瓦纳分裂出来，携带着来自不同谱系的冈瓦纳物种。岛屿曾多次被淹没，直到3700万年前才再次露出水面，但一些研究人员认为，岛屿目前的生物群落包括一些来自分裂前的谱系，这些物种在岛屿被淹没期间曾躲避到靠近Grande Terre的岛屿上，随后再返回。 文本 2 Thomas R. Buckley等人发现，Grande Terre岛上蜡蝉的谱系的“冠年龄”——即该谱系所有物种的最近共同祖先的年龄（也就是该谱系的创始人）——为4110万年，这是岛上现存物种中最古老的谱系之一。Grande Terre岛上几乎所有现存物种都属于最近才起源的谱系，例如，岛上Goodeniaceae植物的谱系冠年龄仅为200万年。 中文解析： 根据text 1第一句的时间表述，The island of Grande Terre split from the former supercontinent Gondwana around 80 million years ago，于是划线部分“Gondwanan species”从continent携带而来的时间需要在80million years ago，那么根据text2中的时间来看，不会有那么古老的生物，那么对应了C选项。
exam_name: 2024年12月第6套阅读语法（注：第5套均为旧题，不录入第5套）

question:
Text 1 According to a study by a conservation group representing 11 tribal nations in the Great Lakes region, the northern wild rice ( manoomin in the Ojibwe language) will have significantly worse outcomes over the next 50 years if temperatures increase as much as some models suggest. By contrast, the white-tailed deer ( waawaashkeshi in Ojibwe) should be able to withstand the highest predicted warming without much harm and so likely won’t require the conservation efforts that the northern wild rice will. Text 2 US government agencies involved in conservation are unfortunately not able to address every possible threat to natural resources. They must use the best information available to decide which species are most threatened and therefore most in need of conservation efforts.

Based on the texts, both authors would most likely agree with which statement?
selections: A. State, federal, and tribal groups involved in natural-resource management in the Great Lakes region should immediately begin conservation programs for both the northern wild rice and white-tailed deer.
B. Agencies involved in natural-resource management in the Great Lakes region should focus their conservation efforts more on the northern wild rice than on the white-tailed deer.
C. A collaborative approach is necessary to keep temperatures in the Great Lakes region from increasing to the highest predicted levels.
D. Conservation efforts focused on the northern wild rice are more likely to be successful if they incorporate state and federal agency resources with the knowledge of tribal groups in those efforts.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 文本 1 根据一个代表五大湖地区11个部落民族的保护组织的研究，如果温度如一些模型预测的那样在未来50年内显著上升，北方野米（Ojibwe语中称为manoomin）的状况将显著恶化。相比之下，白尾鹿（Ojibwe语中称为waawaashkeshi）应该能够承受预测的最高气温升高，几乎不会受到太大影响，因此可能不需要像北方野米那样的保护努力。 文本 2 参与保护工作的美国政府机构不可能应对所有可能威胁自然资源的情况。他们必须利用现有的最佳信息来决定哪些物种受到的威胁最大，因此最需要保护工作。 中文解析： 在这道题目中，文本1提到了保护北部野生稻和白尾鹿的情况，指出北部野生稻可能面临严重问题，而白尾鹿能够承受较高的升温而不受太大影响。文本2则强调了政府机构在保护方面无法处理所有可能的威胁，必须根据最佳信息来决定哪些物种最需要保护。因此要优先保护濒危的northern wild rice.

question:
The following text is from Julia Alvarez’s 2000 novel In the Name of Salomé . Salomé, a poet, is hosting guests in the front parlor of her family home, and Ramona is her sister. A salon is a social gathering for the exploration of intellectual ideas. It was evening when the two men got up to leave. Tia Ana had already come into the room several times to see if these guests had departed yet. The front parlor had always been her special province, as she used it for her little school. Now, every evening, it turned into Salomé’s salon, as Ramona called it, and it was never in order for its transformation back to a classroom the following morning. ©2000 by Julia Alvarez

Based on the text, what most likely motivates Tía Ana’s behavior during Salomé’s salon?
selections: A. She considers the guests to be uninteresting and is trying to convince them to leave.
B. She is impatient to share her plans to start a new school with the guests and hopes they will support her.
C. She is anxious for the gathering to disperse so that she can ready the space for her own needs.
D. She is frustrated because she needs assistance elsewhere in the house, but Salomé is unavailable while entertaining the guests.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 以下文字摘自朱莉娅·阿尔瓦雷斯（Julia Alvarez）2000年的小说《以萨洛梅之名》。萨洛梅是一位诗人，正在家中的前厅接待客人，而拉莫娜是她的妹妹。沙龙是一个用来探索知识思想的社交聚会。 当那两位男士起身准备离开时，已经是晚上了。安娜姨妈已经进来几次，看看这些客人是否已经离开。前厅一直是她的专属领域，因为她在那里开办了自己的小课堂。现在，每个晚上，它都会变成萨洛梅的沙龙，正如拉莫娜所称，而第二天早晨，它又必须迅速恢复成课堂的模样，永远不会有时间整理好。 中文解析： Tia Ana多次进入房间看看客人是否已经离开，说明她急于让聚会散去，以便她可以为自己的需要准备空间。这表明她需要将房间从沙龙状态恢复为教室状态。

question:
Apple’s introduction of the iPhone in 2007 is a quintessential instance of brand extension—the company leveraged its brand recognition as a computer manufacturer to enter a product category where it had not previously competed. An outstanding question is whether perceived category similarity predicts consumers’ likelihood of purchasing brand extensions. To answer this question, Alicia Grasby et al. identified 30 extended-brand pairs (e.g., the same brand of laundry detergent and air freshener) in 52 weeks of purchases by approximately 60,000 households and, for each pair, calculated the change in probability of a brand in one category being purchased if the same brand was purchased in the other category.

Based on the text, which potential study design would be most likely to produce evidence that would enable Grasby et al. to answer their research question?
selections: A. Have a representative sample of the households rate the similarity of the product categories in each extended-brand pair, then determine how, if at all, those ratings correlate with the change in probability that the team calculated for each pair.

B. Have a representative sample of the households rate the similarity of one product in each extended-brand pair to other products in the same category, then determine how, if at all, those ratings correlate with the change in probability that the team calculated for each pair.

C. Poll a representative sample of the households to determine the degree of brand recognition for each brand in the extended brand pairs, then determine how, if at all, the degree of brand recognition correlates with the frequency with which a different group of households purchased at least one product of that brand.

D. Poll a representative sample of the households to determine the degree of brand recognition of each brand in the extended brand pairs, then determine how, if at all, the degree of brand recognition correlates with the average cost of each product in the pairs.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 苹果在2007年推出Iphone是品牌延伸的典型实例——该公司利用其作为互联网搜索提供商的品牌认知度进入了一个之前未曾竞争的产品类别。一个突出的问题是，感知的类别相似性是否能够预测消费者购买品牌延伸的可能性。为了回答这个问题，Alicia Grasby等人识别了30对扩展品牌（例如，同一品牌的洗衣液和空气清洗剂），并在约60,000个家庭的52周购买中计算了每对品牌在一个类别中被购买的概率变化，如果在另一个类别中购买了同一品牌。 中文解析： 依据An outstanding question is whether perceived category similarity predicts consumers’ likelihood of purchasing brand extensions.这个研究针对同一品牌下的不同商品研究，如果想要研究购买同一品牌的另一种商品概率，只需要进行样本研究，去看人们对成对商品的相似性给出评分rating，然后看这个值和购买可能性值之间的关系。

question:
Hypothesizing that lullabies, characterized by their slow tempos, are universally calming to infants, Constance M. Bainbridge and colleagues played a lullaby sung in the Western Nahuatl language and a non-lullaby sung in the Serbian language to a group of infants. The team found that the infants’ heart rates and pupil size both decreased more during the lullaby than during the non-lullaby. Since a decrease in heart rate is associated with relaxation, the team concluded that the lullaby relaxed the infants. However, noting that reduced heart rate can also be associated with increased attention, one critic argues that instead, the lullaby simply attracted the infants’ attention.

Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the critic’s claim?
selections: A. Parents of infants in the study preferred the Western Nahuatl lullaby over the Serbian non-lullaby.
B. Infants in the study had never heard the Western Nahuatl lullaby before.
C. More frequent blinking has also been found to be a reliable indication of attention.
D. Pupil size typically increases when a stimulus captures a person’s attention.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 康斯坦斯·M·贝恩布里奇（Constance M. Bainbridge）及其同事假设，作为特征的摇篮曲，其慢节奏对婴儿具有普遍的安抚作用。于是，他们为一组婴儿播放了一首用西方纳瓦特尔语（Western Nahuatl）演唱的摇篮曲和一首用塞尔维亚语演唱的非摇篮曲。研究小组发现，在摇篮曲播放时，婴儿的心率和瞳孔大小都比播放非摇篮曲时减少得更多。由于心率下降通常与放松有关，因此研究小组得出结论认为，摇篮曲让婴儿放松。然而，有批评者指出，心率下降也可能与注意力集中相关，他们认为摇篮曲只是吸引了婴儿的注意力，而非让其放松。 中文解析： 文本结论是lullaby只是吸引婴儿的注意力，如果要weaken this conclusion，我们可以说关注事物，pupil size increases，但是根据文本their heart rate and pupil size both decrease.

question:
The olona shrub is one of many forest plant species native to Oahu (a Hawaiian island) that are at risk of extinction. The survival of most of these species in the wild largely depends on birds eating their fruits and then dropping the seeds in different locations. Although Oahu’s native fruit-eating birds have all gone extinct, the common waxbill and other fruit-eating bird species have been brought to the island and are now common there. Studies confirm that these non-native birds are spreading plant seeds on Oahu, suggesting that the birds ________

selections: A. are dropping higher numbers of native forest plant seeds around the island than native bird species did in the past.
B. show significantly more interest in eating the fruits of native forest plants than in eating the fruits of non-native ones.
C. may be necessary for the continued survival of vulnerable forest plant species. such as the olona shrub.
D. may also engage in other activities that affect the ability of olona shrubs and other vulnerable forest plants to continue to spread to new areas.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： Olona灌木是夏威夷岛欧胡岛（Oahu）本土众多面临灭绝风险的森林植物物种之一。大多数这些物种在野外的生存主要依赖于鸟类吃掉它们的果实，然后将种子散播到不同的地方。尽管欧胡岛的本土果食鸟类已经全部灭绝，但普通蜡嘴雀及其他果食鸟类已被引入岛屿，并且现在在岛上很常见。研究证实，这些非本地鸟类正在欧胡岛上散播植物种子，这表明这些鸟类________。 中文解析： C选项强调了非本地鸟类在传播濒危植物种子方面的重要性

explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在滑板运动中，900是一个技巧，即滑板者在空中旋转两圈半，这个技巧非常罕见，每次成功完成都是一个历史性的时刻。________ 自从Mitchie Brusco和Tas Pappas分别在2011年和2014年完成了他们的900后，粉丝们便将他们视为这项运动的巨人。 中文解析： 第一句表达换板中的900很难，第二句说粉丝把两位能完成的人看作titans，前后因果关系
exam_name: 2024年12月第6套阅读语法（注：第5套均为旧题，不录入第5套）

question:
Visually distinguishing the common raven ( Corvus corax ) from the Chihuahuan raven ( Corvus cryptoleucus ) can confound even seasoned bird watchers. ________ the two species share similarities that—at times—make the birds appear virtually identical. Size, though, remains a differentiating feature: the common raven tends to be larger.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 区分普通渡鸦（Corvus corax）和奇瓦瓦渡鸦（Corvus cryptoleucus）在外观上甚至让经验丰富的鸟类观察者感到困惑。________ 这两种物种在外形上有许多相似之处——有时甚至让这些鸟看起来几乎完全相同。然而，大小仍然是一个区分的特征：普通渡鸦通常较大。 中文解析： 第一句说confound watchers，第二句说相似度很高identical，前后一致用indeed表示强调。
exam_name: 2024年12月第6套阅读语法（注：第5套均为旧题，不录入第5套）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • Elizabeth Catlett (1915-2012) was a celebrated African American artist. • She is best known for creating sculptures and prints that explore the Black experience. • Mahalia is a 2002 sculpture by Catlett. • Paulina is a 2009 print by Catlett.

The student wants to provide an example of one of Catlett’s sculptures. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The sculpture Mahalia was created by celebrated artist Elizabeth Catlett in 2002.
B. Elizabeth Catlett, a celebrated artist, was born in 1915.
C. The print Paulina was created by celebrated artist Elizabeth Catlett in 2009.
D. Artist Elizabeth Catlett is best known for creating sculptures and prints that explore the Black experience.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个课题时，一名学生做了以下笔记： • 伊丽莎白·卡特（Elizabeth Catlett，1915-2012）是著名的非裔美国艺术家。 • 她以创作探索黑人经验的雕塑和版画而闻名。 • 《马哈丽亚》（Mahalia）是卡特在2002年创作的雕塑。 • 《保琳娜》（Paulina）是卡特在2009年创作的版画。 中文解析： 题目哟球provide an example of sculptures, 根据notes第三条，A选项符合sculpture具体例子
exam_name: 2024年12月第6套阅读语法（注：第5套均为旧题，不录入第5套）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • Lighthouses send out crucial light signals to help ships and other watercraft navigate at night. • Before automation, lighthouses were run by lighthouse keepers. • Kate Walker was the lighthouse keeper at Robbins Reef Light in New York. • She held this position from 1894 to 1919. • Georgiana C. Brumfield was the lighthouse keeper at Turkey Point Light in Maryland. • She held this position from 1895 to 1919.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between Kate Walker and Georgiana C. Brumfield. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Lighthouse keepers during the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries were crucial to ensuring safe navigation for watercraft.
B. From 1894 to 1919, the nighttime waters of New York were more navigable thanks to Kate Walker.
C. Kate Walker and Georgiana C. Brumfield were both lighthouse keepers during the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries.
D. Kate Walker and Georgiana C. Brumfield spent their careers as lighthouse keepers in different lighthouses.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个课题时，一名学生做了以下笔记： • 灯塔发送至关重要的光信号，帮助船只和其他水上交通工具在夜间导航。 • 在自动化之前，灯塔由灯塔看守管理。 • 凯特·沃克（Kate Walker）是纽约罗宾斯礁灯塔（Robbins Reef Light）的灯塔看守。 • 她在1894年至1919年间担任这一职务。 • 乔治安娜·C·布鲁姆菲尔德（Georgiana C. Brumfield）是马里兰州土耳其角灯塔（Turkey Point Light）的灯塔看守。 • 她在1895年至1919年间担任这一职务。 中文解析： 题目要求两个人的共同点，他们都是lighthouse keepers，且时间相近，于是C选项满足
exam_name: 2024年12月第6套阅读语法（注：第5套均为旧题，不录入第5套）

question:
• The University of Oslo in Oslo, Norway, is home to a Foucault pendulum. • The pendulum consists of a weighted ball that swings at the end of a roughly 14-meter-long cable. • Like all Foucault pendulums, it dangles from a fixed point that ensures the swing path of the pendulum doesn’t change. • To an observer, the swing path of a Foucault pendulum appears to change over time because Earth rotates beneath it. • Foucault pendulums are used as a simple way to provide evidence of Earth’s rotation.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to specify the length of the Foucault pendulum’s cable?
selections: A. With a swing path that appears to change over time, a Foucault pendulum provides evidence of Earth’s rotation.
B. The Foucault pendulum at the University of Oslo consists of a weighted ball and a cable.
C. Although the swing path of a Foucault pendulum doesn’t actually change, it appears to change due to Earth rotating beneath the pendulum.
D. The Foucault pendulum at the University of Oslo in Oslo, Norway, includes a cable that is roughly 14 meters long.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： • 挪威奥斯陆的奥斯陆大学拥有一座傅科摆。 • 这个摆由一个加重的球组成，悬挂在一条大约14米长的绳索末端。 • 和所有傅科摆一样，它从一个固定点悬挂，确保摆动路径不发生变化。 • 对于观察者来说，傅科摆的摆动路径随着时间的推移似乎发生了变化，因为地球在它下面旋转。 • 傅科摆作为一种简单的方式，用来提供地球自转的证据。 中文解析： 题目要求specify the length,于是只有D选项的meters long满足
exam_name: 2024年12月第6套阅读语法（注：第5套均为旧题，不录入第5套）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • Mauritania is a country in North Africa. • A high percentage of Mauritania’s population (39.9 percent) is under fifteen years old. • It has the thirty-fourth-largest under-fifteen population in the world. • Roughly 40 percent of Africa’s population is under fifteen years old—the highest of any continent. • According to the United Nations (UN), Africa’s “ high number of young people is an opportunity for the continent’s growth—but only if these new generations are fully empowered to realise their best potential.”

The student wants to emphasize the global rank of Mauritania’s youth population. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. With 39.9 percent of its population under fifteen years of age, Mauritania has the thirty-fourth-largest population for that age range in the world.
B. Africa’s high population of young people is due in part to the high percentage of young people in Mauritania.
C. Making up roughly 40 percent of the continent’s total population, Africa’s under-fifteen population offers “an opportunity for the continent’s growth,” according to the UN.
D. “Only if these new generations are fully empowered to realise their best potential,” says the UN, will Africa’s high percentage of young people lead to the continent’s growth.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个课题时，一名学生做了以下笔记： • 毛里塔尼亚是位于北非的一个国家。 • 毛里塔尼亚有很高比例的年轻人口（39.9%）年龄在十五岁以下。 • 它拥有世界上排名第34的十五岁以下人口。 • 大约40%的非洲人口年龄在十五岁以下——这是所有大洲中最高的比例。 • 根据联合国（UN）的说法，非洲“年轻人数量众多是该大洲发展的机遇——但前提是这些新一代人能够充分发挥他们的最大潜力。” 中文解析： 题目需要强调global rank of Mauritania’s youth population，A选型的39.9 percent 是youth population，thirty-fourth-largest说明了全球的排名
exam_name: 2024年12月第6套阅读语法（注：第5套均为旧题，不录入第5套）

question:
Jessica Watson, who was the youngest person to sail nonstop and unassisted around the world, undoubtedly accomplished much, but to gain a lasting place in our historical memory, there is little that can ________ being the first to do something. For example, people will always remember that Jeanne Baré was the first woman to circumnavigate the world.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 杰西卡·沃森是最年轻的无停靠、无人协助环绕地球航行者，她无疑取得了巨大的成就，但要在我们的历史记忆中留下持久的位置，几乎没有什么能够______成为第一个做某事。例如，人们将永远记得让娜·巴雷（Jeanne Baré）是第一个环绕地球航行的女性。 中文解析： 这个文本在SAT中多次变体出现，大意是虽然Louise很有成就，但是想在历史上拥有地位，什么都比不过“the first to do something”,于是选择prevail over表示战胜，超过。
exam_name: 2024年12月第6套阅读语法（注：第5套均为旧题，不录入第5套）

question:
Despite stated claims of global relevance, much major research on income inequality performed in the 2010s suffered from a myopic focus on a few countries in North America and Western Europe, partly due to limited data availability. Researchers would later ______ this shortcoming after gaining new access to administrative records located in nations in Africa, such as Ivory Coast, and Eastern Europe, such as Poland.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 尽管有全球相关性的声明，但2010年代关于收入不平等的许多重要研究仍然存在狭隘的视野，主要集中在北美和西欧的少数几个国家，这在一定程度上是由于数据的限制。研究人员后来会______这一不足，因为他们获得了来自非洲国家（如科特迪瓦）和东欧国家（如波兰）行政记录的新数据。 中文解析： 在这个句子中，ameliorate（改善、改进）是最合适的词，因为它指的是在获得新的数据后，研究人员会改进或解决之前由于数据有限而产生的问题。 其他选项：postulate指的是提出假设；santion，批准、制裁；rationalize，合理化。
exam_name: 2024年12月第6套阅读语法（注：第5套均为旧题，不录入第5套）

question:
In the mid-1980s, the price of vintage and even new baseball cards rose dramatically, which had the counterintuitive effect of ________ demand: buyers who hadn’t previously wanted to purchase baseball cards thronged the market, believing prices would continue to rise and the cards could be resold later at a profit.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在1980年代中期，复古和甚至新的棒球卡价格剧烈上涨，这产生了一个反直觉的效果______了需求：那些以前不打算购买棒球卡的买家涌入市场，认为价格将继续上涨，并且这些卡片可以在以后转售获利。 中文解析： 从冒号后的解释可以看到buyers suddenly thronged the market,于是前面应该需求激增，于是选择eliciting，表示加速，刺激消费。
exam_name: 2024年12月第6套阅读语法（注：第5套均为旧题，不录入第5套）

question:
The fact that publications by University of California-Berkeley economist Bronwyn Hughes Hall, who studies innovation and economics, are so frequently cited in other scholars’ work ________ the usefulness of her research for her peers—other economists clearly find her studies valuable for their own scholarship.

explanations: 题目文本翻译： 加利福尼亚大学伯克利分校经济学家布朗温·休斯·霍尔（Bronwyn Hughes Hall）的研究成果频繁出现在其他学者的著作中，这一事实______她的研究对同行的有用性——其他经济学家显然认为她的研究对他们自己的学术工作具有价值。 中文解析： 破折号后面解释说明，其他经济学家认为她的研究valuable，所以前面表达useful的意思，underscore表示强调，突出

question:
Shedding light on the thermal biology of fungi, research by Radamés Cordero et al. indicates that certain mushrooms (including Boletus separans and species from the genus Thelephora ) can achieve a hypothermic state through evaporative cooling. Effects of this thermoregulation were not limited to the fungi’s fruiting bodies and root-like hyphae: temperature reductions were observed in the air immediately surrounding the mushrooms. Though slight, the reductions inspired an air-cooling device; using approximately 400 grams of mushrooms, the team’s prototype lowered the air temperature in a controlled environment by 10℃in forty minutes.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It identifies an unexpected observation that motivated the study of evaporative cooling in fungi that is discussed earlier in the text.
B. It provides empirical evidence to bolster the claim made earlier in the text that certain fungal species maintain a hypothermic state.
C. It establishes a finding central to the text’s discussion of a practical application resulting from the team’s study of fungal thermal biology.
D. It presents a tangential finding about thermoregulation in certain fungal species that the experiment described later in the text was designed to explain.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 关于真菌热生物学的研究，Radamés Cordero等人的研究表明，某些蘑菇（包括分离牛肝菌（Boletus separans）和属于须状真菌属（Thelephora）的物种）能够通过蒸发冷却达到低温状态。这种温控效应不仅限于真菌的子实体和类根的菌丝体：在蘑菇周围的空气中也观察到了温度的降低。尽管温度变化较小，但这一现象启发了一种空气冷却装置；使用大约400克蘑菇，团队的原型装置在40分钟内将控制环境中的空气温度降低了10℃。 中文解析： Temperature reduction surrounding the mushrooms 是一项发现，随后的air-cooling device是来自团队的实际应用，注意划线句的前面是were not limited to their bodies,于是A选项的描述不准确
exam_name: 2024年12月第6套阅读语法（注：第5套均为旧题，不录入第5套）

question:
In Grenada, use of solid fuel (e.g., coal, wood) as a share of total household fuel use fell by more than a third between 2000 and 2019; such shifts are often explained by appeal to the energy ladder, a model holding that fuel choice is mediated mainly by household income (specifically, high-technology fuels displace solid fuels as incomes rise). Moses Pundo and Gavin Fraser’s study of fuel use in Kenya shows this model to be reductive, however: household fuel use was heterogeneous, flexible, and influenced by several factors. including the age of the household head.

Which choice best describes the function of the information about Grenada in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It provides an example of a type of change that the text goes on to suggest is poorly suited for evaluating whether the energy ladder is a viable model.
B. It introduces a finding that the text goes on to suggest can be explained in two different ways that are equally compelling.
C. It illustrates the kind of phenomenon that the text goes on to suggest is frequently but inadequately accounted for by the energy ladder.
D. It describes a trend that the text goes on to suggest has a similar cause as a seemingly unrelated trend observed in Kenya.
explanations: 题目文本解析： 在格林纳达，2000年至2019年间，固体燃料（例如煤、木材）在家庭总燃料使用中的比例减少了三分之一以上；这种变化通常通过“能源阶梯”模型来解释，该模型认为燃料选择主要受到家庭收入的影响（具体来说，随着收入的增加，高科技燃料取代固体燃料）。然而，Moses Pundo和Gavin Fraser对肯尼亚燃料使用的研究表明，这一模型过于简化：家庭燃料使用是多样化的、灵活的，并且受到多个因素的影响，包括家庭主人的年龄。 中文解析： 因为它强调了Grenada燃料使用变化是一个现象，而这种现象常常被能量阶梯energy ladder模型所忽略或不足以解释，因为还有别的很多原因。
exam_name: 2024年12月第6套阅读语法（注：第5套均为旧题，不录入第5套）

question:
In a study by Mika R. Moran, Daniel A. Rodriguez, and colleagues, residents of Quito, Ecuador; and Lima, Peru, were surveyed about parks in their cities. Of the 618 respondents from Quito, 82.9% indicated that they use the city’s parks, and of the 663 respondents from Lima,72.7% indicated using city parks. Given that the percentage of Quito respondents who reported living within a 10-minute walk of a park was much lower than that reported by Lima respondents, greater proximity alone can’t explain the difference in park use.

The text makes which point about the difference between the proportions of Quito residents and Lima residents using parks?
selections: A. It was much larger than the researchers conducting the study expected.
B. It could be due to inaccuracies in the survey results.
C. It was calculated using sources that predate the survey.
D. It is caused by something other than the parks’ proximity to city residents.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在Mika R. Moran、Daniel A. Rodriguez及其同事的一项研究中，调查了厄瓜多尔基多和秘鲁利马的居民对本市公园的看法。在基多的618名受访者中，82.9%表示他们使用城市公园；在利马的663名受访者中，72.7%表示使用城市公园。考虑到基多受访者报告称居住在距公园10分钟步行距离内的比例远低于利马受访者，单纯的接近度无法解释公园使用差异。 中文解析： 根据文本数据距离公园距离近比例低的却去公园的比例高，这表明，公园距离居民的远近并不是导致两个城市居民使用公园比例差异的唯一原因。
exam_name: 2024年12月第6套阅读语法（注：第5套均为旧题，不录入第5套）

question:
The bird species Schistocichla leucostigma (the spot-winged antbird) shares some territory in French Guiana with Thamnomanes caesius (the cinereous antshrike), which emits a loud alarm call when it detects predators. Biologist Ari Martinez and colleagues recorded T. caesius alarm calls and played them in the vicinity of wild S. leucostigna . Finding that the birds often froze in place or scattered into vegetation upon hearing the calls, they concluded that S. leucostigma associates T. caesit us alarm calls with danger.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support Martinez and colleagues’ conclusion?
selections: A. In some instances, S. leucostigma froze in place or scattered into vegetation when Martinez and colleagues approached but before they began playing sounds.
B. When Martínez and colleagues played control sounds of random noise in the vicinity of S. leucostigma , the birds displayed no reaction.
C. Other bird species than S. leucostigma also showed a tendency to freeze in place or scatter into vegetation when Martinez and colleagues played T. caesius alarm calls.
D. Martínez and colleagues played alarm calls from different T. caesius individuals and observed no significant variation in the responses of S. leucostigma .
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 鸟类物种Schistocichla leucostigma（斑翅蚁雀）与Thamnomanes caesius（灰蚁鹛）在法属圭亚那共享部分栖息地，后者在发现捕食者时会发出响亮的警报叫声。生物学家Ari Martinez及其同事录制了T. caesius的警报叫声，并在野生S. leucostigma附近播放这些叫声。研究发现，当S. leucostigma听到这些叫声时，它们通常会停顿不动或迅速散入植被中，因此他们得出结论，S. leucostigma将T. caesius的警报叫声与危险联系在一起。 中文解析： 文本结论是S小鸟人物T鸟calls是危险，要支持这个结论就需要证明S小鸟如果听到别的叫声是没有反应的，那么B选项符合
exam_name: 2024年12月第6套阅读语法（注：第5套均为旧题，不录入第5套）

question:
The Lego Group’s introduction of the Legoland theme park in 1968 is a quintessential instance of brand extension—the company leveraged its brand recognition as a toy manufacturer to enter a product category where it had not previously competed. An outstanding question is whether perceived category similarity predicts consumers’ likelihood of purchasing brand extensions. To answer this question, Alicia Grasby et al. identified 30 extended-brand pairs (e.g., the same brand of wristwatch and necktie) in 52 weeks of purchases by approximately 60,000 households and, for each pair, calculated the change in probability of a brand in one category being purchased if the same brand was purchased in the other category.

Based on the text, which potential study design would be most likely to produce evidence that would enable Grasby et al. to answer their research question?
selections: A. Have a representative sample of the households rate the similarity of the product categories in each extended-brand pair, then determine how, if at all, those rating correlate with the change in probability that the team calculated for each pair.

B. Poll a representative sample of the households to determine the degree of brand recognition for each brand in the extended-brand pairs, then determine how, if at all, the degree of brand recognition correlates with the frequency with which a different group of households purchased at least one product of that brand.

C. Poll a representative sample of the households to determine the degree of brand recognition of each brand in the extended-brand pairs, then determine how, if at all, the degree of brand recognition correlates with the average cost of each product in the pairs.

D. Have a representative sample of the households rate the similarity of one product in each extended-brand pair to other products in the same category, then determine how, if at all, those ratings correlate with the change in probability that the team calculated for each pair.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 乐高集团于1968年推出乐高乐园主题公园，这被认为是品牌扩展的典型案例——公司利用其作为玩具制造商的品牌知名度，进入了一个此前未曾涉足的产品类别。一个悬而未决的问题是，感知的类别相似性是否能预测消费者购买品牌扩展的可能性。为了回答这个问题，Alicia Grasby等人识别了30对扩展品牌组合（例如，同一品牌的手表和领带），并在52周的购买数据中，针对大约60,000个家庭，对每对组合进行了分析，计算出如果在一个类别中购买了某个品牌，另一个类别中购买该品牌的概率变化。 中文解析： 依据An outstanding question is whether perceived category similarity predicts consumers’ likelihood of purchasing brand extensions.这个研究针对同一品牌下的不同商品研究，如果想要研究购买同一品牌的另一种商品概率，只需要进行样本研究，去看人们对成对商品的相似性给出评分rating，然后看这个值和购买可能性值之间的关系。

question:
Neuroscientist Kiyohito Iigaya and colleagues developed a computational model to predict how much a person will enjoy a particular work of art on a scale from 1 (not at all) to 4 (very much). They then recruited participants to use the same scale to rate several sets of paintings in various styles and calculated the correlation between the ratings predicted by the model and those reported by the participants. Assuming participant P4 gave equal ratings to the abstract and cubist paintings, the data in the graph indicate the model predicted that ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the example?
selections: A. P4’s ratings for abstract and cubist paintings would differ from one another.
B. P4 would derive less aesthetic pleasure from cubist paintings than from abstract paintings.
C. P4 would derive more aesthetic pleasure from cubist paintings than from abstract paintings.
D. P4’s rating for abstract and cubist paintings would equal one another.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 神经科学家Kiyohito Iigaya及其同事开发了一个计算模型，用以预测一个人对特定艺术作品的喜好程度，评分范围从1（一点也不喜欢）到4（非常喜欢）。随后，他们招募参与者使用相同的评分尺度对多组不同风格的画作进行评分，并计算模型预测的评分与参与者报告的评分之间的相关性。假设参与者P4对抽象画和立体主义画作给出了相同的评分，那么图中的数据表明，模型预测________。 中文解析： participant P4给出的值一样，但是表上的correlation柱状图不一样，于是可以看出model预测值不一样

question:
Many studies have found a positive association between levels of dissolved organic carbon and mercury in bodies of fresh water in North America. But Petri Porvari and Matti Verta did not find this correlation in a study conducted in Finland, leading some scientists to hypothesize that the association is particular to North America. However, several other studies conducted outside North America, such as one by Sara M. Ekström and colleagues in Sweden, showed similar results to the North American studies, while few have produced results similar to those of Porvari and Verta’s study, suggesting that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the hypothesis that the positive association is particular to North America is correct.
B. levels of dissolved organic carbon and mercury in bodies of fresh water are both much higher in Finland than elsewhere.
C. there were circumstances unique to Ekström and colleagues’ study that impeded accurate measurements of mercury levels.
D. dissolved organic carbon and mercury levels do typically rise and fall together in fresh water.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 许多研究发现，北美淡水体中溶解有机碳和汞的浓度之间存在正相关关系。然而，Petri Porvari 和 Matti Verta 在芬兰进行的研究中未发现这种相关性，这导致一些科学家假设这种关联仅限于北美。然而，在北美以外进行的几项其他研究，如Sara M. Ekström及其同事在瑞典的研究，显示出与北美研究相似的结果，而很少有研究得出了类似Porvari和Verta研究的结果，这表明________。 中文解析： 在原文中提到了在北美以外的研究中研究结果显示了与北美研究类似的结果，而很少有研究产生了与  Porvari and Verta 和同事的研究类似的结果。这表明北美以外的研究结果更多地支持了溶解有机碳和汞之间存在正相关的假设，也就是typically rise and fall together

question:
Chelsea Wood et al. tracked temperature-driven changes in the abundance of Anisakis sp. (a complex life cycle parasite, or CLP, that requires three host species throughout its life cycle), Gyrodactylus sp. (a directly transmitted parasite, which requires only one host species), and 83 other parasite taxa found on eight fish species. CLPs are transmitted when an infected host is ingested by an individual of another species, typically shielding CLPs from the external environment, whereas directly transmitted parasites are exposed to external conditions during transmission. However, Wood et al. found that three-host CLP abundance decreased as sea temperatures rose, whereas directly transmitted parasite abundance was largely stable, suggesting that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. any advantages that the transmission strategy used by three-host CLPs may have conferred did not completely offset the negative effects of other temperature-driven factors on CLP abundance.
B. CLPs primarily transmitted by ingestion were less dependent on host species adversely affected by warming temperatures than were CLPs that use other transmission strategies.
C. as the number of host species involved in a parasite’s transmission increases, the parasite is better protected against rising temperatures.
D. directly transmitted parasites identified in the study were more likely to use transmission strategies that shield them from warming temperatures than were three-host CLPs.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： Chelsea Wood等人追踪了温度驱动的Anisakis sp.（一种复杂生命周期寄生虫，简称CLP，需要三种宿主物种才能完成其生命周期）、Gyrodactylus sp.（一种直接传播的寄生虫，只需一个宿主物种）以及其他83种寄生虫分类群在八种鱼类中的丰度变化。CLP在其感染的宿主被另一个物种的个体摄入时传播，这通常使得CLP在传播过程中能够避免外部环境的影响，而直接传播的寄生虫在传播过程中则暴露于外部条件。然而，Wood等人发现，随着海洋温度升高，三宿主CLP的丰度下降，而直接传播的寄生虫丰度基本保持稳定，这表明________。 中文解析： 根据文本Opechona sp（CLP）需要依赖三种寄生虫，但是Anthocotyle merlucci只需要依赖一种寄生虫，CLP在寄主感染后会发生转移，能起到保护作用，但是另一种是directly transmitted则是直接暴露在外部环境下，但是结果确实前者易受到温度影响，后者反而保持稳定数量，因此可以得出结论CLPs获得的优势不足以抵消温度对其产生的负面影响。
exam_name: 2024年12月第6套阅读语法（注：第5套均为旧题，不录入第5套）

question:
Prolonged exposure to anthropogenic noise (sounds from human sources like traffic or mining) can affect animals, as Amy Morris-Drake and colleagues found in a 2017 study of dwarf mongooses. Researchers conducted a meta-analysis of studies of how such noise affects animals and found that, for every study, relevant traits or behaviors of the animals were observably different between the exposed group and the otherwise similar but unexposed group. Although, on average, studies of mammals showed larger differences than studies of birds did, for every class of animals examined, there were individual studies showing differences well above the average for mammals. Therefore, the results of the meta-analysis suggest that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the studies in the meta-analysis that examined mammals were more likely than those that examined birds to specify whether the observed effects were detrimental.
B. the differences that studies attribute to exposure to anthropogenic noise are likely to be more pronounced for birds than they are for mammals.
C. the difference found in the study conducted by Amy Morris-Drake and colleagues was likely larger than the average difference for studies of dwarf mongooses included in the meta-analysis.
D. some studies of birds found larger effects of exposure to anthropogenic noise than some studies of mammals did.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 长期暴露于人类活动噪音（如交通或采矿等人类源噪音）会影响动物，正如Amy Morris-Drake及其同事在2017年对侏儒獴的研究中发现的那样。研究人员对噪音如何影响动物的研究进行了元分析，发现每项研究中，暴露组和未暴露组之间，相关的特征或行为都有明显不同。尽管平均而言，哺乳动物的研究显示的差异大于鸟类的研究，但在每个动物类别中，都有个别研究显示的差异远高于哺乳动物的平均水平。因此，元分析的结果表明，________。 中文解析： 最后的结论指出有些个体individuals表现出的差异高于mammals的平均数，那么就说明D正确，也就是birds有些比mammals的个体还要更多的影响。
exam_name: 2024年12月第6套阅读语法（注：第5套均为旧题，不录入第5套）

question:
Long thought to be sessile (immobile), adult Chelonibia testudinaria , barnacles that adhere to sea turtle shells, have been observed to shift slightly in position over time—a phenomenon that has been attributed to the barnacles’ passive displacement by water currents. ________ a research team found that adult C. testudinaria moved toward the heads of their sea turtle hosts and thus against the prevailing water flow, behavior consistent with self-initiated locomotion.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 长期以来，人们认为成年 Chelonibia testudinaria（附着在海龟壳上的藤壶）是定居的（不动的），但近年来观察到它们会随着时间略微改变位置——这一现象被归因于藤壶被水流动带动的被动位移。_______，一项研究团队发现成年 C. testudinaria 会向海龟的头部移动，从而逆着主导水流的方向，这种行为与自发的运动一致。 中文解析： 文章先说这些附着在海龟壳上的螺旋藻（C. testudinaria）被认为是固定不动的，它们的移动被认为是由于水流的被动推动。然而，研究团队发现这些螺旋藻其实是主动向海龟头部移动的，这与之前认为它们是被动移动的解释相矛盾。因此，新的发现削弱了原先的解释，选项B最合适。

question:

The student wants to provide an explanation and example of Kepler’s first law of planetary motion. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Kepler’s first law of planetary motion, which describes the orbits of Jupiter and other planets in the solar system, states that the object being orbited is one of the ellipse’s foci.
B. Jupiter’s moon Europa completes an orbit in 3.55 Earth days on average, a clear example of Kepler’s first law of planetary motion, which describes the elliptical orbit of planets.
C. Kepler’s first law of planetary motion states that the orbit of a planet around the Sun is an ellipse; for example, planetary satellites orbit their planets in an elliptical fashion.
D. Europa’s orbit of Jupiter is elliptical, demonstrating Kepler’s first law of planetary motion, which describes the elliptical orbits of planets but applies to moons as well.
explanations: 题目文本翻译： 在研究一个话题时，一名学生做了以下笔记： • 开普勒的第一定律说行星围绕太阳的轨道是一个椭圆。 • 该定律还指出，在椭圆轨道中，被围绕的天体位于椭圆的一个焦点上。 • 开普勒的行星运动定律同样适用于天然卫星（例如月亮）。 • 欧罗巴是木星的一个卫星，平均每3.55个地球日环绕木星一圈。 • 欧罗巴的轨道是椭圆形的。 中文解析： 选项明确指出 Europa 的轨道是椭圆形的，直接展示了开普勒第一定律的应用。它不仅描述了行星的椭圆轨道，还提到这一定律适用于卫星，完整地使用了笔记中的信息。
